jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LCSW/LMFT/LMHC) 60K-75K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Belgrade, MT

Salary:

60K - 75K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Arizona is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and/or Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $60,000 – $75,000 / year

jobs.title: Education and Outreach Specialist
jobs.excerpt: OverviewLynker Corporation is a leading provider of innovative solutions in ocean science and exploration.
jobs.description:
Overview

Lynker Corporation is a leading provider of innovative solutions in ocean science and exploration. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for innovation, Lynker leverages cutting-edge technologies and scientific expertise to support the creation and delivery of improved operational weather forecasts. As part of our ongoing growth and expansion, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Education and Outreach Specialist to join our growing team.

Responsibilities

Duties will include the following:

Professional Development / Outreach Training You will provide instructional and design leadership to implement a national educator professional development program across online, onsite, and hybrid platforms to enhance ocean literacy and advance agency mission objectives.
  • Program Design and Coordination: Providing the instructional and design leadership for national educator Professional Development (PD) effort (online/onsite/hybrid), including program/presentation design, agendas, content, and videos; designing, coordinating, and delivering national NOAA Ocean Exploration professional learning and professional development opportunities for educators (online, hybrid, and/or onsite) to advance NOAA Ocean Exploration mission objectives and exploration science subject matter. This work includes developing objectives and agendas, developing workshop materials (including design and development of presentations, handouts, supply guides, etc.), curating NOAA Ocean Exploration content (multimedia, expeditions, fact sheets, lessons, etc.), communicating workshop priorities, needs, and expectations with all relevant internal and external partners, and creating informational and promotional materials for educator opportunities; including education content development, product graphic design, and outreach promotion.
  • Network Management: Work with a network of Professional Development Facilitators; maintaining and training a network of internal and external workshop facilitators (5 minimum); work with the Education Team Lead as a TPOC to identify new facilitators (i.e., Host Partner recruitment) and meet workshop implementation needs (planning, logistics, promotion, implementation, and instruction); leading facilitator training and monitoring meetings to ensure consistency of all NOAA Ocean Exploration educator opportunities across the country; and executing the training of Ocean Exploration and Research Facilitators.
  • Partnership and Liaison Coordination: Serving as the Alliance Partner site coordinator liaison (onsite PD/online PD); and coordinating with the Education Team Lead and Outreach and Education Division Chief (TPOCs) to cultivate and establish new Alliance Partnerships with science institutions including, but not limited to, aquaria, museums, universities, and other informal science centers in coordination with the COR and/or applicable TPOC(s) and coordinating, preparing, and executing planned ocean education partner meeting logistics (both onsite and virtual) including agendas and meeting minutes.
  • Execution and Evaluation: Regularly presenting workshops and promoting offerings; overseeing advertising; designing, promoting, and executing ocean exploration topical education webinars/presentations in coordination with the COR and/or applicable TPOC(s); and executing and guiding PD evaluation(s) and summative workshop evaluations.
  • Workshop and Course Management: Managing Professional Development Workshops for educators in the use of Learning Ocean Science through Ocean Exploration curriculum in accordance with Government-approved deadlines; and providing program management for development, design, and execution of online EX teacher professional development courses in cooperation with the College of Exploration.
  • Outreach and Web Services: Coordinating with graphics designers and national partners to develop workshop announcements and post to Ocean Exploration Educator listserv, The BRIDGE, and National Science Teachers Association (NSTA) Building a Presence for Science listservs; and coordinating with the NOAA National Ocean Service Special Projects Team to keep the Professional Development offering and Education Alliance page up to date on the OE website.
  • Project Coordination: Collaborating with the NOAA Office of Ocean Exploration and Research to provide project coordination, program, and technical services for education products and activities that engage educators, students, and the general public, enhancing America’s ocean literacy through the excitement of ocean expeditions, exploration and discovery.

Outreach and Partnerships

You will provide technical and administrative services for the management of existing alliances and the development of new educational partnerships and programs.

  • Alliance Partnership Management: Maintaining the Alliance Partnership by coordinating with the Director of Education of OER (TPOC) to manage, track, and document financial agreements with the National Marine Sanctuary Foundation and establish new alliance partnerships.
  • Education Program Development: Preparing and coordinating with the Director of Education of OER (TPOC) and national partners to develop an education outreach program to advance the NOAA Ship Okeanos Explorer expeditions and telepresence capability and performing expedition education outreach in the community

Education / Outreach Product Development

You will provide technical and administrative services for the creation, management, and refinement of educational materials and digital content.

  • Content Management and Gap Analysis: Establishing, curating, and maintaining a storage management system for all historic and current education content; identifying gaps in current content and priorities for the development of new materials.
  • Education Product Development: Planning, coordinating, and executing the development of education products—including coordinating the technical inputs of external partners—that meet contemporary classroom needs, standards, and instructional methods.
  • Brand Identity and Graphic Design Services: Coordinating the development of a unique brand identity for NOAA Ocean Exploration for education products produced in print and shared online;
  • performing the graphic design of new educational materials and performing technical reviews of the work of external partners.
  • Translation and Evaluation Coordination: Executing education and outreach product translations, including consulting and coordinating with regional language and local dialect experts and performing technical reviews of work completed by external partners; identifying resource evaluation needs and coordinating the workflow of external evaluators in coordination with the COR and/or applicable TPOC(s)

Education / Outreach Strategy and Programmatic Growth

You will provide technical and administrative services for the development, implementation, and expansion of education and outreach strategies.

  • Education Strategy and Implementation: Executing education strategy development and implementation to advance the NOAA Ocean Exploration and NOAA Education Strategic Plans; analyzing the education landscape and educator needs; performing evaluation of current education product development, educator training, and ocean exploration education communication approaches; identifying gaps in current education offerings; and formulating novel promotion and outreach approaches to expand the reach and utility of NOAA Ocean Exploration education offerings.
  • Promotion and Communications Strategy: Coordinating the development and execution of a promotion strategy for sharing NOAA Ocean Exploration expedition updates and discoveries, education products, and educator and student opportunities to a national educator audience (and international where relevant) using communications tools such as, but not limited to email, social media, NOAA Ocean Exploration and Deep Ocean Education Project websites, conference presentations, and educator newsletters; providing prompt updates for the NOAA Ocean Exploration website as education products and educator opportunities arise; strategically growing the ocean education audience.
  • Educational Outreach Material Development: Planning, developing, maintaining, and executing lists of educational outreach materials and needed supplies, and related activities to achieve NOAA Ocean Exploration outreach and engagement priorities; initiating and planning projects, including requirements and resourcing needs documents, that lead to innovative, new approaches to communicating information about ocean exploration to education-specific audiences.
  • Expedition Education Coverage: Executing expedition education coverage through the implementation of modernized web-based approaches and the delivery of technical and administrative services for Ocean Exploration Education outreach events and presentations.

Qualifications

The Ideal candidate will have the following:

Education and Prior Experience:■ Bachelor’s degree in Science Education, Curriculum Development, or a related field; OR a degree inmarine/ocean science-related field with professional experience as an educator, outreach specialist, or program coordinator in a formal or informal education setting.■ Deep understanding of oceanography, marine ecosystems, and current marine technology.■ Demonstrated experience developing age-appropriate educational materials or programming (lessons,readings, videos, etc) that support national formal education standards and instructional strategies (e.g.,NGSS, Ocean Literacy, phenomenon-based learning).

○ Core Competencies:■ Ability to translate complex scientific data, technology, and discoveries into clear, engaging materials fordiverse audiences.■ Ability to manage the full product development lifecycle, work with external contractors, establish projectmilestones, monitor deliverables, and provide timely feedback.■ Ability to lead collaborative education initiatives with interagency partners, cooperative institutes, and ocean education networks.■ Practical understanding of Section 508 compliance standards for digital materials and experience coordinating web-posting workflows for online educational collections.

○ Desirable Soft Skills:■ Strong oral and written communication skills across diverse audiences.■ Excellent interpersonal and collaborative skills with internal and external stakeholders.■ Proven ability to adapt quickly to evolving program requirements and agency priorities.■ Demonstrated critical thinking and proactive problem solving skills.■ Excellent time management and organizational skills.■ Demonstrated initiative and self-direction in managing assigned program areas.■ Strong attention to detail when reviewing drafts, enforcing visual/content consistency, and ensuring compliance with federal standards.■ Ability to work effectively both independently and as a collaborative team member.

○ Travel & Work Conditions:■ This is a 100% remote position (full-time telework). The selectee will perform their duties from an approved alternative worksite anywhere within the United States

■ Occasional travel is required (5+ trips annually). The selected candidate must be willing and able to travel to lead regional and national educator professional development workshops, facilitate classroom testing and product feedback cycles, and present program initiatives at professional educational or scientific conferences.● Due to frequent travel obligations, proximity to a major commercial airport is highly preferred tofacilitate efficient and cost-effective official travel

About Lynker

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities – creatively and effectively.

Lynker offers a team-oriented work environment, and the opportunity to work in a culture of exceptionally skilled professionals who embrace sound science and creative solutions. Lynker's benefits include the following:

  • Comprehensive healthcare for the employee at no monthly cost
  • Healthcare benefit covers medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision
  • Personal Time Off (PTO) Policy plus paid holidays
  • Highly competitive compensation plan regularly calibrated against industry and location benchmarks
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company-matching
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – we're all company owners!
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Life and accident insurance
  • Tuition assistance/Training/Workforce improvement reimbursement per year
  • Spot bonuses for exceptional performance
  • Annual Employee Recognition Awards with bonuses
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Free centralized, self-directed Learning Management System to learn at your own pace
  • Personalized career growth plans for every employee

Lynker is an E-Verify employer.

Lynker is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local laws.

Pick your own schedule!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

jobs.description:
About CarbonCure Technologies

CarbonCure Technologies
is a fast-growing carbon utilization technology company on a mission to reduce embodied carbon in new concrete construction. With hundreds of carbon mineralization systems operating worldwide, CarbonCure’s technologies inject and permanently embed captured CO₂ in concrete while also enabling reductions of carbon-intensive cement from each truckload of concrete. This innovative solution has saved hundreds of thousands of metric tons of CO₂ to date, and that impact grows with every truckload of concrete our producer partners supply in their markets. CarbonCure’s cutting-edge research and innovation have also garnered global recognition and prestigious awards, most notably the Carbon XPRIZE Grand Prize and induction into the Cleantech 100 Hall of Fame. CarbonCure’s investors include Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Blue Earth Capital, BDC, Amazon, Taronga Ventures, 2150, Microsoft, Samsung Ventures, BH3 Growth Equity, Carbon Direct, GreenSoil Investments and Mitsubishi Corporation. Follow CarbonCure on
LinkedIn.

Our Culture

Our team is made up of energetic, entrepreneurial individuals who are passionate about driving meaningful solutions to combat climate change. Besides being dedicated to our mission, we believe in work-life balance and active involvement in our local communities. We value integrity and accountability; and our core values include customer success, earned trust, data-driven decisions, and straight-talk. We don’t take ourselves too seriously, but we are here to change the world.

Purpose Driven Position

Reporting to the VP, APAC & EMEA, the Technical Manager is responsible for leading, developing, and coordinating technical operations across the Asia‑Pacific region to ensure successful installation, service delivery, and long-term customer success for CarbonCure’s solution. This role oversees both internal technical staff and external distributor partners, ensuring operational consistency, high-quality execution, and continuous improvement across all markets in the APAC sales region.

The Technical Manager, APAC, serves as the primary regional contact for technical strategy, installation excellence, equipment reliability, concrete performance, and regulatory enablement, playing a crucial role in CarbonCure’s growth and customer satisfaction throughout the APAC region.

This is a remote position, with preference for candidates located inJapan, South Korea, or Taiwanfor proximity to customer sites.

What you'll be doing

Regional Technical Team Leadership:

  • Lead and manage day-to-day activities of regional technical staff, consultants, and distributor field technicians across Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, and emerging markets.
  • Provide hands-on leadership through coaching, site visits, and performance feedback to ensure consistent quality and adherence to CarbonCure standards.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive technical competency program, including onboarding and training for employees, distributors, and third-party partners.
  • Establish and reinforce best practices for safety, installation, troubleshooting, concrete testing, and customer communication.

Customer Success & Technical Execution:

  • Own and execute on the regional technical strategy in alignment with APAC roadmaps for Japan, Singapore, South Korea, and additional developing markets.
  • Lead technical delivery for stages 2–5 of our Value Stream Map (VSM), including:
    • Pre‑installation planning and scheduling
    • On‑site installations and commissioning
    • Ongoing preventive maintenance
    • Concrete validation testing (both in laboratory and field)
    • Optimization of system performance and carbon credit revenue
  • Manage relationships and workflows with third‑party labs to support testing requirements for cement validation.
  • Oversee limited‑resource service models in smaller markets such as Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, and Hong Kong, ensuring reliable customer support and escalation paths.
  • Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives to elevate service levels, reduce downtime, and standardize processes across the region.

Operational Excellence:

  • Establish and refine regional equipment assembly, refurbishment, and maintenance capabilities to reduce lead times and enhance reliability.
  • Develop and sustain a vetted network of equipment vendors, service providers, and concrete technicians, particularly in high‑priority markets.
  • Oversee technical planning and forecasting, ensuring the region delivers on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to installation output, uptime, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with R&D and Engineering teams to provide field insights that influence product design, quality improvements, and operational improvements.

Regulatory & Market Development:

  • Lead APAC regulatory strategies, including obtaining and maintaining certifications such as JIS (Japan), KS (Korea), and other standards required for new and existing market entry.
  • Support and participate in industry engagement initiatives and customer advocacy groups.
  • In collaboration with the VP, APAC & EMEA, conduct market assessments for expansion opportunities in other regions, outlining technical requirements, risks, and operational needs for successful entry.
  • Represent CarbonCure at technical symposiums, regulatory meetings, and partner discussions as a regional subject-matter expert.

This role will require travel throughout the APAC region, up to 50%.

What you'll need to succeed

  • Strong technical foundation in concrete mix design management. Experience in hardware engineering, industrial equipment, software systems, and field service operations are additional assets.
  • Proven leadership experience managing distributed technical teams across multiple countries and cultures.
  • Prior experience in the concrete, construction, or industrial equipment sector.
  • Familiarity with construction-related regulatory approval processes; experience with JIS, KS, or similar standards is an asset.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to execute operational tasks while contributing to long-term regional growth initiatives.
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to work effectively with sales, technical services, engineering & product development.
  • Bilingual capabilities, must speak Japanese and English; additional APAC languages are an asset (e.g. Korean, Cantonese).
  • Valid passport and willingness to travel up to 50%.

We are changing the world. Join us!

Closing Statement

We would like to thank all applicants for their interest. Please note only those selected for an interview will be contacted. If you feel passionate about this opportunity and believe that you have the skills to excel in this role, apply! Or if this sounds like someone you know, please share this posting.

We want you to know that you can be a great candidate even if you don't fit everything we've described above. You can also have important skills we haven't thought of. If that's you, don't hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself. We are committed to fostering diversity in our organization and building an equitable and inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and experiences. We're taking steps to meet that commitment. We especially encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, people of color, LGBTQ people, veterans, and people with disabilities.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: AI Data Platform Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Experience Required: 6+ years

Job Summary
We are seeking a AI Data Platform Engineer to define and lead the architecture of our enterprise data platform, spanning ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and consumption layers. The role drives the strategic direction of data infrastructure, sets standards for data modeling and lifecycle management, and partners with data engineering, analytics, ML, and business stakeholders to deliver a coherent, scalable data foundation. The ideal candidate combines deep technical mastery of modern data platforms with strong architectural judgment, and has led data-platform programs of meaningful scope and complexity.

  • Establish data contract and data product principles to drive ownership, quality, and decoupling between producers and consumers.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on pipeline and warehouse design proposals across teams.
  • Drive cost optimization and capacity planning across the data platform estate.
  • Design disaster recovery, multi-region, and high-availability strategies for critical data assets.
  • Mentor data engineers and architects on platform standards and emerging best practices.
  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, decision records, and reference patterns.
  • Stay current with data platform research, vendor offerings, and open-source ecosystem developments.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in data engineering, with significant time in architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise across at least two major data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.
  • Strong understanding of lakehouse architectures, modern table formats, and streaming systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Spark, Flink, or Kafka at production scale.
  • Strong data modeling expertise across dimensional, normalized, and data-vault patterns.
  • Experience implementing governance, lineage, and catalog capabilities.
  • Solid grasp of cloud platforms, networking, identity, and cost optimization.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Track record of leading large data platform initiatives across teams.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with data mesh or data product architectures.
  • Familiarity with semantic layers such as dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, or LookML.

Job Description

Position Overview

As a Solutions Engineer II, you are the technical expert prospects trust during the sales conversation. You partner with Account Executives to show prospects exactly how Momentive products solve their problems, delivering in-depth demos and tailoring solutions to each prospect's requirements. You work with more independence than a Solutions Engineer and take on more complex opportunities, helping prospects say yes with confidence.

You will support a full pipeline of active sales opportunities, each typically moving through a 90-day (or shorter) sales cycle. You will deliver in-depth product demonstrations and presentations, design customized solutions based on customer requirements, act as the technical resource for Account Executives throughout the deal, and keep our demo environments and knowledge resources current and ready to go. You report to the Manager/Director, Solutions Engineering and work closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to bring the right technical story to every opportunity.

A Day in the Life

  • Deliver in-depth product demonstrations and presentations that show the value and capabilities of our products, often across multiple opportunities in the same week.

Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

About Rouge Care

Rouge Care is a premium red light therapy company building the future of health technology through clinically inspired wellness devices, software, and design. We're looking for a Head of Marketing to own the brand, the demand engine, and the one number that decides whether we grow profitably.

Role Overview

The Head of Marketing owns marketing at Rouge Care end to end — brand, creative, paid acquisition, lifecycle, content and earned media, and the measurement behind all of it. You lead a small in-house team plus a freelance creative layer, you own the budget, and you sit on the leadership team. This is a head-of-department seat, not a channel specialist role: you set the plan, you make the calls, and you are accountable for the outcome.

A few things make this different from a standard DTC marketing seat. Rouge Care is a modern wellness brand, not a device company — spec-sheet marketing is off-brand, and the work is helping people feel, perform, recover, and age better. Our economics are acquisition-led: most customers buy once, come back for accessories, and upgrade when a new hardware generation earns it. That means CAC has to pay back on the first order, and the real levers are AOV, referral, owned content, and long-cycle nurture — not a 90-day repeat rate. And we sell in six markets, with the US as the largest.

You'll be measured on one number: blended MER, anchored to contribution margin, with new-customer CAC and payback as the leading indicators. We run on EOS — weekly Level 10, quarterly Rocks, a scorecard — and you'll bring that discipline into the marketing team.

Reports directly to the COO.

What You'll Own

Brand & Creative

  • Own the positioning and the message: what Rouge Care stands for, in the words customers actually use, consistently across every market and channel.
  • Direct the creative engine — creative strategy, in-house and freelance creative talent, and a testing pipeline that produces enough volume to learn fast without diluting the brand.
  • Hold the premium bar. Every ad, email, and page should look and sound like a wellness brand people trust, not a hardware spec sheet.

Paid Acquisition & Performance

  • Own the paid media plan and budget across Meta, Google, TikTok, and marketplace advertising, and the split between awareness and conversion spend.
  • Lead the media buying team to scale new-customer acquisition profitably, judged on true MER and payback — not platform-reported ROAS.
  • Open and scale new markets with a repeatable playbook: localization, offers, creative, and channel mix that transfer cleanly from one country to the next.

Lifecycle & Owned Channels

  • Own email and SMS (Klaviyo) as a revenue channel: flows, campaigns, segmentation, and the long-cycle nurture that keeps customers engaged between hardware generations.
  • Grow revenue per customer — bundles, accessories and stands, upgrade campaigns at each new launch, referral, and reviews.
  • Build the launch playbook with Product so every new generation, accessory, and software feature lands with a full go-to-market plan.

Content, Community & Earned Media

  • Lead PR, organic social, creator and influencer programs, community, and SEO/AEO as a coherent visibility engine, not a set of side projects.
  • Make our science and our customers' results the story: education-led content that earns trust before the first click.
  • Partner with Sales and Strategic Partnerships on B2B, practitioner, and corporate wellness marketing so the brand shows up consistently everywhere it sells.

Web, CRO & Measurement

  • Own the Shopify storefront and PDPs as conversion assets, with a standing CRO cadence and a clear view of what the top competitors are doing better.
  • Own the marketing dashboard and attribution stack (Triple Whale and first-party data): MER, CAC, contribution by channel and by cohort, reported weekly and trusted by the leadership team.
  • Run the marketing operating rhythm — annual calendar, quarterly plan, weekly scorecard, budget and forecast — so the department runs on a system rather than on you.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in DTC or e-commerce marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team and owning a P&L-level number (MER, CAC, or contribution margin).
  • Proven track record scaling paid social and search profitably on seven-figure annual budgets, with a clear-eyed view of incrementality and attribution.
  • Experience with premium, considered-purchase products — high AOV, long consideration cycles. Wellness, health-tech, or consumer hardware is a strong plus.
  • Brand instinct and performance discipline in the same person: you can direct a creative and read a cohort analysis in the same afternoon.
  • A builder of teams and systems — hiring, briefing, managing freelancers, and running a weekly cadence that makes the team better without you in every room.
  • AI-native marketer who uses AI tooling instinctively for creative volume, research, analysis, and speed.
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a remote environment, taking ownership, and moving fast.
  • Bonus: Klaviyo, Shopify, and Triple Whale; Amazon marketing; multi-country expansion; experience operating inside EOS.
  • Bonus: bilingual French/English (Montreal headquarters).

Benefits

  • Remote-first work environment
  • 4 weeks vacation
  • 5 personal/sick days
  • Group insurance
  • RRSP matching up to $5,000
  • $500 annual health & wellness flex allowance
  • Legendary Christmas party

jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

jobs.excerpt: Company DescriptionZayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Program Manager, Long Haul OSP Deployment

The Program Manager, Long Haul OSP Deployment is responsible for the successful delivery of long haul fiber deployment programs through direct management of turnkey engineering and construction contractors and oversight of multiple concurrent projects.


This role combines strategic program leadership with hands-on project execution responsibilities, ensuring projects ($100mm+) are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with Zayo quality standards.


The Program Manager serves as the primary operational and contractual interface between Zayo, turnkey vendors, and customers. This position is accountable for contract administration, project controls, budget management, regulatory compliance, contractor performance, risk mitigation, and project closeout activities across a portfolio of long haul network expansion projects.


The Program Manager reports to the Director, Long Haul OSP Deployment.


Key Responsibilities

Program & Project Leadership

  • Lead the delivery of multiple long haul OSP deployment projects simultaneously, including greenfield, overpull, and network expansion initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource forecasts.
  • Drive project execution from initial planning through engineering, permitting, construction, testing, acceptance, and closeout.
  • Monitor project performance against scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
  • Identify project risks and implement mitigation and recovery plans to maintain delivery commitments.

Contractor & Vendor Management

  • Serve as the primary contractual and operational interface with turnkey engineering and construction partners.
  • Draft, review, negotiate, and administer engineering and construction contracts.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with contractual requirements, milestone commitments, production targets, safety standards, and quality expectations.
  • Conduct contractor performance reviews and drive accountability through structured reporting, corrective action plans, and executive escalations when required.
  • Review and approve contractor invoices, production reports, schedules, and change orders.

Contract Administration & Financial Management

  • Manage project budgets, capital expenditures, forecasts, and financial reporting.
  • Evaluate and process change orders, assessing impacts to project scope, cost, and schedule.
  • Validate quantities, unit pricing, schedule-of-values reporting, and contractor invoicing.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, contract records, correspondence, and audit-ready project files.
  • Provide regular financial and operational updates to leadership and key stakeholders.

Engineering, Permitting & Regulatory Oversight

  • Collaborate with Fiber Engineering to validate route design, constructability, fiber assignments, and project requirements.
  • Oversee engineering package development, permitting strategies, and regulatory compliance activities.
  • Manage complex permitting and environmental requirements, including NEPA, Section 106, Tribal engagement, right-of-way negotiations, state utility commissions, and federal funding requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with NTIA and other government-funded program requirements, including Davis-Bacon, BABA, and environmental assessment obligations.

Construction & Material Management

  • Oversee contractor material forecasting, procurement coordination, receiving, inventory tracking, and field deployment activities.
  • Monitor field production rates and construction progress against established schedules.
  • Support resolution of field issues impacting schedule, cost, quality, or customer commitments.
  • Ensure adherence to OSP construction standards, fiber specifications, testing requirements, and safety practices.

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

  • Deliver project-level, program-level, and executive-level reporting, including progress updates, financial summaries, risk assessments, and recovery plans.
  • Maintain proactive communication with customers, internal stakeholders, contractors, and leadership teams.
  • Facilitate issue resolution across cross-functional teams to minimize project impacts.
  • Present project status and recommendations to Program leadership and customer stakeholders.

Testing, Acceptance & Closeout

  • Oversee fiber testing, acceptance, and closeout processes to ensure compliance with Zayo standards.
  • Review and validate project deliverables, as-built documentation, redlined network diagrams, and inventory updates.
  • Ensure timely delivery of complete project closeout packages to GIS, Operations, Network Engineering, and Inventory teams.
  • Verify that all project documentation, testing records, permits, and customer deliverables are complete and accurately archived.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead, mentor, and develop project managers and deployment personnel as assigned.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and implement best practices for contractor management, project controls, reporting, and long haul deployment execution.
  • Partner with regional and functional teams to align deployment strategies with broader network objectives.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Telecommunications, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Equivalent industry experience may be substituted for formal education.

Experience

  • Minimum of eight (8) years of telecommunications, fiber deployment, or OSP project management experience.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years managing complex outside plant construction projects and contractor relationships.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering multimillion-dollar fiber deployment projects on schedule and within budget.
  • Experience administering engineering, construction, and turnkey (EPC) contracts.
  • Experience managing federal and state regulatory requirements, permitting, and environmental compliance.
  • Prior leadership experience managing project teams or cross-functional deployment organizations preferred.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong knowledge of OSP construction methods, fiber optic infrastructure, and long haul network architecture.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modeling, budget forecasting, data analysis, reporting, pivot tables, lookups, and project performance tracking.
  • Understanding of fiber testing standards, acceptance requirements, and closeout procedures.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, route maps, construction packages, and testing documentation.
  • Familiarity with GIS platforms, Google Earth, and network inventory systems.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce, Sitetracker, and project management systems preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong contract negotiation and administration skills.
  • Excellent financial management, forecasting, and budgeting capabilities.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to travel as required to support project execution, contractor oversight, and customer engagements.

Estimated base salary range: $77,100 - $118,600 USD/annually


The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.


Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.


The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.


Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

  • Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan
  • Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave

jobs.title: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) - Plymouth, MA
jobs.excerpt: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

jobs.description:
Are you ready to link your passion with a purpose? At NantIQ, we bring together healthcare technology solutions with complementary capabilities and provide the strategy, investment, and connections that help each one thrive. NaviNet® and NaviNet AllPayer®, our payer-provider collaboration solutions, increase operational efficiency, unlock savings, and enhance communications. Eviti®, our evidence-based oncology utilization management solution, helps payers manage costs while ensuring patients receive appropriate, guideline-aligned care. We're seeking innovative thinkers who love doing meaningful work. If you're looking to bring your skills and expertise to a connected network of growing technology companies, it's time for you to join us! To ensure we can provide the best in healthcare tech, we focus on building the best team. Through holding true to our core values — clarity, empathy, collaboration, integrity, a sense of community, and a pioneering approach — we are creating a vibrant culture where ideas can blossom, people can thrive, and success can flourish.

NantIQ is adding a Senior Customer Support Analyst (Sr. CSA) to our Customer Support team. In this role, you'll serve as the primary point of contact for our health plan trading partners, providing timely, high-quality customer and technical support. A successful team member in this role troubleshoots complex problems, and communicates clear solutions and status updates to all internal and external stakeholders. You have strong attention to detail and ensure thorough case documentation and escalation follow-through while creating knowledge base content and collaborating with your colleagues to improve support processes. This is a remote position, offering the opportunity to work remotely within the United States.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Serve as a Client Support Liaison for health plan trading partners. In this capacity, the senior client support analyst is responsible for tracking plan-specific metrics, trending issues, and for escalating and following up on specific case issues
  • Provide timely responses and status updates for all customer support and technical support requests from users and plans
  • Clearly articulate solutions to problems verbally and in writing
  • Monitor multiple tools concurrently to troubleshoot issues and find solutions
  • Work effectively with others to brainstorm solutions to complex problems.
  • Analyze data, look for trends, and report on them as necessary.
  • Ensure all support requests, follow-up and resolution notes are appropriately documented, particularly when escalation is required.
  • Provide proactive and constructive feedback to peers and counterparts when appropriate
  • Create and edit articles in Knowledgebase pertaining to technical support, common issues, troubleshooting steps and associated operational support processes.

Education & Experience Requirements:

  • 5 years’ of related experience required with a Bachelor’s degree (equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of degree)
  • Advanced knowledge of job area
  • Proficiency working with Microsoft Office applications (such as Word and Excel)
  • Familiarity working with CRM systems and Salesforce.com strongly preferred.
  • Passionate about providing exceptional customer service and producing high-quality work.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to effectively problem solve, including difficult problems
  • Recommend process improvements as identified
  • Ability to work independently under limited supervision
  • Ability to effectively and professionally communicate with internal partners, external customers, vendors, etc.

This is an hourly, non-exempt position. The hourly range for applicable US-based applicants to this position is below. The specific rate will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications, prior experience as well as geographic location.

  • $28.00 - $37.50 per hour, plus bonus potential

We value each of our employee’s total wellness. From robust medical, dental, and vision insurance, to financial planning assistance, to physical and mental wellness discounts, including an optional annual subscription to the Headspace app and unlimited access to our online learning platform, we understand that our company succeeds when our employees succeed as individuals.

Additional notable benefits include:

  • Paid Time Off (hourly) / Flex Time Off (salaried) programs for Full Time employees
  • Growth and Development opportunities
  • 401(k), including a 3% company match
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave, including a flexible return-to-work program
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Discounts on popular cell phone plan providers
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Travel Assistance
  • Education Assistance Program
  • And much more!
