Join our team at NCD, a top-tier insurance provider, consisting of a unique and eclectic group of winners, nerds, and gamers who balance a fun, kind, and thoughtful approach to life with an unwavering commitment to unparalleled member satisfaction.
jobs.description:
Life is too short to work with jerks.

Join our team at NCD, a top-tier insurance provider, consisting of a unique and eclectic group of winners, nerds, and gamers who balance a fun, kind, and thoughtful approach to life with an unwavering commitment to unparalleled member satisfaction. Our ecosystem is rooted in our five core values: Relentless Positivity, Growth Obsessed, Get it Done, Helpful Spirit, and Solution Driven.

We are not just coworkers, but a community, working tirelessly towards 'Spreading the Smile' to our members, agents, and each other. NCD is at the forefront of dental and vision insurance, in partnership with our carrier partners MetLife, VSP, and Zurich. Our continuous growth is a testament to our commitment to delivering outstanding agent and customer satisfaction.

If you are ready to win each day, are eager to grow, and aspire to contribute to an organization that is setting the pace in the industry, then we are looking for you. Together, let’s drive change and take NCD to new heights. Join us and become a vital part of our success story as we continue to transform lives and 'Spread the Smile.

Summary:

Do you enjoy connecting with people and consider yourself a great listener? If so, then NCD has a perfect role for you. NCD Dental & Vision has an opportunity for a remote Customer Service Advisor to join our team. Your role is simple: provide the highest level of phone service and support to our customers in a timely manner.

This position is 100% work from home.  All remote employees must maintain a workspace that allows professional conversations free from distractions and/or background noise. This position requires 2-4 weeks of paid remote training. Equipment will be provided.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Handles both inbound and outbound communication with members and/or providers.
  • Communicates with clients across multiple channels, including phone, email, and chat.
  • Reviews member products and answers questions regarding products, current policies, adds/changes, resolving disputes, and processing transactions.
  • Refers new product enrollment or changes to existing enrollment to a licensed agent.
  • Addresses billing or service complaints and inquiries; forwards escalated issues to correct department for investigation.
  • Documents all member interactions and comments in CRM software; maintains accurate notes describing every client contact.
  • Continually maintains working knowledge of all company products and services.
  • Educates members about managing their health and well-being so they can select the best benefit plan options and maximize the value of their health plan benefits.
  • Builds trust with members across the healthcare life cycle and improves member retention.
  • Meets performance goals and established KPIs in the areas of call quality, conversation effectiveness, member satisfaction, call volume and average handle times, attendance and schedule adherence.
  • Attends and participates in team meetings, skill builders, training exercises.

 Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of customer service or call center experience
  • College degree preferred, but not required
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proficient computer skills including MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams
  • Ability to multitask by listening, typing, speaking, and navigating multiple interfaces simultaneously
  • Bilingual is a plus (Spanish bilingual employees receive an additional pay differential)

 NCD Benefits:

  • Company-paid health, dental, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Opportunity for professional development
  • Work from home allowance and support
  • Positive work environment

 Equal Opportunity

NCD is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe our differences make us stronger and help us better serve our members, agents, partners, and each other.

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera Solutions Engineers are the technical leaders in the sales account team. We’re a close-knit community and truly enthusiastic about our work, which gives us the opportunity to grow our personal reputation both internally and externally in the data community. We are responsible for securing the technical win in each sales opportunity and for building an ongoing relationship with our customers to ensure their business success with Cloudera technologies

.

As a Solutions Engineer you will:

  • Own the technical sales process from introductory meetings (net new sales) through post-sales (customer satisfaction, upselling, and subscription renewals)
  • Supporting the technical needs of customers including discovering new use cases for Cloudera’s technology
  • Designing solutions for your customers’ needs using Cloudera technologies, based on reference architectures and common patterns
  • Demonstrating Cloudera products in a way that inspires your customers to say “yes” to Cloudera
  • Partnering with your Account Managers to show your customers the true value of a Cloudera solution and drive successful sales
  • Presenting product roadmap and vision to inspire your customers to think bigger
  • Interfacing with other Cloudera teams to ensure your customers hear one Cloudera voice
  • Advocating for your customers’ needs to Product Management and Engineering
  • Participating in external publicity and evangelism (conferences, meetups, webinars, blogs)

Achievements are aligned to a team goal with annual sales targets, as well as to your participation in knowledge exchange with peers and the wider community.


We're excited about you if you have:

  • A passion for using technology to make a difference to people and organisations. We'll supply some amazing tools to help you with this and you'll provide the connection to use cases, which make it real for your customers
  • A minimum of 5 years experience in a customer-facing role, ideally in a pre-sales context
  • The ability to create and give technical presentations and demonstrations
  • Experience with some of the following technologies:
    • Big Data, Data Warehousing or Relational Databases
    • One or more of the three major cloud service providers (AWS, Azure or GCP). Formal certification is not required, but would be a great thing to have
    • Data Engineering, Data Science or Machine Learning

Overview and Introduction to Communitas International

Communitas is a church planting organization with 50 years experience working in Western Europe, Central and Eastern Europe, Latin America and North America. Our leading edge ministry is looking for the right person to help lead us into greater Kingdom ministry. Our current mission family of over 200 includes full-time, bi-vocational employees, as well as affiliates, with many of that number being non-Americans. Communitas operates in over 20 different countries as we start new initiatives and nurture churches and church-planting projects toward reproducible maturity.

Communitas is rooted in missional theology. Our three core values center on being Kingdom seeking, Grace oriented and People focused. Our church planting methodology is not tied to a specific formula, but rather the spirit of serving others and the embracing of a progression of actions that lead to a healthy, maturing church, making our approach very adaptable to unique contexts (see for details). We are pioneers and risk takers. We value honesty and encouragement. We collaborate well, within our global regions, as well as with partner organizations.

The Need and Opportunity

Across post-Christian secular culture people have largely given up on church, but spirituality remains important to them. Communitas International is at the forefront of sparking that spirituality with mission and helping people ‘taste and see that the Lord is good’. Our church planting organization offers the following:

  • A firm commitment to expressing the passionate love of God for the world in word and deed.
  • Substantial experience in reaching people in post-Christian culture.
  • Strategic coaching for planters and churches by experienced cross-cultural practitioners.
  • Robust training for team leaders and members via online cohorts, on-site events and regional/global seminars and conferences.

Chief Multiplication Officer

Mobilization, Human Resources, Global field leaders, Field staff

None

Remote work engagement

Full-time, part-time, bi-vocational (support-raised); volunteer

The Videographer will use video production and visual storytelling to strengthen Communitas’ brand, expand audience engagement, and share the stories of what God is doing through our ministry partners and communities around the world.

This position is responsible for creating compelling video content from concept development through final production, including planning, directing, filming, editing, and distributing video projects across digital platforms.

  • Produce, direct, film, and edit professional-quality video projects for web, social media, ministry communications, and other platforms.

  • Capture creative still photography to support Communitas’ communications and marketing efforts.

General Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrates spiritual maturity and a growing relationship with Jesus Christ.
  • Aligns fully with the mission, vision, values, and Statement of Faith of Communitas.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and integrity in all matters.
  • Maintains a collaborative, learning-oriented, and positive leadership posture.
  • Commits to excellence in communication, stewardship, and organizational representation.

Qualifications:

  • Be a committed follower of Jesus Christ with a strong alignment with the mission, vision, and values of Communitas.
  • Demonstrate a passion for ministry, storytelling, and using creative gifts to serve others.
  • Be a collaborative team member who works well with diverse groups of people.

  • Be willing and able to travel as ministry opportunities require.

Funding:

Candidates may serve in this role through a traditional full-time ministry position, part-time role, bi-vocational arrangement, or volunteer capacity. Communitas provides onboarding, training, coaching, and ongoing support to help team members build and sustain a healthy ministry partnership team.

jobs.description:
Type: Permanent, Full-Time

Reports To: President & CEO

Location: Canada (Remote, up to 20% occasional travel)

Salary Range: $115,000 - $125,000 /yr

This position is for one active vacancy.

About Generate Canada

Generate Canada is a not-for-profit organization that for 30 years has been bringing together leaders from government, business, academia and civil society to drive change aimed at strengthening Canada’s economy, and the natural and social systems on which it depends.

We have built a national platform of pre-competitive innovation labs that we call ‘Solution Spaces’. They help develop and scale solutions - be it partnerships, investments, policies, standards, and/or new technologies - that are deemed most critical for a clean economy and a resilient future.

Our portfolio of Solution Spaces is ever-evolving to respond to complex and persistent challenges, and to fill gaps not already being addressed by other organizations. We are currently focused on advancing regenerative agriculture, the circular economy across construction and plastics supply-chains, and blended sustainable finance for nature-based solutions.

Just now we are working on these and inter-related issues through the following Solution Spaces: CANZA (the Canadian Alliance for Net Zero Agri-food), the Canada Plastics Pact (CPP), Circular Construction Canada, and the Nature Investment Hub.

Generate Canada first develops and supports these platforms, then continually identifies and acts on cross-cutting synergies and opportunities to scale their impact. By working on the front-lines of these system change initiatives we are well equipped to provide information and insights to advance thought leadership on the issues and solutions we are working on, and on our evolving methods.

To learn more visit .

What You’ll Do

As the Senior Director of External Relations, you will step into a newly established leadership role responsible for shaping and leading Generate Canada’s approach to external engagement and influence. You will support the design and execute on strategies to cultivate and steward funders and collaborators across industries, government, academia, and NGOs. By leveraging these partnerships alongside our internal experts, you will advance thought leadership and expand the reach and impact of Generate Canada and its Solution Spaces.

The position reports to the President & CEO, works closely with our Solution Spaces senior leaders, and is supported by our Sr. Manager of Communications and other communication and government relations staff across Generate Canada. The Senior Director serves as a key liaison within a dynamic, distributed leadership structure that evolves in response to external shifts and opportunities.

As Senior Director, External Relations, your key responsibilities will include:

Thought Leadership Strategy

  • Develop and execute a thought leadership strategy that positions Generate Canada, its Solution Spaces, and its partners as credible sources of expertise systems-level economic, environmental and social change.
  • Identify, support and engage leaders, policymakers, academics, and other collaborators in the development of events and communications that build attention and awareness across mediums.
  • Support leaders in commissioning, shaping and promoting research, reports, Op-eds, and speaking opportunities that strengthen our brand and demonstrate our unique value proposition.
  • Partner with Solution Space leaders to identify and amplify insights generated from ongoing convening.

Government Engagement

  • Design, coordinate and where appropriate lead government engagement and foster constructive dialogue with elected officials, policy advisors, and civil servants across all levels of government.
  • Monitor relevant policy and legislative developments and provide timely, actionable briefings to the CEO, Managing Directors, and Board.
  • Represent Generate Canada in government and multi-stakeholder policy forums, and support Solution Space leaders in preparation for government meetings, consultations, and submissions.
  • Build and maintain a structured map of government relationships and a coordinated engagement calendar across the organization.

Partnerships and Resource Mobilization

  • Cultivate and steward mutually beneficial corporate, association, and foundation partnerships that help secure financial and in-kind support for both programmatic activities and operations.
  • Partner with the CEO, Management Team, and staff to develop effective tools, policies, and systems for thoughtful contributor recognition, partnership pipelines and stewardship programs.
  • Develop Generate Canada and its Solution Spaces’ case for support to reinforce our collective and unique value propositions, aid in the tailoring of prospective partner funding proposals and sponsorship packages.

Position-related Coordination & Systems

  • Support the strengthening of policies, systems, and tools (CRM/relationship management, briefing templates, government-engagement protocols, and thought-leadership content pipelines) needed to carry out and coordinate this work consistently across the organization.
  • Work closely with our Solution Spaces to identify opportunities for amplifying their outreach efforts, and harnessing their expertise and networks to strengthen the collective of the organization on significant cross-cutting issues.
  • Contribute to Board and funder reporting on external affairs impact and progress.

Who You Are:

  • Mission-Driven Partner: You are a passionate champion of our mission and continually seeking opportunities to strengthen Canada’s economy, and the natural and social systems on which it depends.
  • Strong Communicator: You communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, building trust and maintaining strong relationships both internally and externally.
  • Catalytic: Collaborative leader who thrives in cross-functional teams and can build alignment across sectors and stakeholder groups.
  • Team Player: Skilled at building interpersonal connections and fostering a supportive, communicative, and collaborative environment.
  • Resilient and Adaptable: Comfortable navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities.
  • Independent and Innovative: Motivated to take initiative and solve complex challenges.

Essential Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressively senior experience in government relations, public policy, communications, and/or partnerships/development; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in economics, business, environmental studies, public policy, political science, communications, not-for-profit management or fundraising, or a related field; Masters preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with senior government officials, and translating policy environments into organizational strategy.
  • Proven success securing and stewarding significant corporate, philanthropic, or blended-finance partnerships.
  • Excellent written, public speaking, and media/stakeholder communication skills; with confidence representing the organization publicly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of or strong affinity for systems-change, multi-stakeholder coalitions, market-building, and issues related to our Solution Spaces that focus on the interdependent nature of the economy, environment, climate change, and social wellbeing.
  • Bilingual proficiency (English/French) is a strong asset given the national scope of the role and federal government engagement.
  • Experience in decentralized, multi-stakeholder, or federated organizations.

How To Apply

Applicants must be authorized to work in Canada and currently reside in Canada. This role does not offer visa sponsorship. Please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your relevant experience (details not found in resume) to be considered for this opportunity.

Please note: We would rather receive a short cover letter from YOU than a formal letter from an AI tool.

This posting will remain open on Generate Canada's career site until the position is filled:

What To Expect From The Hiring Process

We respect your time and value transparency. Selected candidates can expect the following stages:

  • Intro video call with our Human Resources Representative (15 minutes)
  • First Panel Interview (45 minutes)
  • Candidate Exercise / Assessment Task
  • Second Panel Interview (60 minutes)
  • Peer Panel (15-30 minutes)
  • Offer & Onboarding

Please note: This is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the organization.
All interviewed applicants will be notified of the outcome within 45 days of their final interview.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Generate Canada embraces diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are passionate about our people and committed to employment equity. We are at our best when everyone has a seat at the table, and when we are made to feel like we belong. While all qualified persons are invited to apply, we welcome applications from Indigenous persons, racialized persons, persons with disabilities, women, and LGBTQIA2S+ persons.

Generate Canada values equitable opportunities, sustainable solutions, and collaborative and inclusive processes. Generate Canada recognizes and accepts differences in cultural, religious, and political processes and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or age.

At Generate Canada we’re committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process and will do our best to support you. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the interview process, please let us know when we reach out to schedule your interview.

AI Disclosure Statement

At Generate Canada, we are committed to a transparent and human-centered recruitment process. We want to assure all candidates that we do not utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools for candidate screening or selection, at this time. All applications are reviewed and assessed by a human.

This is a hands-on role. You will investigate vulnerabilities, operate security monitoring, improve infrastructure and access controls, automate recurring work, and lead technical remediation. Our Compliance Manager owns the ISMS, policies, audit coordination, and legal or regulatory interpretation; you will own the implementation, operation, and testing of the technical controls behind them.

We care more about demonstrated ownership and sound judgment than a specific number of years or a previous job title.

What you will own

  • Run the vulnerability-management lifecycle: scanning, triage, prioritization, remediation, exceptions, and verification.
  • Operate and improve security monitoring and SIEM tooling, including alert quality, dashboards, detection rules, and integrations.
  • Investigate security alerts and lead the technical response to security incidents.
  • Improve the security of Linux hosts, cloud infrastructure, networks, firewalls, containers, and internal services.
  • Own technical controls for identity and access management, least privilege, just-in-time access, secrets, and certificates.
  • Automate patching, evidence collection, recurring control checks, and other security operations.
  • Coordinate penetration tests and drive technical findings through remediation and verification.
  • Translate SOC 2 and ISO 27001 control requirements into effective technical implementations.
  • Produce clear technical evidence for internal and external audits in partnership with the Compliance Manager.
  • Maintain security runbooks, system documentation, risk-based priorities, and operational metrics.
  • Help engineering teams make practical security decisions without adding unnecessary process.

What we are looking for

  • Proven ownership of technical security in a production SaaS, cloud, hosting, or infrastructure environment.
  • Strong Linux systems, networking, and cloud-security fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with vulnerability management, patching, hardening, and remediation at scale.
  • Experience operating SIEM or security-monitoring systems and investigating security events.
  • Practical understanding of IAM, privileged access, secrets management, certificates, and network controls.
  • Ability to automate operational work using Python, Bash, infrastructure-as-code, or similar tools.
  • Experience participating in incident response and communicating clearly during high-pressure situations.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar security-control frameworks.
  • Strong written and spoken English and comfort working independently in a remote, asynchronous team.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Wazuh or a comparable SIEM/security-monitoring platform.
  • Experience with Teleport, PAM, or just-in-time access systems.
  • Experience securing large Linux server fleets or hybrid cloud/on-premise environments.

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits from the technical-control side.
  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or ISO 27001, although certification is not required.

What success looks like

Within your first six months:

  • Technical security operations have a clear owner, documented priorities, and reliable response expectations.
  • Vulnerability findings are consistently triaged, remediated, or explicitly accepted based on risk.
  • Security monitoring is stable, actionable, and connected to an effective incident-response process.
  • Recurring patching, access-control, and evidence-collection work is increasingly automated.
  • Engineering and Infrastructure teams receive clear, practical guidance and security issues reach closure.
  • Technical controls and audit evidence are reliable enough that compliance work does not depend on senior engineers doing manual follow-up.

How you will work

You will work closely with the Engineering and Infrastructure teams and partner with the Compliance Manager. The Compliance Manager owns governance, policies, the ISMS, audit coordination, and regulatory interpretation. You own the design, implementation, operation, testing, and remediation of technical security controls.

This role is an individual-contributor position with broad ownership and direct influence on how Semaphore protects its systems, customers, and company data.

Senior Fullstack Software Engineer — Ecosystem Experience

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software.

Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

You’ll join our Ecosystem Experience team — the group that connects Semble to the wider healthcare ecosystem: labs, pharmacies, partner APIs, webhooks, and Semble Connect, our automation platform built on Workato.

We work closely with Product, Business, and external partners, and we ship in a large TypeScript monorepo used across the company.

We are a passionate and driven team, proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact — We do work that matters.
  • Collaboration — We are in it together.
  • Human touch — We care deeply

We are also quick to embrace new technologies: we have rapidly adopted AI internally, and we are always looking to work with people who are excited to augment their work with AI.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and EU, with occasional travel to our London or Paris offices, within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What You Will Be Doing

As a senior engineer on Ecosystem Experience, you’ll own problems end to end — from partner discovery through design, implementation, rollout, and production reliability.

We expect you to operate with a high degree of autonomy and to raise the technical bar for the team.

  • Lead the design and delivery of integrations that move clinical and operational data safely between Semble and external systems, including REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, HL7, SFTP, and iPaaS/automation flows.
  • Work across the stack in our Yarn/Nx TypeScript monorepo: React on the frontend, Node.js services and domain modules on the backend, GraphQL (internal and public APIs), and MongoDB.
  • Take ambiguous partner specs and product goals and turn them into clear technical designs, sequenced delivery plans, and clinically safe, testable solutions.
  • Make sound architectural trade-offs — simplicity vs flexibility, build vs buy, speed vs long-term maintainability — and document the decisions so others can follow them.
  • Own production outcomes: monitoring and alerting (e.g. Datadog), incident diagnosis, root-cause analysis, and durable fixes — not just shipping features.
  • Improve reliability and operability: failure handling, retries, idempotency, credentials/secrets, multi-tenant config, and safe rollouts across many production environments.
  • Contribute to Semble Connect and related automation — provisioning, connections, recipe/webhook patterns, and the product surfaces that expose them to practices.
  • Set a high quality bar through design reviews, thorough code reviews, automated tests (unit, integration, e2e), and pragmatic CI/CD improvements.
  • Mentor and unstick teammates; give clear feedback; help more junior engineers grow without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Influence the Ecosystem Experience roadmap and technical standards — surfacing risks early, proposing better approaches, and aligning stakeholders when requirements conflict.

What We Are Looking For

We’re looking for a senior fullstack engineer who enjoys messy real-world integrations as much as clean product UI — someone comfortable reading a partner OpenAPI spec in the morning and shipping a resilient production path by the afternoon.

You should already be operating at a senior level: driving work independently, elevating those around you, and thinking beyond the ticket in front of you.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years' professional experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript, including substantial time operating as a senior / staff-of-one on complex features.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js backends and APIs (REST and/or GraphQL).
  • Proven experience integrating with third-party systems — APIs, webhooks, auth flows, retries, idempotency, credentials/secrets.
  • Ability to design systems, not just implement tickets: break down large problems, define interfaces/contracts, and leave codebases easier to change than you found them.
  • Comfort working in ambiguity — clarifying requirements, challenging weak specs, and driving decisions when information is incomplete.
  • A production ownership mindset: debugging complex issues across services, reading logs/metrics traces, and preventing the same incident twice.
  • Solid automated testing habits (unit/integration/e2e) and comfort with CI/CD; you know when to add coverage and when not to over-engineer.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB or similar) and cloud-hosted applications (AWS preferred).
  • Strong written and verbal communication — RFCs/tech notes, partner discussions, and clear updates for Product and other engineers.
  • Collaborative leadership without needing formal authority: mentoring, reviewing thoughtfully, and aligning people around a plan.
  • Security and privacy awareness appropriate for handling sensitive healthcare data — least privilege, secrets hygiene, safe logging.
  • Comfort using AI coding tools to accelerate delivery without lowering the quality bar.

Strong Pluses

  • Healthcare, HL7/FHIR, lab/pharmacy, or other regulated-domain integrations.
  • iPaaS / automation platforms (Workato or similar).
  • Design systems / component libraries, and large monorepo experience.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / CDK), observability (Datadog or similar), and multi-tenant SaaS.
  • Experience leading technical delivery across multiple engineers or workstreams.
  • Playwright or Cypress e2e experience.
  • Bilingual English–French.

What You’ll Get in Return

  • The great feeling coming with knowing you do something that matters: improving healthcare!
  • £70,000–90,000 package, based on your experience and the value you can bring.
  • Autonomy and ownership — we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s the reason we hire you!
  • 36 days off: 25 holidays + bank holidays + 3 extra days (birthday and ‘feel good’ days) — that we will expect you to actually take so you can recharge and rest.
  • Comprehensive health & wellbeing support — including private health insurance, and mental health support and free therapy sessions through Oliva.
  • Hybrid & flexible work environment — work from anywhere in the UK, with also some flexibility to work across Europe. You decide how much or how little you go to the office.
  • Get the tech you need — You will get the latest MacBook (unless you prefer Windows) and take your pick across a wide range of equipment to setup your home office ergonomically.
  • Work alongside an inspiring team — our two founders have started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.
  • Fantastic office space in Central London, right outside Monument — with a roof terrace, weekly activities, loads of natural light, and cute doggies!
  • The usual free bits coming with nice offices — barista coffee, tea, fruits, happy hours and activities...

We are now recruiting for a Senior Workforce Planning Analyst to join the Capita Health Assessment Advisory Service (HAAS) contract.

This is a home based role.

Job title:

Senior Forecasting and Performance Analyst

Job Description:

What you'll be doing :


  • Produce short, medium and long-term workforce plans to support operational demand and resource requirements.
  • Analyse performance, demand and capacity data to provide insight and recommendations that support business decisions.
  • Investigate forecast variances and identify root causes to continuously improve planning accuracy and effectiveness.
  • Support impact modelling and scenario planning to help assess operational and business changes.
  • Work closely with Operations, Finance and Project teams to ensure plans are robust, accurate and aligned to business priorities.
  • Identify risks to service delivery and performance, providing data-led recommendations and supporting mitigation activities.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to increase efficiency, improve resource utilisation and enhance planning processes.

  • Experience working with SLAs, KPIs, and performance frameworks.

  • Experience using workforce planning, scheduling, or forecasting systems (e.g. WFM tools, BI platforms).

You’ll get the chance to follow your chosen career path anywhere in Capita. You’ll be joining a network of experienced, innovative and dedicated individuals across multiple disciplines and sectors. There are countless opportunities to learn new skills and develop in your career, and we’ll provide the support you need to do just that. Our purpose is to create a better outcome for you.

Responsibilities ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: Estimating Responsibilities Helps set the estimating strategy and tactics to enhance Casey's ability to win work while maintaining an acceptable level of risk and anticipating customer needs and proposing solutions. Perform detailed estimates in accordance with the scope of work, performing quantity take-offs, determining manpower, equipment requirements, obtaining material quotes and firm subcontractor quotes in accordance with policies, procedures, and authority delegations. Prepare estimates with limited information by leveraging experience to fill technical gaps in information. Schedule and facilitate review meetings with operations sponsor, and senior management. Review and comprehend technical and contractual documents such as Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotes (RFQs). Read Drawings: Able to read and translate engineered drawings for industrial projects, including but not limited to, Mechanical equipment erection detail drawings, P&ID’s, process flow diagrams, general arrangement. Candidate must also be able to navigate a 3D model. Prepare material Takeoffs: Organize, format, and maintain material takeoffs from all types of drawings listed above. Obtain material and subcontract pricing from several vendors to ensure competitive pricing that adheres to project schedule constraints. Build Estimate: Sort, organize, and enter all data into InEight Estimate Software including labor rates, factors, material, and subcontract pricing. Proposal Preparation: Organize, word process, format, edit, and support final production of proposals for bid and negotiated industrial construction projects in conjunction with other Casey estimating efforts. Planning: Work with the Director of Estimating on the following: Assist in formulating the company's future direction and supporting tactical initiatives. Participate in the implementation of strategic business plans. Assist in the creation and actively participate in Leadership Training. Manage capital requests and group’s budget. Develop performance measures that support the company's strategic direction. Operations: Work with the Director of Estimating on the following: Maintain in-depth relations with all members of the group and your supervisor. Oversee the operations of the group. Manage any third parties to which functions have been outsourced. Implement operational best practices: controls, systems, etc. Provide daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual reporting as deemed by your supervisor. Supervise and manage estimating processes. Supervise team of estimators and schedulers to develop competitive direct and indirect cost estimates, provide input to financial models, etc. Interface with Proposal Managers as needed to provide input to proposal development. Supervise quantity take-offs and scope reviews with Subcontractors. Comply with standard Phase Code Structure on bids to ensure seamless transfer after award. Maintain historical database of actual costs from completed jobs. Ensure estimate instructions are clear so Subcontractors are using same basis in compiling their estimate. Lead effort to develop most cost-effective construction means & methods, traffic control or logistics plans, and project schedule. Lead estimate reviews with management to ensure that all estimate data required is provided to Proposal Manager for inclusion in Management Review packages. Supervise estimate close-out, subcontractor and material comparisons, final cut/add sheet, completion of all pricing forms, revenue curves, etc. as required for proposal. Work with estimating team to improve estimating practices, estimate set-up, etc. and develop new estimating leaders. Assist in scheduling resources, developing potential partners, design team members, etc. Coordinate with Business Development and Operations on upcoming opportunities. Track and review unsuccessful bids for learning opportunities. Aid in development and maintaining of InEight estimating software and additional take-off tools utilized to complete estimates. Risk Management: Understand and mitigate your groups risk profile. Monitor all open legal issues involving the group, and legal issues affecting the industry. Construct and monitor reliable control systems. Report risk issues to the Dir of Estimating as needed. Assist in risk and contingency analysis. Manage, lead direct reports, and mentor. Supervisory: Supervises the Estimating Resources within their respective office Provides assistance to other Estimating Managers upon request for coverage, assurance or other purposes Qualifications EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: Bachelors Degree or a equivalent combination of education and experience. 10+ years estimating experience required with supervisory experience. Field experience on industrial construction projects. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED: Be knowledgeable of MIC Health and Safety programs and project specific regulations. When on-site, actively participate in daily toolbox meetings with crews and subcontractors. Set a personal example of safe behavior. Proficient in Salesforce, Viewpoint and Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Read, analyze, and interpret blueprints, professional journals, technical procedures, contracts, or governmental regulations. Write reports, business correspondence and document project activities. Effectively present information and respond to questions from project managers, superintendents, clients, customers, and the public. Ability to read and understand drawings, including symbols, and takeoff materials. Must be a self-starter with ability to manage multiple priorities and work with diverse employee base. Strength in communication, organization, and leadership. Competent in Microsoft Suite of products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.). Experience with Blue-Beam, Navisworks, Egnyte, P6 and Microsoft Project. Experience with InEight Estimate (Hard Dollar) a plus. Technical writing ability. Effectively present information to top management, public groups and/or boards of directors. Calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume; ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry. Interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form. Other may duties may be assigned PHYSICAL DEMANDS: This position requires prolonged sitting at a desk and working at a computer. Must be able to lift up to 20 pounds at times. HOURS: This position is a standard full-time position, with general business 40-hour operating schedule, Monday-Friday. TRAVEL: Must be able to travel up to 50% of the time. Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We are looking for a technical specialist who owns the performance of the Improvado website end to end: how it is found (SEO and GEO), how fast and healthy it is, and how well it converts visitors into pipeline. This is an analytics-driven, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in Google Search Console, GA4, and the browser dev tools as in a keyword report. Because the website is our main product-facing marketing surface, you will also shape how the product is presented on it. In practice, the role covers part of what product marketing would otherwise do.

What You Will Do

Technical SEO and GEO

  • Own the technical health of the site: crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, page speed, structured data and schema, rendering, redirects, internal linking, and site architecture.
  • Optimize the site for AI search (generative engine optimization): make Improvado understandable, citable, and recommended in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and similar engines.
  • Monitor visibility in both classic and AI search, and turn the findings into prioritized fixes.

Website optimization and conversion

  • Continuously improve page performance, UX, templates, and key conversion paths (demo requests, sign-ups, high-intent pages).
  • Plan and run experiments (A/B tests, template and layout changes, messaging tests) and measure their impact on conversions and pipeline.
  • Work with engineering, design, and external contractors to ship improvements to the website stack (CMS, CDN, caching, tracking).

Analytics and measurement

  • Build and maintain dashboards that connect organic and on-site behavior to leads, pipeline, and revenue.
  • Own tracking quality: events, attribution, and data accuracy across GA4, Search Console, and related tools.
  • Analyze data to find growth opportunities, and report findings in clear, decision-ready form.

Product and messaging input

  • Use search demand, AI-visibility, and on-site behavior data to guide positioning, messaging, and landing page strategy.
  • Work with stakeholders so website content reflects ICP needs and the product’s value propositions.

What We Are Looking For

Must have

  • 3+ years in SEO and/or website optimization, with measurable results in organic growth or conversion.
  • Strong technical SEO skills and a good understanding of how websites are built, served, and rendered.
  • Ability and willingness to work in the Eastern Time (EST) time zone, with working hours aligned to the US East Coast.
  • Hands-on experience with GEO or AI search optimization, or a clear, demonstrable track record of working on it.
  • Strong analytics experience: GA4, Google Search Console, and BI or dashboard tools (Looker Studio, Superset, or similar). You build your own reports and draw conclusions from the data.
  • Proficiency with SEO tooling (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalents).
  • Ability to work effectively with developers, designers, and marketers in a distributed team.

Nice to have

  • B2B SaaS or marketing technology background.
  • Experience with Webflow or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS and JavaScript.
  • SQL or advanced spreadsheet skills; experience with AI-assisted or automated workflows.
  • Experience with CRO and experimentation platforms.
  • Exposure to product marketing, positioning, or messaging.

You are

  • Analytical, curious, and driven by measurable outcomes.
  • Self-directed and comfortable owning a channel without heavy supervision.
  • A clear communicator across time zones.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $125k - $145k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

125K - 145K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

The BPC will work closely with CDW business stakeholders, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Enterprise and Solution Architects, ServiceNow technical resources, and other MyCDW workstreams to define the future-state operating model and ensure business requirements translate into a cohesive ServiceNow design. The individual must operate as a consultant and process designer—not simply as a requirements gatherer, challenging unnecessary customization, avoiding replication of legacy processes, and guiding stakeholders toward ServiceNow best practices and standardized, scalable enterprise processes.


What you will do

jobs.excerpt: WHO WE ARE: The Partnership on AI (PAI) is the leading forum addressing the most important and difficult decisions on the future of AI.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

The Partnership on AI (PAI) is the leading forum addressing the most important and difficult decisions on the future of AI.

We are a nonprofit that invites diverse voices into the process of technical governance, design, and deployment of AI technologies. Our diverse Partners work together across industry, academia, and civil society to form responsible AI solutions so that AI empowers humanity -- contributing to a more just, equitable, and prosperous world.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Partnership on AI is seeking a Principal Researcher to lead the technical backbone of PAI’s work, with emphasis on benchmarking, evaluation, and technical standards that strengthen PAI's impact. This person will report to the Chief Programs and Insights Officer and work closely with colleagues leading PAI’s focus areas: AI, Human Connection, and Well-Being; Trustworthy AI Value Chains; and AI & Shared Prosperity

PAI's approach is sociotechnical by design: we don't treat "technical" and "social" as separate tracks, but as a single problem to be solved coherently. This role will direct how PAI orients its work around that philosophy. The Principal Researcher will bring deep technical fluency to questions that are also social: for instance, how multi-turn safety degradation in chatbot design affects psychological well-being, how agent identification and authentication systems can support authentic interaction without compromising privacy, and how societally agreed norms actually get built into model specs and evaluation practice. The job is to make sure PAI's guidance across the AI value chain--model, product, and policy layers, for example--is principled in the public interest and grounded by stakeholders, technically implementable and measurable, and transferred to the appropriate body responsible for benchmarks, evaluations, and standards.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Strategic Planning & Vision

  • Develop PAI's point of view on the evaluation and benchmarking ecosystem, including assessing the infrastructure required for PAI to successfully develop and run its own evaluations and directing PAI’s strategy for integrating into the evaluation ecosystem, in collaboration with supervisor and executive team
  • Advance the adoption of shared industry guidance through development of and integration into benchmarks, evaluations, and technical standards, in collaboration and partnership with relevant organizations in the auditing and certification space
  • Offer technical leadership and shape the strategic direction of PAI’s focus areas (AI, Human Connection, and Well-Being, AI and Shared Prosperity, and Trustworthy AI Value Chains) in collaboration with those leading those focus areas and with the Chief Programs and Insights Officer.
  • Support technical efforts from other PAI teams, including Policy and International
  • Work with PAI’s Partnerships team to structure work to support fundraising efforts
  • Consider which questions across PAI can be addressed most effectively and urgently with sociotechnical solutions that PAI is well placed to develop, and design and build implementation pathways.

Research & Subject Matter Expertise

  • Work closely across PAI projects in order to ensure that guidance is technically feasible and implementable, e.g., as evaluations or standards, and supporting testing and sandboxing exercises related to PAI guidance where relevant
  • Design approach for maintaining PAI’s benchmarking, evaluation, and standards work over time, including quality control for established partnerships
  • Author/co-author peer-reviewed research papers, policy briefs, and accessible reports that translate PAI’s insights into actionable recommendations for industry, policymakers, and civil society, with an emphasis on bridging technical and social considerations.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Initiate and lead collaborative research partnerships with academic institutions, civil society organizations, and industry Partners to advance programmatic work.
  • Represent PAI at select conferences (e.g., NeurIPS) and other venues, presenting findings and methodological innovations.
  • Run point on key relationships with benchmarking, technical standards, and evaluation-oriented organizations and settings, including AISIs and assurance bodies
  • Collaborate with Partnerships team to test approaches to earned-revenue models, including but not limited to licensing or content contributions to credentialing and training programs

Strategic Communication and Impact

  • Translate rigorous findings into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences, including industry and civil society leaders, policymakers, and affected communities.

You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. jobs.description:
This is a three-term position with the possibility of extension based on funding and organizational needs. The salary range for this position is $61,000 to $72,000

ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW

As a strategic partner of the United Nations, the United Nations Foundation brings together fresh thinking and diverse voices around innovative ideas to drive progress and tackle problems. Sometimes we work behind-the-scenes, shaping negotiations and connecting experts, advocates and decision-makers. Other times we drive public awareness and involvement through communications, campaigns, and convenings. Over the years we’ve developed a diverse and dynamic portfolio of capabilities, tools, and platforms to help the UN build a better world for everyone, everywhere.

The Global Partnership for Sustainable Development Data (the Global Partnership), an alliance hosted at the UN Foundation, is a fast-growing, dynamic international partnership bringing together over 700 different organizations including governments, UN agencies, private companies, civil society organizations, and many others. We make connections and broker partnerships to address the problems of gaps in data production, poor data use, access, quality, and to work with stakeholders to fully harness the new opportunities of the data revolution in the service of sustainable development. We aim to link and align action, capacities and resources across geographies, sectors and data communities.

JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to the Senior Director of Operations, and in close coordination with the Agriculture Program Lead, the Manager will support the Global Partnership’s thematic engagements on agriculture data. This includes working with the Global Partnership’s Regional Leads to strengthen agriculture and food security data systems in Global Partnership countries and coordinating advocacy related to country work in Rome, where the UN’s food agencies are headquartered. They will develop and maintain strong trusted relationships with government representatives and Global Partnership partners from all regions, with a strong focus on West Africa. The Manager will also develop and contribute to knowledge products that aim to shape key stakeholders’ view of the importance of agricultural data, the need to strengthen data systems and capacities, and how to achieve that.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Country Duties

  • Develop strong relationships with government partners at the country-level in National Statistical Offices, Ministries of Agriculture and other entities to understand their data needs, identify ways to strengthen data systems, and promote data use and sharing in the food and agriculture sector
  • Develop use cases in collaboration with government partners and provide advice and assistance on their implementation
  • Engage with select political and technical partners to identify opportunities for their engagement in support of country level implementation on agricultural data
  • Develop and organize various meetings, seminars, events and roundtables that aim to address issues related to the gap in agricultural data, and data use and sharing
  • Procure and manage consultants engaged to assist with the work

Advocacy

  • Provide support for the Global Partnership’s activities related to advocacy in Rome, where the UN’s food agencies are headquartered, by:
    • Understanding the political landscape and helping to implement the strategy for stakeholder engagement and influence in Rome;
    • Building relationships with member state representatives and other stakeholders in Rome;
    • Assisting with the management of consultants; and,
    • Assist with the coordination of meetings and events
  • Engage at regional and global levels to support the Global Partnership’s strategy on agricultural data, in diverse areas spanning official and non-official data communities
  • Develop and contribute to various knowledge products that make the case for investing in agriculture data and statistics, improving data governance and data sharing, leveraging concrete country examples, and linking to related global policy processes

Other Duties

  • Develop and maintain an understanding of the dynamics and key issues on data for development and identify how these may affect or help strengthen agricultural data
  • Liaise with key donors and program partners in the agriculture sector to build and maintain new funding and project relationships
  • Coordinate closely with the Communications team and MEL Manager to capture impact stories, results and lessons from country and Rome-based work, and contribute content that supports the Global Partnership's communications and reporting efforts
  • Other duties as assigned

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Agricultural Data Manager is not a supervisory role.

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION and/or EXPERIENCE

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • Bachelors’ degree in international development, public policy, agricultural development or related field or commensurate years of experience
  • 5-7 years of related work experience
  • Knowledge of data-related issues in the agriculture sector
  • Knowledge of intergovernmental data sharing best practices preferred
  • Familiarity with the 50x2030 Initiative preferred
  • Proficiency in French and English required
  • Understanding of Rome-based agencies’ governance and budgeting processes preferred
  • Experience in data for development and financing for data preferred
  • Project management experience preferred

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the required skills and competencies.

  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and consistently deliver high-quality results with integrity and reliability
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, functions, and diverse perspectives to foster productive working relationships and achieve shared organizational goals
  • Strong critical thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to evaluate information, exercise discretion, anticipate challenges, and make informed decisions in complex or evolving situations
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to prioritize competing demands, coordinate resources, manage timelines, and deliver results within established deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, communicate clearly, manage expectations, and navigate competing priorities to achieve desired outcomes
  • Ability to apply relevant technical, functional, and professional expertise to solve problems, inform decisions, implement effective solutions, and continuously improve work practices

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The essential functions of this role will generally be performed in a remote work environment, provided the employee maintains a dedicated workspace that supports confidentiality and productivity. Remote employees must ensure limited background noise and environmental distractions to effectively perform essential job functions

This role will also travel frequently, with approximately 6 trips per year of 1 to 2 weeks duration each.

LOCATION

This role must be based in Rome, Italy, or Abuja / Lagos, Nigeria. Applicants located in Nigeria must have or be able to secure a Schengen visa in order to travel to Rome as needed.

DISABILITY SPECIFICATIONS

The United National Foundation will make reasonable accommodations in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.

REQUIRED APPLICATION MATERIALS

To be considered for this position, please upload both a resume and cover letter. Applications that do not include both documents will be considered incomplete and will not be reviewed.

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

For full-time, U.S. benefit eligible employees, UNF offers an excellent range of benefits, including:

  • a choice between two health plans through UnitedHealthcare (PPO or HDHP with HSA)
  • dental insurance
  • vision insurance
  • flexible spending accounts
  • 403b retirement savings plan with a generous matching contribution
  • group term and supplemental life insurance
  • short-term disability
  • long-term disability
  • back-up care
  • employee assistance program

Additionally, all benefit eligible employees have 12 paid holidays, 20 vacation days, 10 sick days, 3 personal days, and 8 weeks of family leave care.

The United Nations Foundation is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Paris HQ – Open to full remote (working on CET to EST time-zones) or hybrid in Paris.

Full time - Permanent

About Current AI

Current Al
is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale. Launched at the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025, the organisation has already raised hundreds of millions through partnerships with the French government, AI Collaborative, and other leading governments, philanthropic, and industry partners.

If AI is the transformative revolution we perceive it to be, it needs to serve the public interest today and tomorrow. At Current AI, our goal is to help build a collaborative, collective, and global vision for AI, not one governed by a specific country or a company.

Today, there are builders and researchers around the world developing public interest AI building blocks (datasets, models, compute, audits and applications), but efforts are not always co-ordinated or additive. To have a genuine shot at being an alternative, we must harness the full breadth of work happening across open source and public interest AI. That means leveraging government influence and resources, philanthropic funding, and private sector expertise and scale towards building the alternative.

Role Overview

AI Potluck is Current AI's effort to build an open-source, public-interest AI stack together with the ecosystem. Organisations contribute models, datasets, evaluations, tools, compute and research. Those contributions become shared building blocks that others can use, improve and adapt. There are currently two products in the AI Potluck portfolio: The Gap Map, a data visualization tool that shows what exists across open-source AI and, critically, what is still missing. Alpha is a working demo of our vision for what a viable public option can be. Alpha is where contributions from partners and the public AI ecosystem plug in and reach real users.

As Product Manager: Partnerships, you will hold the contributor roadmap for AI Potluck. You will scope potential partner contributions and write PRDs, then work cross-functionally with our Build team to ship. Your success is measured by your ability to proactively shape technical contribution pathways for the Potluck, successfully onboard new partners and launch new product integrations within the AI Potluck, and to drive broader ecosystem adoption beyond our direct intervention.

Working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Programmes and Movement teams, you will structure and execute strategic product partnerships that enrich our stack, drive ecosystem adoption, and ensure external contributions align with our open-source vision.

What you’ll do

The partnership opportunity pipeline is led by the Movement team, bringing plenty of inbound partners. Your role is to turn roadmap needs and inbound contribution ideas into product specifications and work cross-functionally to see them go live.

Product Partnership Pipeline Management

  • Own the roadmap of contributions to AI Potluck and keep it in step with Build's product roadmap and release cycles, establishing and tracking against success metrics.
  • Assess strategic fit, technical interoperability, and alignment with open-source and mission goals of potential partners.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to structure integration models and cost/value frameworks.

Partner Relationship Management & Ecosystem Building

  • Cultivate long-term relationships with product partners, acting as the primary point of contact for ongoing technical integrations.
  • Drive partner adoption of Alpha, encouraging partners to join the Potluck as contributors back to the open-source stack.
  • Design repeatable contribution pathways so partners are able to contribute without bespoke support.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Product Strategy

  • Work closely with Engineering and Product turn roadmap gaps into scoped asks for open calls and bounties, and turning inbound offers into integrations and PRDs..
  • Ensure third-party partner strategies directly align with Current AI’s overarching product roadmap and release timelines.

Product Management

  • Bring contributor and user insight into the product vision and roadmap, , in close collaboration with the VP Product.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and other teams to guide each contribution from conception through launch and iteration.

What we’re looking for

Essential Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management or Product Partnerships roles involving open source and AI systems.
  • Experience in open-source ecosystems, including bringing external contributions into a shipped product.
  • Proven track record of taking external contributions from first conversation to live in production.
  • Experience writing PRDs and technical specs that engineering teams, in-house or external, can build from.
  • Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Research, Programmes, and Leadership teams to balance risk, feasibility, and product impact.
  • Fluent English with clear written and verbal communication skills tailored to both technical teams and external partner executives.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in research-product organizations, or public-interest technology initiatives.
  • Background in structuring complex integration models for AI/ML tools, compute providers, or datasets.
  • Experience designing the technical requirements for open calls, bounties or challenges.
  • French proficiency is a plus.

Character traits

We’re looking for people who:

  1. Put the mission before personal credit and work well in low-ego, highly collaborative teams
  2. Exercise good judgment and integrity, including knowing when to push back or say no
  3. Enjoy building from scratch and making progress with imperfect information
  4. Have a bias to action, shipping useful things and helping others do the same
  5. Are comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution as needed
  6. Work effectively across cultures, time zones, and disciplines
  7. Believe AI can serve the public interest - and are willing to do the practical, hands-on work to make that true.

The offer

We’re committed to ensuring that team members are supported, well-compensated, and able to thrive. We also adjust to local market conditions.
