As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike stops breaches, and the sensor is where that fight happens first. The Sensor Detection Platform team builds the on-sensor detection engines (behavioral pattern matching, process classification, and emerging on-sensor inference) that execute detection logic on hundreds of millions of endpoints in real time, along with the infrastructure that lets detection engineers author, test, deploy, and manage that content safely across the entire Falcon fleet.


We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this platform. You will manage multiple teams responsible for the sensor-side detection engines and template/pattern frameworks, the process and application classification systems that power features like Application Abuse Prevention and agentic-workload identification, and the supporting infrastructure: content build and channel-file delivery pipelines, feature-flag and staged-rollout controls, pre-release validation and test environments, and the fleet health observability that keeps detection running reliably on customer endpoints.


This is a high-leverage role at the foundation of CrowdStrike's detection strategy. Every detection the company ships, whether endpoint, identity, or hybrid, ultimately executes through your platform, and every improvement you make translates directly into faster, higher-quality protection for thousands of customers with zero tolerance for endpoint disruption.


What You'll Do:


  • Own the multi-year strategy, architecture, and roadmap for on-sensor detection: execution engines, template and pattern frameworks, process classification, and the content delivery infrastructure that supports them
  • Lead and grow an organization of managers and senior engineers across multiple teams, owning the full talent lifecycle: hiring, coaching, performance, and succession
  • Be accountable for both detection efficacy and endpoint footprint (the CPU, memory, and I/O cost of detection on customer machines), including performance budgets, regression gates, and fleet health SLOs
  • Make shipping detection content to the fleet provably safe: pre-release validation, staged channel-file deployment, rollback, exclusion management, and end-to-end testing across OS platforms and sensor versions
  • Drive the evolution of on-sensor intelligence, including process classification for AI and agentic workloads and the runtime foundations for on-sensor model inference
  • Partner closely with detection content engineering, the core sensor organization, the Cloud Detection Platform, and product management to deliver a coherent hybrid sensor/cloud detection architecture
  • Reduce operational drag on the platform: drive down support escalation volume, keep test infrastructure trustworthy, and streamline release operations
  • Anticipate and manage escalations and cross-team dependencies, and represent the platform in architecture and planning forums across the product organization
  • Drive annual operating plan and organizational planning for your area, and reflect CrowdStrike's culture in how your teams operate

What You'll Need:


  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams and 2+ years managing managers
  • Deep endpoint experience: building and operating software that runs on customer endpoints at scale, including EDR/endpoint security agents, OS internals across Windows, macOS, and Linux, and the performance and compatibility discipline that work demands
  • Experience safely delivering software and content updates to very large distributed fleets, where a bad push is customer-visible within minutes
  • A track record of being fully accountable for strategic outcomes over one-to-two-year horizons, not just project delivery
  • Strong architectural judgment: you can engage credibly in design reviews, weigh efficacy-versus-footprint tradeoffs on constrained devices, and make build/buy/consolidate calls
  • Experience managing operational excellence for customer-facing systems: incident response, release safety, fleet health monitoring, and escalation management
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, including organizational change, competing priorities, and cross-team dependencies
  • Excellent communication skills with executives, peers, and engineers
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:


  • Domain experience in detection engineering, malware analysis, or threat intelligence, including adversarial evaluation programs such as MITRE ATT&CK evaluations
  • Experience with detection-as-code, content management systems, or rule/template authoring platforms
  • Experience with on-device ML: model runtimes, inference on heterogeneous hardware, or resource-constrained deployment of models
  • Experience integrating AI-assisted or agentic workflows into engineering practice

jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We’re looking for a driven, commercially sharp Enterprise Business Development Manager to open head office doors with the UK’s multi-site restaurant groups and bring them onto First Table at scale.

This is a newly created, national new-business role. Until now we have signed restaurants one site at a time through our regional BDMs. You’ll change that for groups: selling at head office level under group master agreements covering current and future sites, rather than site by site.

The UK & Ireland is one of our biggest growth bets, with a plan to multiply supply across 22 target cities over the next two years. You’ll have a defined named-account list built from our proprietary market data, the backing of our field sales and Partner Success teams, and the freedom to build a group portfolio from zero.

This is a full-time, permanent role reporting to our GM, UK & Ireland.

About us

At First Table, our vision is simple: to be the first place diners go to book a table.

First Table now offers our great dining experiences at amazing restaurants across the UK. Following the recent city launches in Bournemouth, Leicester, Norwich, and Southampton, we are doubling down on building a strong presence and connected team across the UK.

First Table is a dining discovery platform that connects diners to restaurants through their love of food. Through our clever tech, we help restaurants get their night off to a great start and give diners a compelling reason to try somewhere new. It’s a win-win situation. From early bird offers to last table reservations, we make discovering and booking great dining experiences fast, easy, and rewarding.

At the heart of everything we do are our values: Grow Together, Win-Win-Win, and Own It. These guide how we show up for each other, our restaurant partners, and our diners and they’re a big part of what makes First Table a great place to work.

Learn more about our story here:

About the role

You’ll own new-business sales to the UK’s multi-site restaurant groups. Your named-account list is made up of bookable, premium-casual groups where our model demonstrably works, including brands already live on First Table whose sites outperform the typical independent. Your job is to turn that list into master agreements, and master agreements into live sites, on rollout schedules you negotiate and drive.

This is a hunting role. Once a group’s sites are live, they move to our Partner Success team for account management and you move on to the next deal, re-engaging an existing group only to extend the agreement or sell new sites into it.

If you’re looking for a book to manage, this isn’t that job. If you want to open head office doors and build a group portfolio from zero, it is.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the named-account list: prospect, qualify and prioritise the UK’s dining groups, starting with brands already live on the platform whose numbers make the case for us.
  • Sell at head office level, reaching operations directors, commercial directors and founders, and running multi-stakeholder sales cycles of 3 to 6 months.
  • Close group master agreements covering current and future sites.
  • Negotiate rollout schedules into every agreement and drive them, working with Partner Success on onboarding and local BDMs on launch support, so contracted sites actually go live.

Employment Terms
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.

For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Platform Reliability Engineer to ensure the availability, performance, and operational excellence of large-scale distributed systems in production. As an SRE you will live at the boundary between development and operations, applying strong software engineering principles to infrastructure and operations problems, and continually pushing the platform toward higher reliability with lower operational toil. The ideal candidate will combine deep systems knowledge with strong programming skills, a measurement-driven mindset, and the discipline to design, automate, and operate complex services so that reliability becomes a first-class engineering deliverable rather than a reactive concern.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define, instrument, and continually refine service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets for critical services, and use those measures to drive concrete engineering and prioritization decisions.
  • Lead incident response and resolution for production issues, acting as a calm and effective incident commander when needed, and ensuring high-quality post-incident reviews that drive lasting improvements.
  • Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing strategies using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, Datadog, or similar tooling so that operators have rich, actionable visibility into system behavior.
  • Build and maintain robust on-call processes, runbooks, and escalation paths that reduce mean time to detect and mean time to resolve while protecting the well-being of the engineers on rotation.
  • Automate operational toil aggressively by writing production-grade tooling in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages, replacing manual workflows with reliable, auditable automation.
  • Architect and operate large-scale Kubernetes clusters and container-based workloads, including autoscaling, capacity planning, network policy, and integration with service meshes.
  • Design CI/CD pipelines that promote safe, frequent, and observable releases, supported by automated testing, canary deployments, feature flags, and progressive rollout strategies.
  • Lead capacity planning and performance engineering activities, building models that predict growth and stress, and validating those models through load testing and chaos experiments.
  • Partner closely with application development teams to embed reliability practices early in design — including failure-mode analyses, graceful degradation patterns, and dependency hardening.
  • Strengthen the platform’s resiliency through chaos engineering, fault injection, dependency isolation, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and well-tested failover paths.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security posture in collaboration with security teams, including patch management, vulnerability remediation, and secure-by-default platform defaults.
  • Contribute to the technical roadmap for reliability tooling, observability platforms, and developer-experience improvements that reduce friction and improve outcomes for engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers across the organization on SRE practices and foster a strong, blameless culture of operational excellence.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SRE, DevOps, or production engineering experience supporting large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, or Java, with the ability to build robust automation and tooling.
  • Deep, hands-on experience operating Linux at scale, including networking, performance tuning, and systems-level troubleshooting.
  • Production experience operating Kubernetes and container-based workloads.
  • Strong working knowledge of observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, or commercial equivalents.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Solid understanding of distributed system design, including consistency models, partitioning, and failure semantics.
  • Demonstrated experience leading incident response and conducting effective post-incident reviews.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience defining and operationalizing SLOs and error budgets in real production environments.
  • Exposure to chaos engineering practices and tools such as Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, or Litmus.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Background in capacity planning, performance engineering, or large-scale load testing.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, or Consul.

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.

We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

Manager, Business Development Operations
Department: Business Development
Location: Fully remote - Preferably UK
Reports to: Director, Business Development

About Living Goods

Community health is one of the most proven ways to save lives. But as community health systems scale, many struggle to maintain quality, control costs, and deliver consistent results. Scale without performance puts lives at risk.

Living Goods is a government performance partner that supports countries in Africa to build affordable, intelligent, high-impact community health systems. For almost 20 years, we have worked alongside the governments of Kenya, Uganda, and Burkina Faso to make community health work at scale. Our work focuses on aligning policies, financing, technology, and workforce to turn government investment into consistent, reliable, quality care for families. Our approach is research-proven, built for real-world constraints, and delivers life-saving care for about $2 per person served.

As global health funding tightens and expectations for measurable results grow, governments need systems they can afford, sustain, and manage for results. Our 2027–2030 strategy is built for this moment. It focuses on strengthening the operating foundations of government-led systems, scaling proven solutions, and developing new approaches to emerging challenges, including intelligent systems that use data and AI to better support government community health workers (CHWs) and the systems around them.

Our vision is simple: when families need healthcare, it’s there. Not eventually. Not only when a program reaches them. But reliably—through systems designed to work, improve, and endure.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a highly capable and motivated Manager of Business Development (BD) Operations to serve as a key member of our fundraising team. You will own the systems, data, and processes that allow our fundraising team to operate, with a particular focus on our CRM (Microsoft Dynamics 365). In Year 1, you will lead the deployment of our newly optimized CRM in partnership with our internal tech team, and you will be the business owner of the system going forward.

This role is about more than keeping systems running. We are looking for someone who can turn clean data into insight, build processes that give fundraisers more time with donors, and produce the funding status reporting that the fundraising team, leadership, and the Board need. You will work closely with Finance, Programs, and Digital Transformation (internal tech). The position reports to the Director of Business Development and manages the Associate, Business Development Operations.

You will thrive in this role if...
You are a CRM expert who gets systems deployed and used. You can pick up a build that is already in motion, work with our internal tech team to finish it, and take it live. You know how to plan a rollout, test with real users, train a busy team, and manage the shift from the old way of working to the new one. Once the optimized CRM is live, you keep improving it.

You turn data into decisions. You know how to build a weekly fundraising dashboard, a monthly Board report, and a portfolio review that leaders can trust. You can spot trends, flag risks early, and tailor funding status updates to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.

You see a process and instantly see how to make it better. You can find where handoffs, duplicated steps, or unclear ownership are slowing a team down, and design simpler processes that people actually adopt. You build those processes into the tools the team uses every day, including our CRM and project management tools, so proposals, reporting, and deadlines run more smoothly. You’ve already put AI to work in a way that transformed a process, not just sped up a task, and you can walk us through it: what you built, what it replaced, the results, and the guardrails you used.

You know how to manage up, down, and across. You set priorities, resolve bottlenecks, and keep shared services working together. You build trust with fundraisers, finance, and technical teams.

Responsibilities
  • Lead deployment of our optimized CRM in partnership with the internal tech team, building on requirements and back-end work already completed.
  • Own the rollout plan: user acceptance testing, data migration and validation, training, go-live, and post-launch support, and serve as business owner of the system after launch.
  • Oversee donor, funder, and partner data to ensure clean tracking, segmentation, and reporting, and set data governance standards and an enhancement roadmap so quality is sustained after launch.
  • Drive CRM adoption across the Business Development team and other critical functions in the organization through training, user guides, and change management, and monitor usage so gaps are caught early.
  • Lead deployment of project management software within the fundraising team: configure it for proposal development, grant reporting, and deadline tracking, train the team, and drive adoption so work is visible, handoffs are clear, and reporting is more efficient.
  • Produce the Business Development reporting suite: fundraising dashboards, Board reports, and portfolio reviews. Track KPIs and analyze revenue trends for leadership.
  • Design and refine Business Development workflows, including prospecting research, proposal processes, and handoffs between Business Development, Programs, and Finance.
  • Track proposals, reports, and supplementary materials to make sure internal and external deadlines are met.
  • Project manage the Business Development enablement function (operations, proposal development, reporting): set priorities, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure shared services work together coherently.
  • Bridge BD and Finance on gift reconciliation.
  • Work with fundraising relationship managers to support their operational needs, and manage and develop the Associate, Business Development Operations.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required, in business, information systems, nonprofit management, or related field.
  • 5–7 years of experience in development, fundraising, or business development operations, including at least 2–3 years owning or administering a CRM. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience deploying a CRM, including testing, training, and driving user adoption.
  • Experience configuring and rolling out project management or workflow tools for a team. Experience with Asana preferred.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in a work setting to transform processes, such as reporting, research, or data cleanup.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including experience building dashboards and reports.
  • Experience designing and improving workflows and cross-functional processes.
  • Working knowledge of gift and grant accounting, such as reconciliation and restricted versus unrestricted funds. Experience with multi-entity fundraising is preferred.
  • Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and communication skills.
  • Collaborative spirit, demonstrated by active listening, clear communication, being a team player, and earning trust across departments, with executive team members, country teams, and peers.
  • Line management or coaching experience preferred.

Compensation
A competitive salary and benefits package commensurate with experience including health insurance and bonus opportunity. The opportunity to be your best while making lives better for those in need.

Living Goods is an equal opportunity employer and will consider every qualified applicant for employment. Living Goods does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, sexual orientation or disability.

Our current job openings are displayed on our website, where you can search for open positions and apply directly. Living Goods does not offer any positions without an interview and never asks candidates for money. If you are asked for money, we strongly recommend that you do not respond and do not send money or personal information. If offered a role at Living Goods, we’ll request consent to complete a background check, which is part of our hiring process.

jobs.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Medtronic Executive Search team partners with senior business leaders to identify, assess, and attract executive talent for critical leadership roles across the organization. The team leverages executive search expertise, talent market intelligence, executive research, and strategic talent advisory capabilities to support leadership hiring, succession planning, and long-term talent strategies.

This U.S.-based remote position leads a team of Executive Search Consultants responsible for delivering executive hiring outcomes across multiple business units, functions, and leadership levels. The Senior Manager, Executive Recruitment partners closely with executive leaders, Human Resources, Talent Management, and key stakeholders to develop and execute executive talent acquisition strategies aligned with enterprise priorities.

Reporting to the Sr Director, Talent Acquisition, this leader provides strategic direction, coaching, and operational leadership to the Executive Search Consultants while personally leading select high-profile executive searches. The role is accountable for driving search excellence, leveraging market intelligence to inform talent decisions, building diverse executive talent pipelines, and ensuring an exceptional executive candidate and stakeholder experience.


As a trusted advisor to senior leadership, the Senior Manager plays a critical role in executive hiring, succession planning, leadership pipelining, and broader organizational talent strategy, helping to strengthen Medtronic's leadership bench and long-term talent competitiveness.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead, develop, and coach a team of Executive Search Consultants, providing strategic direction, performance management, mentoring, and professional development.
  • Manage team capacity, workload prioritization, and resource allocation to ensure timely delivery of executive search engagements and proactive pipeline initiatives.
  • Partner with senior executives, HR leaders, and Talent Management partners to understand business priorities and develop executive hiring and talent acquisition strategies.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders on executive talent trends, market dynamics, succession planning considerations, and leadership talent availability.
  • Oversee and guide executive search strategies, including research plans, talent mapping, market intelligence, sourcing methodologies, and candidate engagement approaches.
  • Lead and support executive-level recruitment projects for Vice President, Senior Vice President, and C-suite positions, including select critical leadership searches.
  • Build and maintain executive talent communities and succession-focused pipelines across key business functions and leadership disciplines.
  • Ensure the delivery of high-quality executive candidate assessments, interview processes, and executive search recommendations.
  • Analyze and communicate executive talent market intelligence, competitive talent insights, compensation trends, and executive recruiting best practices to stakeholders and leadership teams.
  • Partner with Talent Management and HR organizations to support long-term leadership pipeline planning and succession initiatives.
  • Establish and maintain executive search metrics, reporting, and performance indicators to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Drive adoption of executive search best practices, processes, tools, and technologies to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Represent Executive Search in enterprise talent discussions and contribute to broader talent acquisition and workforce planning initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate and current executive search activity, candidate data, and market intelligence within Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, and executive search reporting tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 7+ years of experience in search, executive recruiting, talent acquisition, or leadership talent sourcing, with 5+ years of managerial (people or program) experience; OR Advanced degree and 5+ years of experience in search, executive recruiting, talent acquisition, or leadership talent sourcing, with 5+ years of managerial (people or program) experience.
  • Experience leading executive-level recruitment initiatives for Vice President, Senior Vice President, and C-suite positions.
  • Experience developing and implementing executive search strategies, market mapping initiatives, succession-focused talent pipelines, and executive talent acquisition programs.
  • Experience partnering with senior executives and HR leaders to influence talent decisions and provide strategic talent advisory services.
  • Experience utilizing LinkedIn Recruiter, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, executive search tools, and advanced sourcing methodologies.
  • Experience presenting executive talent market insights, hiring strategies, competitive intelligence, and recruiting recommendations to executive leadership audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, and developing high-performing recruiting or executive search teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • People leadership experience, including leading executive recruiters, search consultants, talent acquisition professionals, or related teams.
  • Strong preference for experience recruiting executive-level talent within the medical technology, medical device, healthcare technology, life sciences, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical industries.
  • Experience leading executive search teams within a corporate executive recruiting function, retained executive search firm, or boutique executive search organization.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related business discipline.
  • Experience supporting executive succession planning, leadership assessment, and long-term executive talent pipeline strategies.
  • Knowledge of executive compensation benchmarking, leadership assessment methodologies, competitive talent intelligence, and executive labor market trends.
  • Experience working within complex global or matrixed organizations supporting multiple business units and executive stakeholder groups.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

The incumbent investigates complaints of professional misconduct in an unbiased and professional manner while ensuring transparency, efficiency, and public protection.

À propos du Collège des consultants en immigration et en citoyenneté (le Collège)

Le Collège est l’autorité mandatée par le gouvernement du Canada pour réglementer la pratique des consultants réglementés en immigration canadienne (CRIC) et des conseillers réglementés en immigration pour étudiants étrangers (CRIEE). Son rôle et ses pouvoirs sont établis dans la Loi sur le Collège des consultants en immigration et en citoyenneté (Canada). Le Collège établit les normes de la profession en matière de délivrance de permis, de formation et d’éthique et veille à leur application dans l’intérêt public.

Secteur Organisme d’autoréglementation (OAR)

TITRE DU POSTE : Enquêteur ou enquêteuse

Service : Conduite professionnelle

Supérieur immédiat : Superviseur·e, enquêtes

Exigences linguistiques : Bilinguisme non essentiel

Lieu : Canada

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous?

Souhaitez-vous faire partie d’une équipe qui a à cœur de renforcer et de soutenir la profession de consultant en immigration et en citoyenneté? Si vous partagez notre passion et notre objectif, posez votre candidature ci-dessous pour vous joindre à une équipe qui apporte une contribution importante.

De quelle façon ce rôle soutiendra-t-il notre équipe?

Le titulaire du poste fait enquête sur les plaintes pour manquement professionnel d’une manière impartiale et professionnelle tout en assurant la transparence et l’efficience du processus, ainsi que la protection du public.

Les responsabilités comprennent les éléments suivants (sans toutefois s’y limiter)

  • Examiner les plaintes afin d’évaluer les risques et cerner les problèmes potentiels liés à la conduite en vertu du Code de déontologie du Collège, du Règlement administratif et de la loi.
  • Enquêter sur les plaintes et allégations relatives au manquement professionnel.
  • Recueillir, interpréter, documenter et conserver les renseignements et les éléments de preuve pertinents. Il peut s’agir d’obtenir des citations à comparaître et des mandats.
  • Mener des entrevues avec les plaignants, les témoins et les titulaires de permis afin d’aider le conseiller juridique, le Comité des plaintes et le Comité de discipline à établir les faits de l’affaire en cause.
  • Assurer la liaison avec d’autres parties prenantes, incluant les membres du public, les conseillers juridiques, les membres du Tribunal et les organismes d’application de la loi afin de recueillir des renseignements supplémentaires.
  • Assurer la liaison avec les titulaires de permis et leurs conseillers juridiques dans le but d’obtenir les dossiers clients, les communications et les documents pertinents dans le cadre d'une enquête.

  • Collaborer avec d’autres membres du personnel afin de cerner les tendances et les pratiques exigeant une enquête plus approfondie (p. ex. les stratagèmes frauduleux et les cas de récidive).

Ce rôle soutiendra notre équipe en y apportant les éléments suivants

  • Pensée critique et capacité d’analyse permettant d’analyser la preuve et d’en tirer des conclusions
  • Aptitudes pour la gestion du temps et sens de l’organisation permettant de gérer et de hiérarchiser des priorités et des échéances concurrentes
  • Sens de l’organisation permettant de gérer les échéances et un volume élevé de documents et de dossiers liés aux cas
  • Souplesse permettant de travailler dans un environnement au rythme rapide et changeant en faisant preuve d’un esprit d’équipe et d’initiative
  • Aptitudes pour la gestion des relations interpersonnelles et des relations avec les parties prenantes permettant de désamorcer une situation et d’interagir de manière professionnelle et respectueuse avec les parties prenantes (titulaires de permis, témoins, etc.) qui éprouvent souvent du stress, de l’inquiétude ou de la colère face à l’affaire en cause
  • Aptitudes pour la communication écrite et verbale permettant de préparer les dossiers relatifs aux cas (p. ex. rapports de plainte, résumés des entrevues et affidavits), de témoigner dans le cadre d’audiences disciplinaires et de communiquer avec diplomatie et respect avec des parties qui font souvent face à des barrières linguistiques
  • Souci du détail permettant de veiller à l’exactitude et à l’exhaustivité de l’examen des documents et des dossiers
  • Tact et discrétion afin de traiter des questions de nature confidentielle et sensible

Formation et expérience requises

  • Connaissance de logiciels bureautiques et administratifs

jobs.excerpt: OVERVIEWReporting to the Senior Manager, Data Management & Governance, the Senior Specialist, Strategic Contract Data Governanceis responsible for leading proactive contract governance, standardization, and contract digitization enablement initiatives across Circular Materials’ enterprise procurement and contract lifecycle processes.
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Management & Governance, the Senior Specialist, Strategic Contract Data Governanceis responsible for leading proactive contract governance, standardization, and contract digitization enablement initiatives across Circular Materials’ enterprise procurement and contract lifecycle processes.

This role is accountable for establishing standardized contract structures, pricing schedules, Statements of Work (SoWs), exhibits, and operational language before procurement cycles begin, ensuring contracts are operationally scalable, analytically consistent, and digitally optimized.

This role requires deep expertise in commercial contract interpretation and contract lifecycle management. The successful candidate will analyze complex contractual agreements, understand negotiated business and operational requirements, and translate contractual obligations, pricing structures, service deliverables, and governance requirements into standardized operational, reporting, and system-ready data structures. Success in this role requires the ability to bridge legal, procurement, operational, and technology disciplines to ensure contract terms can be consistently governed, digitized, and operationalized across the enterprise.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Procurement, Operations, Legal, Technology, Service Provider Reporting and Data Governance teams to establish standardized contract frameworks and governance practices. Working across these functional areas to translate complex contractual language, commercial terms, pricing structures, and operational obligations into scalable business processes, reporting requirements, and system-ready data structures that support enterprise-wide consistency, and automation.

This is a full-time, salary paid position, which requires residency in Canada.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead enterprise-wide contract exhibit, pricing, and language standardization initiatives across procurement cycles.
  • Analyze and interpret complex commercial contracts to identify business rules, operational requirements, pricing mechanisms, service obligations, performance metrics, and reporting requirements that must be standardized and converted into structured, system-ready information.Evaluate historical contracts, Statements of Work (SoWs), and procurement artifacts to identify opportunities for operational and reporting standardization.
  • Translate negotiated contract terms and legal language into operational processes, data elements, metadata structures, reporting requirements, and technology-enabled workflows.
  • Establish standardized contract structures and governance practices that improve consistency, reduce operational complexity, and support downstream analytics.
  • Partner with Procurement, Operations, Legal, Technology, and Data Governance teams to define future-state contract requirements prior to procurement release cycles.
  • Support the development of standardized contract language, metadata structures, and reporting requirements through the creation of an effective digital repository for contract data and downstream impacts for each term or contract exhibit
  • Work with Technology teams to operationalize AI-enabled contract digitization and automated data extraction capabilities using AWS Textract and related platforms.
  • Support scalable, automation-driven contract governance processes that reduce manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Support future-state contract governance strategies that improve operational efficiency, vendor management, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve functional SOPs, work instructions, process maps, and related business documentation across enterprise systems, including SAP and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
  • Document end-to-end business processes, including process inputs and outputs, business rules, controls, decision points, exception handling, roles and responsibilities, and system dependencies.
  • Facilitate process discovery sessions, walkthroughs, and interviews to gather detailed functional and operational information.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, information systems, data management, legal studies, or a related discipline.
  • Certification in Contract Management, Data Governance, Business Analysis, or Process Governance would be considered an asset.
  • Certification in business analysis, technical writing, process mapping, or content management would be considered an asset.

Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in contract governance, procurement operations, enterprise contract management, or data governance.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing, interpreting, and operationalizing complex commercial agreements, including multi-year service contracts, pricing schedules, Statements of Work (SoWs), exhibits, governance frameworks, and performance obligations.
  • Proven experience standardizing contract exhibits, pricing schedules, Statements of Work (SoWs), and reporting structures.
  • Experience translating contractual language into business processes, system requirements, data structures, contract lifecycle management platforms, or enterprise applications.Experience supporting contract digitization, intelligent document processing, or automated data extraction initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of how contractual terms, obligations, and commercial constructs are represented within operational and technology environments.
  • Experience working with enterprise systems including SAP ECC/S/4HANA, CLM systems, D365.

Knowledge/Competencies/Skills

  • Exceptional ability to interpret sophisticated contract language and understand the operational, financial, reporting, and system implications of negotiated contractual terms.
  • Strong understanding of procurement lifecycle management, contract governance, and operational standardization practices.
  • Strong technical understanding of AWS Textract, OCR/intelligent document processing technologies, or similar automation platforms.
  • Advanced understanding of unstructured/semi-structured contract data, metadata structures, and contract data governance.
  • Ability to bridge legal, procurement, operational, and technology disciplines to transform contractual language into structured, scalable business processes and system requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across Procurement, Legal, Operations, Technology, and Data Governance teams.
  • Ability to identify operational risks and standardization opportunities before procurement execution.
  • Strong process mapping and documentation skills, including experience with Visio, BPMN, Lucid or similar.
  • Ability to translate technical system functionality into business-friendly language without losing critical operational detail.
  • High attention to detail and commitment the bigger Data Management & Governance strategy
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Lucid and Visio or comparable documentation tools.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • All CM employees work 40 hours per week, remotely from a home office environment.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

ExpectedCompensation:

  • An annual base salary in the range of $85,000 to $115,000.
  • The salary range listed complies with the OntarioEmployment Standards Actand reflects a potential base salary range for this role. The actual salary offered will be determined within the range, and will depend on factors, such as the candidate’s unique qualifications, relevant experience, work location and expected contributions.

Artificial Intelligence

Applicant and Interviewee Communication

  • Applicants who have been interviewed will be informed whether a hiring decision has been made within 45 days of their final interview.

Record Retention

  • Job posting records and associated application forms will be retained for at least three years.

ABOUT CIRCULAR MATERIALS

Circular Materials is a national not-for-profit producer responsibility organization (PRO) that supports producers in meeting their extended producer responsibility (EPR) obligations across Canada. Created by producers for producers, we design, and deliver effective recycling programs that drive advance innovation, improve environmental outcomes and create value across the recycling supply chain.

Through full-service program delivery, including collection, management, promotion, education, and reporting, we are advancing systems where more materials are recycled and returned to producers for use in new packaging and products.

Learn more at circularmaterials.ca.

Circular Materials is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a workforce that reflects diversity of thought, skills, experiences, and backgrounds as we work together to accelerate a circular economy for people and the planet.

jobs.description:
Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over ~23000 professionals in >160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree.

For additional information about Solenis, please visitwww.solenis.com or follow us on social media.

The Senior Manager, Digital Product Strategy leads the enterprise digital product strategy for Solenis across all business divisions. In this role, you will create and deliver a unified product roadmap that connects corporate priorities to high-value digital investments, driving both growth and operational productivity.

Your work will focus on guiding new product innovation (NPI) initiatives and integrating automated digital solutions directly into customer business processes using IoT and AI. By establishing regular governance and reporting routines, you will align division-specific product owners, manage project milestones, track risks, and proactively resolve cross-divisional conflicts before they cause delivery delays.

Additionally, you will handle demand planning, feature prioritization, and success measurement against digital KPIs. Partnering closely with eCommerce and Digital Customer Experience leaders, you will build a pipeline for a customer self-service portal and launch new digital service revenue streams separate from core chemical and equipment sales. Ultimately, you will bring strong problem-solving skills to navigate a complex matrix structure, streamlining digital delivery and reducing risks across the entire company.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Develop and deliver an integrated New Product Innovation (NPI) and connected services roadmap to drive growth, value, and scale across all business divisions.
  • Manage a portfolio of digital projects using IoT and AI to automate customer business processes and enhance Solenis's offerings.
  • Lead demand planning, feature prioritization, risk management, and milestone tracking across divisions to ensure on-time delivery against digital KPIs.
  • Manage, mentor, and build a team of division-specific digital product owners while establishing clear product ownership standards.
  • Partner with eCommerce and Digital Customer Experience leaders to build a customer portal pipeline and launch new digital service revenue streams.
  • Coordinate across multiple leadership tiers and a complex matrix organization to maximize operational efficiency and reduce delivery risks.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA preferred.
  • 12+ years of experience in digital strategy, product management, or portfolio leadership.
  • Proven track record managing teams of product managers and overseeing multiple concurrent roadmaps.
  • Strong background navigating complex matrix organizations.
  • Experience in B2B, industrial, or manufacturing sectors is highly preferred.

Additional Knowledge and Skills:

  • Mastery of Agile frameworks, Scrum, and the software development lifecycle.

jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.description:
Position Scope:

This position is responsible for the mobilization and initial engagement of prospective missionary employees, guiding individuals from their first point of contact through the early stages of the application process. With a focus on identifying, recruiting, and encouraging those exploring cross-cultural ministry, the Global Mobilizer plays a vital role in helping raise up new workers for the harvest and shepherding them toward missional service with Communitas.

This role provides leadership in candidate cultivation and recruitment efforts, including building relationships with prospective missionaries, facilitating discernment conversations, maintaining engagement throughout the recruitment pipeline, and ensuring a smooth transition into the formal application process. Working closely with a small team, the Global Mobilizer helps develop and implement strategies that increase awareness of missionary opportunities and identify individuals called to serve internationally.

A key focus of this role is fostering meaningful connections with prospective missionaries while also understanding the ministry needs and opportunities within Communitas fields and projects. Through relational engagement, effective communication, and thoughtful coordination, the Global Mobilizer serves as a bridge between those exploring missionary service and the ministries where God may be calling them to serve.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective missionary candidates.
  • Build relationships with individuals exploring international ministry opportunities.
  • Guide candidates through initial discernment conversations and next steps.
  • Manage and track candidate engagement throughout the recruitment pipeline.
  • Coordinate communication, follow-up, and handoff to the formal application process.
  • Assist in developing and implementing recruitment and mobilization strategies.
  • Represent Communitas at conferences, events, and networking opportunities as needed.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records within applicant tracking and database systems.
  • Collaborate with team members to improve processes and enhance candidate experiences.
  • Support the organization's mission by identifying and encouraging future ministry leaders.

General Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrates spiritual maturity and a growing relationship with Jesus Christ.
  • Aligns fully with the mission, vision, values, and Statement of Faith of Communitas.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and integrity in all matters.
  • Maintains a collaborative, learning-oriented, and positive leadership posture.
  • Commits to excellence in communication, stewardship, and organizational representation.

Qualifications:

  • Education & Experience
    • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Communications, Marketing, Psychology, Ministry, or a related field preferred.
    • 1–2 years of leadership, recruiting, ministry, coaching, or related experience.
    • International ministry experience or experience living cross-culturally strongly preferred.
    • Experience working with applicant tracking systems, databases, or CRM platforms preferred.
  • Skills & Competencies
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
    • Strong interpersonal and relational abilities.
    • Effective project management and organizational skills.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain momentum on ongoing processes.
    • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures and geographic locations.
    • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, social media platforms, and cloud-based collaboration tools.
    • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.
    • Flexible and adaptable in a changing work environment.
    • Additional language skills (Spanish, German, or other languages) are highly valued.
  • Spiritual & Personal Characteristics
    • Demonstrate a growing relationship with Jesus Christ and alignment with the mission and values of Communitas.
    • Possess a passion for helping people discern and pursue God’s calling.
    • Maintain a positive, encouraging, and servant-hearted attitude.
    • Be proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented.
    • Work with excellence, integrity, and professionalism.
    • Exhibit a teachable spirit and commitment to ongoing personal and professional growth.
    • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive information.
    • Have a genuine desire to see God glorified among all nations.

Additional Requirements

  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed.
  • Reliable internet access and a suitable home office environment for remote work.

Funding:

This position is funded through personal ministry partnership development (support raising), which covers both salary and ministry-related expenses. Individuals who are self-employed or serving in a bi-vocational capacity are encouraged to apply. Communitas provides onboarding, training, coaching, and ongoing support to help team members build and sustain a healthy ministry partnership team.

Salary: $45,000-$60,000

DEPARTMENT OF GAMING

The Arizona Department of Gaming (ADG) regulates tribal gaming, event wagering, fantasy sports, horse racing and pari-mutuel/simulcast wagering, and unarmed combat sports; investigates illegal off-reservation activities; and provides and supports prevention, education, and treatment programs for people and families affected by problem gambling through its Division of Problem Gambling (DPG).

Senior Procurement Specialist

Job Location:

Arizona Department of Gaming
100 North 15th Avenue
Suite 202
Phoenix, Arizona 85007

This position offers the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures. May be required to come into office occasionally or on short notice.

Posting Details:

Salary: $75,000 – $85,000

Grade: 22

Closing Date: November 01, 2026

Job Summary:

The Arizona Department of Gaming is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Senior Procurement Specialist. This position will lead complex procurement operations, strategy, and administration for the agency. This position will also be responsible for managing the end-to-end sourcing process in compliance with the Arizona Procurement Code, executing data-driven strategy and continuous improvement initiatives, administering grant programs, and providing cross-functional business support across agency operations.

The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

Job Duties:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

● Integrates technical data, statements of work, delivery schedules, milestone payments, terms and conditions, and other contractual elements into cohesive requirements. Executes end-to-end procurement processes, including development of contractual terms and conditions, conducting RFQ/RFPs, and actively negotiates contractual agreements with suppliers.
● Collaborates in market complexity analyses and develops strategies to manage risk to the State. Develops relationships with internal customers and suppliers to ensure contracts achieve State objectives.
● Develops and maintains reports, providing recommendations regarding industry and market trends. Uses data analytics to assist internal stakeholders in the development of business strategies designed to optimize expenditures and ROI. Works with subject matter experts to gather and assess business requirements; makes recommendations to internal stakeholders based on analysis conducted.
● Collaborates to develop, maintain, and improve agency policies and procedures for issuing grants. Researches best practices and requirements for a successful grant program and coaches relevant agency staff on grant management compliance. Assists in writing grant requirements, reviewing submissions, and awarding grants.
● Assists the team as backup/support to general business services tasks related to fleet, facilities, and travel coordination.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):

Knowledge of:

• Arizona State statutes and rules related to government procurement activities, contract administration, and grants.
• Best practices in determining and conducting appropriate sourcing strategies/methods.
• Continuous improvement tools and methods.

• Effective negotiation techniques.

  • Supply Chain, logistics, and resource management.
    • Research methods.
    • Effective techniques of relationship management.
    • Solicitation techniques.
    • Using eProcurement, word processing, spreadsheet, email software.
    • Source of supply, local and national markets, and pricing trends
    • Grant compliance, issuance, and management principles.

    Skills in:

    • Effectively negotiating complex contractual agreements, terms, and conditions with suppliers.
    • Process optimization using continuous improvement techniques.
    • Preparing written determinations, justifications, and formal procurement documentation.
    • Developing and implementing various sourcing strategies based upon business' strategic goals.
    • Interpreting and applying intricate laws, rules, policies, and procedures.
    • Conducting market complexity analyses and utilizing data analytics to optimize expenditures and ROI.
    • Leading various project teams.
    • Develop and implement various monitoring strategies to ensure accountability.
    • Synthesize, summarize, and analyze a variety of data sources and formulate workable recommendations.

    Ability to:

    • Develop and implement strategic sourcing strategies.
    • Work in a dynamic team environment and be responsive to changing goals and priorities.
    • Work remotely and with minimal supervision.
    • Manage and guide multiple projects simultaneously from ideation through closeout.
    • Provide guidance, training, and support to agency staff regarding policy compliance and processes.
    • Build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders, agency leadership, and external suppliers.
    • Solving complex problems requiring a broad "big picture" perspective.
    • Interpreting business issues and recommending solutions/best practices.
Selective Preference(s):
  • A Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business Management, Finance or equivalent years plus direct experience.
    • NIGP-CPP, CPPB, CPPO, or similar certification.
Pre-Employment Requirements:

● None

Benefits:

The Arizona Department of Gaming offers a comprehensive benefits package to include:

○ Sick leave

○ Vacation with 10 paid holidays per year
○ Paid Parental Leave - Up to 12 weeks per year paid leave for newborn or newly-placed foster/adopted child (pilot program)
○ Affordable medical and dental insurance
○ Participation in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) and long-term disability plans
○ Life insurance
○ Optional employee benefits include short-term disability insurance, deferred compensation plans, and supplemental life insurance

jobs.excerpt: Are you someone who can spot a winning YouTube angle before anyone else does?
jobs.description:
Are you someone who can spot a winning YouTube angle before anyone else does?🎯

We're looking for someone who wants to build YouTube channels from scratch and watch them take off. You'll spot the topics and keywords worth chasing, launch new channels, produce content at scale, own the SEO and rankings, and keep testing until you find what actually works.

This is not a traditional content creator role. You’re expected to think like a YouTube growth/product manager, not just produce videos. You'd be joining our YouTube department, a fully remote team that builds and grows channels across several markets, inside a digital media company that's been ranking content through SEO for years. 🚀

🏆 Our playing field is iGaming (online casino) one of the most competitive markets out there, and for that exact reason, one of the most rewarding.

The role

It starts before any video exists: finding the keywords worth going after and studying what competitors rank for and why.
From there, you produce at scale: ideas, scripts, voice-over, thumbnails, publishing. Often remixing what you already have to test a new angle, rather than starting from a blank page.

Once channels are live, the work turns analytical: rankings, CTR, retention, signups. You read them and decide the next move.
Most tests won't work: That's the job. What matters is how fast you learn, and how quickly you scale what lands.

You'll use AI and automation throughout, and work within YouTube's policies as a regulated industry.

Where you'll spend your time:

  • Finding opportunities: keywords, search intent, competitors, channel angles
  • Building and producing: channels, content at scale, packaging
  • Outranking the competition: SEO, positions, CTR, retention
  • Converting: turning views into signups
  • Testing and adapting: scaling what works

Who we're looking for

We care more about how you think and what you can do than your degree or previous job title.

  • You're a heavy YouTube user and understand why some videos perform better than others
  • You're analytical and comfortable making decisions from numbers
  • You naturally think in terms of testing, measuring and improving
  • You're proactive and comfortable owning projects independently
  • You understand the basics of SEO, keywords and search intent
  • You're comfortable with content production and basic video editing
  • You already use AI tools and actively explore new ones
  • Excellent English, written and spoken

You'll launch things that go nowhere, and watch good ideas underperform for reasons you can't explain yet. The people who do well here keep adjusting, and read a failed test as information.

A strong plus: you've already built a YouTube channel, website, social account or other digital project. Didn't work? That's fine. What we care about is what you learned.

What we offer

🎯 Real ownership — your own channels, your own decisions, your own numbers.

🚀 A head start — years of internal tools, automation and market data, yours from day one.

📈 Performance over seniority — several of our team leads started here in junior roles.

💰 Variable compensation — part of your pay follows how your channels perform.

🌏 Full remote — 35 hrs/week, flexible hours, at least 4 hrs overlapping Bangkok time.

🌴 Generous vacation leave

About GreenTomatoMedia

We're a digital media company based in Chiang Mai, Thailand, with 1,500+ websites across 8 languages, several million visitors every month, and a fast-growing YouTube department.

We don't work with clients or agency briefs. We build and grow our own products and brands, which means short decision cycles, real freedom to experiment, and the ability to see the impact of your ideas. 🌟

Our team brings together 45+ nationalities 🌎, and we believe a good idea should win because it works — regardless of who came up with it.

The Hiring Process

  1. Initial interview with HR that will last between 30-45 minutes.
  2. Practical test to evaluate your knowledge, and problem-solving skills.
  3. Final Interview with your potential team lead & reference check.

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
