For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking a GPU Systems Engineer with deep expertise in CUDA programming, GPU architecture, and high-performance computing to design and optimize compute-intensive workloads on modern accelerator hardware. This role focuses on extracting maximum performance from GPU platforms for AI training, inference, scientific computing, and high-throughput data processing workloads. The ideal candidate combines low-level systems mastery with strong software engineering practices, and has a track record of delivering measurable performance improvements on production GPU systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement high-performance CUDA kernels for compute-intensive workloads across AI and HPC use cases.
  • Profile and optimize GPU code using tools such as Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, and CUDA profilers.
  • Tune memory access patterns, occupancy, register usage, and shared memory utilization for peak performance.
  • Develop highly optimized libraries for linear algebra, attention, and other ML primitives.
  • Optimize multi-GPU and multi-node training using NCCL, RDMA, and high-performance networking.
  • Implement custom operators and fused kernels in PyTorch, JAX, or Triton.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers to identify performance bottlenecks in training and inference pipelines.
  • Develop benchmarks and regression tests to safeguard performance over time.
  • Evaluate new GPU architectures and feature sets, and advise on adoption strategy.
  • Contribute to compiler-level optimizations for tensor programs where appropriate, working at the boundary between ML frameworks and underlying accelerator codegen to unlock performance not reachable through framework-level tuning alone.
  • Optimize memory hierarchy usage across HBM, L2, shared memory, and registers.
  • Implement mixed-precision and quantized compute paths that maximize accelerator throughput while preserving numerical fidelity within bounds acceptable for the target workloads.
  • Document performance characteristics, design decisions, and tuning playbooks for internal teams.
  • Stay current with GPU architecture, CUDA evolution, and emerging accelerator technologies.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in GPU programming and performance engineering.
  • Deep expertise in CUDA C/C++ and GPU programming models.
  • Strong understanding of modern GPU architectures, memory hierarchies, and execution models.
  • Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing GPU workloads in production.
  • Familiarity with NCCL, MPI, and high-performance interconnect technologies.
  • Experience integrating custom kernels into ML frameworks.
  • Strong C++ skills and familiarity with modern systems programming practices.
  • Solid grounding in linear algebra and numerical methods.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with research and engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or other GPU kernel authoring frameworks.
  • Familiarity with TensorRT, FasterTransformer, or vLLM internals.
  • Exposure to compiler infrastructure such as LLVM or MLIR.
  • Open-source contributions to GPU or ML performance libraries.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed training infrastructure.

The Senior Analyst, Fraud and AML is the hands-on center of our day-to-day fraud and AML work. You’ll triage and work our alert and case queues, investigate the more complex cases, and turn what you see into specific improvements to our rules and processes.
Strong fraud triage experience is at the heart of this role. You’ll know quickly what needs attention now, what can wait, and what is simply noise, and you’ll document every decision so it holds up to review.

Fraud and money laundering risk often show up in the same accounts and the same money movements, so you’ll work both sides. You’ll also be a trusted backup to the Senior Manager on Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) referrals and bank partner escalations.
You’ll join a program that already has dedicated leadership and a clear direction, and you’ll help turn that direction into daily practice. You’ll report to the Senior Manager, Fraud and AML, and work closely with product, engineering, operations, and data colleagues, as well as our banking and brokerage partners.

If you’ve triaged fraud alerts and worked first-line fraud and AML cases, enjoy spotting patterns that lead to better controls, and want to help run fraud and AML for financial products that impact millions of people, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🛠️

Triage and work the queues 🛡️

  • Triage incoming fraud and AML alerts quickly and accurately, separating real risk from noise and prioritizing by member impact and potential loss
  • Own the day-to-day health of our alert and case queues: timeliness, quality, and clear, well-documented dispositions
  • Work alerts and cases across fraud and AML, including account takeover, first-party and ACH abuse, money mule activity, and business use of consumer accounts
  • Track turnaround targets (SLAs) and run quality checks on case decisions, so decisions stay consistent, timely, and defensible

Investigate and escalate 🕵️

  • Investigate complex, multi-account cases from first signal to a documented, defensible decision
  • Prepare SAR referrals and supporting case documentation, meeting our bank partner timelines
  • Escalate to and coordinate with bank and brokerage partners when a case requires it, and serve as backup to the Senior Manager on partner escalations
  • Support incident response by helping trace root cause and documenting what changed and why

Measure and improve controls 📊

  • Review how our rules and controls perform: alert precision, time to decision, false positives, and loss outcomes
  • Turn patterns you see in cases into specific tuning proposals, and follow remediation through to completion
  • Flag emerging fraud and AML patterns early, before they become losses or compliance findings
  • Feed disposition and data quality findings back into our rules, routing, and the vendor tools we rely on

Support the AML program 🧭

  • Support day-to-day Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and AML compliance, including case documentation, training, and testing evidence
  • Help the Senior Manager prepare for independent testing and bank partner audits by keeping records complete, consistent, and easy to retrieve
  • Contribute to procedures and incident write-ups that are clear, concise, and practical

Partner across the business 🤝

  • Work with product, engineering, operations, and data colleagues to improve controls and align on shared metrics and definitions
  • Share what you’re seeing with the Senior Manager regularly, including emerging patterns, queue health, and control performance
  • Explain findings and trade-offs between loss prevention and member experience in plain language

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 💫

In your first 90 days:

  • You understand our products, members, partners, and fraud and AML workflows
  • You own the alert and case queues and keep them moving within SLA
  • You’re triaging with confidence, working investigations independently, and preparing SAR referrals with little rework
  • You’ve put forward your first tuning and process improvement recommendations

Within your first year:

  • Queue health, quality checks, and SLA reporting are consistent and trusted by leadership
  • Your tuning and remediation work has measurably improved alert quality and reduced manual effort
  • Case files are audit-ready and have held up in partner and independent reviews
  • You’re a go-to expert on how we triage, investigate, and respond to fraud and money laundering

ABOUT YOU 🦄

  • 4+ years of experience in fraud operations with AML compliance for deposit and/or brokerage products (ideally both) at a fintech
  • Hands-on experience in fraud triage — you can quickly assess an alert, separate real risk from noise, prioritize what matters most, and make clear, well-documented decisions under time pressure
  • Strong analytical skills — you spot patterns in data and back your decisions with evidence, not just intuition
  • Exceptional communicator — both written and verbal communication, including case documentation that stands up to audit
  • A collaborative, curious mindset, and energy for working in a fast-moving environment where our program is evolving

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 🎯

  • Industry certifications such as CAFS, CAMS, CFCS, or CFE
  • Experience tuning rules, scenarios, or models, or working with case management and alerting tools
  • Experience supporting independent testing, regulatory exams, or partner audits
  • Deep familiarity with US regulatory landscape and fraud typologies
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, statistics, STEM, economics, criminal justice, or a related field, or equivalent experience

WE OFFER 💫

Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well.

  • The opportunity to work on a real-world security product used by IT and security teams

jobs.excerpt: VP of Advancement (Philanthropy & Fundraising) About GrowcerGrowcer builds the infrastructure for food sovereignty.
jobs.description:
VP of Advancement (Philanthropy & Fundraising)

About Growcer

Growcer builds the infrastructure for food sovereignty. We're the world leader in modular container farms, with over 900 projects worldwide. We give Indigenous nations, schools, hospitals, food banks and community organizations across North America the farms, training and support to grow fresh food locally, 365 days a year, in places where fresh produce is expensive, scarce, or trucked in from thousands of kilometres away.

The need in Canada is real. Nearly 10 million people, including 2.4 million children, live in food-insecure households (Statistics Canada, 2025), and rates are far higher in northern and remote Indigenous communities.

Every farm changes what a community can count on: fresh food year-round, local jobs and skills, and food grown on the community's own terms. Our partners don't stop at one harvest. They run their farms for years, supply their schools, food banks and families, and train the next generation of growers.

Donations go straight to that impact. A gift through our community foundation partners puts a farm on the ground in a community that's ready to grow but can't fund it alone, turning philanthropy into permanent local food infrastructure rather than a one-time meal.

Today, farms across the Growcer network grow 10 million servings of fresh food every month. In 2026, Growcer received a Governor General's Innovation Award, for advancing food sovereignty and climate resilience through modular farming.

Growcer is entering its next phase of growth and scaling across North America. Effective Growcer employees are tenacious, enjoy a fast-paced environment, and are comfortable working on big-picture challenges with lots of autonomy.

If you want your work to be visible, your impact to be direct, and your mission to be one you'd be proud to explain at a dinner party, you'll feel right at home.

Why This Role Exists

Our clients are First Nations, schools, food banks, hospitals, and nonprofits. They're ready to grow food for their communities, but most can't fund a farm on their own. Today they rely mainly on public grant programs, which are slow, competitive, and can change overnight.

Securing capital is the biggest barrier between a community that's ready and impact on the ground. Our clients need a partner who can help them close that gap. Starting with a pilot alongside RBC, we've shown that philanthropic capital can do exactly that, funding infrastructure directly in the communities that need them.

This role makes that support reliable and scalable, so every client in our network has a real path to funding their project.

Gifts raised through this program fund farm projects for our client communities through donor-advised funds established with our community foundation partners.

About the Role

VP of Advancement is a senior leadership position responsible for building and running Growcer's national philanthropy and fundraising program from the ground up. You'll do two things at once: personally cultivate and close major gifts with donors and foundations capable of funding a project outright, and lead a growing network of province-based fundraising counsel.

You're the connective tissue between the capital being raised and the communities in Growcer's client network waiting to build. You'll be trusted to take on a campaign in the range of $15M and run it end to end. We're looking for someone who can take an idea and run with it, learning quickly on the way.

This role reports to Growcer's CEO. Expect regular travel to donor meetings and partner communities across the provinces you're building out.

This role is probably not for you if you're looking to steward an established donor base with a mature development shop behind you. It's a build.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and scale Growcer's national philanthropy program, taking the regional fundraising-counsel model piloted in Ontario and expanding it into other states and provinces.
  • Personally cultivate, solicit, and steward major-gift relationships with individual donors, family foundations, and corporate giving programs capable of six- and seven-figure gifts
  • Design and run capital campaign strategy at scale
  • Sharpen and localize the case for support for each province and donor audience
  • Collaborate with the sales team to match funded projects to Growcer's client network
  • Own the client intake process for philanthropically funded projects (including any future application-based fund), and the collateral that supports it: donor decks, impact measurement, and client stories
  • Build the reporting and forecasting systems needed to track pipeline and campaign performance across every active region
  • Represent Growcer publicly as its senior advancement voice with donors, foundations, and philanthropic advisors
  • Work closely with Growcer's leadership team to keep fundraising targets aligned with delivery capacity on the ground
  • As the program grows, hire, train, and mentor additional development staff

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Comfortable building something from an early concept: testing an approach, changing it based on evidence, and making the case for a new direction when the data says so
  • A bias toward action over process; moves fast, tests in the field rather than over-designing on paper, and doesn't wait for heavy infrastructure before getting started
  • Fluency with the mechanics of major-gift fundraising: gift range charts, weighted pipelines, solicitation calendars, donor stewardship
  • A strong closer and relationship-builder, equally comfortable in a boardroom, a donor's living room, or a First Nations community hall
  • Comfortable operating with a lot of autonomy in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial organization, without an established playbook to follow
  • An active network across Canadian philanthropy (families, foundations, corporate giving), and the instinct to build one where it doesn't exist yet
  • Genuine interest in food security, Indigenous partnership, and community development
  • Willingness to travel regularly across Canada

Experience & Qualifications

  • As an executive director or head of development, you grew a previous organization's annual funding capacity from $1M to $10M+
  • A track record of personally closing gifts at the six- or seven-figure level
  • Comfort overseeing contractors, consultants, or a distributed team toward shared targets
  • Experience leading or structuring a capital campaign of $10M or more is an asset
  • CFRE designation is an asset but not required

How to Apply

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

Senior Meta Media Buyer

at Resilia || Remote - Worldwide

Resilia is hiring 1–2 senior Meta Media Buyers to take full, hands-on ownership of our Meta ad account.

Role Objective:

You are the pilot, and there is no co-pilot double-checking your work. You will own Resilia's Meta account end-to-end across Facebook and Instagram: structure, launches, budgets, scaling, and daily performance. We are looking for operators who have already run accounts at serious scale and can make high-stakes calls independently, quickly, and correctly. If you need sign-off on every budget change or someone reviewing each launch, this is not the role. If you want real budget, real authority, and real accountability, it is.

What You'll Do:

  • Full Account Ownership: Own the Meta account end-to-end, including structure, campaigns, budgets, and results, with no babysitting and no one re-checking your day-to-day decisions.
  • Budget Scaling at Volume: Run and scale high six-figure daily ad spend, managing pacing and allocation to hit CAC, MER, and margin targets.
  • Launch Velocity: Launch new ads and creative variations quickly and cleanly, with naming conventions, QA, and tracking right the first time, so testing never bottlenecks on execution.
  • Multi-SKU Structure: Manage multiple SKUs within one ad account under a clear, scalable structure, so spend allocation, learnings, and performance by product stay readable at all times.
  • Volatility Management: Diagnose and respond to performance swings in real time, including intra-day budget adjustments, separating noise from genuine decline, and knowing when to cut, hold, or push.
  • Testing Frameworks: Build and run structured tests across creatives, angles, offers, and audiences, and turn results into scaling decisions.
  • Creative Feedback: Translate account data into clear, actionable creative direction for the production team.
  • Reporting: Report performance against business KPIs, not just platform-reported numbers, with a clear point of view on what to do next.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Proven Track Record at Scale: You have personally managed high 7- to 8-figure total Meta ad spend.
  • High Daily Spend Experience: Hands-on experience running and managing high six-figure daily ad spend, and comfort making decisions where every hour carries real money.
  • 3–6+ Years Experience: Hands-on ownership of high-spend Meta accounts in DTC/e-commerce.
  • Advanced KPI Fluency: Strategic command of metrics well beyond native Meta reporting: MER/blended ROAS, new-customer CAC, contribution margin, LTV:CAC, payback period, marginal vs. average CPA, and incrementality. You know when platform numbers are misleading and what to trust instead.
  • Meta Performance Intuition: Deep understanding of how Meta delivery behaves, including learning phases, the effect of budget changes, CPM fluctuations, and intra-day and day-of-week patterns, and how to manage volatility without overreacting.
  • Multi-SKU Account Experience: You have run accounts with multiple products or SKUs without losing structure, clarity, or control of spend allocation.
  • Flawless Execution: A track record of launching high volumes of ads and creative variations seamlessly and without costly errors.
  • Platform Fluency: Deep knowledge of Advantage+, CBO/ABO, cost caps, bid caps, and manual bidding.
  • Attribution Knowledge: Familiarity with Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar tools, and comfort reconciling platform, third-party, and backend data.
  • Complete Autonomy: You work fully independently. You make the call, own the outcome, and communicate proactively, without needing supervision or approval on routine decisions.

WORKING HOURS: REMOTE-FIRST & ASYNCHRONOUS

We prioritize output over hours. However, because this role owns live budgets at high daily spend, we require strong overlap with US business hours (EST/PST) for real-time scaling, intra-day adjustments, and troubleshooting.

HOW TO APPLY

We value proof of performance. Please submit your resume along with a brief case study or ad account screenshots.

  • Spend proof: Screenshots showing total spend and peak daily spend on accounts you personally managed.
  • Scaling proof: An example of scaling an account to high daily spend while holding efficiency, with the targets you were working to.
  • Volatility example: A short write-up of a time performance swung sharply, what you saw, and what you did (including any intra-day moves).
  • Structure and testing: How you would structure a multi-SKU account and your preferred testing logic.

About Resilia:
Resilia is a fast-growing consumer packaged goods (CPG) and supplement brand dedicated to moving past generic health trends and delivering premium, highly credible wellness solutions. We blend cutting-edge formulation with authentic education to empower consumers to take control of their full-body health.

Interested candidates should apply directly for consideration. Upon submitting your application, our hiring team will review your credentials and will notify you if you are selected to participate in the interview process. We appreciate your interest in Resilia and kindly ask that you refrain from inquiries to our teams via LinkedIn.

No third party or agency submissions will be accepted

Resilia is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.

  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

Product and messaging input

jobs.description:
- This position is open to candidates located in Colombia or Costa Rica only -

FinOps Data Engineer – AI Cost & Usage Analytics

Gorilla Logic is looking for a FinOps Data Engineer – AI Cost & Usage Analytics to help build scalable data solutions that provide visibility into AI usage, consumption, and costs across multiple platforms and providers.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of data engineering, cloud financial management, and AI operations, building reliable pipelines that ingest usage and billing data from platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and other emerging AI technologies.

You will be responsible for transforming disparate usage and cost data into a unified data model in Google BigQuery and enabling trusted, self-service analytics through Power BI. You will collaborate closely with FinOps, Finance, Engineering, and other stakeholders to turn complex usage data into actionable insights that support cost allocation, forecasting, optimization, and informed decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest AI usage, billing, and consumption data from multiple providers and platforms.
  • Develop API integrations and scheduled data ingestion processes using Python, Cloud Functions, Cloud Composer/Airflow, or similar technologies.
  • Build reliable ingestion processes with appropriate error handling, retry mechanisms, monitoring, and data-quality validation.
  • Monitor vendor APIs and data schemas and adapt integrations as providers evolve.
  • Design and maintain a unified BigQuery data model that normalizes usage and billing data across AI providers, including token-based, consumption-based, and seat-based pricing models.
  • Build dimensional and analytical data models that support cost allocation and reporting across teams, business units, projects, providers, models, and cost centers.
  • Develop transformation workflows using SQL and tools such as dbt or Dataform to cleanse, deduplicate, normalize, and enrich data.
  • Integrate usage and cost data with organizational hierarchies, cost centers, and financial structures to support chargeback and showback reporting.
  • Optimize BigQuery datasets through effective partitioning, clustering, incremental processing, and query optimization.
  • Implement historical snapshots and slowly changing dimensions to support accurate trend and point-in-time analysis.
  • Apply appropriate data governance, security, access control, auditability, and PII-handling practices.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions that provide visibility into AI spend, consumption trends, cost allocation, budgets, forecasts, and utilization.
  • Optimize BigQuery-to-Power BI connectivity and data models to balance performance, scalability, cost, and data freshness.
  • Develop executive-ready dashboards while enabling detailed drill-down analysis for Engineering, Finance, FinOps, and other stakeholders.
  • Implement appropriate row-level security and access controls within Power BI.
  • Partner with FinOps and business stakeholders to define meaningful cost and usage metrics, KPIs, and anomaly-detection logic.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, and AI spend optimization initiatives with accurate and trusted data.
  • Maintain clear documentation for data lineage, pipeline architecture, transformation logic, and reporting definitions.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes and continuously improve the reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency of the data platform.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment, contributing to technical decisions, planning, and continuous improvement.

Technical Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience designing and maintaining analytical data models.
  • Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery or comparable cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake or Amazon Redshift.
  • Strong experience building data pipelines using Python.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow, Google Cloud Composer, Dagster, or similar tools.
  • Hands-on experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication, OAuth, pagination, rate limiting, and error handling.
  • Experience designing reliable data ingestion, transformation, validation, and monitoring processes.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI, including semantic/data modeling, DAX, dashboard development, and report optimization.
  • Understanding of cloud billing and cost data structures across platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience working with Git and version-controlled development workflows.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD practices for data pipelines and transformation code.
  • Understanding of dimensional modeling, incremental processing, historical data management, and data-quality practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with complex or ambiguous data requirements.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of FinOps principles, practices, and frameworks; FinOps Foundation certification is a plus.
  • Experience integrating with AI/LLM usage or billing APIs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI/Gemini, Azure OpenAI, or GitHub Copilot.
  • Experience with dbt or Dataform for data transformation, testing, and documentation.
  • Experience with enterprise cost allocation, chargeback, or showback models.
  • Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) technologies.
  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance practices in enterprise environments.
  • Experience building cost analytics, anomaly detection, forecasting, or cloud optimization solutions.

jobs.description:
Working Schedule: Pacific Standard Time

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote (Work From Home)

Salary: $1,600 - $2,000

Employer: MSP company operating in Florida, USA

Overview

The Service Technician is responsible for providing first-line technical support to end users by handling inbound calls, portal tickets, and email requests. This role focuses on diagnosing and resolving user issues, delivering excellent customer service, and achieving first-contact resolution whenever possible.

Working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment, the technician will troubleshoot a broad range of hardware, software, endpoint, Microsoft 365, and basic networking issues. The ideal candidate has a solid technical foundation, strong troubleshooting skills, and the experience to resolve user issues efficiently while recognizing when escalation to specialized teams is necessary.

Responsibilities

  • Handle all inbound technical support requests through phone calls, the ticketing portal, and email, serving as the first point of contact for end users.
  • Diagnose and resolve user issues, prioritizing first-contact resolution whenever possible.
  • Troubleshoot Windows/macOS issues, operating system errors, application problems, imaging, and driver conflicts.
  • Investigate network-related problems, including DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs, within the scope of assigned responsibilities.
  • Perform basic server administration and troubleshooting tasks involving Active Directory, Group Policy, and file/print servers.
  • Troubleshoot and support Microsoft 365 services, email issues, mailbox access, and related user requests.
  • Assist with virtualization issues involving Hyper-V and VMware, as well as basic cloud infrastructure troubleshooting.
  • Address security-related issues, including antivirus/EDR alerts, MFA troubleshooting, and access control.
  • Utilize remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools, remote support utilities, PowerShell, and other available tools to investigate and resolve technical issues.
  • Document troubleshooting steps, findings, and resolutions accurately in the ticketing system.
  • Follow established IT service management practices for incident handling, ticket management, and problem resolution.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to Tier 2, Tier 3, or specialized teams when necessary, providing clear documentation of troubleshooting steps and findings.
  • Meet established service-level agreements (SLAs) for response times, ticket updates, and resolution targets.
  • Identify recurring technical issues and recommend solutions to improve service quality and reduce repeat tickets.
  • Contribute to the internal knowledge base by documenting common issues, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices.
  • Communicate clearly with end users and relevant stakeholders, providing timely updates and setting appropriate expectations for resolution.
  • Deliver consistent, professional customer service while managing multiple tickets and prioritizing requests based on urgency and impact.

Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows/macOS endpoints, common business applications, and end-user computing environments.
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and networking fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration and troubleshooting, including user accounts, email, and access-related issues.
  • Understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based services, including Azure and AWS, and basic cloud infrastructure troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of endpoint security solutions, antivirus/EDR tools, MFA, and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience using RMM tools and remote support platforms in an IT support environment.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell, scripting, or automation techniques is an advantage.
  • Ability to recognize the limits of Tier 1 support and determine when escalation is appropriate.

Experience & Education

  • 3–5 years of experience in IT support, technical support, service desk operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience handling inbound support requests and managing tickets in an MSP or similar customer-facing IT environment is preferred.
  • Relevant certifications are an advantage, including CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft certifications, or ITIL 4.
  • Equivalent practical experience and demonstrated technical troubleshooting ability will also be considered.

jobs.description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Position Description

Under the direction of the Director of Compliance Monitoring, the Manager, CIP Compliance leads and oversees Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) compliance monitoring activities within NPCC's Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement Program (CMEP). The position is responsible for managing CIP compliance monitoring engagements, supervising staff, supporting risk-based compliance monitoring initiatives, and fostering effective relationships with Registered Entities and ERO Enterprise stakeholders.

The Manager assists with the development and implementation of compliance monitoring strategies and programs, oversees the performance and quality of CIP compliance monitoring activities, and ensures compliance monitoring engagements are conducted in accordance with NERC Rules of Procedure, NPCC CMEP processes, and applicable Canadian provincial agreements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensures processes and procedures are established, maintained, and continuously improved to support CIP Compliance Audits, Self-Certifications, Spot Checks, and other compliance monitoring activities.
  • Periodically reviews and updates compliance monitoring processes to incorporate changes to NERC Rules of Procedure, CMEP guidance, FERC Orders, Canadian agreements, emerging risks, and ERO Enterprise initiatives.
  • Supports the implementation of risk-based compliance monitoring activities through the evaluation of entity risks, internal controls, compliance history, and other relevant risk indicators.
  • Assists in the development and execution of annual compliance monitoring plans, monitoring strategies, and related program initiatives.
  • Supports the Director of Compliance Monitoring in developing, maintaining, and reporting compliance monitoring documentation, records, metrics, and key performance indicators.
  • Manages CIP compliance monitoring engagements across the United States and Canada in accordance with NERC Rules of Procedure, NPCC programs, and applicable provincial agreements.
  • Serves as Audit Team Lead for assigned engagements, directing audit activities, coordinating resources, facilitating team discussions, reviewing work products, and ensuring the quality and consistency of engagement results.
  • Assists in developing compliance monitoring scopes using risk-informed considerations, including inherent risk assessments, internal controls evaluations, compliance history, and other relevant factors.
  • Reviews audit workpapers, engagement documentation, reports, and other compliance monitoring deliverables to ensure accuracy, consistency, quality, and adherence to NPCC and ERO Enterprise expectations.
  • Ensures compliance monitoring activities are completed in accordance with established timelines and milestones, including notifications, evidence submissions, interviews, site visits, report development, entity comment periods, and final report issuance.

Physical Requirements
