jobs.excerpt: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) $62K-80K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

jobs.title: AI 3D Exhibition Designer – Design Systems & Automation
jobs.excerpt: Are you an AI-driven 3D exhibition designer who can help transform how exhibition stands are designed?
jobs.description:
Are you an AI-driven 3D exhibition designer who can help transform how exhibition stands are designed?

We’re looking for a 3D Exhibition Design Automation Lead to join Expo Centric and help us build the next generation of AI-assisted exhibition design workflows.

This is not a standard 3D Exhibition Designer role.

We are looking for someone who is already confident using AI tools in a practical design environment — not just experimenting with AI images, but using AI to improve design thinking, concept development, workflow speed, documentation, production accuracy and team capability.

The right person will have a strong understanding of 3D exhibition or spatial design, but they must also be highly capable and genuinely experienced in AI-assisted workflows.

You will help Expo Centric explore, test, build and implement AI systems that can support how we design, document and deliver exhibition stands.

You’ll help us answer practical questions such as:

  • How can AI help interpret client briefs and generate better design directions faster?
  • How can AI support 3D exhibition stand concepts, layouts and visualisation?
  • How can AI help designers use rental inventory and modular systems more effectively?
  • How can AI support CAD/Revit workflows, production drawings and handover documentation?
  • How do we prevent AI from creating designs that look impressive but cannot be built?
  • How do we train the design team to use AI properly and consistently?

At Expo Centric, we design and deliver exhibition stands, brand activations and event environments for clients across Australia and beyond. We are now looking for someone who can help us move beyond traditional design methods and build a smarter, AI-enabled design process.

You’ll be part designer, part AI workflow builder, part systems thinker and part trainer.

At Expo Centric, we don’t just fill roles — we build teams that create extraordinary experiences. Every position here plays a key part in delivering projects that wow our clients and help us grow.

You’ll be part of a company that lives by its core values: Courage, Curiosity, Selflessness, Judgement, and Communication.

🎥 Discover what we do at Expo Centric:


🔍 What You’ll Do

  • Lead the research, testing and implementation of AI tools for exhibition design, 3D concept development, design automation and production workflows.
  • Build AI-assisted workflows that help convert client briefs into practical exhibition stand concepts, layouts, design directions and proposal content.
  • Use AI to support faster ideation, moodboards, design rationale, render prompts, layout options and concept refinement.
  • Explore how AI can support CAD, Revit, BIM, SketchUp, Rhino, 3D modelling and production drawing workflows.
  • Help create a structured AI design knowledge base that can support Expo Centric’s design standards, rental inventory, modular systems and production constraints.
  • Develop prompt libraries, AI workflows, design templates, review checklists, QA steps and standard operating procedures.
  • Test AI tools and clearly document what works, what does not work, and what should not be used.
  • Work closely with 3D designers, production designers, project managers, estimators, factory teams and external AI or automation specialists where required.
  • Train design and production team members on how to use AI tools safely, consistently and effectively.
  • Create safeguards so AI-generated outputs are reviewed for buildability, accuracy, budget, modular system logic and production practicality.
  • Help build a long-term roadmap for repeatable AI-assisted exhibition design and production drawing systems.

✅ What You Bring

  • Strong hands-on experience using AI tools in design, 3D, creative production, automation, visualisation or workflow improvement.
  • A strong understanding of 3D exhibition design, spatial design, experiential design, production design, architecture, industrial design, computational design or a related field.
  • Practical experience using AI to support concept development, image generation, design iteration, workflow automation, prompt creation, research, documentation or production improvement.
  • Confidence testing AI tools and judging whether they are genuinely useful or just visually impressive.
  • Strong understanding of how exhibition concepts become buildable, documented and installed environments.
  • Experience with 3D design, CAD documentation, Revit/BIM workflows, production drawings, fabrication packs or technical drawing systems.
  • Practical knowledge of materials, modular systems, custom fabrication, flooring, lighting, graphics and installation logic.
  • Ability to structure information clearly so AI tools can use it reliably.
  • Ability to create prompt libraries, workflows, templates, checklists or repeatable design processes.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to train designers and non-technical team members on new AI tools and workflows.
  • A practical mindset — you understand that AI outputs still need human review, production logic and commercial judgement.

🤖 AI Experience We Are Looking For

This role requires more than general curiosity about AI.

We are looking for someone who can show practical experience with one or more of the following:

  • Using AI tools to support design concepts, spatial design, 3D design or creative workflows.
  • Creating structured prompts, prompt libraries or AI workflow templates.
  • Testing AI tools and comparing outputs for quality, accuracy and usability.
  • Using AI to improve speed, consistency or quality in a design process.
  • Combining AI with tools such as CAD, Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, Grasshopper, 3ds Max, Blender, Adobe tools or other design software.
  • Using AI for research, brief interpretation, concept development, image generation, design narratives or documentation.
  • Understanding the risks of AI hallucination, inaccurate outputs and over-reliance.
  • Building or contributing to AI-assisted systems, agents, automations or knowledge bases.
  • Training others on how to use AI tools effectively and responsibly.

You do not need to be a software engineer, but you must be genuinely strong in AI-assisted design workflows and confident helping a design team adopt AI in a practical way.

🌟 Tools & Experience That Would Be Highly Valued

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:

  • ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini or similar AI assistants
  • Midjourney / DALL·E / Stable Diffusion / Firefly or similar image generation tools
  • AI agents or AI workflow automation tools
  • Prompt engineering or structured prompt libraries
  • Revit
  • AutoCAD
  • 3ds Max
  • SketchUp
  • Rhino / Grasshopper
  • Blender
  • SolidWorks
  • Fusion 360
  • Vectorworks
  • Dynamo
  • Python
  • CAD automation
  • BIM automation
  • Parametric design
  • Generative design
  • CNC workflows
  • Aluvision, BeMatrix, Octanorm or similar modular exhibition systems

You do not need to have used every tool listed. However, you do need to be confident using AI as a serious design and workflow tool, not just as a visual experiment.

🌟 Why Join Expo Centric?

  • Lead a real AI transformation project inside a growing exhibition design and build company.
  • Move beyond traditional 3D design into AI, automation, design systems and workflow leadership.
  • Help shape how Expo Centric uses AI across design, production and project delivery.
  • Work on practical AI tools that improve real project outcomes, not just experimental concepts.
  • Collaborate with design, production, project management, estimating, factory and installation teams.
  • Build workflows that make the design team faster, sharper and more competitive.
  • Access ongoing mentoring from senior leaders and performance-based growth pathways.
  • Contribute to a growing business where your expertise shapes real outcomes.
  • Be part of a company that values Courage, Curiosity, Selflessness, Judgement and Communication.

This Role Will Suit Someone Who

  • Is already using AI regularly in their design or creative workflow.
  • Gets excited about building better systems, not just producing individual designs.
  • Understands that AI is powerful but needs structure, testing and human review.
  • Can tell the difference between a useful AI tool and a gimmick.
  • Enjoys solving design, technical and workflow problems.
  • Understands that exhibition stands need to be buildable, not just visually impressive.
  • Wants to help train a design team to use AI properly.
  • Can work across creative, technical and operational teams.
  • Is comfortable testing unfinished tools and turning messy ideas into practical workflows.
  • Wants to help build the system that supports the future of exhibition design.

This Role Is Not For Someone Who

  • Only wants a traditional 3D exhibition designer role.
  • Has only used AI casually or has no practical AI experience.
  • Only creates AI images without understanding design workflow, buildability or production requirements.
  • Is not interested in systems, process, documentation or team training.
  • Believes AI can replace human design judgement without review.
  • Cannot work with real-world constraints such as budget, materials, modular systems, venue rules and production deadlines.

Ready to Apply?

Submit your CV and a short cover letter outlining how your experience aligns with this role.

Please include:

  • Your 3D exhibition design, spatial design or technical design experience.
  • The AI tools you have used and how you have used them in a design or workflow context.
  • Any examples of AI-assisted design, automation, prompt libraries, workflow improvements or design systems you have worked on.
  • Any experience you have with CAD, Revit, BIM, production drawings or fabrication workflows.
  • Why this role interests you.

Life is too short to work with jerks.

Join our team at NCD, a top-tier insurance provider, consisting of a unique and eclectic group of winners, nerds, and gamers who balance a fun, kind, and thoughtful approach to life with an unwavering commitment to unparalleled member satisfaction. NCD is at the forefront of dental and vision insurance, in partnership with our carrier partners MetLife, VSP, and Zurich. Our continuous growth is a testament to our commitment to delivering outstanding agent and customer satisfaction.

If you are ready to win each day, are eager to grow, and aspire to contribute to an organization that is setting the pace in the industry, then we are looking for you. Together, let’s drive change and take NCD to new heights. Join us and become a vital part of our success story as we continue to transform lives and 'Spread the Smile.

Summary

This position is responsible for researching and providing resolutions for negative online reviews, escalated claims issues, and formal member complaints in a timely and effective manner. This includes reviewing the clinical details of escalated dental and vision claims — procedure coding, clinical documentation, and carrier clinical/consultant review determinations — to confirm whether outcomes were applied correctly and to explain them clearly to members. The successful candidate will have excellent research, problem-solving, and communication skills, along with a working knowledge of dental/clinical claim concepts, to help maintain and improve our company's reputation and customer satisfaction.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Monitor and review customer feedback, complaints, and negative reviews across various online platforms, including social media, review websites, and customer support channels.
  • Research and analyze complex issues related to customer complaints and escalated claims, identifying patterns, root causes, and potential resolutions.
  • Review the clinical details of escalated and denied dental and vision claims — including CDT procedure codes, tooth- and quadrant-level detail, clinical narratives, radiographs, and Explanations of Benefits (EOBs) — to determine whether claim outcomes were applied correctly (e.g., covered vs. non-covered procedures, frequency and age limitations, waiting periods, and missing-tooth provisions).
  • Interpret carrier clinical and consultant claim-review determinations (e.g., MetLife, Zurich) and translate clinical denial rationale into clear, empathetic, plain-language explanations for members.
  • Coordinate with carrier clinical reviewers, dental consultants, and provider offices to obtain the clinical records, radiographs, narratives, and pre-authorization documentation needed to research and resolve disputes.
  • Evaluate coordination of benefits (COB) at the procedure level, and identify clinical denial patterns that may indicate systemic issues or regulatory (DOI) complaint risk.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including MC Training, Engineering, and Sales and Marketing, to gather necessary information and develop comprehensive solutions for member issues.
  • Resolve escalated member issues in a timely and professional manner, ensuring customer satisfaction and maintaining a positive company brand and image.
  • Communicate with customers through various channels, including email, phone, text, and online review platforms to address concerns, provide updates, and resolve issues.
  • Document all interactions, findings, and resolutions in our customer relationship management (CRM) system, maintaining accurate and up-to-date records.
  • Support fraud, waste, and abuse review through clinical claim and provider-signal analysis, including case documentation and referral preparation.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and recommend changes to enhance the overall member experience.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and best practices for the department.
  • Participate in ongoing training and development opportunities to stay current on industry trends, best practices, and company policies.
  • Perform additional tasks and duties as assigned by the management team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in customer service, with a focus on research, problem-solving, and issue resolution; dental, vision, or health insurance claims experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of dental terminology and CDT dental procedure coding, and familiarity with clinical claim-adjudication concepts such as dental necessity, frequency and age limitations, waiting periods, and missing-tooth provisions.
  • Experience reviewing clinical documentation, dental records, radiographs, or EOBs — for example, in a dental front/back office, dental billing and coding, or dental/health insurance claims role.
  • Ability to interpret clinical denial rationale and explain it to members in clear, non-technical language.
  • Dental coding or clinical certification a plus (e.g., Certified Dental Coder (CDC), RDA/CDA, or a claims/coding certification).
  • Strong analytical and research skills, with the ability to identify patterns and root causes of complex issues.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a focus on empathy, professionalism, and active listening.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and build positive relationships.
  • Proficiency in product knowledge and using CRM systems and standard office software, including Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated commitment to providing exceptional customer service and maintaining a positive company reputation.

 NCD Benefits:

  • Company-paid health, dental, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Opportunity for professional development
  • Work from home allowance and support
  • Positive work environment

 Equal Opportunity

NCD is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe our differences make us stronger and help us better serve our members, agents, partners, and each other.

About Trualta

At Trualta, we empower families to help loved ones age in place. Our clinically validated digital health platform brings professional-level training to individuals caring for loved ones with dementia, intellectual or developmental disabilities, Parkinson's Disease, stroke, and other illnesses. Our expanding content library continues to adapt to the unique needs of family caregivers. Caregiving is a serious challenge for many Americans with more than 15% of American workers reporting they are providing ongoing care for a loved one, making a solution like Trualta more valuable than ever.

About the Role

Caregivers often deal with isolation and uncertainty, and long to connect with someone who simply understands. As a Care Coach, that's your mission: through empathy and relationship-building, you'll facilitate virtual group support sessions that give family caregivers a safe, accepted space to be heard and to build confidence in caring for their loved ones.

This is a focused, part-time role for a licensed clinician who wants to use a few hours a week to make a meaningful difference for caregivers.

About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Engine is building the travel and spend management platform for the businesses the rest of the industry overlooked — two products, one ecosystem, growing fast and already cash-flow positive. Partnerships are how we extend that reach, and this role runs the team that turns partnership opportunities into signed, activated, revenue-producing relationships.

We're looking for a Director, Partner Acquisition to lead and scale our channel partnerships team across verticals — GPOs, trade associations, marketplaces, franchise networks and conglomerates, and technology partners — chartered to sign referral, co-sell, and co-marketing partnerships across Engine's full ecosystem. This is an operationally rigorous, enterprise-grade sales leader — a player-coach who installs discipline, builds the vertical playbook from the ground up, and personally drives complex deals across the line.

Reporting to the VP, Business Development, this role owns the front end of partner-sourced growth: a high-throughput engine that prospects, signs, activates, and hands off producing partners to Partner Growth — across every vertical and product.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the team and own the number. Build a team of channel professionals and scale it to 6–8 — at least one per vertical — against clear pipeline, signing, activation, and handoff targets. Set the standard, run the cadence, and hold the line on accountability.
  • Build the vertical playbook. This is a ground-up build with direct influence over vertical strategy and the GTM motion: define the ICP, sourcing mix, and deal structures for each vertical, and codify what works into a repeatable playbook the team runs.
  • Convert and executive-sponsor deals. Operate as a player-coach: step into live opportunities, unblock stalled deals, and personally push complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships across the finish line.
  • Run an operationally rigorous funnel. Install and enforce pipeline discipline — stage gates, time-in-stage, win rates by tier, sourcing channel mix, forecast accuracy, categorized loss reasons, and clean Salesforce hygiene. Make partner-sourced growth predictable, not anecdotal.
  • Sign quality across the full ecosystem. Drive referral, co-sell, and co-marketing agreements spanning Engine Travel and Spend — with at least one rep carrying the full platform into their vertical. Tier mix and committed volume matter as much as logo count.
  • Structure deals that hold up. Negotiate commercially sound, operationally executable partnerships — economics, mutual commitments, and activation plans that survive contact with reality. Own days-in-contracting as a number, not an excuse.
  • Drive activation and a clean handoff, not just signatures. Own time-to-activation, cohort activation rates, and the handoff trigger to Partner Growth — and hold your team accountable to production vs. projection at signing. A partner that signs but never produces is a miss, and the forecast your rep made is the forecast they answer for.
  • Execute cross-functionally. Align Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal to move deals from term sheet to live — fast.
  • Raise the bar on talent. Hire, ramp, and level up channel talent; build a team that compounds in output as it gains context.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in channel sales or partnerships, including 5+ years leading and scaling quota-carrying teams — ideally in high-growth SaaS, fintech, marketplace, or travel technology.
  • A closer and a coach: a proven record of personally converting complex, multi-stakeholder deals, and of building teams that consistently hit signing and activation targets.
  • A builder: has walked into a small team, figured out the build, created the playbook, and scaled it — not just inherited a machine that already ran.
  • Deep operational rigor — fluency in pipeline management, forecasting, stage discipline, and the metrics that make a partnership funnel predictable: conversion by tier, time-in-stage, activation cohorts, and production vs. projection. Salesforce proficiency expected.
  • Multi-motion range: comfort selling and structuring across referral, co-sell, and co-marketing — and across partner types from GPOs and trade associations to marketplaces, franchise networks, and ERP/technology partners.
  • Strong commercial negotiation skills with a bias toward partnerships that activate — not vanity logos.
  • A direct, data-backed communicator who gives and receives hard feedback without flinching.
  • Thrives on speed, high standards, and ambiguity; uses AI and automation to scale both personal and team output.
  • Bonus: experience with two-sided marketplaces, embedded / API distribution, or corporate cards and spend management.

Applications for this role will be accepted through December 31, 2026 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. Overview

The Senior Solutions Analyst serves as the solution-design bridge between business discovery and technical delivery on PhoenixTeam’s Department of the Interior modernization program. Working primarily across data, integration, intake, financial-integrity, and automation initiatives, the role takes validated business requirements and future-state workflows and turns them into clear solution designs that PhoenixTeam’s technical teams can prototype and build.

The strongest candidates combine senior solutions and systems analysis skills with an engineering or architecture mindset. They understand modern enterprise technology well enough to evaluate feasibility, identify enabling datasets and technical dependencies, ask strong technical questions, and keep business need, requirements, solution design, prototype, testing, and user acceptance aligned.

The Senior Solutions Analyst works in small cross-functional delivery pods, stays embedded with business and technical teammates throughout delivery, and uses LLMs and other AI tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, solution exploration, and lightweight prototyping and validation.

Key Functions

  • Lead solution-focused discovery and process assessments with business analysts, process specialists, architects, data engineers, developers, and stakeholders to understand business needs, future-state workflows, dependencies, constraints, and implementation considerations.
  • Translate validated requirements and future-state workflows into solution designs covering user interactions, business rules, data, enabling datasets, APIs and integrations, automation, low-code capabilities, and AI-enabled components.
  • Identify source systems, enabling datasets, data-quality and validation needs, interface requirements, integration points, environment dependencies, and technical assumptions needed to make proposed solutions feasible and buildable.
  • Maintain end-to-end traceability from business need to requirement, solution design, prototype, test scenario, and user acceptance so evolving solutions remain aligned with the intended outcome.
  • Evaluate solution approaches for feasibility, scalability, interoperability, security, accessibility, maintainability, and operational fit, and communicate technical options and tradeoffs clearly to business and technical stakeholders.
  • Leverage LLMs and other AI tools to support research, analysis, solution documentation, solution exploration, and lightweight prototyping or validation.
  • Produce and maintain solution-design artifacts such as solution diagrams, data flows, interface and integration requirements, validation rules, decision and assumption logs, and implementation guidance; provide solution context needed for downstream SOPs, job aids, and adoption materials.
  • Stay embedded through prototyping, pilot testing, refinement, and user acceptance; evaluate whether prototypes satisfy requirements and help resolve gaps between the business need and delivered solution.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of relevant experience in solutions analysis, systems analysis, solution design, technical consulting, architecture support, business systems analysis, or related modernization work.
  • Demonstrated experience translating complex business requirements and future-state workflows into technical or functional solution designs for software, integration, automation, data, low-code, or AI-enabled initiatives.

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineer Manager role, aligning how we lead teams to best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks.

As our Solutions Consultant Manager, you are the technical leader for your District Solutions Consulting team. You will work closely with the District Sales Manager and, along with your team, build relationships with your customers with the goal of helping them detect and prevent advanced cyberattacks and breaches. Our customers need guidance on what applications to deploy from our platform. Your guidance, expertise, and mentorship of your team will keep them ahead of the latest cyberthreats and stay on the leading edge of prevention.

As the technical leader for your assigned territory, you will guide and develop your team to define innovative technical solutions that secure customers' key business imperatives and maximize the value of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You will champion our industry leadership in on-premises, cloud, and security operations services, establishing Palo Alto Networks as the preferred cybersecurity partner for your customers. You will also nurture talent within your team and provide valuable feedback to the product management team on new feature requests and product improvements based on insights gained from your customer interaction. Your team will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks.

  • Act as an escalation point to collaborate with pre-sales and post-sales teams for any issues that arise

  • Working with Product Management, Technical Marketing, and R&D to build requirements and product features for our large customers and provide feedback from customers

jobs.title: RevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About ImprovadoImprovado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.
jobs.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

jobs.description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.excerpt: Position Title: Chief Growth Officer Reports to: Executive Director Team: 2 FTEs on partnerships + 1 marketing contractor Role Type: Full-Time Employee About Us:The Student Basic Needs Coalition (SBNC) is building the national model for connecting students with public benefits and basic needs resources.
jobs.description:
Position Title: Chief Growth Officer

Reports to: Executive Director

Team: 2 FTEs on partnerships + 1 marketing contractor

Role Type: Full-Time Employee

About Us:

The Student Basic Needs Coalition (SBNC) is building the national model for connecting students with public benefits and basic needs resources.

Millions of students are eligible for programs like SNAP and Medicaid, yet the majority never enroll due to complex rules, stigma, and administrative barriers. SBNC addresses this gap by partnering with organizations across the country to implement peer-led outreach programs and deploy Navvy, SBNC’s AI-enabled technology platform that screens students for benefits eligibility and supports the enrollment process.

Since launching in 2020, SBNC has grown rapidly. The organization now partners with 100+ campuses nationwide, has screened more than 50,000 students, and has referred students to over $116 million in potential public benefits. In 2024, SBNC hired its first full-time Executive Director and has since grown to a $2 million organization with a team of seven, expanding to ten staff members this year as it scales its national model.

Position Overview:

SBNC is hiring its first Chief Growth Officer (CGO) to turn strong demand and a growing national network into a repeatable growth and earned-revenue model. We already work with 100+ campuses and regularly hear interest from colleges, systems, states, funders, and other partners, but we have not yet built a sales engine or established pricing for our offerings. The CGO will help determine which institutional segments to prioritize, how to position and package our work, what institutions are willing to pay for, and how to move from interest and pilots to recurring paid partnerships. They will work closely with the Executive Director on SBNC’s highest-priority sales and relationships while building the systems, pipeline, and team needed to make growth increasingly repeatable. This role does not own fundraising; the CGO coordinates with the Executive Director so growth, partner, and funder messaging stay aligned.

The CGO will also lead SBNC's marketing, building our brand and positioning with institutional buyers while owning our direct-to-student and alternative distribution strategy. That includes deciding where investments in digital channels, creator partnerships, and non-campus partners such as national nonprofits, food banks, and workforce programs can most effectively connect students to Navvy. Direct-to-student channels are measured on reach and impact; earned revenue comes from institutional partnerships.

Growth doesn't end at a signed agreement. The CGO will own renewal and expansion, build a partner-success model that sets new partners up to launch well, and close the loop between the field and product so partner and student insights shape how Navvy evolves.

This is a player-coach role for someone who can move between strategy and execution: shaping go-to-market and pricing, personally advancing important partnerships, using data to decide where to invest, developing staff, and working closely with product and the executive team as SBNC scales. The ideal candidate's deepest strength will be institutional sales and partnerships, paired with the judgment to lead marketing and use data to test which channels best reach students.

Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Leadership (15%)

  • Set SBNC's growth and marketing strategy across institutional and direct-to-student channels, identifying priority markets, segments, and distribution opportunities based on data, partner feedback, and org positioning
  • Achieve targets for Navvy screener adoption, partnerships, and revenue, reporting performance to the executive team, funders, and board on a regular cadence
  • Own and evolve SBNC’s go-to-market strategy for paid offerings, including market research, customer segmentation, positioning, packaging, pricing, pilot design, sales motion, and testing what institutions will pay for
  • Manage, lead and build the growth function over time, including defining roles, systems, processes, developing staff, and planning future hiring needs as the team expands

Business Development & Earned Revenue (40%)

  • Build and manage a strong, nationwide pipeline of campus, state, system, and other institutional partners
  • Lead partnership development and sales strategy from initial outreach through negotiation, close, and implementation, with direct personal ownership of the organization's highest-stakes system and state-level relationships and managerial oversight of all partnerships
  • Use Hubspot CRM data and forecasting to drive pipeline visibility and data-informed decisions across the growth team
  • Diversify and scale SBNC's earned-revenue base so it grows alongside philanthropic revenue, ensuring pricing and packaging decisions preserve equitable student access as well as organizational sustainability
  • Hold accountability for the earned-revenue P&L, setting annual and multi-year targets in partnership with the COO

Partner Success & Field Learning (25%)

  • Build a scalable partner-success model, ensuring new partners launch successfully with the support, tools, and expectations needed to drive student and staff engagement
  • Own renewal and expansion strategy and targets, identifying opportunities to deepen relationships, improve retention, and grow revenue over time
  • Partner closely with the Chief Product Officer to ensure Navvy is delivered effectively to campuses/partners, owning the feedback loop so partner and student experience insights inform product development
  • Sponsor and sustain the growth team's community of practice among institutional partners, translating field learnings into documented, replicable practices that inform SBNC's tiered engagement model and go-to-market approach
  • Track partner satisfaction and account status as core success measures

Marketing & Direct-to-Student Reach (20%)

  • Lead demand generation, brand awareness, and growth marketing efforts, managing contractors and external partners as budget allows
  • Build SBNC's brand and positioning with institutional buyers through case studies, conference presence, thought leadership, and sales enablement materials that support pipeline growth
  • Own SBNC's direct-to-student reach strategy, testing channels such as creator partnerships, social, search, and referral to connect students not served through campus partners
  • Build non-campus distribution partnerships (e.g., national nonprofits, food banks, workforce programs) that embed Navvy where students already seek help
  • Run a structured channel-testing portfolio with clear hypotheses, success thresholds, and stop criteria, scaling what works and sunsetting what doesn't
  • Track reach and efficiency metrics (completed screenings, cost per completed screening, downstream benefit applications)

Skills and Competencies

We recognize that some individuals from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don't meet 100% of the listed qualifications. Please don't let that discourage you from applying! We value the unique skills, experiences, and perspectives that each applicant brings, and we encourage you to apply if you believe your background demonstrates the required skills and competencies.

Required for all Roles at SBNC:

  • Commitment to SBNC's mission to help postsecondary students connect to the resources they need to stay enrolled, complete their education, and build a foundation for economic mobility.
  • Treating students as co-designers, not only people we serve, and prioritizing those facing the greatest barriers first, true to our value of Lead With Students.
  • Resourcefulness and a sense of urgency in removing friction between students and the benefits they qualify for, while maintaining a high bar for quality and follow-through, our value of Unlock Every Dollar.
  • A commitment to Design for Scale by thinking a step ahead of where the organization is today, prioritizing what matters most, and building for the next campus, policy shift, or student barrier before it arrives.
  • Comfort wearing multiple hats, Owning the Outcome, asking for help when stuck, and showing up for teammates when it counts. A startup mentality.
  • Treating growth and innovation as an ongoing habit and leaning on the team to Learn Together by seeking feedback, sharing it openly, and adapting when needed.

Required for this Role:

  • Functional or executive-level leadership experience with 7+ years of management experience, including significant experience leading growth, partnerships, business development, sales, or a related function, while remaining willing and able to perform individual-contributor-level work
  • Personally owned and drove at least $500K in annual recurring revenue from higher education institutions, government agencies, systems, or similarly complex institutional buyers
  • Experience leading both new business development and partner success/expansion, including renewals and upsells
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategy, including market research, positioning, pricing, pipeline development, and testing what drives adoption
  • Experience partnering with or overseeing marketing to drive pipeline or adoption
  • Experience building systems, processes, or a team from the ground up in an early-stage or resource-constrained environment, rather than solely optimizing an existing function
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to navigate complex institutions and influence senior decision-makers
  • Strategic and analytical mindset, using market feedback, performance data, experimentation, and CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) to refine growth strategy

Preferred for this Role:

  • Experience converting grant-funded or free pilots into paid, recurring offerings, including repricing existing partners and managing the shift in partner and funder expectations
  • Familiarity with how colleges, systems, and state agencies budget and buy, including procurement cycles, RFPs, and grant-funded purchasing
  • Experience pricing offerings in a mission-driven context, balancing access with sustainability (e.g., tiered or sliding-scale models)
  • Experience in SaaS or tech-enabled services, partnering with product teams to turn customer feedback into roadmap priorities
  • Experience building brand and sales enablement for institutional buyers, such as case studies, conference strategy, and thought leadership
  • Experience growing awareness or adoption through marketing or non-enterprise channels, such as digital or consumer marketing, community or channel partnerships, or product-led growth, with fluency in funnel metrics
  • Experience reaching students, young adults, or low-income communities through digital channels, creators, or community organizations
  • Experience managing external marketing agencies or contractors and deploying a marketing budget
  • Knowledge of public benefits programs or student basic needs
  • Experience building practitioner networks or communities of practice

Other Logistics

  • Location: Fully Remote
  • Full-time: 5-day work week, 40-45 hours
  • Salary Range: $170,000 (SBNC posts a single, non-negotiable salary per role) plus a 10% target performance bonus.
  • Timeline: Applications will reviewed on a rolling basis until 10/27

We take care of our employees by providing the following perks and benefits:

  • Medical insurance (100% Paid Employee Only Coverage, 50% for dependents)
  • Flexible PTO (after a 90-day introductory period)
  • 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave
  • 11 federally recognized holidays
  • Paid Org-wide office closures: March (1 week); July (1 week); November (1 week); End of year (2 weeks)
  • Starter 401(k) retirement plan
  • Home office setup stipend

As a small nonprofit, please note that we do not, at present, provide the following benefits.

  • Disability income insurance or life insurance
  • Employer matches for retirement contributions
  • Dental or vision insurance

Remote Work & Sponsorship

Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in one of the 50 U.S. states or the District of Columbia. U.S. territories and work from abroad are not eligible. SBNC does not offer visa sponsorship.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Building an inclusive, high-performing team that is diverse across lines of personal identity is integral to our success and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

This means we do not discriminate against any job applicant or employee because of their race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

Job Title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Role Summary

The CISO is responsible for establishing and leading the organization's cybersecurity strategy, protecting information assets, systems, and infrastructure from evolving threats. This role ensures robust security governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance while enabling secure business growth and digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Cybersecurity Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with business objectives
  • Advise CEO, Board, and executive leadership on cyber risks and mitigation strategies
  • Build a security-first culture across the organization

2. Security Architecture & Operations

  • Oversee security architecture across networks, applications, cloud, and endpoints
  • Ensure implementation of security controls, monitoring, and threat detection
  • Lead Security Operations Center (SOC) and incident response capabilities

3. Risk Management & Governance

  • Establish cybersecurity risk management frameworks and policies
  • Conduct risk assessments, vulnerability management, and penetration testing
  • Align with standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, and CIS Controls

4. Compliance & Regulatory Oversight

  • Ensure compliance with regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and local cybersecurity laws

5. Incident Response & Resilience

  • Lead incident response planning, crisis management, and breach handling
  • Ensure business continuity and disaster recovery readiness
  • Conduct simulations and tabletop exercises

6. Identity & Access Management (IAM)

  • Oversee identity governance, access controls, and privileged access management
  • Ensure secure authentication and authorization mechanisms

7. Third-Party & Cloud Security

  • Manage vendor and third-party risk assessments
  • Ensure security across cloud platforms and outsourced services

8. Security Awareness & Training

  • Develop organization-wide security awareness programs
  • Train employees on cyber risks, phishing, and best practices

Qualifications & Experience

jobs.title: Infrastructure and Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Statewise is looking for a hands-on Infrastructure and Security Engineer who treats security and reliability as engineering disciplines, not checklists.
jobs.description:
Statewise is looking for a hands-on Infrastructure and Security Engineer who treats security and reliability as engineering disciplines, not checklists. This is not a “keep the lights on” role. This is an ownership role for someone who wants to design, harden, and scale the infrastructure behind a complex, state-configurable Medicaid EHR platform serving pediatric nursing and IDD home care providers.

We are at a turning point. Our platform runs on AWS, our compliance foundation is solid, and our team is growing. Now we need someone to take our infrastructure to the next level of maturity: more resilient, more observable, more scalable, and hardened beyond baseline compliance. This role will own that evolution.

You will own infrastructure confidence across our production systems: web platform, mobile backend, data pipelines, and integrations. You will define how our systems are provisioned, secured, monitored, and recovered.

Who is Statewise

Statewise is building the future of Medicaid home care software. We are the only EMR and EVV platform built specifically for Medicaid home care providers across Pediatric Nursing, Therapy, Personal Care, andIntellectual and Developmental Disabilities (IDD) services. Our software is designed to handle complex, state-by-state rules and real clinical workflows without the bloat of traditional systems. Everything we build is rooted in simplifying complexity so providers can focus on delivering high-quality care.

What You’ll Do

  • Own AWS Infrastructure Architecture & Security
    • Architect and maintain AWS infrastructure across compute, networking, databases, caching, storage, and serverless services
    • Design for scalability, elasticity, and cost efficiency
    • Own VPC architecture, subnet segmentation, routing, and security boundaries
    • Design and enforce IAM policies, least-privilege access, and secrets management
    • Strengthen encryption standards (at rest and in transit) and key management
  • Elevate Reliability & Operational Maturity
    • Design and improve monitoring, alerting, and observability across the stack
    • Move from reactive alerts to proactive system health signals
    • Define uptime expectations, SLAs, and capacity planning
    • Create and maintain incident response runbooks and disaster recovery plans
    • Regularly test and validate backup and recovery procedures
  • Mature Security Beyond Baseline HIPAA
    • Strengthen AWS security services usage including GuardDuty, WAF, CloudTrail, Config, and Security Hub
    • Own vulnerability scanning, patch management, and remediation tracking
    • Support audits, security assessments, and penetration test remediation
    • Drive toward steady-state audit readiness, not scramble-based compliance
  • Own CI/CD & Deployment Safety
    • Improve and maintain Azure DevOps build and release pipelines
    • Implement low-blast-radius release strategies
    • Enforce security gates within deployment workflows
    • Improve rollback confidence and deployment predictability
  • Partner with Engineering
    • Collaborate on infrastructure needs for new services and features
    • Drive infrastructure-as-code practices where they create leverage
    • Influence architectural decisions related to scalability, cost, and security
    • Raise operational awareness and security discipline across the team

What We’re Looking For

  • You learn systems quickly and reduce ambiguity for yourself and others
  • You take ownership of production outcomes, not just task completion
  • You think in systems: blast radius, failure domains, and network topology
  • You design for security and reliability from the beginning
  • You automate what matters without over-engineering
  • You are comfortable making production decisions under pressure
  • You communicate risk and tradeoffs clearly
  • You are hands-on and operate confidently in live environments
  • You use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate investigation, documentation, and operational clarity

Experience & Background

  • 5+ years of infrastructure, DevOps, or cloud engineering experience
  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, RDS, VPC, S3, Lambda, IAM)
  • Strong understanding of AWS security services and IAM best practices
  • Experience designing scalable, elastic production systems
  • Experience maturing and hardening HIPAA-compliant environments
  • Strong networking fundamentals: VPCs, subnets, routing, DNS, load balancing
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK)
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated software environments strongly preferred
  • Must be located in and authorized to work in the United States. Statewise does not provide visa sponsorship at this time.

This Role Is Not a Fit If You

  • Prefer managing infrastructure through the console rather than repeatable processes
  • Treat security as a compliance checkbox rather than an engineering practice
  • Are uncomfortable making production decisions without a full committee
  • Focus on tooling over outcomes
  • Avoid documentation and knowledge sharing
  • Need someone else to define what “secure” means for your systems
  • See monitoring as optional rather than foundational

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 45 days, you understand our AWS architecture and security posture and have identified high-leverage improvements
  • Within 90 days, monitoring coverage is stronger, security controls are tightened, and release processes are safer and more predictable
  • Within 6 months, infrastructure is more resilient, observable, and audit-ready as a steady state

The team trusts production. Deployments are predictable. Incidents are contained quickly. Leadership has visibility into operational health and security posture.

Benefits & Perks

  • Remote-first role (Nashville or Fort Worth proximity is a plus, not a requirement)
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Medical insurance with employer contribution
  • HSA with employer contribution
  • Dental insurance available (employee-paid)
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Flexible PTO with an expectation that people actually take time off
  • Paid parental leave

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $135k - $160k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Groton, Massachusetts

Salary:

135K - 160K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $135,000 – $160,000 / year
