Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Senior Records Information Management Specialist for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Senior Records Information Management Specialist will lead the design, governance, and day-to-day administration of the program's records management function, ensuring that electronic records generated across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms are properly captured, controlled, archived, and preserved in accordance with federal recordkeeping law and DoD policy. This role serves as the primary bridge between the content operation and the Government Records Manager, translating recordkeeping requirements into practical, user-centric processes that content and digital teams can execute consistently.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $92,000 – $95,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer the organization's records management program, ensuring records of business and mission activity are properly identified, scheduled, captured, and preserved in compliance with federal recordkeeping law and DoD records management policy.

  • Develop, implement, and annually update records management SOPs and guidance, keeping pace with evolving Federal, DoD, and program-specific policy.

  • Develop and maintain a records management plan governing the transfer, accessioning, and eventual disposition of permanent electronic records to the appropriate federal archival authority, and lead execution of related transfer activities.

  • Conduct periodic compliance reviews and risk assessments of the records program, documenting gaps and recommending corrective actions to leadership.

  • Partner with the Government Records Manager and content stakeholders to design intuitive, user-centric records management systems and workflows; conduct user research to identify pain points and streamline compliance.

  • Direct archiving and digital preservation activities, including secure storage, metadata tagging and indexing, and backup/disaster-recovery practices that ensure long-term accountability, availability, and integrity of records.

  • Ensure archived and published content remains tamper-proof, verifiable, and retained per applicable records schedules, conducting regular audits of archiving, access-control, and publishing workflows.

  • Establish and enforce access-control, permissions, and audit-trail practices across content systems to maintain a defensible chain of custody.

  • Ensure records considerations are reflected in broader digital strategy planning, content governance, and reporting.

  • Deliver required records-related compliance and status reporting on established schedules, and brief findings and recommendations to Government stakeholders.

  • Provide subject-matter guidance and training to content and digital teams on records identification, tagging, and retention responsibilities.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • This position requires an active Secret Clearance.

  • BA/BS in Information Science, Library/Archival Studies, Records Management, or a related field.

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in records information management, including electronic records management within a federal or DoD environment.

  • Demonstrated working knowledge of federal records management law, DoD recordkeeping policy, and archival transfer/accessioning processes.

  • Experience developing and maintaining records management SOPs, retention schedules, and compliance reporting.

  • Experience working within a content management system (CMS) environment and coordinating with cross-functional content/digital teams.

  • Strong written communication skills, with experience producing compliance and governance reporting for government stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Certified Records Manager (CRM) or Information Governance Professional (IGP) certification.

  • Familiarity with cloud-hosted content environments and associated backup and disaster-recovery controls.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

You will set the lifecycle strategy and roadmap, determine where the team should invest, establish how programs are prioritized and measured, and stay close enough to the work to raise the quality of execution and unblock the highest-priority initiatives.

You will work closely with Product Growth, Product, Product Marketing, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and other marketing teams. Lifecycle Marketing will own customer communication strategy, channel planning, lifecycle program design, and marketing execution.

The opportunity is broader than running an email program. Dropbox has a large global customer base, multiple products, and both product-led and sales-assisted customer motions. The Head of Lifecycle Marketing will define how those pieces connect across the customer lifecycle and build the operating model needed to move from individual campaigns toward scalable growth programs.

Responsibilities

  • Own Dropbox’s lifecycle marketing strategy and roadmap across onboarding, engagement, retention, monetization, expansion, and multi-product adoption.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of lifecycle marketers, with clear goals, operating rhythms, and accountability for business outcomes.
  • Build and manage a portfolio of lifecycle programs using customer behavior, product usage, segmentation, triggers, and personalization to improve adoption, retention, and revenue.
  • Partner with Product Growth, Product Marketing, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and other cross-functional teams to connect lifecycle communications with activation, in-product discovery, monetization, and expansion while maintaining clear ownership across teams.
  • Establish a strong experimentation and measurement approach, using controlled tests, holdouts, cohort analysis, customer behavior, and revenue to determine what creates incremental impact.
  • Build the operating model for lifecycle marketing, including prioritization, planning, governance, and the technical and data capabilities required to execute reliably at scale.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience across lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, growth marketing, customer engagement, or closely related disciplines, ideally in a SaaS, subscription, or product-led business.
  • Significant people-management experience, with a track record of hiring, coaching, and leading high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated experience setting lifecycle strategy and translating it into programs that improve customer adoption, retention, monetization, expansion, or revenue.
  • Deep experience with customer segmentation, behavioral triggers, personalization, experimentation, and marketing automation.
  • Strong technical fluency across CRM and lifecycle systems, customer data, campaign orchestration, measurement, deliverability, and related operational requirements.
  • Strong business judgment and experience working across Product, Product Growth, Data Science, Marketing Operations, Engineering, and Product Marketing to turn complex inputs into clear priorities and decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading lifecycle marketing in a product-led growth business with both self-serve and sales-assisted motions.
  • Experience building expansion, cross-sell, or multi-product programs across a broad existing customer base.

jobs.excerpt: Overview Position Summary The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for advancing Lemartec's strategic growth objectives within the Data Center and Mission Critical sector by serving as the single point of coordination for a key customer relationship or market segment.
jobs.description:
Overview Position Summary The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for advancing Lemartec's strategic growth objectives within the Data Center and Mission Critical sector by serving as the single point of coordination for a key customer relationship or market segment. This role provides executive-level visibility into customer plans, market dynamics, project opportunities, and organizational capacity, enabling proactive business and operational decision-making. Working across commercial and operational functions, the Strategic Account Manager develops and maintains a forward-looking view of demand, pipeline, resource requirements, and customer priorities. The role ensures leadership has the intelligence necessary to make informed investment, pursuit, and staffing decisions while delivering a consistent, high-value customer experience. As a trusted advisor to both customers and internal stakeholders, this individual drives alignment, facilitates cross-functional collaboration, anticipates risks and constraints, and identifies opportunities for expansion and long-term partnership growth. Through a combination of strategic insight, operational discipline, and executive communication, the role helps position Lemartec as a preferred partner for mission critical customers and supports the company's continued expansion in a rapidly growing market. Company Overview Founded in 1979, Lemartec is a national general contractor and construction management firm and is part of the General Building group within MasTec’s Clean Energy and Infrastructure segment. As MasTec’s vertical construction arm, Lemartec delivers complex projects across industrial, aviation, power, and large commercial markets. Led at the segment level by Manny García-Tuñón, the General Building Operating Group represents MasTec’s vertical construction capabilities and serves as the platform for future growth in this space. As a MasTec company, Lemartec maintains international capabilities and strategic partnerships throughout the Americas and the Caribbean, enabling the execution of some of the most complex projects in the industries we serve. Through MasTec’s network of more than 22,000 professionals and subject matter experts in Engineering, Procurement, and Construction across over 400 locations throughout North America and the Caribbean, Lemartec is uniquely positioned to serve a diversified customer base. With experience across all 16 disciplines of construction, Lemartec combines deep technical expertise with the strength, scale, and financial backing of MasTec to successfully deliver projects of any size and complexity. The General Building Segment is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) business segment. The CE&I segment generates over $4.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across our renewables, industrial, infrastructure, and general building operating groups. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do. MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #16 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #13 Transportation Contractor). Responsibilities Account and relationship management Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for your assigned customer or category, building relationships at the executive, program, and project levels. Maintain a current view of each customer’s strategy, site plans, procurement approach, and decision-makers. Coordinate customer meetings, reviews, and site visits, and make sure the right Lemartec people are prepared and aligned. Track commitments made to customers and follow through across internal teams. Identify expansion opportunities, new sites, and new scopes within your domain. Demand and pipeline analytics Build and maintain a demand pipeline model for your domain covering opportunity stage, expected timing, scope, size, probability, and geography. Consolidate data from CRM, estimating, customer forecasts, and market sources into a single trusted view. Produce regular dashboards and reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly) showing pipeline health, conversion trends, and forecast changes. Flag leading indicators such as customer capital plans, power and utility availability, equipment lead times and permitting trends that affect demand timing. Cross-functional capacity awareness Maintain snapshot-level visibility into capacity and constraints in operations, estimating, pre-construction, scheduling, procurement, safety, and other teams. Compare the demand pipeline against known capacity and raise potential gaps or conflicts early, before they become commitments. Run a regular cadence with functional leads to keep that picture current, without owning their work. Translate between customer expectations and internal realities in both directions. Qualifications Work Experience and Education 7+ years in construction, engineering, data center, or mission critical industries, in account management, business development, preconstruction, program management, strategy and operations, or a comparable role. Strong analytical skills, including building pipeline models, forecasts, and dashboards from messy, multi-source data. Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and at least one BI or visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau, or similar), plus a CRM platform. Working knowledge of the construction lifecycle (estimating, preconstruction, scheduling, procurement, field operations) and how each constrains delivery. Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to brief executives and customers credibly. Comfort working independently and remotely and travelling as needed (roughly 25%). Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Direct experience with data center, hyperscale, colocation, edge, or other mission critical customers. Familiarity with MEP scopes, power and cooling infrastructure, and long-lead equipment dynamics. Experience supporting senior executives, or in a chief-of-staff, strategy, or business operations role. Background in a design-build, general contracting, or specialty contracting environment. About the Role

As a Business Enablement Specialist, you will design, document and operationalise repeatable processes and the systems that support them. Working across Product, Engineering, Operations and Commercial teams, you will simplify complex workflows, reduce manual work, and ensure teams have reliable tools, clear procedures and the data they need to operate at scale. This is a hands-on role that combines process design, systems configuration, integration work and cross-functional change management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Map, document and optimise end-to-end operational workflows across multiple products and platforms, identifying automation opportunities and failure modes.

  • Configure and maintain internal systems and tooling (CRM, ticketing, workflow orchestration, admin panels and integrations) to support streamlined operations.

  • Design and implement integrations and automations using APIs, webhooks, ETL/ELT patterns and third-party platforms to reduce manual handoffs and data reconciliation.

  • Create clear, scalable process documentation, runbooks and SOPs so teams can operate independently and consistently.

  • Author tracking and instrumentation requirements to ensure operational observability: logs, metrics, alerts and dashboards for key process health indicators.

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to prioritise system improvements, scope development work and validate that releases meet operational needs and reliability standards.

  • Lead change management and training for new processes and systems, including stakeholder communication, onboarding materials and hands-on support during rollouts.

  • Own incident playbooks and contribute to incident response readiness: triage steps, escalation paths and post-incident reviews with actionable remediation plans.

  • Maintain data quality and access controls across operational systems, ensuring privacy-sensitive information is handled according to policy.

  • Continuously measure process performance and iterate: reduce cycle times, error rates and manual interventions through disciplined experimentation and monitoring.

How You’ll Do It

  • Develop clear process maps, decision trees and acceptance criteria that translate business workflows into system requirements.

  • Implement and maintain integrations using standard patterns (webhooks, message queues, scheduled jobs) and document failure/retry behaviours.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and alerts for operational KPIs, and perform routine QA to detect regressions or instrumentation gaps.

  • Create and maintain runbooks and training materials; run workshops and drop-in clinics to increase adoption and reduce support load.

  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to scope deliverables, set success metrics and verify post-deployment outcomes.

Requirements

  • 3+ years’ experience in operations, business systems, process improvement or a related role supporting cross-functional teams.

  • Practical experience with business systems such as CRMs, ticketing/workflow tools, analytics platforms and common SaaS integrations.

  • Working knowledge of integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, ETL/ELT, event-driven architectures) and a pragmatic approach to automation.

  • Strong documentation skills — able to produce unambiguous process specs, runbooks and training guides that scale across teams.

  • Solid analytical skills with experience instrumenting and monitoring processes using metrics, dashboards and alerts.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and business audiences.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments and taking ownership of cross-functional initiatives from discovery through to operational handover.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration platforms, low-code automation tools, or integration platforms (Zapier, Make, Workato, n8n, or similar).

  • Familiarity with SQL or basic scripting (Python, Google Apps Script) to build small automations and perform data validation.

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring stacks (Datadog, Grafana, Looker/Looker Studio or similar) for operational metrics and alerting.

  • Experience designing processes in privacy-conscious environments and implementing appropriate access controls.

  • Previous experience leading cross-functional change programmes or training initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operational workflows are well-documented, measurable and reliably executed with minimal manual intervention.

  • Systems and integrations reduce cycle times and error rates, and internal teams trust the tools and runbooks provided.

  • Incidents are resolved according to playbooks, root causes are addressed, and recurrence is demonstrably reduced.

  • Process and system improvements are delivered iteratively with clear metrics demonstrating impact on scalability and efficiency.

Why Join Us?

You’ll join a collaborative team where your work directly improves how the business operates at scale. This role offers exposure to multiple product lines, the chance to shape tooling and process standards, and the opportunity to make measurable impact by reducing operational complexity and enabling teams to move faster.

jobs.description:
AI Productivity Coach (Level 3)

Reports to: Delivery Director

Location: UK Remote, with national travel as required

About Corndel

Corndel is a unique, multi award-winning UK management and technology training provider that focuses on delivering the highest quality programmes throughout an employee’s career. We are one of the fastest growing companies in the UK and provide a great platform for proactive and motivated individuals to take the next exciting step in their career. You will be joining an organisation with a fun, entrepreneurial and supportive environment, providing fulfilling work and an open, informal culture.

Purpose of the Role

The AI3 Coach (Working Smarter with AI) exists to help learners build confidence and capability in using AI enabled digital tools safely, effectively, and responsibly in the workplace.

In this role, you will coach and support learners on Corndel’s Level 3 Working Smarter with AI programme, helping them adopt practical AI enabled workflows using Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Copilot. You will guide learners to understand not just how to use tools, but how to apply sound judgement, maintain human oversight, and improve productivity in ways that genuinely add value.

You will combine strong digital and M365 expertise with a coaching mindset, empowering learners to develop confidence, good habits, and transferable skills that support their long‑term development.

Core Responsibilities

Learner Coaching & Development

  • Manage a caseload of learners, building trusted relationships through structured one‑to‑one coaching and group workshops.

  • Support learners at different stages of confidence and digital maturity, adapting your approach to meet individual needs.

  • Create an inclusive, psychologically safe learning environment where learners feel comfortable asking questions, practising new skills, and learning from mistakes.

  • Encourage learners to take ownership of their development, building confidence through practical application and reflection.

Digital Productivity & AI Adoption

  • Coach learners to use Microsoft 365 tools (including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel and PowerPoint) to improve everyday productivity.

  • Guide learners in the practical use of Microsoft Copilot and other AI tools, including promptbased approaches that enhance clarity, efficiency and decision making.

  • Support learners to develop safe, ethical, and responsible AI habits, including awareness of data privacy, bias, and security considerations.

  • Help learners recognise opportunities to apply AI enabled workflows in real workplace tasks, balancing innovation with good professional judgement.

Digital Support & Problem Solving

  • Support learners to develop foundational digital support skills, such as diagnosing simple application issues, providing user support, and troubleshooting.

  • Build learner understanding of organisational digital processes, escalation routes, and best practice.

  • Encourage a solutions‑focused mindset, helping learners approach problems methodically and confidently.

Progress, Quality & Outcomes

  • Guide learners through programme milestones, assessments, and portfolio evidence, ensuring consistent progress and timely completion.

  • Support learners to produce high‑quality, compliant evidence that reflects genuine capability and understanding.

  • Engage constructively with learners’ line managers to support progress and reinforce the value of the programme.

  • Maintain high standards of quality, safeguarding, and data handling, making thoughtful decisions that prioritise learner wellbeing and success.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues across Operations, Product, and Curriculum to deliver a consistent and high‑quality learner experience.

  • Stay curious about emerging digital and AI trends, bringing relevant developments into learning conversations where they add value.

  • Contribute ideas and insight to continuously improve delivery approaches and learner outcomes.

Technical Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Expert working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Practical experience using Microsoft Copilot and/or other AI tools to support productivity and workflow improvement.

  • Understanding of AI fundamentals, including how large language models work and how they can be applied responsibly in the workplace.

  • Confidence in prompt‑based interaction with AI tools, with the ability to explain effective prompting strategies to others.

  • Awareness of AI risks and limitations, including data privacy, bias, security, and responsible use.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving common application issues, with an understanding of digital support and helpdesk practices.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non‑technical learners.

Desirable

  • Experience with Power Automate or other low‑code/no‑code automation tools.

  • Familiarity with Copilot Studio or Power Apps.

  • Experience delivering training, coaching, or user support in a professional environment.

  • Teaching, training, or IT support qualifications (e.g. Microsoft Certified Trainer, ITIL).

What Success in This Role Looks Like

In this role, success means that you:

  • Consistently support learners to complete their programme and End Point Assessment successfully and on time.

  • Are trusted by learners as a knowledgeable, approachable, and supportive coach.

  • Enable learners to use AI‑enabled tools with confidence, judgement, and awareness of risk.

  • Maintain high standards of quality, professionalism, and learner care.

  • Contribute positively to a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑performing team culture.

What Brilliant Looks Like

At its best, this role creates impact well beyond individual sessions:

  • Learners describe your support as pivotal in building their confidence with AI and digital tools.

  • You spot patterns across cohorts and proactively improve learner experience and outcomes.

  • You introduce practical, thoughtful ways of using AI that genuinely improve productivity and decision‑making.

  • You balance encouragement with challenge, helping learners build good habits rather than shortcuts.

  • Your influence supports organisations to adopt AI‑enabled productivity in a responsible, sustainable way.

Als Recruiter Techniek ben je de spil tussen onze technici en opdrachtgevers. Jij weet hoe je de beste technici binnenhaalt en samen met je collega plaatst bij je klanten. Vanzelfsprekend bouw je aan je relaties met je kandidaten. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

SD Worx Technics heeft een informele werksfeer waarin gestuurd wordt op output. Er is veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng en initiatieven. We bieden jou de vrijheid en flexibiliteit om de regie over je werk in handen te nemen. Zo krijg je de ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Ervaring in de technische sector en/of detachering

  • Klantgerichtheid en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden

  • Oog voor de marktontwikkelingen en deze weet te vertalen naar kansen voor kandidaten

SD Worx Technics is een specialist in het matchen van technische vakmensen met uitdagende projecten. Wij bieden een persoonlijke benadering en leveren maatwerkoplossingen voor zowel onze klanten als onze medewerkers. Onze cultuur is open en informeel, met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en innovatie. Bij ons staan kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en integriteit centraal.

Bij SD Worx werken we als één team en groeien we samen, van beter tot best. Diversiteit staat centraal in ons bedrijf, omdat het ons inspireert en innovatie stimuleert. We verwelkomen sollicitaties van gekwalificeerd talent, ongeacht afkomst, nationaliteit, geslacht, huidskleur, etnische en sociale achtergrond, religie, leeftijd, handicap, seksuele geaardheid en levensfase.

The Tax Manager is responsible for providing tax compliance, planning, and advisory services for high-net-worth individuals, families, trusts, estates, and closely held businesses. This role partners with wealth advisors to identify tax-saving opportunities, manages complex tax engagements, reviews returns, and delivers strategic guidance to clients. The Tax Manager also supports and mentors tax staff while helping ensure exceptional client service and proactive tax planning solutions.

Job Description:

Primary Responsibilities

  • Identify tax planning opportunities and coordinate with wealth advisors and client service teams to support clients’ broader financial, estate, charitable, and investment objectives;

  • Research tax issues, prepare clear recommendations, and communicate findings to clients, advisors, and internal stakeholders in a practical and professional manner;

  • Manage client engagements, workflow, deadlines, review processes, and coordination with permanent and seasonal tax staff;

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing proactive communication, high-quality service, and timely responses to client and advisor inquiries;

  • Collaborate with wealth management teams to incorporate income tax, fiduciary tax, gift tax, charitable planning, stock option, and multi-state planning considerations into client recommendations;

  • Review and provide guidance to tax preparers and seasonal staff, including technical coaching and feedback during busy season;

  • Assist with internal tax education, process improvements, and practice standards that support consistent, high-quality client service;

  • Monitor relevant tax law developments and assist with communicating timely planning insights to advisors and clients through newsletters, presentations, social media, and other client communications.

  • Perform and manage tax compliance and planning services for high-net-worth individuals, families, trusts, estates, private foundations, closely held businesses, and related entities, including extensions, quarterly estimates, projections, and year-end planning;

  • Prepare and review federal, state, and local tax returns for individuals, trusts, estates, private foundations, partnerships, S corporations, and closely held businesses

Qualifications

  • A CPA, EA, JD, or comparable advanced tax credential, with a minimum of 5+ years of relevant tax experience; public accounting, family office, or wealth management experience preferred.

  • Experience serving high-net-worth individuals and families, including individual, fiduciary, gift, foundation, partnership, and closely held business tax returns.

  • Strong working knowledge of federal and state income tax, fiduciary income tax, gift and estate tax concepts, charitable planning, stock compensation, and multi-state compliance matters.

  • Ability to manage engagements, meet competing deadlines, support staff, and maintain ownership of client deliverables through completion.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain tax concepts clearly to clients and advisors.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, and ability to learn and use tax, planning, workflow, and document management technology.

  • Strong attention to detail, self-initiated follow-through, sound professional judgment, and strong time management and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a client-focused, team-oriented wealth management environment.

  • Willingness and ability to work additional hours, as needed, during peak tax filing and planning seasons.

  • Experience preparing high-net-worth individual, business, partnership, foundation, and gift tax returns preferred.

  • Experience with ProSystem fx® Tax, CCH Axcess, and BNA Income Tax™ Planner; and Big Four or large regional accounting firm experience preferred.

​

This position is an exempt position. The annualized base pay range for this role is expected to be between $110,000 - $130,000 per year base salary compensation range. Actual base pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, subject matter expertise, geographic location where work will be performed, and the applicant’s skill set. The base pay is just one component of the total compensation package. Other rewards may include an annual cash bonus and a comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and 401(k). Please note that the job title is subject to change based on the selected candidate’s experience and education.

Focus Partners is an organization of wealth, asset, and business management resources that brings strength, innovation, and partnership to client relationships. Through a comprehensive range of services, Focus Partners supports clients at every stage of life, helping them manage their financial future. Focus Partners uses research-backed investment strategies to create custom-built portfolios and delivers personalized wealth planning solutions to clients in all 50 states. Focus Partners is part of Focus, a leading financial services firm comprised of wealth management, family office, and business management services. To learn more about Focus, visit focuspartners.com or follow the company on LinkedIn.


Focus is a leading financial services firm comprised of integrated wealth management, family office, and business management services. Blending deep expertise and expansive resources with a boutique, client-first fiduciary philosophy, Focus helps individuals, families, and institutions navigate complex financial situations with highly personalized solutions tailored to their unique needs. To learn more about Focus, visit www.focusfinancialpartners.com or follow the company on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Senior Business Systems Analyst - Workday Adaptive Planning
jobs.excerpt: Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators.
jobs.description:
Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

Make an impact — from near or far

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

The opportunity

The Senior Business Systems Analyst – Workday Adaptive Planning is a hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning administrator, model builder, and reporting expert responsible for the administration, development, optimization, and ongoing support of the organization's Workday Adaptive Planning environment.


This position is a key member of the Financial Analytics and Insights team and will play a critical role in expanding the organization's use of Adaptive Planning as an enterprise planning, reporting, and decision-support platform. The Senior Business Systems Analyst will have significant ownership of the Adaptive environment, including model development, configuration, reporting, dashboards, OfficeConnect, security, data management, system administration, and platform optimization.


You will bring demonstrated, hands-on experience building and administering Workday Adaptive Planning—not simply experience as an end-user. You will understand how to translate complex financial and operational requirements into well-designed Adaptive models, reports, dashboards, and planning solutions that are scalable, intuitive, controlled, and sustainable.


The role will partner closely with Finance, Human Resources, IT, and other business stakeholders to understand business requirements, improve planning and reporting processes, develop solutions, and maximize the value of the Adaptive Planning platform.


This is an opportunity for an experienced Adaptive Planning professional to play a significant role in shaping how the organization uses technology, data, and planning systems to support financial and workforce decision-making. You will report to the Senior Director Financial Analytics and Insights.



What you'll do:

  • Be the primary Workday Adaptive Planning administrator and subject matter expert, with responsibility for the day-to-day administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of the platform.
  • Own and maintain Adaptive Planning structures, including models, dimensions, accounts, levels, versions, sheets, assumptions, formulas, business rules, attributes, and security.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable Adaptive configurations, including model structures, dimensions, assumptions, formulas, calculations, workflows, and reporting solutions to support evolving budgeting, forecasting, reporting, workforce planning, and business requirements.
  • Manage Adaptive Planning user access, roles, permissions, and security while maintaining appropriate data governance and internal controls, while monitoring system performance, data integrity, integrations, and user experience and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain appropriate system documentation, configuration standards, technical documentation, and administrative procedures, as well as training materials, documentation, user guides, and other resources that support effective adoption as well as conduct training and knowledge-transfer sessions for users and stakeholders.
  • Design and build Adaptive Planning models and planning solutions that apply strong understanding of FP&A processes to ensure that the solutions appropriately support financial planning and management practices, that balance flexibility and usability with appropriate controls, standardization, and long-term maintainability.
  • Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to define complex reporting requirements and translate those requirements into effective Adaptive reporting solutions supporting budgets, forecasts, actuals, variances, trends, workforce metrics, and other key financial and operational measures.
  • Partner with Human Resources to develop and maintain workforce planning models and reporting solutions within Adaptive Planning.
  • Develop, maintain, monitor, reconcile and troubleshoot integrations and data flows between Workday Financial Management, Workday HCM, and Workday Adaptive Planning.
  • Partner with FINSYS, HRIS and ITS and other technical teams on complex integrations, data architecture, APIs, and technical issues.
  • Facilitate discussions with business stakeholders to understand underlying business needs and evaluate alternative solutions and recommend approaches that balance business requirements, system capabilities, scalability, controls, and maintainability.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.


What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of progressive hands-on experience in an administrator, developer, model builder, reporting, or systems analyst capacity of which 3+ years utilizing the Workday Adaptive Planning system.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field. Equivalent years of experience in lieu of degree acceptable.
  • Demonstrated experience developing complex Adaptive Planning reports, dashboards, and management reporting solutions.
  • Experience withAdaptive OfficeConnect, including development and maintenance of management reporting packages.
  • Strong experience working with Adaptive Planning dimensions, accounts, levels, versions, sheets, assumptions, formulas, calculations, business rules, and model structures.
  • Experience creating in/out bound integrations between Workday Financial Management, Workday HCM, and Workday Adaptive Planning.
  • Strong understanding of financial planning processes, including budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and variance analysis.

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.


If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to fully engage in any part of the application or hiring process, please complete the Accommodation Request form or contact us at 603-626-9447. A member from the Employee Accommodation Support Center will be in contact with you within two business days to discuss your request.


Compensation


The annual pay range for this position is $80,128.00 - $128,226.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $88,540.00 - $119,788.00.

Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)

You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get:

  • High-quality, low-deductible medical insurance

  • Low to no-cost dental and vision plans

  • 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays)

  • Employer-funded retirement

  • Free tuition program

  • Parental leave

  • Mental health and wellbeing resources

jobs.excerpt: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. Job Details

Summary:

The Information Security Human Risk Analyst-I supports the day-to-day execution of Cencora’s Human Risk program, including Information Security training, simulated phishing, onboarding, awareness communications, reporting support, and program documentation. This role helps deliver consistent, timely, and learner-centered security education that reinforces secure behaviors and supports the organization’s ability to reduce human-related cybersecurity risk.

Responsibilities:

  • Support recurring Information Security training assignments, including learner population review, course assignment preparation, completion tracking, reminder coordination, and basic issue resolution.
  • Assist with simulated phishing campaign operations, including campaign setup inputs, test group validation, launch readiness checks, post-campaign tracking, and learner follow-up activities.
  • Help maintain new hire onboarding security awareness activities, including enrollment support, completion monitoring, and coordination of standard communications.
  • Monitor and triage Human Risk shared inboxes or intake channels, respond to routine questions using approved guidance, and escalate non-standard inquiries to more senior team members.
  • Maintain program documentation, trackers, runbooks, mySecurity content, job aids, and evidence repositories to support consistent execution and audit readiness.
  • Assist with routine reporting by gathering data, updating status logs, validating basic completion information, and preparing inputs for team dashboards or stakeholder updates.
  • Follow documented procedures, identify incomplete or inconsistent information, and raise process, data, or stakeholder issues with clear context and recommended next steps where possible.

Qualifications:



  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Communications, Marketing, Cybersecurity, Business, Education, or a related field preferred, or equivalent work experience.
  • Foundational understanding of information security awareness, training operations, communications, customer service, and data tracking.
  • 2+ years of related experience or equivalent education/work experience.
  • Demonstrates foundational knowledge of cybersecurity principles, threat concepts, security controls, risk management, and data protection practices.
  • Uses analytical and problem-solving skills to review security information, identify issues, and support practical remediation actions.
  • Communicates clearly with team members and stakeholders to document findings, escalate concerns, and support coordinated security activities.
  • Applies attention to detail when handling alerts, documentation, evidence, and process steps to improve accuracy and consistency.
  • Builds working knowledge of security tools, policies, standards, and operating procedures to support effective execution in a controlled environment.
  • Manages assigned tasks with discipline, curiosity, and sound judgment while developing technical capability and professional maturity.
  • Strong written communication, attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and willingness to learn enterprise tools and processes.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Excel, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Learning Management Systems, simulated phishing tools, basic reporting, process documentation, and security awareness content preferred.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks, meet deadlines, ask good questions, and support a friendly, non-punitive learning experience for team members.

jobs.title: CGI Automotive Artist (3Ds Max & V-Ray)
jobs.excerpt: INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands.
jobs.description:
INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Product Specialist is responsible for showcasing and promoting products and services through live demonstrations. The Product Specialist, is a critical function for promoting and educating customers about products and services. The portfolio of solutions aims to elevate the entire radiology workflow by creating an efficient and seamless process when adopting products.  As the Demonstration Specialist, the goal is to create a positive and engaging experience that drives customer interest and sales.

Requirements

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

Customer Solution Presentations & Sales Engagements

  • Maintain expert-level knowledge of Deep Health products, including capabilities, configurations, integrations, and new or upcoming functionality relevant to customer engagements.

  • Develop and maintain reusable sales enablement materials, including presentation scripts, workflow scenarios, FAQs, and supporting content.

  • Partner with Sales to support customer meetings, demonstrations, presentations, workflow assessments, and solution discussions.

  • Clearly communicate clinical workflows, technology capabilities, and solution value to clinical, technical, and executive stakeholders.

  • Translate complex clinical and technical concepts into customer-focused solutions for presentations.

  • Contribute to RFP responses, site visits, and customer-specific demonstrations.

Technology & Product Collaboration

  • Assist with configuring, validating, and maintaining demonstration environments, including representative workflows, test data, integrations, and other elements required to support reliable customer demonstrations.

  • Proficient in the knowledge of healthcare IT, including PACS, RIS, DICOM, HL7, integrations, interoperability, APIs, and cloud technologies.

  • Translate clinical requirements into actionable feedback for product, engineering, and implementation teams.

  • Collaborate on troubleshooting workflow, integration, and usability issues.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies including AI, analytics, automation, and workflow optimization tools.

  • Support product validation, implementations, training, and customer feedback initiatives.

Clinical Workflow & Expertise

  • Serve as a clinical resource for cross-sectional and mammography imaging workflows.

  • Understand and evaluate end-to-end radiology workflows, including image acquisition, PACS/RIS, reporting, and results communication.

  • Collaborate with radiologists, technologists, clinical leaders, informatics, and IT teams to identify workflow challenges and improvement opportunities.

  • Assess how technology, automation, and AI can enhance efficiency, and the quality of the radiologist’s experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Clinical radiology experience with strong knowledge of cross-sectional imaging and mammography workflows.

  • Understanding of radiology operations, healthcare IT systems, and imaging informatics.

  • Experience with PACS, RIS, EHR/EMR, voice recognition, reporting, or related clinical systems.

  • Familiarity with DICOM, HL7, APIs, integrations, and interoperability concepts.

  • Strong presentation, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to engage effectively with clinical, technical, and executive audiences.

  • Comfortable in customer-facing environments and adapting to evolving technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a radiologic technologist, clinical applications specialist, PACS/RIS analyst, imaging informatics specialist, or related vendor role.

  • Knowledgeable with radiology technology implementations and deployments.

  • Exposure to AI-enabled radiology solutions and cloud-based healthcare platforms.

  • Experience supporting sales, customer success, product development, or implementation activities.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted partner across Clinical, Sales, Product, and Technology teams by identifying workflow challenges, aligning technology with clinical needs, and effectively communicating our value to customers and stakeholders.

This role is ideal for someone who thinks clinically, is comfortable with IT and healthcare technology, and can confidently present and demonstrate solutions alongside the Sales team. The individual should be passionate about solving complex workflow challenges and using technology to improve the practice of radiology.

PLEASE NOTE:  This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above.  Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, patients, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance. 

  • Follows all local, state and federal laws concerning employment to include but not limited to: I-9, Harassment, EEOC, Civil rights and ADA.

  • Follows OSHA regulations, RadNet and site protocols, policies and procedures.

  • Follows HIPAA, compliance, privacy, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with RadNet guidelines.

  • Consistently adheres to the time management policies and procedures.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Working Environment

Remote setting with the requirement to travel less than 25%.

Salary range is $120,000 to $130,000 dependent upon experience.

Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

Discover Vanderbilt Health: With eight hospitals and over 180 clinics, we are the region’s largest comprehensive academic health system. Vanderbilt Health has a long tradition of providing world-class care to the people of the Mid-South, living out our mission of moving medicine forward through preeminent programs in patient care, education and research. Here you’ll find a spirit of collaboration and a supportive community where your expertise is valued, your knowledge expanded and your uniqueness celebrated. We are committed to fostering an environment where talented, compassionate people are united in bringing the most advanced care to our neighbors throughout the region.

Organization:

TX Organ Proc and Presv

Job Summary:

Facilitates and coordinates the evaluation of potential transplant and/or living donor candidates. Assists with coordination of care and discharge process for recipients hospitalized for transplantation and living donation and post-operative complications. Provides clinical management transplant recipients and/or living donors, who are followed as outpatients, in collaboration with the transplant team (attending physicians, nurse practitioners, clinical transplant pharmacists, social workers).

.

Position Hours

Variable 24-hour shifts


Department Summary

Vanderbilt Transplant Center is a nationally recognized leader in advanced heart and lung transplantation, providing exceptional outcomes and innovative treatment options for patients with end-stage heart and lung disease. As one of the world's premier transplant programs, Vanderbilt performs a high volume of adult and pediatric transplants while caring for some of the most complex and high-risk patients, including those who may not qualify for transplant at other centers.


The program brings together a multidisciplinary team of transplant physicians, surgeons, pharmacists, nurses, and specialists dedicated to delivering comprehensive, patient-centered care. Vanderbilt is a pioneer in breakthrough transplant therapies, including advanced mechanical circulatory support, ECMO, ex vivo organ perfusion, and multi-organ transplantation. Through leading-edge research, clinical innovation, and access to novel treatment approaches, the team continually expands opportunities for patients awaiting life-saving transplants.


Known for outstanding survival outcomes, shorter wait times, and coordinated care across the continuum of treatment, Vanderbilt Transplant Center serves patients from across the country and around the world, offering hope and improved quality of life through some of the most advanced heart and lung transplant services available today.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Coordinates the evaluation process of potential transplant candidates and/or living donors in collaboration with physicians and other health care professionals. • Educates patients and families about the transplant process, evaluation and waiting phases, and long-term follow-up and care, as well as, living donation when applicable. • Monitors patient progress and provides clinical management during post-transplantation and post living donation. • Ensures the most current practices of transplantation nursing are utilized, and providing system improvements to support optimal transplant outcomes. • Ensures referring physician is kept informed about all phases of the transplant process. • The responsibilities listed are a general overview of the position and additional duties may be assigned. TECHNICAL CAPABILITIES • Transplant Coordination (Intermediate): Demonstrates mastery of transplant coordination in practical applications of a difficult nature. Possesses sufficient knowledge, training, and experience to be capable of successfully delivering coordination services without requiring support and instruction from others. Possess sufficient knowledge to provide interventions that maintain or improve physiology, psychological and social health and interventions that facilitate and optimize behavioral changes and treatment adherence with complex, lifelong therapies. Advocates supporting patients and families in planning, implementation and evaluation of care. Able to train and educate by setting the example, giving technical instruction, providing leadership, and generally raising the level of performance of others while on the job. • Nursing Patient Assessment & Evaluation (Intermediate): Demonstrates mastery of patient assessments and evaluations in practical applications of a difficult nature. Conducts primary care patient interviews and physical examinations. Conducts inquiry with a thorough series of questions when patients state an ailment or complaint in order to accurately identify and elaborate on the problem. Possesses sufficient knowledge, training, and experience to role model and coach less experienced peers. • Nursing Patient Education (Intermediate): Demonstrates mastery of patient education in practical applications of a difficult nature. Possesses sufficient knowledge, training, and experience to be capable of providing patient health education services without requiring instruction from others. Able to train and educate by setting the example, giving technical instruction, providing leadership, and generally raising the level of performance of others while on the job.

Our Nursing Philosophy:

We believe highly skilled and specialized nursing care is essential to Vanderbilt University Medical Center’s mission of quality in patient care, education and research. We believe nursing is an applied art and science focused on helping people, families and communities reach excellent health and well-being.

As a Vanderbilt University Medical Center employee, you make a difference to our patients and their families by bringing compassion and care to those in need of hope and healing. Please see our current employee benefits offered:

jobs.description:
Design, build, and operate the data infrastructure for a clinical trial design platform that extracts insights from clinical protocols, regulatory documents, and published articles to accelerate trial design decisions. This role owns the pipelines that ingest, parse, transform, and serve clinical data - from raw PDF extraction through structured storage in Aurora and GraphDB, to serving curated knowledge for LangGraph-based agentic AI workflows.

Requirements

  • Build ingestion pipelines for clinical trial protocols, ICF documents, SmPCs, CSRs, and published articles (PubMed, CTIS, ClinicalTrials.gov) - handling PDF parsing, text extraction, and structured data normalization
  • Design and implement data models in Amazon Aurora (relational) and GraphDB (knowledge graph) to represent trial design entities: endpoints, eligibility criteria, study arms, interventions, therapeutic areas, and their relationships
  • Develop embedding and vectorization pipelines to prepare extracted clinical text for RAG-based retrieval in LangGraph agentic workflows - chunking strategies, metadata enrichment, and vector store population
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows that transform unstructured clinical content into queryable, linked data across both relational and graph stores
  • Implement data quality validation specific to clinical data - protocol section classification accuracy, entity extraction completeness, cross-reference integrity (NCT IDs, EudraCT numbers, MeSH terms)
  • Build data serving APIs (Python/FastAPI) that expose curated datasets to the Angular frontend and LangGraph agent layer
  • Set up data lineage tracking and audit trails to support regulatory traceability of AI-generated trial design recommendation

Required Skills

  • Strong Python development experience, including PDF/document parsing libraries such as PyMuPDF, pdfplumber, unstructured.io, or similar.
  • Advanced PostgreSQL-compatible SQL, including Amazon Aurora; experience with schema design, migrations, query optimization, and indexing strategies for large clinical datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with Neptune, Neo4j, or similar graph databases; proficiency in SPARQL or Cypher; experience with ontology and knowledge graph modeling for biomedical entities.
  • Experience with AWS services including Aurora PostgreSQL, S3, Lambda, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, and IAM, particularly for data pipeline orchestration.
  • Experience with PDF text extraction, document section classification, and named entity recognition (NER) for clinical/biomedical text; familiarity with embedding models and vector stores such as OpenSearch, pgvector, or Pinecone.
  • Experience building data-serving APIs using FastAPI, including asynchronous programming patterns and backend integration.
  • Experience preparing data for LangChain/LangGraph applications and designing RAG pipelines, including chunking, retrieval, reranking, and prompt-data integration.
  • Experience with Airflow, Prefect, AWS Step Functions, Temporal, or similar workflow orchestration tools; ability to design multi-stage DAGs with dependency management, retry logic, monitoring, and error handling.
  • Experience with Terraform or AWS CDK, Docker, and Git, including automated pipeline testing and deployment on AWS.

Domain Knowledge

  • Understanding of clinical trial structure: protocol sections (objectives, endpoints, eligibility criteria, study design, statistical considerations)
  • Familiarity with clinical data standards or terminologies (MeSH, MedDRA, SNOMED, ATC codes, CDISC) is a strong plus
  • Awareness of regulatory data integrity requirements (21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA+ principles)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with biomedical knowledge graphs (e.g., linking drugs -> targets -> diseases > trials)
  • Prior work with PubMed/MEDLINE data, ClinicalTrials.gov API, or EMA/CTIS data.
  • Apache Spark or Databricks for batch processing of large document corpora
  • dbt for transformation layer management over Aurora
