jobs.excerpt: About UsTameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online.
jobs.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Highlights

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: About Primal Harvest Primal Harvest is a fast-growing health and wellness supplement brand built to make wellness simpler, more trusted, and easier to act on.
jobs.description:
About Primal Harvest

Primal Harvest is a fast-growing health and wellness supplement brand built to make wellness simpler, more trusted, and easier to act on. Our products combine nature, science, and expertise, with formulas designed to support well-being needs.

As a DTC brand with a strong subscription business and a growing marketplace presence, Primal Harvest is entering its next stage of growth. This is an opportunity to help shape how the brand shows up, builds trust, and connects with customers across every touchpoint.

About the Role

The Creative Director is the steward for how Primal Harvest shows up in the world, helping shape and evolve the brand across every customer touchpoint. This role sits in the Brand function and leads the creative team across copy, design, video, and production.

This individual will work closely with the CEO to refine the brand strategy and translate this into creative work which drives both marketing and brand performance goals. This role is accountable for ensuring consistency, quality, and market differentiation across the full spectrum of creative assets including ecomm, ads, social, and packaging.

This role involves both visionary and executional components, requiring someone that can generate a distinctive creative identity, operate with a commercial performance branding mindset, and build high performing teams that leverage both traditional and innovative AI workflows. This hand-on creative roll will require someone who can set the bar, build the system, drive the work, deliver output themselves, and collaborate effectively with a performance marketing team.

This role reports to the CEO (former Bain & Company and O Positiv Health). This role will work closely with the VP of Marketing and will be excited not only by exceptional creative execution, but by helping shape the long-term evolution of the brand.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Primal Harvest’s creative expression across consumer-facing brand touchpoints.
  • Translate brand strategy into clear creative platforms, campaigns, content systems, and channel-specific executions.
  • Build and maintain a consistent visual and verbal brand system across all major customer touchpoints.
  • Lead creative development for performance marketing assets, including paid social, search landing pages, product education, trust-building assets, and retention creative.
  • Direct photography, video, motion, design, copy, and production work across internal and external teams.
  • Develop creative systems for Amazon and marketplace content, including product imagery, A+ content, Brand Store, product education, and trust signals.
  • Lead the creative production process from brief to concept to execution to delivery.
  • Establish creative standards, workflows, review processes, and quality controls so work moves quickly without sacrificing brand quality.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, and channel feedback to improve creative effectiveness over time.
  • Manage creative timelines, budgets, and asset delivery across competing priorities.
  • Leverage the latest AI tools, capabilities, and workflows to produce an even higher quality and volume of creative output in a more cost-effective way than ever before.
  • Partner with executive leadership to influence how the brand evolves as the business scales.
  • Help evolve Primal Harvest's brand, ensuring creative decisions reinforce a differentiated and enduring market position.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of creative experience, ideally across CPG, wellness, supplements, health, beauty, performance, lifestyle, eCommerce, or digitally native consumer brands.
  • A strong portfolio showing brand systems, campaign concepts, performance creative, digital content, packaging, product storytelling, and channel-specific execution.
  • Strong art direction and design judgment across photography, video, motion, typography, layout, and visual systems.
  • Experience creating assets for DTC, Amazon, paid social, email, landing pages, PDPs, organic social, and marketplace environments.
  • Demonstrated experience helping build, reposition, or meaningfully scale a consumer brand—not simply maintaining an established one.
  • Commercial fluency: you understand that creative must build brand trust, improve conversion, support acquisition, and strengthen retention.
  • Ability to operate in a lean, fast-moving environment with limited resources and high expectations.
  • Comfort partnering with cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.
  • High standards and a bias toward action.
  • A clear point of view on what great creative looks like for a modern wellness brand.

What Great Looks Like

  • You make the Primal Harvest brand feel consistent, credible, modern, and emotionally clear across every channel.
  • You build creative that performs on a landing page, holds up on Amazon, strengthens email and paid media, and still feels unmistakably on-brand.
  • You raise the creative quality and volume bars without slowing the business down.
  • You understand how to balance brand consistency with channel-specific performance needs.
  • You turn business priorities into creative work that customers can understand and trust.
  • You bring solutions early, communicate risks clearly, and own outcomes end-to-end.

Benefits

At Primal, you’ll be part of a fast-growing health and wellness brand where your work truly makes an impact. Join us in our mission to educate, inspire, and empower people to take charge of their health and well-being. By contributing to our dynamic team, you’ll play a vital role in shaping a healthier future. Plus, we offer a range of incredible US benefits and perks, including:

  • Comprehensive Health Benefits
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave (primary & non-primary) 
  • Short-term and Long-term disability 
  • 401K + Match
  • ClassPass membership
  • Flexible working options
  • Team Events
  • Product Discounts

Primal Harvest offers a comprehensive benefits package. The annual base salary range for this position is $155,000 - $180,000 USD/year. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to: location, education, skills, training, and experience. This position may also be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, marital status, or any other legally protected factor. Primal Harvest is committed to offering reasonable accommodation to job applicants with disabilities. Primal Harvest does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and is not responsible for any agency fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
Coretek is seeking a Senior Azure Infrastructure Consultant to lead customer Azure infrastructure engagements from discovery and design through implementation, validation, documentation, and transition to managed services. This role is ideal for a senior delivery consultant who can operate as a trusted customer advisor, technical escalation point, and future architect-level contributor. Coretek Services is an industry-leading consulting and managed solutions provider based in Southeastern Michigan, built on a foundation of passionate technology professionals who embody our values of Accountability, Integrity, and Relationships. Coretek specializes in AI & data, cloud, virtualization, networking, security, modern data center, and mobility technologies, and is distinguished as a Microsoft Azure Expert MSP.

SUCCESS IN THE ROLE

  • Deliver customer projects on budget, on schedule, and aligned to defined business and technical outcomes while creating a high-quality customer experience.
  • Serve as a reliable technical escalation point who resolves complex issues and uses those situations to strengthen team capability.
  • Partner effectively with Project Management to set expectations, communicate risks, and maintain clear stakeholder alignment throughout engagements.
  • Contribute to Coretek’s relationship-based culture by consistently demonstrating Accountability, Integrity, and Relationships in work with customers and internal teams.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead discovery and requirements definition to understand the customer’s business drivers, technical constraints, and desired outcomes.
  • Design and implement Azure infrastructure solutions, including detailed solution designs, implementation plans, validation steps, and operational documentation.
  • Implement new Azure environments using Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework principles, including migration of on-premises and cloud workloads through Azure Migrate where appropriate.
  • Validate implemented solutions for functionality, security, resiliency, and operational readiness before customer handoff.
  • Facilitate onboarding of customer environments to Managed Services through clear knowledge transfer, support transition planning, and complete documentation.
  • Develop implementation plans and technical guidance that enable other team members to execute build activities consistently and accurately.
  • Perform troubleshooting, remediation, and root cause analysis for complex Azure infrastructure issues.

Additional responsibilities may include:

  • Support development and review of Statements of Work, technical scopes, solution assumptions, and estimates for complex Azure engagements.
  • Review solution designs and bills of materials with manufacturers, partners, or internal stakeholders to confirm alignment with project requirements.
  • Improve Coretek-defined standards, templates, and repeatable delivery assets based on field experience and lessons learned.

Requirements

TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE & CAPABILITIES

  • Core Azure Infrastructure: Virtual Machines, Virtual Machine Scale Sets, storage solutions, Azure Migrate, Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, monitoring, logging, and operational readiness.
  • Networking: ExpressRoute, virtual networks, routing, load balancing, Azure Front Door, Application Gateway, Private Link, private endpoints, and ingress services.
  • Platform Services: Azure SQL Database, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure App Service, Cosmos DB, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and related PaaS capabilities.
  • Security, Identity, and Governance: Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control, encryption, data protection, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and governance frameworks.
  • Cost Management: Azure Cost Management, cost optimization, rightsizing, tagging strategy, and consumption management practices.

Delivering via Automation and IaC

Well-qualified candidates will have experience deploying Azure infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code and automation. Core experience should include the ability to use provided modules, scripts, and pipelines, and to edit or refactor existing code. Relevant tools and platforms may include ARM or Bicep templates, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub, Packer, Azure DevOps, and PowerShell.

Additional Skills of Value

Coretek delivers a broad portfolio of solutions, and candidates with cross-domain experience that complement Azure infrastructure delivery will be especially valuable. Differentiating experience may include DevOps, AI and data platforms, Microsoft 365 Enterprise, merger and acquisition solutions, Citrix and Microsoft virtualized end-user computing, modern security solutions such as SOC and SIEM platforms, enterprise and cloud networking, network security, load balancing, modern data center technologies, and non-Azure public cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.

jobs.excerpt: A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others.
jobs.description:
A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:
  • You'll be part of Foundant’s product engineering team responsible for development activities along with their ongoing production environments care and feeding to take on their hardest technical problems, and you’ll deliver high-quality working code — not just direction. This is a hands-on role at every level of seniority it carries.
  • You'll own architectural decisions at both the application and service level, making calls that hold up under real production load and remain understandable to the engineers who inherit them.
  • You'll diagnose systemic and architectural issues that cross component and service boundaries, including the ambiguous ones where the cause isn't in any single team code.
  • You’ll see the big picture and work proactively to resolve integration issues or coordinate across team boundaries.
  • You’ll put AI-assisted development and agentic tooling to work in your daily engineering, shortening the path from idea to production-ready code and getting valuable improvements into clients’ hands sooner.
  • Other duties as assigned.
WhatYou’llNeed:
  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time at a principal, staff, or equivalent senior individual contributor level as a hands-on developer.
  • Demonstrated mastery of architectural patterns and the judgment to know which apply in a given context, at both the application and service level.
  • Proven expertise in Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with a track record of building and shipping production software.
  • Extensive full-stack development experience building scalable RESTful applications with React and Java/Spring Boot backend.
  • Advanced proficiency working with large scale relational database management systems (RDBMS).
  • Experience working with analytical systems and databases processing large volume of data.
  • Proficient with AI assisted development practices and tooling.
  • Proven experience developing cloud-based SaaS applications; experience working with AWS is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience owning production services, including reliability, performance, and incident response.
  • Professional experience using AI-assisted development tools in production work. Foundant uses Claude Code; deep expertise with a comparable tool is acceptable.
  • Extensive experience diagnosing and debugging complex technical issues across multiple components and services, including the use of debugging and profiling tools.
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the United States.
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:
  • Adaptive Achievement: Moves between unfamiliar codebases, domains, and problem spaces without losing momentum, and delivers high-quality solutions under shifting priorities and incomplete context.
  • Productive Collaboration: Leads engineers through complex initiatives by influence rather than authority — entering a team as a guest, earning trust quickly, and articulating direction clearly enough that the team can carry it forward without you.
  • Service Orientation: Treats internal engineering teams as clients, and understands that the reliability of a shared service is ultimately felt by the foundations and nonprofits depending on our software to do their work.
  • Business Insight: Weighs the blast radius of shared-service decisions across every product and client, balancing technical elegance against what actually advances the business and the communities we serve.
  • Active Learning: Builds working depth in unfamiliar stacks quickly, and applies rigorous judgment to AI-generated code — knowing when to lean on it, when to scrutinize it, and how to help colleagues do the same.
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.

jobs.description:
About Rancho BioSciences, LLC

Rancho BioSciences is a San Diego–based provider of biomedical data curation and data science services for pharma and biotech, spanning drug discovery through translational research. Our teams of scientists, data engineers, and software experts deliver end-to-end solutions across data curation, management, mining, and analysis to help customers accelerate R&D. We partner long-term with blue-chip clients and emerging biotechs, bringing scientific rigor, quality, and a customer-first mindset to every engagement.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Pathology Research Scientist to join us on a part-time, contractor basis. This individual will provide subject-matter expertise across biomarker discovery, diagnostic development, and computational pathology initiatives, supporting programs spanning translational research through clinical development.

The role requires deep expertise in surgical pathology, digital pathology, and tissue-based assays, and close collaboration with internal and client-facing teams in biomarkers, histotechnology/platform science, data science, and AI/ML. The Pathology Research Scientist will help ensure scientific rigor, clinical relevance, and regulatory-appropriate practices across multiple drug development and diagnostic programs.

The role will be fully remote, however preferred applicants are based on the US East Coast, Western Europe, or in the Asia-Pacific Region.

What you'll do

  • Serve as a pathology subject-matter expert (SME) for biomarker and diagnostic programs, including companion diagnostics, molecular pathology, digital pathology, and associated data science services.
  • Provide scientific guidance through critical literature review and synthesis of primary source data, including peer-reviewed publications, disease staging and grading systems, and established pathology reference standards.
  • Support computational pathology and AI/ML initiatives by translating clinical and histopathologic knowledge into actionable guidance for model design, training, validation, and interpretation.
  • Define disease- and indication-specific annotation guidelines, including relevant tissue compartments, cellular features, morphologic patterns, and common technical artifacts.
  • Perform or review digital slide annotations using validated platforms; provide peer review, quality control, and written validation of human- and algorithm-generated annotations in accordance with project requirements.
  • Support computational pathology and ML/AI teams through the translation of clinical and histopathologic knowledge into actionable guidance for model development, validation, and deployment.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure pathology-derived outputs are clinically meaningful, analytically sound, and fit-for-purpose within research and development workflows.

Qualifications

  • MD/DO, MBBS, or equivalent, with board certification or board eligibility in Anatomic Pathology (AP) or Anatomic and Clinical Pathology (AP/CP).
  • Surgical pathology subspecialty training or certification strongly preferred.
  • Experience in clinical trials, translational research, or drug development & creation strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience working within cross-functional, multi-stakeholder project teams with successful delivery against multiple competing priorities and quick turnaround expectations.
  • Hands-on experience with digital pathology platforms and AI-enabled or computational pathology workflows strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to draft, review, and quality-check research protocols and procedural documents with attention to detail and scientific rigor.
  • Ability to work within sponsor-provided systems, environments, and data governance requirements.
  • Advanced degree (e.g., MS, MPH, or PhD) in a life sciences discipline is a plus.

ROLE TITLE: Director, Social Media
POSITION REPORTS TO: Managing Director, Social Media

APPLICATION NOTE: As part of the application process for this role, please submit a portfolio or reel that represents your content creation experience — including examples of original content you've filmed, edited, and published. You can link your portfolio within your resume or attach it.

LOCATION: Remote

WHAT YOU'LL DO
We're looking for a Director of Social Media — a creator at heart who can concept, design, shoot, edit, and publish content that stops the scroll and grows our audience. This is a hands-on, make-the-content role for someone who knows what makes a still design or video work to engage and excite an audience. You'll turn big ideas into platform-native content, stay ahead of trends, and use performance data to keep making the work sharper. You'll partner closely with our Managing Director of Social Media to bring our channel strategy to life every day.

WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

  • Design and produce original content — from concept to published post — across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms (both static and video)

  • Film original content, including on-camera and behind-the-scenes video, both self-shot and on location

  • Edit video into polished, platform-native content optimized for each channel's format and audience

  • Monitor social and cultural trends daily, identifying which moments are right for the brand to enter — and which aren't

  • Pull, track, and interpret performance data to inform what content to create, continue, or retire

  • Partner with the Managing Director of Social Media to execute channel strategy and hit growth and engagement goals

  • Maintain a consistent publishing cadence and own the day-to-day content calendar

  • Write scroll-stopping copy and captions in a platform-native, brand-aligned voice

  • Engage with the community — responding to comments, sparking conversation, and building audience relationships

  • Manage light production logistics: sourcing talent or corps members to feature, scheduling shoots, and organizing footage

  • Collaborate with the design team to adapt content across formats

  • Stay ahead of platform changes, new tools, and content formats, bringing fresh ideas proactively

A WEEK IN THE LIFE

Monday

  • Review weekend performance and flag what's resonating

  • Join a team sync to align on the week's content priorities

  • Scan trends and cultural moments; pitch timely content ideas

Tuesday

  • Film original content — self-shot, on location, or with featured talent

  • Draft captions and shot lists for upcoming posts

  • Coordinate with the MD of Social on the week's calendar

Wednesday

  • Edit and finalize video for publishing

  • Schedule and publish content across platforms

  • Engage with the community in comments and DMs

  • Design original posts that are visually striking and on brand

Thursday

  • Produce reactive/trend-driven content while the moment is live

  • Collaborate with design on larger campaign assets

  • Review in-progress work with the MD of Social

Friday

  • Pull weekly performance data and extract insights

  • Share learnings and recommend adjustments for next week

  • Organize footage and plan upcoming shoots

YOUR EXPERIENCE

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 4+ years creating social content, with a portfolio or reel of original work you've filmed and edited (show us your illustrative and design chops!)

  • Hands-on video production and editing skills (e.g., CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent), shooting on both phone and camera

  • Deep fluency in social platforms, formats, and what performs on each — especially short-form video

  • A strong understanding of internet culture and Gen Z audiences, with the instinct to know which trends fit the brand

  • Proven track record growing engagement and following on at least one channel

  • Strong copywriting and storytelling instincts in a platform-native voice

  • Comfort pulling and interpreting performance data to guide content decisions

  • Excellent organization and the ability to manage multiple posts and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

  • Comfortable both in front of and behind the camera

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience being on camera as a host or creator

  • Experience with community management and creator/influencer partnerships

  • Personal experience as a content creator with a growing audience

  • Background or passion for design work

YOUR FUTURE TEAM
The Marketing Team’s purpose is to build a differentiated brand presence that surpasses benchmarks set by other prominent national nonprofits, illuminates our mission and impact to diverse audiences, creates understanding, and fosters deeper connections to TFA. Our unique role is to develop and execute cutting-edge marketing campaigns that accelerate the growth flywheel - propelling prospects, corps members, Ignite fellows, and alumni to take action, and ultimately inspiring them to become lifelong advocates. Our marketing strategies will ignite new levels of engagement with broader audiences, fueling a movement that resonates with the hearts and minds of donors, partners, supporters, and the general public.

Overview

Lynker Corporation is a leading provider of innovative solutions in weather and climate science. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for innovation, Lynker leverages cutting-edge technologies and scientific expertise to support the creation and delivery of improved operational weather forecasts. As part of our ongoing growth and expansion, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Capture Manager to join our growing team. The Capture Manager will play a critical role in positioning Lynker for sustained growth by identifying, shaping, qualifying, and capturing high-value opportunities aligned with the company’s technical capabilities and strategic expansion objectives. This is a hands-on capture role for an experienced Federal market professional who combines disciplined capture execution with established customer and industry relationships and actionable market intelligence. The successful candidate will bring demonstrated knowledge, relationships, and market insight within one or more of Lynker’s priority expansion markets, including the Department of Defense/Department of War (DoD/DoW), Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Department of Energy (DOE), Department of Interior (DOI), Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), or adjacent Federal markets that align with Lynker’s capabilities in science, engineering, technology, environmental services, data, and mission-critical IT.

Responsibilities

Duties of the Capture Manager will include the following:

Key Responsibilities

Capture Management and Execution

  • Lead assigned capture efforts from early opportunity identification and qualification through proposal submission, award, and transition.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive capture plans, including customer engagement, competitive assessment, win strategy, teaming, solution development, pricing strategy, and positioning.
  • Translate customer mission requirements, acquisition priorities, and competitive intelligence into differentiated win strategies and value propositions.
  • Lead opportunity qualification and gate reviews and make fact-based bid/no-bid recommendations to growth and executive leadership.
  • Maintain capture schedules, action plans, call plans, competitive assessments, and other capture artifacts necessary to maintain pursuit discipline and accountability.
  • Work closely with proposal leadership to ensure effective transition from capture through proposal development and submission.
  • Maintain CRM/Pipeline tool for information sharing and capture updates.

Market Development and Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain relationships with government customers, industry partners, incumbent contractors, and other stakeholders within assigned markets.
  • Provide actionable insight into agency missions, budgets, acquisition strategies, procurement trends, incumbents, competitors, and emerging requirements.
  • Identify opportunities before formal solicitation and develop customer engagement and shaping strategies that improve Lynker’s competitive position.
  • Identify adjacent opportunities where Lynker’s existing technical capabilities and past performance can be effectively transferred into new customers and mission environments.
  • Represent Lynker at industry events, customer engagements, conferences, and other market-development activities as appropriate.

Opportunity Qualification and Pipeline Development

  • Identify, assess, and qualify new opportunities consistent with Lynker’s strategic growth priorities.
  • Develop a qualified pipeline within assigned markets with realistic probability-of-win assessments, acquisition timelines, competitive intelligence, and next actions.
  • Distinguish actionable opportunities from speculative pipeline and focus capture resources on pursuits where Lynker can establish a credible path to win.
  • Support annual and multi-year market planning by identifying acquisition trends, upcoming recompetes, new programs, and potential white-space opportunities.

Teaming and Competitive Positioning

  • Identify and develop relationships with strategic teaming partners that strengthen Lynker’s capabilities, past performance, customer access, or competitive position.
  • Develop teaming strategies appropriate to each pursuit, including prime/subcontractor relationships, joint ventures, mentor-protégé arrangements, and other strategic partnerships where appropriate.
  • Conduct competitive assessments of incumbents and likely bidders and identify discriminators, vulnerabilities, and potential teaming opportunities.
  • Support positioning on relevant GWACs, BPAs, IDIQs, OTAs, and other contract vehicles that provide access to Lynker’s target markets.

Internal Collaboration

  • Partner with the CGO, Business Unit Leaders, Proposal Team, technical SMEs, and executive leadership to align capture strategy with Lynker’s operational capabilities and strategic priorities.
  • Engage technical and operational personnel early enough in the capture lifecycle to develop credible, differentiated solutions.
  • Participate in structured capture reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of Lynker’s business development and capture processes.
  • Provide concise reporting on capture status, customer intelligence, competitive positioning, risks, next actions, and probability of win.

Qualifications

The Capture Manager selected should have the following qualifications:

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible Federal business development, capture management, account management, or related experience, including substantial direct responsibility for competitive captures.
  • Demonstrated success leading or materially contributing to the capture and award of Federal contracts in the $30-100M+ range.
  • Established customer, industry, and partner relationships and strong market knowledge within at least one of the following:
    • Department of Defense/Department of War (DoD/DoW)
    • Department of Homeland Security (DHS)
    • Department of Energy (DOE)
    • Department of Interior (DOI)
    • Federal Aviation Administration (FAA)
    • Other Federal markets directly aligned with Lynker’s strategic expansion objectives
  • Demonstrated ability to develop actionable customer and competitive intelligence rather than relying solely on publicly available procurement information.
  • Experience shaping opportunities prior to solicitation release.
  • Strong understanding of Federal acquisition processes, including FAR/DFARS environments, OTAs, competitive procurements, IDIQs, GWACs, BPAs, and task-order competitions.
  • Experience developing capture plans, win strategies, competitive assessments, customer engagement plans, teaming strategies, and value propositions.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct organizational authority.
  • Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to operate independently while maintaining disciplined coordination with corporate growth and operational leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

The Ideal Capture Manager will have the following:

  • Established relationships and demonstrated market knowledge across two or more Lynker priority expansion markets.
  • Experience capturing science, engineering, environmental, data, AI/ML, cloud/HPC, cybersecurity, software development, or mission-critical IT programs.
  • Experience working within a growing small or mid-tier Federal contractor where capture managers are expected to personally execute capture activities rather than primarily oversee them.
  • Demonstrated experience converting customer relationships and market intelligence into qualified opportunities and contract awards.
  • Experience developing new agency accounts or expanding an organization beyond its traditional customer base.
  • Shipley capture training, Certified Capture Manager/Professional credentials, or equivalent formal capture methodology experience.
  • Experience with Technomile CRM, MS SharePoint, and GOVWIN IQ.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by the quality and maturity of the opportunities developed and captured, not by gross pipeline volume. Key indicators include:

  • Development of a credible, qualified pipeline within assigned expansion markets.
  • Increased customer access and meaningful engagement with decision-makers, program stakeholders, and acquisition personnel.
  • Identification and shaping of opportunities prior to solicitation release.
  • Achievement of capture milestones and disciplined advancement through Lynker’s gate-review process.
  • Improved competitive positioning and probability of win on assigned pursuits.
  • Development of strategic teaming relationships that materially improve Lynker’s competitive position.
  • Contract wins and expansion into new agencies, mission areas, and contract vehicles.

Salary range is commensurate with experience, market relationships, demonstrated capture success, and depth of knowledge within Lynker’s priority expansion markets. Exceptional candidates with a particularly strong customer network, demonstrated recent wins, and the ability to immediately establish Lynker within a priority market may warrant consideration above the stated range. The position should also be eligible for performance-based incentive compensation tied to individual and corporate growth objectives.

About Lynker

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities – creatively and effectively.

Lynker offers a team-oriented work environment, and the opportunity to work in a culture of exceptionally skilled professionals who embrace sound science and creative solutions. Lynker's benefits include the following:

  • Comprehensive healthcare for the employee at no monthly cost
  • Healthcare benefit covers medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision
  • Personal Time Off (PTO) Policy plus paid holidays
  • Highly competitive compensation plan regularly calibrated against industry and location benchmarks
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company-matching
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – we're all company owners!
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Life and accident insurance
  • Tuition assistance/Training/Workforce improvement reimbursement per year
  • Spot bonuses for exceptional performance
  • Annual Employee Recognition Awards with bonuses
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Free centralized, self-directed Learning Management System to learn at your own pace
  • Personalized career growth plans for every employee

Lynker is an E-Verify employer.

Lynker is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.excerpt: COMPANY OVERVIEWDoes the idea of applying your talents at a company that assists people in understanding how to obtain additional health care benefits and compensates well for doing so, inspire you?
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Does the idea of applying your talents at a company that assists people in understanding how to obtain additional health care benefits and compensates well for doing so, inspire you? We call it “Doing good while doing well” and invite you to apply to join us and begin moving forward along a beneficial career path – one built on providing solutions by helping others navigate through the complex world of health care benefits.

Here at BeneLynk, our mission is to improve lives and positively impact social determinants of health barriers by providing our healthcare partners with the information they need, and people with the advocacy they deserve. We are laser-focused on our longstanding area of expertise in the healthcare world. We fully understand barriers and surface solutions, then provide the advocacy that changes lives and improves outcomes. Everything we do, from the systems we build, to our government relations, to our outreach operations, is in service of this one central vision.

WHO WE ARE

We are big-hearted people, passionate about serving our health plan clients, their members, and each other. We are a team in every sense of the word, striving toward a common mission – that is the goal of everyone at BeneLynk. Every day, we are relentless in helping people who need essential resources to make their lives easier and healthier. The members we serve call us "miracles," "kind," "professional," "human," and "compassionate," and all with "service that gets the job done." We pride ourselves on creating a healthy environment for our employees to thrive in their ability to assist others.

QUALITY ASSURANCE ANALYST

POSITION SUMMARY

Benelynk is building the technology platform that powers Veteran Directed Care (VDC), a VA program that gives veterans the flexibility to direct their own long-term in-home care, including hiring and managing their own caregivers. We are seeking to hire a Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst to support a new product being added to our portfolio.

The Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible for monitoring, inspecting, testing, and proposing measures to correct or improve the organization’s products so that they meet established quality, functional, and compliance standards. In practical terms, this role designs and executes the test strategies, test plans, test suites, test cases, and test scripts that validate product functionality End-to-End — identifying, logging, and reproducing defects before they reach the user, and confirming that what was built matches what was asked for.

This position supports the technology platform BeneLynk is building to power Veteran Directed Care (VDC), a VA program that gives veterans the flexibility to direct their own long-term in-home care, including hiring and managing their own caregivers.

BeneLynk’s Engagement Advocates use an internal, proprietary platform (i.e., Veteran Choose) to guide veterans through the full lifecycle — onboarding, caregiver engagement, time submission and approval, payroll, and reporting. The platform also includes a self-service module that allows the Veteran, Case Manager, and Direct Care Worker to access the system directly to perform the functions they require and to retrieve their unique actions and reports.

Because this platform serves several very different audiences within a single connected system — veterans (many of whom are elderly or non-technical), family caregivers, professional Direct Care Workers, Enrollment Advocates, and partner agencies (ADNAs) — the QA Analyst must validate distinct role-based experiences, permissions, and workflows rather than a single user path. The role also carries a high-consequence testing burden: errors in eligibility, service authorizations, budgets, timesheets, or payroll affect a veteran’s care and a caregiver’s paycheck. Accuracy is not a preference here; it is the product.

The QA Analyst will work in conjunction with the Chief Product Officer, the Product Owner, the UI/UX Product Designer, Operations, and the Engineering (ENG) team to design, develop, test, validate, deploy, monitor, and manage the solutions being released. In addition, this individual will assist in capturing business needs and business requirements from stakeholders and in defining corresponding project and product directives relative to Product Development (PD) initiatives.

At BeneLynk we know that innovation does not come without rolling up our sleeves and getting the work done. The QA Analyst will be an integral piece in defining and executing testing strategies that ensure BeneLynk continues to deliver high-quality products and services to its customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Represent BeneLynk’s Customers:This function is listed first, because we always want to be thinking of how best to serve our internal and external customers. The first responsibility of the QA Analyst is to understand the business needs and goals of BeneLynk’s clients — and the lived experience of veterans, caregivers, and Direct Care Workers — along with the functionality of the products and services designed to address them.
  • Ensure Product Quality:The QA Analyst is responsible for designing and executing End-to-End validation and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of product functionality across both the Advocate-facing platform and the self-service module. This individual is vital to the assurance and attestation that BeneLynk products are absent of issues and recurrently adhere to the Voice of the Customer (VOC).
  • Validate Program and Payroll Integrity:The QA Analyst will validate the complex program logic that sits underneath the interface — eligibility, service authorizations, budget calculations, timesheet capture and approval, payroll processing, and reporting — including boundary conditions, rounding, retroactive corrections, and error-state handling.
  • Team Collaboration:This role is responsible for fostering an effective and collaborative team structure, working with colleagues across technical, business, and operational departments. This cohort will be part of a team structured to understand, design, and execute QA and UAT plans based on the business goals, needs, and requirements captured from these teammates.

This role may have multiple responsibilities, reflecting the small, but growing, size of BeneLynk as a company. All of us, including our senior management team, are on the front line performing what needs to be accomplished to establish BeneLynk as the nation’s premier provider of benefit and SDoH advocacy services.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Test Design and Execution

  • Develop test strategies, test plans, test suites, test cases, and test scripts — providing a high level of testing and analysis coverage across existing functionality and new features.
  • Execute role-based testing across all platform personas — Enrollment Advocate, Veteran, Case Manager, Direct Care Worker, and partner agency (ADNA) — validating that permissions, visibility, and available actions are correct for each role.
  • Validate the VDC service lifecycle End-to-End: onboarding, caregiver engagement, time submission and approval, payroll, and reporting.
  • Identify appropriate parameters, functions, and data to test and validate product attributes; parameters may include general function, validity of results, accuracy, reliability, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Test the self-service module against real-world usage conditions — including mobile devices, low-bandwidth connections, and assistive technology — recognizing that many end users are elderly, non-technical, or non-native English speakers.
  • Support accessibility validation against WCAG 2.1 AA as a baseline requirement, escalating findings to design and engineering.

Requirements, Documentation, and Reporting

  • Review design specifications, wireframes, prototypes, and project/product parameters to understand the scope, requirements, and function of the software product.
  • Conduct testing and analysis to ensure that products perform according to user requirements and within established guidelines as conveyed within the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and Project Charter (PC).
  • Assist in Requirements Gathering (RG) with stakeholders and end users, and help translate captured business needs into testable acceptance criteria.
  • Provide the testing scope/overview documentation, test plan, test results, and associated tickets for resolution and prioritization.
  • Maintain clear documentation of test coverage, results, and decisions to support audit readiness and compliance traceability (e.g., HIPAA, VA program requirements).

Defect Management and Continual Improvement

  • Identify, log, and recreate error codes, bugs, and defects; report findings to the Product Management Office (PMO) and/or Engineering (ENG) when applicable or required.
  • Respond quickly to QA/UAT and/or Production (PRD) issues, research and identify ways to reproduce defects, update tickets, and monitor the status of project/product initiatives accordingly.
  • Devise best practices, processes, and procedures to stringently inspect and report detailed quality issues for prompt correction.
  • Facilitate proactive solutions by collecting, analyzing, and communicating quality data.

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Collaborate with stakeholders including Product Management, Design, Engineering, Operations, and Leadership to understand the journey of our Advocates and the veterans and caregivers they assist.
  • Work on multiple initiatives to prioritize features, devise program testing and analysis requirements, create corresponding documentation and process flows, and define on-time delivery of End-to-End testing.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Chief Product Officer and/or BeneLynk leadership personnel regarding QA/UAT and/or business-related objectives.

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES/EXPERIENCE:

  • 2–4+ years in Quality Assurance (QA) and/or User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including experience leading product testing and analysis efforts across multiple QA and/or UAT initiatives.
  • Experience in Agile business/software development lifecycle processes and methodologies; experience with or knowledge of SCRUM fundamentals, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Experience performing End-to-End testing across multiple applications and developing test plans, test scripts, and a coverage matrix for comprehensive testing of the systems under test.
  • Ability to create test plans, test suites, and test cases from project/product specifications and/or verbal communication channels.
  • Experience creating written QA/UAT test reports showcasing test progress, status, test plan completion, defects identified, and associated risks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason through complex conditional business rules and identify the edge cases others miss.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Calm under pressure, with a proactive and self-starting attitude and excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to serve as a liaison among developers, designers, product managers, and operations.
  • Experience presenting information to teams, stakeholders, and/or executives.
  • Proficiency in the MSFT Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and/or related software.
  • Adept at understanding the premise, intent, and utilization of QA/UAT operations and how they coalesce with product design, development, and delivery processes.
  • Recurrently portrays a collegial comportment and candor to all BeneLynk cohorts.

REQUIRED EDUCATION/TRAINING

  • Associate degree in a related field required. Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred.

SUPERVISORY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • This position has no direct reports.
  • Assists Product Management leadership in orchestrating and supervising QA/UAT operations when applicable or required.
  • Assists Product Management leadership in performing training and development initiatives related to QA/UAT operations when applicable or required.

PREFERRED SKILLS/ABILITIES/EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION/TRAINING

  • Use of MSFT Azure DevOps (Test Plans, Test Suites, Test Cases) or a comparable test management suite.
  • Experience testing payroll, timekeeping, EVV, billing, or other financial transaction systems where calculation accuracy is material.
  • Familiarity with Veteran Directed Care (VDC), VD-HCBS, Financial Management Services (FMS), Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS), or VA program operations.
  • Experience in relevant fields including health plan systems, Medicare and Medicaid benefits, and/or SDoH database companies.
  • Testing and deploying solutions in a call center environment.
  • Exposure to accessibility testing standards and assistive technology.
  • Familiarity with test automation concepts and tooling.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field from a regionally accredited university.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at a time.
  • Must have a stable internet connection.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is a remote position.

POSITION TYPE/ EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK

Full-time/Exempt – This is a salaried position

SALARY

Based on Experience; Up to $80k annually

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

We offer competitive salaries and benefits here at BeneLynk, as we truly value our employees and the amazing work that they do each day. Please see below for a list of some of our awesome employee benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Employee Assistant Program Benefits
  • 401K Match
  • 15 Paid Days Annually
  • Excellent Growth & Advancement Opportunities

EMPLOYEE PERKS

Work hard, play hard!Having an engaged workforce and positive work environment is one of our top priorities here at BeneLynk. We do so through numerous initiatives that can be found below. We like to call our virtual work community, “The Bene-Verse”. We also have an internal Culture Ambassador committee dedicated to ensuring all employees have a pleasant and exciting work experience.

  • Monthly Company Town Hall Events:We love the opportunity to come together as a company. Join us monthly as we discuss exciting company updates, internal promotions, internal awards, upcoming events, and more!
  • Monthly Internal Mental Health Newsletters:Our Culture Ambassadors spearhead an internal newsletter centered on mental health topics. Our employees’ overall wellbeing is our top priority, so we like to provide support whenever it is needed through this uplifting internal newsletter.
  • Monthly Streaming Services Perk:Yes- we pay YOU to enjoy the television shows that you enjoy! We pay up to a $12 per month for any streaming service subscriptions that you currently have.
  • Tickets at Work Perk:Enjoy discounted movie tickets, hotel stays, and more through our company’s ‘Tickets at Work’ perk!
  • Monthly Lunch & Learn Events:Meet key members of our Senior Management team through engaging Lunch & Learn sessions on a monthly basis. Lunch is on us for those employees that sign up!
  • Monthly Bene-Verse Events:We put on awesome monthly events for our employees including virtual trivia, team building exercises, guided painting sessions, and more!

EEO STATEMENT

At BeneLynk, we don’t just accept differences; we celebrate, support, and thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our products, and the communities that we serve. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling this company’s unwavering commitment to equal employment opportunity. BeneLynk is an equal opportunity employer, and as such, employment here is solely based on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to their professional expertise.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any preemployment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our HR team.

E-VERIFY

BeneLynk participates in E-Verify. We will provide the U.S. Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employer’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

***Offer of employment is contingent upon the results of a required background and drug screening.***

jobs.description:
Overview

Under the direction of a Manager or Senior Manager, the Clinical Data Lead is an integral part of the account team as the subject matter expert, ensuring partner satisfaction through management of all quality tasks including new team member orientation, pre-submission cleaning of cases, validation of abstractor accuracy (IRR), completion of Fallout Reviews and the Second Look process.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct orientation to medical records for new abstraction team members
  • Manage the green-lighting process and completion of on-going IRR, identifying any performance concerns in collaboration with the Clinical Services Lead and escalating concerns to Senior Manager/Manager
  • Effectively manage the fallout review/exception/occurrence reporting and Second Look process, ensuring accurate reporting, and partnering with the Clinical Services Lead to ensure partner notification and review
  • Provide follow-up/feedback/education to the project team on quality issues or trends identified during greenlighting, on-going IRR, second looks, pre-submission cleaning, review of project quality trends, etc.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Services Lead and Senior Manager/Manager to identify quality trends in the data with respect to internal team performance, and also identify hospital quality trends to share with partners
  • Mentor, train and provide guidance to new hires during the onboarding process at assigned facilities
  • Maintain and share abstraction team support documents, including Measure Detail and Documentation Clarification Forms, regularly updating with new measures and/or partner EMR changes
  • Complete the 1st pass of pre-submission clean-up, update cases when missing documentation is provided
  • Subject matter expert in assigned registry or measure. Provide expert abstraction support – 15% - 20% abstraction
  • Other quality tasks, as assigned
  • Attend new partner orientation in order to orient new team members as added to the project
  • Work closely with the Clinical Services Lead, as needed, for case-specific questions
  • Other partner tasks, as delegated by the Clinical Services Lead or the Senior Manager/Manager

Qualifications

  • 2+ years direct data abstraction experience in the Adult National Surgical Quality Improvement Program (NSQIP).
  • Experience abstracting procedure targeted cases
  • SCR (Surgical Clinical Reviewer) Certification
  • Surgical nursing background (preferred)
  • Exposure to multiple patient medical record systems (EMRs) and clinical databases
  • 1+ years providing coaching and guidance to teams (preferred)
  • RN, LPN, RT, RVT, or RCIS credentials (preferred)
  • Intermediate proficiency with MS Office (Microsoft Excel)
  • Demonstrates high standards for accuracy and attention to detail
  • Demonstrates technical savvy and strong desire to learn new systems and technology
  • Thrives working independently and takes ownership of projects
  • Consistently and clearly communicates, adjusting style and tone as needed to effectively collaborate with hospital partners, peers, abstractors and others
  • Demonstrates strong self-organizational and time management skills to concurrently manage multiple accounts, adjusting as needed to shifting timelines and priorities
  • Adapts to changes in project timelines, requirements, and assignments
  • Maintains a high degree of responsibility in keeping PHI secure and confidential

jobs.excerpt: OverviewUnder the direction of the Manager or Senior Manager, the Clinical Services Lead plays a vital role in the account team, driving partner satisfaction through continuous communication and effective project management.
jobs.description:
Overview

Under the direction of the Manager or Senior Manager, the Clinical Services Lead plays a vital role in the account team, driving partner satisfaction through continuous communication and effective project management. The Clinical Services Lead is responsible for ensuring partner deliverables are met during new implementations and ongoing projects by monitoring and prioritizing case workflows and addressing first-tier service issues. As a key member of the clinical leadership team, this role collaborates closely with Clinical Data Leads, Clinical Data Quality Specialists, the abstraction team, and Client Services management to ensure high-quality service delivery to our partners.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee deadlines, team productivity, and case completion providing follow-up as necessary to ensure partner deliverables are met and target service line operational goals are achieved.
  • Coach team members on missed deadlines and inform SM/MCS of missed deadlines.
  • Create case assignments.
  • Monitor partner case volumes and hours to ensure teams are properly staffed to meet partner turnaround time, and request resource adjustments as needed.
  • Review key operating metrics to provide data driven recommendations to support business financial goals.
  • Serve as our partners’ primary point of contact for Client Services.
  • Maintain high levels of partner satisfaction by driving engagement and anticipating customer needs through ongoing communication, including scheduling and facilitating partner meetings and agendas.
  • Responsible for overall deliverables to partners including meeting deadlines, data submission agreements, and service agreements as outlined in the partner contract.
  • Championing the use of QC technology to streamline internal workflows and providing technology demonstrations for partners, as needed.
  • Proactively identify risk to partner satisfaction and escalate to SM/MCS.
  • Act as primary owner within Client Services for new implementations, reporting out on status when asked and serving as the point to solve implementation delays by working closely with the Project Manager and SM/MCS.
  • Participate in process improvement work to support overall Q-Centrix or Client Services department initiatives.
  • Discuss quality performance opportunities with partners to decrease fallout reviews or enhance quality outcomes.
  • Other quality tasks, as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Familiar with hospital Core Measures and/or the Get With the Guidelines Stroke registry
  • Intermediate proficiency with MS Office (Microsoft Excel)
  • Exposure to multiple patient medical record systems (EMRs) and clinical databases
  • 1+ years providing coaching and guidance to teams (preferred)
  • Experience with evaluating operating financial metrics (preferred)
  • RN, LPN, RT, RVT, or RCIS credentials (preferred)
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to approach problems in a systematic method using the ability to synthesize data and suggest recommendations.
  • Demonstrates high standards for accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrates technical savvy and adeptness to learn new systems and technology.
