jobs.excerpt: About JitsuJitsu is a last-mile delivery service that allows brands to give their customers a consistent delivery experience all the way to the doorstep.
jobs.description:
About Jitsu

Jitsu is a last-mile delivery service that allows brands to give their customers a consistent delivery experience all the way to the doorstep. Using a proprietary AI-powered technology platform, Jitsu helps its customers deliver on their promise of affordable, reliable, expedited shipping with a 99+% on-time delivery rate. Logistics teams can now provide a differentiated delivery experience at a competitive cost through successful first delivery attempts, fewer claims, coverage in the markets that matter, and upfront pricing with no hidden surcharges. Jitsu operates in urban areas across the U.S., enabling high-volume shippers to exercise control over their end-to-end delivery network. Learn more at gojitsu.com

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer to lead the design and architecture of mission-critical apps our delivery fleet and operations teams rely on in the field and in our logistics facilities. Thousands of delivery partners and Jitsu staff use these apps at any given moment, and our operations run on them. That means you'll own real solutions to real business problems. You'll become a trusted member of a team that cares deeply about quality and craft, because we believe that's the best way to serve our clients, customers, partners, and teammates. AI is changing how software gets built week to week, and we see that as an opportunity. Together, we'll turn each new capability into better tools and better ways of working.

What You'll Do

We're not hiring someone to close tickets. We're hiring someone to understand real operational problems and own the solutions, using whatever technology the problem calls for.

  • Start with the problem. Spend real time with the people who rely on our work: operations leaders, site leads, warehouse teams, and delivery partners. You'll do whatever it takes to deeply understand the problem and the people you're serving, which may include visiting warehouses, working a sort shift, or riding along on a delivery route.
  • Own the solution, not just the code. Take problems from discovery through design, delivery, and adoption, and stay with them until they're actually solved in the field.
  • Build technology that holds up in the real world. Our Flutter apps move millions of shipments a year, in warehouses and on the road. You'll make them work offline, scan fast, track location reliably, and ship releases our operations can count on.
  • Work across the stack. If the right solution needs a backend service, a data fix, new tooling, or a process change, you'll make sure it happens, building it yourself when needed, and also partnering with the broader engineering team.
  • Shape how we build with AI. Help us figure out what new AI capabilities mean for our tools, our workflow, and our craft, and turn the best ideas into everyday practice.
  • Raise the bar for everyone. Mentor teammates, set technical direction and quality standards for mobile, and make the engineers around you better.

What Matters Most

We care more about how you solve problems than about any list of skills. The engineers who thrive here are the ones who see every unfamiliar problem as something they can figure out. We believe almost anything can be learned and accomplished if you ask the right questions and assemble the right context.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Owns solutions end to end. You don't hand off a problem just because it's outside your area. You dig in and get it done instead of waiting for someone else.
  • Uses AI to go beyond their specialty. You can point to real work outside your core expertise that you shipped by working effectively with AI tools.
  • Has good judgment about AI. You know when its output is right, when it's subtly wrong, and how to give it the context it needs.
  • Makes the people around them better. You communicate clearly, explain your thinking to technical and non-technical audiences, and people want you on their projects.

Permission to Play

These are the baseline for this senior role. They're necessary, but they're not what will set you apart:

  • 5+ years building and shipping production iOS and Android apps, with deep Flutter expertise.
  • Solid mobile architecture skills: state management, modular structure, and patterns that keep a growing codebase maintainable.
  • Experience designing and consuming REST and gRPC APIs, and a working understanding of distributed systems.
  • A track record of performant, reliable features for a large user base, built alongside other engineers.

Nice to Have

  • Native iOS or Android SDK experience (Swift or Kotlin).
  • Experience integrating on-device or cloud AI/ML features into mobile apps.

Why Jitsu

  • Solve meaningful business problems that have a visible impact every single day
  • Be part of a well-funded, fast-growing company tackling complex and relevant challenges
  • Gain critical experience applying cutting-edge AI technologies in a variety of settings
  • Competitive compensation and equity incentives
  • Health, vision, and dental insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Unaccrued PTO Policy
  • 100% remote

jobs.description:
RESPONSABLE DE L’IMPLÉMENTATION CLIENT

FCM adopte une approche globale des voyages d’affaires et se spécialise dans la gestion de programmes de voyages nationaux et internationaux pour les entreprises de moyenne et grande envergure.
Classée parmi les cinq plus grandes sociétés de gestion de voyages au monde, FCM dispose d’un réseau d’affaires présent dans plus de 97 pays, avec des sièges sociaux mondiaux à Londres, Brisbane, Singapour et New York. Appuyée par la force mondiale de Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combine une expertise locale et une portée internationale afin d’offrir à ses clients une expérience véritablement personnalisée.
Fondée en juin 2004, FCM a été nommée Meilleure société de gestion de voyages au monde pendant huit années consécutives aux World Travel Awards.

Pour en savoir plus sur FCM, veuillez cliquer ICI


À propos du poste

Joignez-vous à FCM à titre de Responsable de l’implémentation client et jouez un rôle clé dans la prestation d’une expérience d’intégration fluide auprès de clients nationaux et multinationaux. Ce poste est au cœur de la réussite client, veillant à ce que les nouveaux clients soient implantés avec succès, soutenus efficacement et positionnés en vue d’un partenariat à long terme. Vous collaborerez avec les parties prenantes internes et les équipes clientes, gérerez plusieurs projets d’implémentation simultanément et contribuerez à l’atteinte de résultats exceptionnels pour la clientèle. Si vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, coordonner des projets et offrir une expérience client remarquable, cette occasion vous permettra d’avoir un impact concret.

Responsabilités principales

  • Gérer l’implémentation et l’intégration de clients nationaux et multinationaux conformément aux processus d’implémentation établis.
  • Offrir une expérience client d'une qualité supérieure tout au long du cycle de vie de chaque projet.
  • Coordonner et animer les réunions d’implémentation avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Assurer le suivi des échéanciers et veiller au respect des jalons convenus pour chaque implémentation.
  • Identifier, communiquer et escalader les risques liés aux projets en appliquant les méthodologies de gestion des risques en place.
  • Maintenir à jour et avec exactitude la documentation d’implémentation, les énoncés de travaux (SOW) et les dossiers de projet.
  • Recueillir et valider de manière proactive les informations nécessaires à la bonne réalisation du projet.
  • Soutenir les projets d’implémentation régionaux pour les clients multinationaux ainsi que l’adoption continue des outils en ligne.
  • Assurer le suivi de l’avancement des projets et des échéanciers au moyen des outils internes de gestion de projet.
  • Veiller au respect des normes, systèmes, processus et meilleures pratiques liés à l’implémentation.
  • Collaborer efficacement avec les collègues, les gestionnaires et les parties prenantes afin d’atteindre les objectifs d’implémentation.
  • Appuyer les activités de tests d’acceptation par les utilisateurs (UAT) et veiller à l’exactitude des implémentations.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue grâce aux revues de projet et aux commentaires des clients.
  • Favoriser un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et accessible où tous les Flighties se sentent accueillis, respectés et soutenus dans leur réussite.
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche ou responsabilité connexe assignée.
  • Autres tâches et responsabilités assignées
  • Contribuer à un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et accessible où tous les Flighties se sentent accueillis, respectés et soutenus afin de s’épanouir

Expérience et compétences

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience au sein de Flight Centre ou 2 ans d’expérience à titre de Gestionnaire de l’implémentation ou dans un poste similaire.
  • Excellente compréhension des processus d’implémentation.
  • Feuille de route démontrée en matière de réussite dans des fonctions antérieures.
  • Solides compétences en coordination de projets et en gestion du temps.
  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.
  • Fort sens des affaires et excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des clients et des parties prenantes à divers niveaux organisationnels.
  • Connaissance des outils de réservation en ligne, un atout.
  • Approche souple et grande capacité d’adaptation dans un environnement d’affaires en constante évolution.
  • Disponibilité pour effectuer des déplacements occasionnels, au besoin.
  • Bilinguisme (français et anglais) requis
  • Une connexion Internet fiable et à haut débit est requise pour assurer les responsabilités essentielles du poste, y compris, sans s’y limiter, la vidéoconférence, l’accès aux systèmes de l’entreprise et le traitement sécurisé des données de l’entreprise.
  • Le bilinguisme français/anglais est requis, en raison de la nature du poste qui consiste à traiter avec des clients et des fournisseurs français et anglais.

Des conditions de travail qui ont de quoi séduire!

FCTG est reconnu dans le monde entier pour ses magnifiques conditions de travail et sa culture entrepreneuriale encore plus exceptionnelle. Nous savons que notre personnel est notre atout le plus précieux. C’est la passion et le dévouement de nos équipes qui maintiennent notre entreprise au sommet de son industrie. C’est également la raison pour laquelle nous offrons des avantages sociaux et des primes hors du commun à notre personnel.

  • Amusez-vous: l’importance d’avoir du plaisir au travail imprègne chacun de nos gestes.
  • Obtenez des récompenses et une reconnaissance: voyez vos succès et ceux des autres être applaudis lors des fameuses soirées Buzz que nous organisons régulièrement, ainsi qu’au rassemblement mondial annuel. Il faut le vivre pour le croire !
  • Puisez dans votre génie : nos collaborateurs se servent de leur vivacité d’esprit, de leur savoir-faire et de leur persévérance pour trouver en tout temps une solution.
  • L’amour du voyage : notre société a été fondée par des personnes qui voulaient voyager et qui souhaitaient que d’autres en fassent autant. Cette passion marque immanquablement tout notre personnel et l’ensemble de nos services.
  • Des liens personnels : le fondement de notre grande entreprise repose sur les relations personnelles.
  • Diversité, équité et inclusion : engagement envers la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion à travers des initiatives telles que la Journée de la diversité (congé payé pour observer un jour férié ou une célébration culturelle de votre choix) Groupes de ressources pour les employés (équité raciale, équité des genres, LGBTQ2IA+, accessibilité, justice environnementale ), les initiatives éducatives du DEI et les pratiques équitables, y compris des évaluations régulières de l'équité et des protocoles de recrutement inclusifs.
  • Une carrière, et non un boulot: nous offrons à tous de véritables possibilités de croissance et d’évolution personnelle.
  • Nous offrons notre soutien tout temps à nos employés : nous nous engageons fermement à soutenir chaque employé dans son développement professionnel et personnel.
  • Redonner en retour : nous nous engageons à faire une différence grâce à notre programme de responsabilité sociale d'entreprise, qui soutient les organismes de bienfaisance désignés via le bénévolat et la collecte de fonds, notre programme environnemental de bureau, des espaces de bureau certifiés LEED® Gold et une journée de bénévolat rémunérée par année civile.

Voici un aperçu des avantages offerts :
Avantages

  • Politique généreuse de congés payés
  • Avantages et rabais liés aux voyages
  • Programmes de santé et de bien-être et services de bien-être financier pour les employés
  • Soirées de reconnaissance et conférences nationales et internationals
  • Avantages sociaux collectifs, incluant l’assurance maladie complémentaire, les soins dentaires et de la vue, les soins d’affirmation de genre et les soins de fertilité
  • Assurances, incluant l’assurance vie, l’assurance décès et mutilation accidentels, l’assurance maladies graves et l’assurance invalidité de longue durée
  • Programme d’aide aux employés
  • REER/RPA avec contribution de l’employeur
  • Programme de remboursement des frais de scolarité
  • Régime d’actionnariat des employés – possibilité d’acheter des actions de la société à la Bourse australienne, avec une contribution partielle de l’employeur, sous réserve des modalités et conditions applicables
  • Possibilités de carrière à l’échelle mondiale au sein d’un réseau de marques et d’entreprises

Emplacement – TÉLÉTRAVAIL, Canada

Si vous pensez que c’est là le poste que vous cherchiez et que vous souhaitez adhérer à notre culture entrepreneuriale primée, POSTULEZ SANS TARDER.

Cette offre d'emploi correspond à un poste vacant que nous cherchons actuellement à pourvoir.

Dans le cadre de notre processus de recrutement, nous pouvons utiliser des outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA) pour soutenir différentes étapes, notamment la présélection et l’évaluation des candidatures. Ces outils nous aident à évaluer les candidats en fonction des qualifications, des compétences et de l’expérience pertinentes pour le poste. Notre philosophie numéro un? Nos employés. La promesse de Flight Centre Travel Group est de fournir un environnement où prônent le respect, la dignité et des opportunités pour tous nos employés. Nous nous engageons à procurer un environnement où règne l’égalité en matière de respect, de dignité et de possibilités pour tous les membres de notre personnel. Join Mitto and be beyond! 🚀

Eager to go beyond? If so, we’d love to meet you!

We’re Mitto and we’re thrilled to be revolutionizing the way the world communicates through our Cloud-Communications-Platform-as-a-Service (CPaaS).

We were launched in 2013 with SMS and quickly blossomed beyond to include voice, chatbots, all major chat apps, and CRM/marketing platform integrations. We also developed pre-built tools for bulk campaigns and conversational support chats. We’re riding a wave into the future, and you can join! 🏄🏼

Here at Mitto, you’ll be working with a global team of people that’s spread out across 32 locations - and growing! We’re proud to be a group of curious minds that scour the landscape for whatever’s next in omnichannel communication. We’re adaptive, resilient, and determined. 💪 🧠

In joining Mitto, you’ll enjoy an endless array of opportunities and benefits. With us, you’ll get to skip the morning commute and work from the comfort of your own home! 🏠 Our team members also enjoy a supportive, engaging, and collaborative culture with flexible working hours.

The role: Partnerships Manager

📍Location: UK

As our next Partnerships Manager, you’ll go beyond in developing, managing, and growing Mitto’s strategic SaaS partnerships across the EMEA region by driving joint go-to-market success, expanding pipeline opportunities, and strengthening long-term ecosystem relationships. In return, you’ll be part of a global company that goes beyond for you too—giving you everything you need to be ahead of tomorrow, everything you need to be beyond.

How you’ll go beyond: 📈

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic SaaS partners across EMEA
  • Develop and execute partner business plans aligned with Mitto’s growth objectives
  • Build strong relationships with partner executives, sales leaders, and key stakeholders
  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline to generate new revenue opportunities
  • Identify opportunities for Mitto’s customer engagement solutions within partner ecosystems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, Product, and Marketing teams to accelerate deal progression
  • Deliver partner enablement sessions and ensure strong understanding of Mitto’s products and value proposition
  • Execute joint go-to-market initiatives, including campaigns, webinars, events, and account mapping activities
  • Support partner-led customer presentations, workshops, and executive meetings
  • Expand adoption of Mitto’s integrations and grow Mitto’s presence within enterprise B2C accounts across EMEA

What you bring to the table: 🤓

  • 5+ years of experience in Partner Management, Alliances, Business Development, or Channel Sales
  • Experience working within CPaaS, Customer Engagement, CRM, Marketing Automation, SaaS, or MarTech ecosystems
  • Proven ability to build, manage, and grow strategic technology partnerships
  • Strong commercial acumen with a proven track record of generating pipeline and revenue through partnerships
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) is mandatory and additional European languages are considered a plus
  • Willingness to travel across EMEA for partner meetings, customer engagements, industry events, and conferences

How we’ll go beyond for you: 💗

  • A collaborative environment of talented individuals across the world that enables you, and every other team member, to make a direct impact on our collective success
  • Full flexibility in where, when, and how you work (remote-first culture, generous time off, flexible hours, lots of autonomy to do your best work)
  • From 25 days of paid time off to "New Baby" gifts – at Mitto, we take care of your wellbeing in and outside of work
  • Opportunities to work with some of the world’s leading SaaS platforms and enterprise brands
  • A fast-growing, international environment where innovation and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do

Ready to take your career beyond? 🚀

Then we’re ready to hear from you. Shoot us a message today. 📲

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAt BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better.
jobs.description:
About the Role

At BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better. Our newsletter and email program is central to how we engage our members and drive results for our advertising and merchant partners—and this role runs that engine.

We’re seeking a highly hands-on Director of Newsletter & Email Marketing who lives and breathes newsletter strategy, deliverability, engagement, and monetization. If you have run a monetized newsletter program at scale—this is the role for you. This is a true player-coach role: you’ll shape the strategy, but you’ll also be in the work: building campaigns, solving problems, analyzing performance, testing, optimizing, and jumping in wherever needed, while leading a high-performing team.

You’ll own a high-volume newsletter program of 40+ campaigns per week, along with automated lifecycle journeys, partnering closely with internal marketing stakeholders, Ad Sales and Merchant teams—advising on best practices and turning sold inventory and placements into engaging, effective campaigns. As a strategic right hand to the VP of Global Marketing, you’ll balance commercial performance with a great member experience while continuously pushing the program forward.

If you’re a hands-on email leader who wants to take a strong, high-volume program and make it even better—sharper targeting, cleaner deliverability, and more value for members and partners alike—we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Newsletter Excellence, Monetization and Partner Performance

  • Execute the newsletter program as a high-performing media channel, optimizing how sponsored placements and commissionable offers are delivered to drive strong, defensible performance for our partners while protecting the member experience.
  • Serve as the email and newsletter expert to Ad Sales and the Merchant team, advising on inventory, placement, and campaign best practices and bringing data-backed recommendations that improve monetization to the teams responsible for what is sold and placed.
  • Report program and placement performance credibly to partners and leadership, using defensible, trustworthy metrics.
  • Own the execution and performance of every campaign, translating results into best-practice guidance and recommendations that help Ad Sales, Merchant, and Marketing teams improve outcomes over time.
  • Propose and, once approved, execute the global (22-market) newsletter strategy and roadmap, balancing send volume and frequency with engagement and long-term list health. Translate the strategy into a market-by-market campaign and inventory calendar used cross-functionally by Ad Sales, the Merchant team, and Marketing.

Campaign Execution and Deliverability Excellence

  • Oversee a full portfolio of concurrent campaigns-from planning through send and post-send analysis.
  • Build, QA, schedule, and deploy newsletter and email campaigns in our ESP, personally and through your team.
  • Manage dynamic, catalog-driven offer placement and per-segment/per-client targeting and suppression at scale.
  • Develop mobile-first templates flexible enough to A/B test any element, refreshed quarterly on performance, best practices, and trends; run an ongoing testing program across offers, segmentation, timing, and creative.
  • Own inbox placement, sender reputation, and deliverability across multiple sending domains and markets - IP/domain warm-up, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), list hygiene, audience data quality, and feedback loops - monitored with tools such as Validity/Everest, Google Postmaster Tools, and Microsoft SNDS.
  • Serve as the internal expert on deliverability best practices and mailbox-provider requirements.

Engagement, Lifecycle, and Product Campaigns

  • Balance commercial goals with a great member experience, delivering the right offer to the right member to drive discovery, clicks, and purchase activity.
  • Own audience segmentation and personalization by market, client, and member behavior, matching messaging and placements to the right audiences with a focus on engagement and deliverability, while ensuring client settings are always respected.
  • Design and run lifecycle and behavior-based journeys-activation, welcome, re-engagement, and win-back-to grow engagement and long-term value while reducing churn.
  • Own a smaller but strategically important set of product marketing and go-to-market sends that grow adoption of BenefitHub's own products and verticals (e.g., home and auto insurance, the browser extension), in partnership with Marketing stakeholders.

Performance, Team and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Define and track KPIs across performance, engagement, deliverability, and lifecycle - including weekly reporting on open rate, CTR, CTOR, and sender reputation - and lead regular performance updates to marketing leadership, the executive team, and the broader company on results, trends, and priorities, adjusting based on data.
  • Ensure advertiser- and partner-facing metrics are accurate and defensible, with an awareness of non-human/invalid traffic (bots, scanners, prefetch) and its impact on reported performance, partnering with analytics to mitigate it.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of email marketers and email marketing specialists responsible for executing our newsletter, email marketing, and journey programs.
  • Oversee, own, and continuously improve the operating framework for intake, QA, approvals, and reporting for efficiency and clear cross-departmental communication.
  • Manage vendor relationships (ESP, CDP, and deliverability tools) and act as a key stakeholder in ESP strategy, capabilities, and any platform evaluation or migration.
  • Ensure compliance with email and privacy regulations across our markets (e.g., CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR), and own consent, subscription, and preference management.

What You Bring—Required

  • 9+ years of hands-on email marketing in a high-volume program, including at least 7 years running a newsletter or email program monetized through sponsored placements and/or commissionable/affiliate revenue.
  • Experience programming reoccurring newsletters: maintaining send and inventory calendar while balancing paid placements with member experience.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in email deliverability, compliance and reputation management (IP/domain warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, mailbox-provider relations).
  • Hands-on mastery of a major enterprise ESP and CDP / marketing-automation stack — our current stack includes Iterable and Lytics — across segmentation, dynamic content, automation, lifecycle journeys, behavioral targeting, and reporting.
  • Proven success managing and developing a high-performing team.
  • Strong command of segmentation, personalization, dynamic content, A/B testing methodologies, plus experience building triggered and automated journeys
  • Advanced knowledge of marketing analytics, attribution modeling, and performance measurement, building KPIs and dashboards and translating performance data into insights for partners and executives — with the judgment to distinguish genuine engagement from invalid traffic.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

What sets you apart—preferred

  • Background at an ecommerce, marketplace, perks/benefits, affiliate, deals, newsletter publishing or media/ad-monetization company preferred (e.g., PerkSpot, EBG / Perks at Work, LifeMart, Rakuten, Groupon, RetailMeNot, or similar)
  • Understanding of the HR, benefits, and employee-engagement landscape
  • Experience with multi-tenant programs, product-marketing/GTM email, global multi-market programs, and evaluating or migrating ESPs.

Benefits include:

  • Medical and Dental (Employer paid 75% of monthly contributions)
  • Telehealth (Employer paid 100%
  • Vision Insurance (Employer paid 100% of monthly contributions)
  • Domestic Partner Coverage for all insurance plans
  • 100% employer-paid Life Insurance
  • 401(K) retirement plan options (including employer contribution)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous Sick Time Off (STO) Program
  • Generous Paid Paternity and Maternity Leave Policies
  • 11 Holidays (Including office closed day after Thanksgiving)
  • Flexible Spending Account program
  • Voluntary Benefit Programs (STD, LTD, Life Insurance, Accident, Cancer)

About BenefitHub

BenefitHub is the premier employee lifestyle benefits platform, connecting millions of employees with exclusive discounts, rewards, and perks. Our mission is to enhance the lives of employees worldwide while helping organizations attract, retain, and engage top talent through meaningful benefits.

jobs.title: Closing Team Leader
jobs.excerpt: Overview• At World Business Lenders (WBL), we provide flexible, short-term commercial loans backed by real estate to help small and medium-sized businesses across the United States, particularly those facing difficulties securing traditional financing.
jobs.description:
Overview

  • At World Business Lenders (WBL), we provide flexible, short-term commercial loans backed by real estate to help small and medium-sized businesses across the United States, particularly those facing difficulties securing traditional financing.
  • We are a fast-moving, results-driven organization focused on efficient execution, strong risk management, and protecting the company's collateral position.

About the Role

  • The Closing Team Leader supports the day-to-day operations of the Closing function, helping ensure loans move efficiently from Clear-to-Close through funding while meeting quality standards, internal procedures, and required service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • This role provides hands-on leadership, guidance, and support to Closing team members, monitors workload and pipeline performance, and helps resolve operational issues that may affect closing timelines or funding. The Closing Team Leader works closely with Title, Underwriting, Credit, Processing, Valuations, Legal, and Funding to ensure closing conditions are satisfied accurately and on time.
  • The role also supports coordination with closing attorneys, title companies, settlement agents, and other third-party partners to facilitate timely closings and protect WBL's collateral position.

What Success Looks Like

  • Maintain an organized, productive Closing Team with clear priorities and accountability.
  • Ensure loans progress efficiently from Clear-to-Close through closing and funding, meeting established SLAs and quality standards.
  • Promote accurate and complete closing documentation while minimizing delays and post-closing defects.
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks, resolve routine operational issues, and escalate complex exceptions appropriately.
  • Support effective coordination across internal departments and external partners while helping protect WBL's collateral position.

What You'll Be Doing

Closing Operations & Team Leadership

  • Coordinate the day-to-day activities of the Closing Team, including workload distribution, task prioritization, and deadline management.
  • Monitor the closing pipeline to ensure loans progress from Clear-to-Close through closing and funding.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, training, and day-to-day support to Closing team members.
  • Monitor team productivity, turnaround times, workload, and compliance with established SLAs.
  • Follow up on outstanding closing conditions, missing documentation, and pending approvals.
  • ·Review closing packages and related documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established procedures.
  • Help ensure loan documents, settlement statements, payoff documentation, closing instructions, and funding conditions are properly addressed before closing.
  • Assist team members in resolving routine closing issues and escalate complex exceptions when necessary.
  • Coordinate with Underwriting, Credit, Processing, Valuations, Legal, Title, and Funding to address outstanding conditions and keep transactions on schedule.
  • Communicate pipeline status, delays, risks, and operational concerns to management.
  • Support onboarding and training for new team members and reinforce established procedures and performance expectations.

Title Coordination & Collateral Requirements

  • Coordinate with the Title Team to ensure title clearance requirements are addressed before closing.
  • Track outstanding title conditions, lien-related requirements, vesting issues, and other items that may affect closing readiness.
  • Follow up on title commitments, title policies, lien searches, payoff information, and related documentation as needed.
  • Help ensure title requirements and exceptions are resolved accurately and within established timelines.
  • Coordinate with title specialists and escalate complex title defects, lien priority concerns, judgments, vesting issues, or other exceptions affecting collateral.
  • Support the verification of requirements necessary to protect WBL's collateral interests and first-lien position.
  • Communicate title-related delays and outstanding requirements to the appropriate internal stakeholders.

Attorney, Title & Settlement Partner Coordination

  • Maintain day-to-day communication with closing attorneys, title companies, settlement agents, escrow providers, and other third-party partners.
  • Follow up on pending documents, closing schedules, payoff statements, settlement figures, and other transaction requirements.
  • Help resolve routine vendor and transaction-level issues that may affect closing timelines.
  • Monitor partner responsiveness and communicate recurring service issues or delays to management.
  • Support positive working relationships with external partners to improve coordination, turnaround times, and closing quality.

Process Improvement & Quality Control

  • Follow established SOPs, checklists, workflows, and documentation standards.
  • Identify recurring errors, process gaps, and workflow bottlenecks and recommend practical improvements to management.
  • Perform quality checks on closing documentation and ensure identified issues are addressed before closing or funding.
  • Monitor outstanding items, recurring defects, and operational trends.
  • Support corrective actions and process updates designed to improve accuracy, efficiency, and consistency.
  • Help maintain accurate pipeline records, transaction notes, and reporting.
  • Reinforce consistent application of procedures and quality standards across the team.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure day-to-day Closing activities follow company policies, established procedures, applicable legal requirements, and relevant investor requirements.
  • Verify that required closing conditions and documentation are addressed before loans proceed to closing and funding.
  • Identify and escalate potential legal, title, documentation, lien, and collateral risks.
  • Follow established escalation procedures for exceptions, unresolved conditions, and transactions requiring additional review or approval.
  • Work with Legal, Title, and other relevant stakeholders to help resolve issues while protecting WBL's collateral position.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation and communication records in accordance with company procedures.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree, Associate's degree, or equivalent relevant education and experience preferred.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in mortgage or commercial lending closing, title, escrow, settlement, or related lending operations preferred.
  • Previous experience providing day-to-day guidance, training, workflow coordination, or operational support to team members.
  • Experience managing loan pipelines, closing deadlines, and service-level requirements.
  • Experience reviewing loan documentation, title commitments, settlement statements, payoff documentation, and closing requirements.
  • Experience coordinating with closing attorneys, title companies, settlement agents, and internal lending departments.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, troubleshoot, and escalate closing, title, documentation, and funding issues.

Must-Have Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of loan closing, title clearance, collateral documentation, and real estate-secured lending.
  • Ability to coordinate workloads, prioritize deadlines, monitor SLAs, and manage high-volume pipelines.
  • Experience reviewing closing documentation, identifying deficiencies, and resolving routine issues while escalating complex matters.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and timely execution.

Preferred Background / Industry Experience

  • Experience in commercial or private lending, Non-QM mortgage lending, MCA, title insurance, escrow, or settlement.
  • Experience with real estate-secured commercial loans and coordinating with Title and Funding teams.
  • Previous experience as a Senior Closer, Closing Lead, Closing Supervisor, or in a similar leadership role.

Key Soft Skills

  • Leadership, team coordination, and accountability.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Effective communication and collaboration with internal teams and external partners.
  • Problem-solving, prioritization, and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.

Specific Technical Skills Needed

  • Knowledge of loan closing, settlement, funding, post-closing, and title clearance processes.
  • Ability to review title commitments, lien searches, collateral documentation, loan documents, and settlement statements.
  • Understanding of lien priority, title defects, UCC filings, and applicable lending and real estate regulations, including TRID, RESPA, and TILA.
  • Proficiency with loan origination systems, document management platforms, e-signature tools, and Microsoft Excel.
  • Familiarity with title systems such as CSC and NETRO, as well as quality control, risk identification, and exception management.

Remote Work Requirements

• Stable, reliable internet connection.

• Professional and dedicated remote working setup.

• Ability to work effectively across a remote, multinational organization and maintain confidentiality.

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to connect well with different teams and stakeholders

Benefits

What We Offer

💰 Compensation in USD.

🏖️ Benefits include paid time off (PTO).

🌍 Work Environment: Fully remote work environment.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. Position Summary

LRS Federal is seeking an experienced Construction Cost Engineer to support multiple construction
programs across both public and private sectors. The successful candidate will provide estimating, cost
engineering, quantity takeoffs, constructability support, proposal pricing, and cost analysis throughout the

project lifecycle.

This position will support active construction projects, business development efforts, and future proposal
opportunities while working closely with Project Managers, Design Managers, QA personnel, and

executive leadership.

The ideal candidate possesses strong estimating experience across multiple project types and delivery
methods and is capable of developing accurate conceptual through definitive estimates while providing
practical construction insight during project execution.

This is a fully remote position with occasional travel as required.

Primary Responsibilities

Construction Cost Engineering

  • Prepare conceptual, budgetary, detailed, and definitive construction cost estimates.
  • Develop detailed quantity takeoffs from construction drawings and specifications.
  • Review contractor estimates for completeness, accuracy, and reasonableness.
  • Develop independent cost opinions throughout design and construction.
  • Support value engineering evaluations from a cost perspective.
  • Prepare cost comparisons and life-cycle cost analyses.
  • Assist with change order evaluations and cost negotiations.
  • Analyze cost impacts associated with RFIs, design revisions, substitutions, and scope changes.
  • Maintain historical cost databases and benchmarking information.

Project Support

  • Participate in multidisciplinary design reviews.
  • Review drawings for constructability from a cost and execution perspective.
  • Identify cost risks and opportunities early in design.
  • Support schedule and sequencing discussions where they impact project cost.
  • Assist Project Managers with forecasting, budgeting, and cost tracking.
  • Provide independent cost opinions to support owner decision-making.

Proposal Support

  • Develop pricing for competitive proposals and negotiated procurements.
  • Prepare labor, equipment, subcontractor, and material estimates.
  • Coordinate vendor and subcontractor quotations.
  • Support proposal narratives and pricing strategies.
  • Assist with capture planning and proposal reviews

Required Experience

Candidates should possess estimating experience supporting one or more of the following project delivery methods:

  • Design-Build (DB)
  • Design-Bid-Build (DBB)

  • Construction Management Agency (CMa)
  • Progressive Design-Build (PDB)
  • Integrated Project Delivery (IPD)
  • EPC / Engineer-Procure-Construct
  • Job Order Contracting (JOC)

IDIQ Task Order Contracting Experience estimating projects within one or more of the following markets is preferred: Healthcare, Industrial Manufacturing, Mission Critical / Data Centers, Heavy Civil Infrastructure, Commercial, Government Facilities, Municipal, Water / Wastewater, others

Qualifications Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Quantity Surveying, or related discipline (or equivalent professional experience).

  • Strong analytical and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Not required but nice to have:

  • Ten or more years of estimating or cost engineering experience.
  • Experience supporting large commercial, industrial, healthcare, infrastructure, or institutional projects.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Owners, Designers, Contractors, and Construction Managers.
  • Professional certifications such as: ○ Certified Cost Professional (CCP) ○ Certified Estimating Professional (CEP) ○ Professional Engineer (PE) ○ Certified Construction Manager (CCM) ○ Project Management Professional (PMP)

jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.

HCO Behavioral Health Services and Elevate Healthcare Group are expanding our Christian Counseling program and are seeking compassionate, clinically skilled Licensed Mental Health Professionals who desire to thoughtfully integrate Christian faith into evidence-based counseling.

This opportunity is ideal for licensed therapists who believe emotional healing and spiritual growth can work together and who are passionate about providing ethical, clinically sound, Christ-centered counseling to individuals, adolescents, couples, and families seeking faith-integrated care.

At HCO Behavioral Health Services and Elevate Healthcare Group, we believe clients should have the opportunity to receive counseling that honors both sound clinical practice and their Christian faith.

Our Licensed Christian Counselors thoughtfully integrate evidence-based therapeutic approaches with Biblical principles, Christian values, and faith-based perspectives when desired by the client and clinically appropriate.

We respect each client's autonomy, beliefs, treatment goals, and individual journey while maintaining the highest standards of ethical, professional, and evidence-based care.

jobs.excerpt: RSB – Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials is a global, multi-stakeholder organisation dedicated to driving the truly sustainable development of the bioeconomy.
jobs.description:
RSB – Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials is a global, multi-stakeholder organisation dedicated to driving the truly sustainable development of the bioeconomy. Frequently recognised as an industry leader in supply chain sustainability, RSB applies its best-in-class sustainability framework across sectors including aviation, chemicals, materials, and shipping.

Our small, dedicated team operates remotely from countries around the world, working collaboratively with a diverse base of member organisations, industry partners, and policymakers. For more information, please visit .

Purpose of This Call
RSB now invites eligible firms and individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services described below. This Call for Expressions of Interest is not yet linked to a specific project or immediate assignment. RSB is building a pre-approved External Consultant Roster: a qualified pool of selected specialists and organisations that will be called upon for project-based work for the next 2-3 years.

We are primarily seeking to engage consultancy firms, agencies, and other established organisations, providers that can offer dedicated capacity, depth of expertise, and continuity across assignments. At the same time, we warmly welcome expressions of interest from independent consultants and other individual specialists whose qualifications and experience match the profiles sought. Throughout this document, “Consultant” refers to both firms and individuals unless stated otherwise.

Consultants accepted onto the roster will complete a brief onboarding process to become familiar with RSB’s systems, ways of working, and sustainability framework, so that engagements can begin efficiently when a relevant need is identified. When a specific project or capacity gap emerges, RSB will contact roster members whose profile best matches the assignment, share a defined scope of work, and invite them to submit a proposal.

Inclusion on the roster is an expression of readiness and fit and not a guarantee of immediate work or remuneration.

The Services
The ERP & Supply Chain Systems Consultant will support RSB Advisory Services in translating RSB standard and certification requirements into operational workflows and system controls. Consultants in this profile help clients embed traceability, chain-of-custody and certified-material reconciliation requirements into their existing ERP, procurement, inventory, production and sales processes. Work takes place within existing Advisory Services projects, with delivery focused on scope, timeline, budget and audit readiness, and on avoiding the creation of parallel spreadsheet-based processes.

Geographical scope: This call is open to consultancy firms and independent consultants based in, or with demonstrated working experience in, Europe, LATAM, North America and Asia. As this is a consultancy engagement rather than an employment position, there is no requirement to be located at an RSB office; assignments will be delivered remotely or on-site as projects require. Candidates with knowledge of industrial supply chains and operational practices in one or more of these regions are particularly encouraged to apply.

Role purpose: To support RSB Advisory Services clients in embedding RSB standard and certification requirements into their existing ERP, procurement, inventory and supply chain control systems, with a particular focus on traceability, chain-of-custody and certified-material reconciliation.

Full or partial coverage: Applicants are eligible whether they wish to cover the full scope or only a clearly defined subset of the technical areas and task requirements described below (partial coverage), based on their knowledge, skills and capabilities. Partial coverage applicants are encouraged to submit their candidacy as well.

Confidentiality: Due to non-disclosure and confidentiality commitments within RSB Advisory Services, specific project-related work cannot be attached to or disclosed in this call.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to mapping the client’s existing procurement, production, inventory and sales processes and the systems that hold them.
  • Support the design of chain-of-custody data flows and controls, including identity preserved, segregation and mass-balance models, within the client’s existing ERP and operational systems, connected to current processes rather than maintained in parallel spreadsheets, and considering RSB Book and Claim registry requirements where relevant.
  • Help translate RSB standard and certification requirements into ERP-enabled traceability controls, including material receipt, supplier certification checks, batch or lot identification, separation of certified and non-certified stock, mass-balance bookkeeping, transaction-level evidence, sustainability documentation and reconciliation points across procurement, production, storage, sales and dispatch.
  • Define record-keeping, reconciliation points and evidence trails that are specific enough to support RSB audit requirements and practical enough for client teams to maintain after hand-over.
  • Support the development of process documentation, standard operating procedures and training materials that enable client staff to apply the new traceability and chain-of-custody workflows consistently.
  • Ensure an effective hand-over that reduces, rather than generates, follow-up demand on RSB’s Sustainability Foundations and Advisory Services teams.

Requirements

Essential (all applicants, firms and individuals, must meet these criteria):

  • Strong written and spoken English proficiency.
  • Ability to maintain regular availability overlapping with CET working hours of a minimum of 4 hours per day.
  • Proven output/delivery track record in your area of expertise.
  • Full compliance with all applicable local laws and regulations, including tax and social security obligations, and legal authorisation to perform consultancy services in the country of residence or operation.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, the ability to operate autonomously, and a proactive approach to communicating progress, risks, and opportunities in a clear and constructive manner.
  • Self-sufficiency in a remote and fully digital working environment with reliable internet connectivity. Video calls and collaborative tools will be used for coordination.

Specific to this profile:

  • Demonstrated experience implementing, configuring or advising on ERP or procurement systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics) in an industrial or manufacturing context involving physical product flows, such as mills, refineries, blenders or traders. Corporate finance ERP experience alone is not sufficient.
  • Working knowledge of at least one chain-of-custody framework (RSB, ISCC, EU RED, CORSIA or equivalent) and of mass-balance accounting, sufficient to translate certification requirements into ERP-enabled traceability, certified-material control and audit-evidence processes with minimal onboarding from RSB.
  • Experience in procurement, inventory and materials-management process design, including internal material-flow mapping and reconciliation.
  • Ability to translate certification requirements into practical operating procedures, ERP data fields, control points, reconciliation routines and audit-ready evidence trails.
  • Experience developing process documentation and training materials.
  • Comfortable in client-facing roles and multi-stakeholder processes, with a patient, iterative co-design approach.
  • Track record of keeping iterative implementation projects to an agreed scope, timeline and budget.
  • Ability to hold regular client calls in the Americas, European or Asian time zones as assignments require.

For firms / agencies:

  • Ability to assign appropriately qualified personnel to assignments and to ensure continuity of delivery, including cover for absences.
  • Confirmation that the named individuals proposed for RSB assignments meet the essential criteria above.

Desirable (will strengthen your Expression of Interest):

  • Familiarity with the RSB Principles & Criteria and RSB chain-of-custody requirements, including how they translate into procurement, traceability, certified-material accounting and audit-evidence controls.
  • Industrial supply chain experience in at least one of the following markets: North America, LATAM (particularly Brazil), Europe or Asia.
  • Language skills relevant to the region of work (e.g. Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin).

Indicative Outputs (may include but are not limited to):
Specific deliverables, estimated time input, and project duration will be clarified in the Terms of Reference (TOR) issued to shortlisted roster members when a project need is identified.

  • Process and system maps of the client’s procurement, production, inventory and sales flows
  • Chain-of-custody data-flow and control designs (identity preserved, segregation, mass balance) within existing ERP systems
  • Requirements-to-system mappings translating RSB requirements into ERP data fields, control points and reconciliation routines
  • Record-keeping, reconciliation and audit-evidence trail specifications
  • Standard operating procedures, process documentation and training materials
  • Hand-over packages enabling client teams to maintain the workflows independently

Benefits

Working with RSB offers the opportunity to contribute to a globally recognised organisation at the forefront of sustainability and systems transformation.

  • Meaningful, mission-driven work: Contribute to advancing sustainability standards and real-world impact across global value chains, influencing how industries operate and evolve.
  • Flexible, high-impact assignments: Participate in intellectually engaging, project-based work that allows you to apply your expertise to real-world challenges.
  • Opportunity for ongoing collaboration: Consultants on the roster may be engaged on multiple assignments, fostering longer-term professional relationships with RSB.

Submission deadline: 24 October 2026
Type of Engagement: Project-based (as required) with an overarching Framework Agreement
Preferred Provider Type: Independent consultants and individuals, firms, agencies, and established organisations
Remuneration: Agreed day rate
Location: Remote
Framework Agreement Duration: Until September 2028 [2 years], unless a Consultant or RSB request removal or changes to the Framework Agreement.
Working Hours / Time Zone: No fixed time-zone restriction; minimum 4 hours per day overlapping with CET working hours for coordination with RSB, and availability for client calls in the Americas, European or Asian time zones as assignments require.
Roster Launch: November 2026

Diversity & Inclusion
RSB is committed to fostering diversity and inclusion across all its work. We strongly encourage expressions of interest from individuals and firms representing underrepresented groups, including, but not limited to, women, persons from the Global South, persons with disabilities, and members of other historically marginalised communities. We believe that diverse perspectives strengthen the quality and relevance of our work.

Conflict of Interest
Applicants must disclose any actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest at the time of expression of interest and throughout the engagement. A conflict of interest exists where the Consultant has personal, professional, or financial relationships that could impair objectivity or create unfair advantage.

Anti-Corruption & Integrity
RSB operates a zero-tolerance policy with respect to fraud, bribery, corruption, and any other form of misconduct. All Consultants are expected to adhere to the highest ethical standards and to comply with applicable anti-corruption laws. Any breach may result in immediate termination and referral to relevant authorities.

How to Submit Your Expression of Interest
To be considered for inclusion on the RSB External Consultant Roster, Consultants should submit the following:

  • The completed questionnaire within this call for expressions of interest
  • A company capability statement (for firms/agencies) or a current curriculum vitae (for individuals), including a description of experience in similar assignments

Later in the submission process, RSB will request further information to confirm shortlisted Consultants as trusted providers as part of our due diligence process:

  • Firms / organisations (and their employees): Tax identification and proof of registration

OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. Job Title: Business Development Executive

Are you looking to build a career in software sales and seeking for an opportunity to build the experience you have already gained? We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded person who is early-in-their-career to join the VertiGIS UK sales team.

You don't need to be an expert in geospatial technology, we're more interested in your ability to communicate, build relationships, learn quickly and understand what customers need. If this sounds like you, and you have a couple of years of experience in technical sales, Pre-Sales or GIS, then we would love to hear from you.

Our sectors are growing at pace, and we have decided to bring in someone with a couple of years’ experience in the real world. You'll work alongside experienced sales and technical colleagues who will help you develop the skills and experience needed to build a successful career in software sales.

If you think you have what it takes, then contact us to set up a conversation.

The Role

Your focus will be on our existing customers. You’ll build strong customer relationships, understand their business challenges, manage software renewals and identify opportunities where VertiGIS technology and services we can provide additional value.

This is not primarily a new-business or "hunter" role. Instead, you’ll focus on developing and growing existing accounts through thoughtful account mining, manage your sales pipeline, identifying upsell opportunities and making sure our customers continue to get value from working with us.

As your experience develops there will also be opportunities to win new business and build your own pipeline.

Requirements

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • Some experience in technical sales, solution sales, account management, pre-sales or a similar customer-facing commercial role.

  • An interest in technology and an ability to understand technical products and solutions.

  • The confidence to build relationships and have commercially focused conversations with customers.

  • A natural curiosity and willingness to ask questions to understand what customers really need.

  • An interest in developing existing accounts and spotting opportunities to provide additional solutions or services.

  • Good organisation skills and the ability to manage multiple customers, opportunities and renewal dates.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A collaborative approach and willingness to work with technical specialists and professional services teams.

  • The initiative and ambition to develop your own commercial skills and, over time, explore new-business opportunities.

  • Experience within GIS, geospatial technology, software, SaaS or another technical environment would be useful, but we’re equally interested in people with a strong technical-sales foundation who are keen to learn.

About VertiGIS:

At VertiGIS, we help organisations unlock the full value of their geospatial data. Our solutions enable customers across utilities, telecommunications, government, infrastructure and commercial sectors to manage assets, optimise workflows and make smarter, data-driven decisions. We combine industry expertise with powerful geospatial technologies to deliver real-world outcomes for our customers.

What We Offer:

  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements

  • Access to mentoring and career development pathways

    In addition to... 

  • Generous annual leave allowance plus your birthday as a Gifted Day

  • Free gym access at our Cambridge office 

  • Option to buy or sell annual leave 

  • Company Pension scheme

  • Group Income Protection scheme and Life Assurance 

  • Private Health Insurance and Health Cash Plan 

  • Inclusive Fertility and Pregnancy Loss Leave (also accessible to partners)

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave

  • Annual Personal Development Allowance

Interested?

Please submit your CV and a brief covering letter outlining your relevant experience and confirming your eligibility for security clearance

Our HR team will be reviewing applications initially, and if your experience and skills seem like a great fit, we'll be sure to connect!

You can expect a call from the hiring manager to chat about the role, your background, and how you could contribute to our team. Then there will be an interview where you'll also have the chance to:

  • Meet some future colleagues

  • Ask any questions you have

  • If we're not quite the right match, we'll let you know why, so you can continue your job search with valuable feedback. 

Please note that we require that all candidates are able to demonstrate their eligibility to work in the UK or Ireland

Highlights

Your focus will be on our existing customers. You’ll build strong customer relationships, understand their business challenges, manage software renewals and identify opportunities.
