jobs.excerpt: Who We AreYellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

We’re looking to hire a Senior Frontend Engineer located within Africa to join our fast-growing, fully remote team. You will join our Commercial Pod, the team that owns the systems our commercial business runs on: trade execution, treasury operations, commercial operations, and the internal tooling our operations teams use every day.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will own significant surfaces of our B2B suite and contribute to the shared design system that other pods build on. You will collaborate closely with our Technical Lead, Product Managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver interfaces that hold up under money-movement scrutiny.

Candidates with experience in FinTech or Crypto products are strongly preferred. We value clear communication, strong ownership, and engineers who are passionate about delivering exceptional user experiences.

Our technology stack includes: Vue 3 (Composition API), TypeScript, Pinia, Vite, Vitest, Storybook, SCSS with Figma-derived design tokens, our internal design system published to AWS CodeArtifact, Node.js, Serverless Framework, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, AWS SQS, SNS, EventBridge, EKS, Valkey, Datadog, GitHub Actions, and more.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of frontend features across the internal tooling products, from design doc through to production and post-release monitoring
  • Build and extend components in our Vue 3 design system, caring about the API surface other engineers consume and not just the pixels
  • Integrate against REST APIs fronting our serverless and EKS services, designing for real-world async behaviour: eventual consistency, retries, idempotent submissions, and partial failure states a user has to understand
  • Instrument what you ship, so frontend work is observable in Datadog and carries correlation IDs through to the backend
  • Write and review design docs, take part in our design doc review sessions, and run Knowledge Sharing Sessions for the wider engineering org
  • Provide clear and concise communication and updates regarding feature development statuses to the team and stakeholders
  • Adhere to internal coding standards, development processes, and design best practices, and help shape them as our engineering standards mature
  • Ensure quality through thorough testing and peer review of your work and the work of cross-functional teams
  • Take part in the Commercial dev support rota, roughly once every five weeks
  • Embrace and demonstrate our values: humility, creativity, and independence
  • Write and maintain clean, maintainable, and well-tested code for the future (and present) of the company’s platform

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Frontend Engineer (full-stack experience is a plus but not required)
  • Expert-level proficiency with Vue 3, the Composition API, and TypeScript. Strong React or Svelte engineers who can make a credible case for picking up Vue 3 quickly will be considered
  • Deep understanding of modern JavaScript, component-based architecture, and state management patterns such as Pinia
  • Strong experience with modern CSS and SCSS, token-based styling, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility
  • Proven experience building and optimising scalable, high-performance UIs, including data-dense surfaces such as tables, dashboards, and forms with hard validation rules
  • Real experience building or maintaining a shared component library or design system, including versioning, breaking changes, and consumer migration paths
  • Strong experience working with RESTful APIs and integration patterns, and comfort reasoning about distributed backends and failure
  • Solid understanding of frontend application security, including XSS, CSRF, content security policies, and secure client-side data handling
  • Experience working with AWS, especially in contexts relevant to frontend (CloudFront, S3, Cognito, CodeArtifact)
  • Experience with testing tools such as Vitest, Jest, Vue Test Utils, Cypress, or Playwright, and with Storybook for component development

What Would Make You Stand Out

  • Experience in FinTech, Crypto, or other highly regulated environments, especially anything involving FX rates, trading, or money movement
  • Exposure to African markets or other multi-currency, multi-regulator environments
  • Knowledge of serverless architectures and how frontend apps interact with them
  • Familiarity with performance monitoring and observability tools, particularly Datadog RUM, logs, and traces
  • Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and best practices
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for frontend deployments, and with automated release tooling such as release-please and Conventional Commits
  • Experience deprecating and migrating off a legacy frontend without freezing product delivery
  • Practical use of AI coding tools in your daily workflow

Team

  • Exude your upbeat energy and enthusiasm every day to motivate your team to be the best they can be in every aspect of what they do
  • Celebrate the success of others by recognising the contributions of committed team members and their achievements
  • Clear and accurate written and verbal communication is a must
  • Collaborate with your peers to collectively think of innovative ideas that drive business through technology
  • Build and utilise working relationships with internal business partners across the organisation and external business contacts
  • Keen interest in learning and sharing current trends and advancements in modern web and back-end frameworks

What We Offer

  • Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive compensation and meaningful health coverage, and all full-time employees are participants in our stock option plan.
  • Learning & Development: Access to resources, support, and autonomy to grow professionally.
  • Remote-First Flexibility: We embrace a fully remote work environment.
  • Mental Health Support Services: Your mental well-being matters to us.
  • Global & Diverse Team: You will have the opportunity to work with talented professionals from 24+ countries across the world, in a multicultural and collaborative environment.
  • Global Impact: You’ll be part of a team shaping the future of global FinTech and stablecoin accessibility.

Ready to Join Us?

Are you up for the challenge? Apply today and be part of shaping the future of FinTech. Let's innovate, disrupt, and lead together!

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

jobs.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Machine Learning Research Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Salary: $100k - $150k
Experience: 6+ years
Sponsorship: No new H1B sponsorship available. H1B transfers welcomed for qualified candidates.

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.

BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.
No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking an Machine Learning Research Engineer to bridge cutting-edge applied research and production engineering, designing and shipping advanced machine learning systems that solve high-impact business problems. The role blends scientific rigor with practical software engineering, requiring deep understanding of modern ML and deep learning techniques alongside the ability to build robust, scalable, and well-instrumented production pipelines. The ideal candidate stays current with the rapidly evolving AI research landscape, can critically evaluate new techniques for real-world applicability, and is comfortable operating across the full lifecycle from problem framing and experimentation to deployment and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, prototype, and evaluate applied AI solutions across natural language, vision, recommendation, and structured data domains.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML formulations with clear success metrics and evaluation strategies.
  • Stay current with the latest research in deep learning, large language models, and adjacent areas, and assess applicability to internal use cases.
  • Implement rigorous experimentation workflows including baselines, ablations, and statistically sound evaluation methodology.
  • Build production-quality training and inference pipelines using modern ML frameworks and orchestration tools.
  • Collaborate with ML platform engineers to ensure efficient use of compute, storage, and accelerator resources.
  • Optimize models for accuracy, latency, throughput, and cost based on production requirements.
  • Develop tooling for dataset construction, labeling, validation, and ongoing monitoring of data quality.
  • Partner with product, design, and domain experts to ensure model behavior aligns with user needs and policy requirements.
  • Implement safety, fairness, and reliability evaluations and incorporate findings into model selection decisions.
  • Document research findings, design decisions, and operational characteristics clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor engineers on applied ML methodology, evaluation rigor, and responsible deployment.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, reading groups, and prototype-to-production playbooks.
  • Influence the broader AI roadmap based on research insight, capability gaps, and emerging opportunities.

Required Qualifications
  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a closely related field; or equivalent applied experience.
  • Six or more years of combined research and applied ML engineering experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.
  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating deep learning models at non-trivial scale.
  • Solid grounding in mathematics, statistics, and the theoretical foundations of modern ML.
  • Experience taking ML models from research prototype to production with appropriate observability and safeguards.
  • Familiarity with distributed training, mixed-precision training, and accelerator hardware.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to explain complex methods clearly.
  • Demonstrated ability to read, evaluate, and adapt techniques from current research literature.
  • Track record of shipping impactful applied AI projects.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Published research at top-tier AI/ML venues.
  • Experience with large language model training, fine-tuning, or evaluation.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation, agentic systems, or multimodal architectures.
  • Exposure to responsible AI, model evaluation, and alignment practices.
  • Experience contributing to open-source ML projects.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
We recognize that our people are our strength, and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company.
We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Veterans.
Position offered by “No Fee Agency.”

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Bright Vision Technologies (BV Teck) is committed to equal employment opportunity (EEO) for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status as defined by applicable federal, state, or local laws. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Business Intelligence Lead is a senior individual contributor role supporting Humana's Conversational Channels Product organization, including Interactive Voice Response (IVR), Intelligent Virtual Assistants (IVA), and emerging AI-powered member engagement experiences.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Business Intelligence Lead is a senior individual contributor role supporting Humana's Conversational Channels Product organization, including Interactive Voice Response (IVR), Intelligent Virtual Assistants (IVA), and emerging AI-powered member engagement experiences. This is not a traditional reporting role. The ideal candidate combines deep analytics expertise with product, project, and leadership capabilities, enabling them to operate as a strategic partner to Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business Intelligence leaders.

The Business Intelligence Lead will serve as a key partner to the Director of Business Intelligence, helping drive analytics strategy, KPI governance, portfolio planning, delivery execution, and stakeholder alignment across a portfolio of conversational experiences. The role will also provide mentorship and technical leadership to a team of Business Intelligence Engineers, establishing best practices for reporting, analytics, measurement, data quality, and delivery excellence.
Success in this role requires a balance of strategic thinking, technical expertise, Agile delivery experience, and cross-functional leadership. The ideal candidate is comfortable influencing decisions, navigating complex initiatives, translating business objectives into measurable outcomes, and helping both leaders and engineers succeed. This position plays a critical role in advancing Humana's Conversational Channels strategy, member experience goals, and data-driven decision making.

Responsibilities
As a Business Intelligence Lead, you will:

  • Serve as the primary analytics partner for Conversational Channel initiatives, including IVR, IVA, and AI-driven customer engagement programs.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Designers, Digital leaders, Operations, and external partners to define and measure business outcomes.
  • Support the Director of Business Intelligence in prioritization, stakeholder management, roadmap planning, and execution tracking across multiple initiatives.
  • Translate business objectives into measurable success criteria and analytics requirements before initiatives are launched.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to a team of Business Intelligence Engineers, helping elevate analytical capabilities, reporting standards, and development practices.
  • Drive the planning and execution of analytics work within Agile delivery frameworks, participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, PI planning, and release activities.
  • Develop and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, and operational reporting solutions using Power BI, and other visualization platforms.
  • Analyze conversational channel performance, including containment, authentication, intent recognition, self-service utilization, transfer behavior, abandonment patterns, and customer experience metrics.
  • Present insights and recommendations to senior leaders and executive stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree plus 7+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, Data Engineering, Product Analytics OR Master's degree plus 4+ years of relevant experience.
  • Advanced SQL with 3+ years of experience with demonstrated ability to work across large-scale enterprise datasets.
  • 3+ years of Power BI experience.
  • 1 year of experience translating business requirements into analytics solutions and actionable insights.
  • 1 year of experience presenting data analytics to Senior Leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced Degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or related field
  • Advanced in SQL, DAX, and other data systems
  • Experience supporting IVR, IVA, Conversational AI, Contact Center, Digital Customer Experience, or Customer Engagement platforms.
  • Prior experience serving as a team lead, technical lead, project lead, or product owner.
  • Experience defining and governing enterprise KPIs and measurement frameworks.
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms such as Google BigQuery and Databricks.
  • Familiarity with conversational analytics, speech analytics, journey analysis, or customer experience measurement.

jobs.excerpt: Who is Michaels Energy? Michaels Energy is a veteran-owned energy consulting firm helping businesses minimize waste and maximize value through energy efficiency, engineering, and decarbonization solutions.
jobs.description:
Who is Michaels Energy?

Michaels Energy is a veteran-owned energy consulting firm helping businesses minimize waste and maximize value through energy efficiency, engineering, and decarbonization solutions.

We partner with utilities, businesses, and other organizations to design and deliver programs that reduce energy consumption, improve building and process performance, and create lasting value for our clients and the customers they serve. Our work combines technical expertise, business insight, and practical implementation.

At Michaels Energy, our passion is developing long-term client relationships with energy users, utilities, consultants, and partners. This passion, combined with our core values of proactive and responsive service, intuitive analysis, collaborative partnerships, and fanatical execution, forms the foundation of our corporate culture.

What is the role?

We're seeking an accomplished Senior Program Manager to lead a portfolio of utility energy efficiency programs in the New England area. This is an opportunity for a business-minded leader who can connect program strategy, financial performance, client relationships, and operational execution to deliver results.

As a Senior Program Manager, you'll own the performance of your assigned portfolio, serving as a trusted partner to utility clients and leading cross-functional teams that include engineering, outreach, marketing, and other delivery professionals.

You'll have significant autonomy to shape program strategy, strengthen operations, manage financial performance, and identify opportunities to grow the business. Success requires more than managing projects: it requires sound business judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to build productive relationships with clients, colleagues, and senior leadership.

In this role, you will help lead the next phase of growth for Michaels Energy's New England utility programs.

Our growing portfolio includes successful commercial and industrial energy efficiency program implementation, with opportunities to expand our work with utility partners across the region.

You'll build on established delivery success while shaping the strategy, operating model, and financial foundation needed to support growth. Working closely with utility clients and internal technical and engagement teams, you'll translate emerging opportunities into effective, scalable, and financially sound programs.

This opportunity is well suited to a leader who understands the New England utility energy efficiency landscape and enjoys growing client relationships, strengthening teams, and turning program opportunities into measurable results.

Where can you work?

Remote within New England, with regional travel for client meetings and team collaboration. Up to approximately 15% travel.

What You’ll Lead

Portfolio Strategy and Business Performance

  • Own the financial and operational performance of assigned utility programs, including revenue, profitability, budgets, forecasting, and contractual commitments.
  • Develop and execute portfolio strategies that align client objectives, program performance, and Michaels Energy's business goals.
  • Develop financially sound program budgets and scopes of work, translating staffing requirements, delivery activities, and performance targets into sustainable financial plans.
  • Monitor performance, anticipate risks, and make informed decisions to improve financial and operational results.
  • Partner with business development and company leadership to identify, shape, and pursue opportunities for portfolio growth and contract renewal.

Client Relationships and Strategic Partnerships

  • Serve as a primary relationship manager and trusted advisor to utility client counterparts.
  • Develop a deep understanding of client priorities, contractual expectations, regulatory considerations, and changing market conditions.
  • Lead strategic client conversations about program performance, emerging opportunities, challenges, and priorities, building credibility through transparent communication and proactive problem-solving.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Execution

  • Lead multidisciplinary delivery teams across engineering, outreach, marketing, program operations, and other functions.
  • Establish clear priorities, accountabilities, staffing plans, and effective channels for collaboration that align resources with contractual and financial commitments.
  • Develop and improve processes, tools, and operating practices that support consistent, efficient, high-quality program delivery.
  • Anticipate and resolve delivery challenges, working collaboratively across teams to deliver results.

Organizational Leadership and Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to a culture of accountability, partnership, continuous learning, and strong execution.
  • Identify and advance improvements to program economics, operational effectiveness, and the client and customer experience.
  • Communicate effectively with clients, delivery professionals, and senior leadership, translating complex program and financial information into actionable insights.

What Success Looks Like

After 3 months, you will have:

  • Established productive working relationships with key clients, cross-functional team members, and company leadership.
  • Developed a strong understanding of your portfolio's contracts, financial performance, delivery commitments, and growth opportunities.
  • Assessed the strengths, risks, and improvement opportunities within your portfolio and developed a practical plan for near-term priorities.

After 6 months, you will have:

  • Established a reliable operating rhythm for managing portfolio performance, financial forecasts, client relationships, and team accountability.
  • Demonstrated sound financial stewardship and progress against contracted program goals.
  • Implemented meaningful improvements to portfolio operations, delivery effectiveness, or financial performance.
  • Advanced a clear strategy for sustaining and growing the portfolio in partnership with clients and company leadership.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for an experienced leader who combines business acumen, operational discipline, and the ability to get results through people and partnerships.

Required qualifications

  • At least five years of relevant experience leading complex programs, portfolios, or business operations, ideally within utility energy efficiency, energy services, electrification, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen and accountability for business results, including developing and managing budgets, forecasting financial performance, and making decisions informed by financial and operational data.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams, aligning resources, and delivering results through collaboration and influence.
  • A track record of building strong client or stakeholder relationships and communicating effectively with senior-level decision-makers.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities, with a commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Especially valuable experience

  • Leadership of utility-sponsored energy efficiency or decarbonization programs, particularly commercial and industrial initiatives.
  • Developing contract scopes, program budgets, and financial models that balance client commitments with business performance.
  • Identifying and developing opportunities for contract expansion, renewal, or new business.
  • Familiarity with the utility, regulatory, and market environment in the relevant region.

Compensation and Benefits

The anticipated base salary range for this position varies by geographic location and relevant qualifications. Compensation is determined based on experience, skills, work location, and internal equity.

Mitsubishi Chemical America is seeking an experienced Payroll Specialist to join our Corporate Payroll team. In this role, you'll help ensure employees across multiple businesses are paid accurately and on time while supporting payroll operations in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) highly preferred

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with minimal ramp-up.

jobs.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

About the role:

The Compliance Analyst – UK at Reserv will play a valuable role in supporting our

company’s adherence to UK regulatory requirements, industry best practices and ethical

standards. This position is designed for a developing compliance professional with strong

UK complaints knowledge, who will assist in developing and implementing compliance

programs and initiatives to help mitigate risks and safeguard our operations. A familiarity

with TPAs is ideal.

This is a hands-on role, with guidance and oversight from your manager. Your focus will be

doing the work: resolving UK complaints and responding to GDPR data subject access

requests (DSARs), Data Protection Act (DPA) requests and Request for Access to Data

(RAD1) requests accurately, fairly and within the required timescales, with particular care for

vulnerable customers.

Who you are:

  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org.
  • Passionate Risk & Compliance professional who cares about the customer and their experience.
  • Empathetic. You exercise empathy and patience towards everyone you interact with.
  • Sense of urgency - at all times. That does not mean working at all hours.
  • Creative. You challenge existing assumptions and find ways of leveraging technology to reimagine the R&C process.
  • Curious. You want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and be decisive when it counts.
  • Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were done differently, you action on it.
  • Communicative. (we'd love to know what this means to you)
  • And did we mention, a sense of humor. Claims are hard enough as it is.

What We Need:

We need you to be able to perform the following key responsibilities:

Regulatory Compliance

  • Possess awareness of UK requirements, including UK GDPR, the Data Protection
  • Act 2018, FCA rules, Consumer Duty and FCA guidance on vulnerable customers, and apply them to day-to-day complaints and data requests.
  • Help translate regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance for claims handlers and UK colleagues, working alongside the wider compliance team.
  • Assist in drafting and updating procedures and training materials, including complaints and data protection.
  • Help document and communicate relevant changes to stakeholders.

Compliance Program Management

  • Manage UK complaints from intake through resolution, recognising vulnerable customers and adapting to their needs, and ensuring timely, accurate and fairresponses in line with internal complaints procedures and FCA rules, including Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS) referrals.
  • Respond to GDPR DSARs: verify requests, gather data from systems and teams, apply redactions and exemptions, and meet statutory deadlines.
  • Process DPA requests and Request for Access to Data (RAD1) requests, validating each one and issuing accurate, timely responses.
  • Monitor and approve sanctions screening alerts for payments, investigating potential matches, deciding whether to release or block, and escalating true or unresolved matches in line with UK sanctions requirements.
  • Maintain organised records of all complaints and requests, and escalate breaches, vulnerable-customer concerns and potential data incidents promptly.
  • Support responses to audits and regulatory enquiries by preparing materials and gathering documentation.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Track complaints and DSAR, DPA and RAD1 volumes, turnaround times and outcomes, including cases involving vulnerable customers, and help flag trends and root causes.
  • Prepare regular compliance reports, with oversight from your manager.

Risk & Control Oversight

  • Support control testing and documentation for UK claims compliance, and help identify improvements based on complaint trends, audit findings and incidents.

Ownership & Execution

  • Take ownership of your assigned compliance areas and seek opportunities to improve processes.
  • Manage your own caseload and deadlines in a fast-paced environment, seeking guidance where needed.
  • Check your work carefully, including complaint responses and data disclosures, before it goes to customers, colleagues or regulators.
  • Adapt quickly to new areas and contribute beyond core responsibilities as needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with claims, technology and quality teams to provide practical compliance support and to automate complaint and request tracking where possible.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure consistency in guidance and regulatory interpretation.
  • Participate in team meetings and company initiatives to stay aligned with broader compliance and operational objectives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Legal Studies, Risk Management, or related field (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications).
  • 2-3 years of experience in compliance, complaints or claims within the insurance industry or wider UK financial services.
  • Strong knowledge of UK complaints, including FCA complaints rules and the Financial Ombudsman Service, gained through hands-on experience resolving customer complaints.
  • Working knowledge of UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, ideally with experience responding to DSARs and DPA requests (experience of RAD1 requests is a plus).
  • Awareness of the FCA’s expectations for the fair treatment of vulnerable customers, with the empathy to identify vulnerability and support customers appropriately.
  • Awareness of UK sanctions regulations, ideally with experience reviewing sanctions screening alerts for payments.
  • Good understanding of UK insurance claims regulations and compliance frameworks, with awareness of Consumer Duty.
  • Experience of insurance claims handling or claims compliance, preferably across multiple lines of business.
  • Strong interest in compliance and regulatory work, with a desire to develop a career in risk and compliance.
  • Good analytical and research skills with the ability to find, interpret and apply regulatory information and understand its impact on the business.
  • Strong writing skills with the ability to create clear, concise guidance, procedures and training materials.
  • Comfort with technology and AI tools, with enthusiasm for leveraging automation to improve compliance processes.
  • Strong technical skills in systems such as Excel or Google Sheets, with the proven ability to learn and adapt to new systems quickly.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain regulatory concepts clearly to non-compliance audiences and to handle sensitive customer matters with empathy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities while maintaining high-quality outputs.
  • Self-starting mindset with the ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks.
  • Collaborative team player who works well across functions and contributes to a positive team culture.
  • Professional certifications such as Chartered Insurance Institute (CII) or International Compliance Association (ICA), are a plus.

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

About the role

Rove Next is a new premium line from Rove Concepts, a Vancouver-based modern furniture brand selling direct to consumer across Canada and the US. Rove Next launches with improved versions of our best-selling pieces, and it needs its own marketing built from the ground up.

We're looking for an Email & Lifecycle Marketing Specialist to help execute and optimize the customer journey from first interaction through repeat purchase. You'll own the day-to-day execution of email campaigns and automated flows while helping us build a lifecycle marketing engine that scales through AI, automation, and strong operational discipline.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building, testing, improving, and shipping high-quality work.

Initially focused on Rove Next, with room to expand across the Rove Concepts group as the brand grows.

Email campaign execution from planning through deployment using Klaviyo.

Building, maintaining, and optimizing automated customer journeys including welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, and retention flows.

Customer segmentation to deliver personalized marketing experiences.

Campaign QA including copy, links, layouts, dynamic content, and scheduling to ensure every send is accurate before launch.

Working closely with our creative, e-commerce, and marketing teams to support launches, promotions, and seasonal campaigns.

Running A/B tests and analyzing campaign performance to continuously improve engagement, conversions, and customer retention.

Maintaining email calendars and ensuring projects are delivered on time.

Using AI tools to improve workflows, content creation, and campaign execution wherever practical.

Must-haves

Two or more years of experience in email marketing, CRM, or lifecycle marketing within an e-commerce or DTC business.

Experience with Klaviyo or a comparable email marketing platform.

Strong understanding of customer segmentation, marketing automation, and lifecycle campaigns.

Excellent attention to detail with the ability to catch issues before campaigns are deployed.

Fluent, native-level English, written and spoken. You will be writing customer-facing copy under our brand.

Comfortable working independently, managing multiple campaigns, and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to have

Furniture, home, or another considered-purchase category with a longer buying cycle.

Experience with Shopify, GA4, HTML for email editing, or AI-powered marketing workflows.

What success looks like

Email campaigns are delivered accurately and on schedule with minimal revisions.

Lifecycle flows continue to improve customer engagement, retention, and repeat purchases.

Campaign reporting leads to measurable improvements through testing and optimization.

AI becomes part of your daily workflow to improve speed, quality, and efficiency.

How to apply

Send your CV to .

In a few lines, tell us:

  • One email or lifecycle campaign you're most proud of and the results it achieved.
  • One AI tool or workflow you use regularly to improve your work.

Please also include a short voice note (around 60 seconds) introducing yourself and telling us why you'd be a good fit for this role.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid project.

jobs.title: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) - Highlands Ranch, CO
jobs.excerpt: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $115k - $135k/year Position Requirement: Full-Time FLSA Status: Exempt Location: Highlands Ranch, Colorado Salary:115K - 135K+Work from Home!
jobs.description:
Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $115k - $135k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Highlands Ranch, Colorado

Salary:

115K - 135K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $115,000 – $135,000 / year

Passionate Educators are needed at the Stride K12 partner school, Ohio Virtual Academy (OHVA). We want you to be a part of our talented team!

The mission of Ohio Virtual Academy (OHVA)is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

The 504 Coordinator role is to work with staff to improve educational outcomes for all students through high-quality interventions that are matched to students’ academic, social-emotional, and behavior needs.

jobs.excerpt: About Onfleet Onfleet’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully.
jobs.description:
About Onfleet

Onfleet’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully. Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About the role

Onfleet is hiring two senior SDETs to shape how our engineering teams build and trust automated quality. At Onfleet, the team that builds a feature owns its quality. Developers write and maintain their own tests. Your job is to make those teams better at it: you pair with them, teach, review, and find the cases they missed. You will not be the person who tests everyone else's work.

Together with our quality leads, you’ll own our test frameworks and the shared quality tooling every team depends on. You’ll also do feature development in production code and internal tooling. You’ll be part of our core quality engineering group, sometimes embedded on one team and sometimes working across several.

You’ll start by taking ownership of our existing automation and making it more reliable and complete, alongside greenfield work on new platform services. We measure this role by what the teams can do because you were there.

How We Work

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Generating code is the easy part. Knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. The engineers who thrive here are scrutinizing and questioning: they reject AI slop and catch the wrong call before it ships.

Every engineer helps improve how we work instead of only following it. For this role that means building and improving the agentic tooling itself: test generation, review, verification, and the workflows around them.

We are candid and have a low ego. Challenge us on tooling direction, and expect to be challenged back.

What You’ll Do:

  • Strengthen the current suite. Improve reliability, extend coverage, and modernize patterns. A flaky test is a failing test.
  • Own the test frameworks. Unit, integration, and end-to-end, treated with the same care as production code.
  • Own the quality gates in CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery). Pipelines, checks, and gates, so standards are enforced by the system and not by people.
  • Build agentic quality tooling. Extend the agents and workflows we use for test design, review, and verification.
  • Raise the bar through teams. Pair on test design, review code, help make hard-to-reach code testable, and write things down so the practice outlives any one person.
  • Ask the testability question early. In planning, ask how we'll test it and how we'll know it broke in production.
  • Know when a release is healthy. Metrics, dashboards and alerts that tell us something is wrong before a customer does, and that tell a team whether a release is safe to keep rolling out.
  • Ship features. Full-stack work in production code and internal tooling, alongside the teams you support.

What You'll Bring (required):

  • 8 or more years of professional software development experience, in any role.
  • 5 or more years where building and maintaining test automation was a core part of your job, as an SDET, test automation engineer, or software engineer who owned test infrastructure. Your title matters less than the work.
  • You build software, not just tests: test frameworks, internal tools, CI tooling, or product features. You want feature development in production code and internal tooling to be part of your job here.
  • Depth across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including hands-on work with a browser framework such as Playwright or Cypress.
  • Hands-on CI ownership: you have created, configured, or fixed a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent), not just used one.
  • A track record of being the person who drove automated test coverage on a team, whatever your role was.
  • Working knowledge of DevOps practice: how code is built, deployed and monitored in production. You have added metrics, dashboards or alerts so a team knew when something broke.
  • Daily professional use of AI coding agents, and experience building or improving agentic tooling, not just using it.
  • A multiplier mindset: you get your satisfaction from the team shipping safer and faster, not from your own test count.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, roughly C1 level, and experience working day to day on an international team.

Nice To Have:

  • Mobile development (Android or iOS) and mobile test automation, using native frameworks such as Espresso or XCUITest, or cross-platform tools such as Appium or Maestro.
  • TypeScript, Node.js, and React.
  • Rust, or another statically typed language.
  • Clear evidence of driving CI/CD practice for a whole team or company.
  • Production canaries and progressive delivery: you have used production signals (error rates, latency, business metrics) to decide whether a release continues or rolls back, through canaries, feature flags or automated rollback.
  • Test data and environment management: getting a realistic system into a known state quickly and repeatably.
  • Test-driven development (TDD).
  • AWS and cloud-native services.

Location and Benefits:

  • Remote, open to candidates based in Canada or Latin America.
  • The team works on US Pacific Time. You'll need to reliably work a schedule that frequently matches US Pacific business hours (9am to 5pm PT).
  • Flexible PTO.
  • Laptop and work-from-home setup stipend.
  • Monthly technology stipends (internet and AI tooling).

Onfleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Onfleet's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.

We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $70,000 to $95,000 USD per year for candidates in both Canada and Latin America, depending on experience, skills, and background. Where an offer lands within that range reflects the depth and experience a candidate brings to the role.

How We Hire

You need an identity-verified LinkedIn profile to apply. That's the free "Verified" badge, the shield icon next to your name. We check for it, and applications without it don't move forward.

Before any offer, we verify your identity and work history. That includes a live video ID check and reference calls. We use AI, automated systems, and a person to review applications: every application that meets the requirements is also read by an engineering leader or a recruiter. If you misrepresent your identity or experience, the process ends.

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.

About Rainforest Foundation US

For over 30 years, Rainforest Foundation US (RFUS) has worked to address climate change and safeguard biodiversity by promoting the rights of indigenous peoples and local communities and supporting their efforts to protect and defend their rainforests. Science shows that forests managed by indigenous peoples are healthier, suffer less deforestation, capture more carbon, and contain more biodiversity than forests managed by private or public entities--including nationally protected areas. What’s more, scientists tell us that protecting forests is as important as reducing greenhouse emissions if we hope to stem the tide of ecological collapse.

RFUS works in partnership with indigenous and local communities and their representative organizations to protect tropical rainforests by supporting their efforts to secure rights to their lands, strengthen monitoring and land security, influence laws and policies that protect their resources, and build strong and sustainable community leadership. By investing directly in indigenous and local communities, RFUS connects the people rooted in the land with the tools, training, and resources to be effective advocates and protectors of the forests they call home.
