jobs.excerpt: The RoleAt Uscreen, we help creators build something that lasts, powering independent video businesses to build sustainable revenue and scale their impact.
jobs.description:
The Role

At Uscreen, we help creators build something that lasts, powering independent video businesses to build sustainable revenue and scale their impact. We're a fast-growing SaaS company, and our all-in-one video membership platform helps creators generate revenue through subscriptions, communities, courses, and live-streamed events across web, mobile, and TV apps.

We're hiring a Director of Revenue Operations to own the systems, data, and strategy that drive revenue performance across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. This is the person who connects the dots: how we map and segment our market, how leads are scored and routed, how reps are territoried and incentivized, how pipeline is forecast, and how all of that flows between the CRM, the warehouse, and the teams who act on it.

This is a build role. The foundations are here: a CRM with real history in it, a data warehouse that holds our source of truth, an outbound motion getting off the ground, and a sales team with momentum. What's missing is someone to connect them into one engine and own what comes out of it. You'll get real latitude to decide how this function works, and you'll be expected to build it yourself rather than direct it from a distance.

You'll do it inside an AI-native team. We treat AI as a core part of how we work, and in this role especially: mapping and enriching a market that no off-the-shelf database covers well, automating the operational work that shouldn't take a human, and getting to answers faster than a traditional ops function could.

What You'll Do

Revenue Strategy & Outcomes

  • Set and track the operational targets that feed the revenue engine: pipeline coverage, opportunity generation, conversion by stage, speed to lead
  • Build the market map. Define how we segment, target, and prioritize accounts in an SMB and DTC creator market that standard playbooks don't cover
  • Design territories and account assignment so reps have both ownership and a pool to go win
  • Drive ICP targeting, CAC efficiency, and pipeline velocity in partnership with GTM and Analytics

GTM Infrastructure & Systems

  • Own and optimize the GTM tech stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Intercom, and related tools), including how they integrate, what we buy, and when we replace something
  • Implement scalable processes for lead routing, scoring, attribution, and enrichment
  • Ensure high data integrity and system hygiene across all revenue systems: deduplication, territory structure, and the standards that keep lifecycle marketing and outbound from firing on bad data
  • Lead and support the Salesforce admin function in managing system configuration, integrations, and automation
  • Use APIs and custom scripts to integrate data across CRM, marketing automation, product usage, and billing
  • Build and maintain automated workflows with AI tooling (Clay, LLM APIs, Python and similar), driving experimentation and continuous improvement across the revenue engine

Forecasting, Analytics & Reporting

  • Build and maintain real-time dashboards on funnel metrics, pipeline health, and revenue forecasts
  • Identify and influence the metrics that drive revenue growth: pipeline value, campaign ROI, close rates, conversion by stage
  • Partner with the CRO, Finance, and Marketing on strategic planning, forecast accuracy, and budgeting
  • Work with the Analytics team on the handoff between CRM and warehouse, so reporting is built where the data actually lives
  • Use AI tooling to generate predictive insight and make reporting scale without more headcount

Revenue Process & GTM Enablement

  • Define and document GTM processes, rules of engagement, SLAs, and territory models
  • Own deal desk and approvals management: pricing and discount approvals, non-standard terms, quote-to-close workflow, and the escalation path that keeps deals moving without leaking margin
  • Support compensation planning, quota design, and incentive alignment in partnership with Finance
  • Enable onboarding, offboarding, training, and operational workflows across Sales, CS, and Marketing

Strategic Projects & Cross-Functional Support

  • Identify and remove friction points in the sales process
  • Act as the connective layer between Sales, CS, Marketing, and Finance
  • Support pricing strategy, pipeline inspection, and contract workflows
  • Build the readouts that let leadership see what's working without having to ask

Lead the Function

  • Manage and develop our Revenue Operations Manager, who owns day-to-day core ops today and is ready for a strategic leader to learn from
  • Direct GTM engineering capacity, whether in-house or contracted, toward the highest-leverage build work
  • Operate as one point of a three-way partnership with FP&A and Data/Analytics, where each function is a check and a balance on the others

What You Bring

  • 6+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Ops, BizOps, or GTM Strategy at B2B SaaS companies, including time as a hands-on individual contributor
  • You have scaled a company through the roughly $20M ARR range in a capital-efficient, lean-team environment. You're energized by building the system rather than inheriting a finished one
  • Hands-on and technical. You don't need to write production SQL, but you need to understand systems integration, how CRM and warehouse data flow into each other, and what breaks when they don't. You build things yourself before you delegate them
  • SMB, DTC, or PLG market experience. Our buyers are independent creators, not procurement departments, and they cannot be pulled off a list in ZoomInfo. You'll need to be creative and analytical about how we find and qualify them
  • Real depth in the strategic side of RevOps: comp and attainment design, pipeline modeling, segmentation, and partnering with Finance on planning
  • Experience running a deal desk or approvals process, or standing one up
  • Fluent with AI tools as part of how you work, not as an experiment. You use them for enrichment, market mapping, agent workflows, and automating the repetitive parts of ops, and you have the judgment to know where their output needs a human
  • A communicator who produces readouts, not just meetings. You can show a team what changed and why it matters
  • Comfortable in a remote-first, fast-moving environment with a small team and a wide surface area

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in the creator economy, video, membership, or community software
  • Salesforce and HubSpot in the same stack, with a warehouse behind them
  • Background building outbound and prospecting motions from close to zero
  • Experience with revenue recognition workflows or multi-currency billing
  • Direct experience partnering with a CRO or a founder-led GTM team

How We Work, Our Values

These are the five values we hold ourselves to, and what they look like in this role:

  • Customer Obsessed. You build systems that make the creator's experience better, not just the reporting easier. You remember there's a real business at the end of every record in the CRM.
  • Push the Pace. You ship the working version and improve it. You move at the speed of the decision in front of you.
  • Own the Outcome. You own the revenue numbers this function influences, not just the dashboards that display them.
  • Simplicity Wins. You take a tangle of tools and process and make it something the team can actually follow.
  • Go Further Together. You build the trust with Finance, Analytics, Sales, and Marketing that makes this function work at all. Without it, RevOps has no inputs.

What We Offer

  • 100% remote first company
  • Flexible PTO plus 8 paid company holidays
  • Medical benefits with cost sharing: health, dental, and vision (US based)
  • 401(k) plan with company match (US based)
  • Flexible parental leave
  • Remote-first
  • Stipends for technology, coworking space, and professional development

Note: Benefits may vary depending on location and local regulations. Final eligibility and coverage details will be shared during the hiring process.

Company Description

The International Fresh Produce Association (IFPA) is the largest global organization serving the fresh produce and floral supply chain. With a mission to unite the industry, IFPA drives innovation and collaboration to create a vibrant future for all its members. The association provides value through advocacy, connecting members, and offering actionable guidance to support industry prosperity. IFPA is dedicated to empowering businesses and professionals across the supply chain to succeed with confidence and purpose.

Position Summary

The Director of International Relations is instrumental in executing IFPA’s Global Advocacy and Policy Strategy (GAPS), as well as advancing IFPA’s global presence and influence by building strategic relationships with international and regional standard-setting bodies, key associations, and IFPA’s Global Councils (IFPA’s volunteer leadership groups that provide strategic leadership in IFPA’s key member markets). This role includes a strong focus on advancing IFPA’s priorities across its three key regions—Asia, North America, and Europe—ensuring coordinated engagement and regionally relevant advocacy strategies.

This role is responsible for tracking and coordinating IFPA’s engagement in global and regional forums, ensuring that policy topics are relevant to IFPA members and fully aligned with GAPS. The Director serves as the main point of contact for identified international bodies, manages relationships with peer associations, and ensures the integration of global member perspectives into IFPA’s advocacy strategy. The Director works closely with IFPA leadership, internal subject matter experts —including health and nutrition, sustainability, trade, food safety and supply chain—and the IFPA membership team to ensure consistency, relevance, and strong member engagement across global initiatives. Additionally, the Director supports the development and delivery of annual Global Council advocacy updates and facilitates structured engagement with IFPA staff, Global Council members, volunteer leaders and IFPA members.

Position Responsibilities

Global Council Engagement & Internal Coordination

  • Facilitate regular engagement to gather feedback on policy priorities and GAPS with Global Councils and other volunteer committees and councils, as appropriate, with particular attention to region-specific priorities across Asia, North America, and Europe.
  • Facilitate the involvement of volunteer leaders and Global Council members in advocacy efforts, including calls to action, engagement with policymakers, and participation in relevant events.
  • Ensure Global Council and other volunteer leader committees and councils input informs global advocacy strategy and execution.
  • Coordinate with IFPA’s internal subject matter experts in health and nutrition, sustainability, and supply chain to ensure policy positions are informed and aligned with global policy goals and member needs.
  • Coordinate with the IFPA membership and global operations teams to ensure international policy and advocacy initiatives align with member needs and to support member engagement in global activities.
  • Support cross-functional collaboration to integrate global perspectives into IFPA’s broader policy work.
  • Support the development and delivery of the annual update on Global Council advocacy activities.
  • Assist IFPA communications and marketing teams in developing and coordinating international and regional content to support advocacy and policy initiatives.

International Policy & Standards Tracking

  • Track IFPA’s engagement in key global and regional standard-setting bodies (e.g., Codex Alimentarius, APEC, EU) with targeted monitoring of developments impacting Asia, North America, and Europe.
  • Monitor emerging policy topics and assess their relevance to IFPA members.
  • Maintain a centralized record of IFPA’s participation and influence in international forums.
  • Draft and coordinate comments on proposed standards and regulatory frameworks issued prioritized global and regional bodies or key focus regions on topics such as food safety, market access, etc.
  • Coordinate with IFPA internal subject matter experts to identify relevant committees, work streams, and initiatives within international standard‑setting bodies where IFPA will engage, ensuring that designated subject matter experts lead the technical work and representation and serving as the technical lead and representative when appropriate or required.

Representation & Strategic Partnerships

  • Act as IFPA’s main point of contact for identified global and regional bodies and partner organizations to those bodies.
  • Build IFPA’s visibility and credibility in international policy and regulatory spaces.
  • Coordinate and lead, as necessary, IFPA participation in meetings, consultations, and working groups particularly within IFPA’s priority regions of Asia, North America, and Europe.
  • Manage relationships with key international associations and coalitions.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities to expand IFPA’s global footprint through collaboration including strengthening IFPA’s visibility and partnerships across its three focus regions.
  • Support alignment of global advocacy efforts with IFPA’s mission, purpose, and member priorities.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in international relations, public policy, agriculture, food systems, or a related field required.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in international policy, advocacy, or stakeholder engagement.
  • Passion for advancing global consumption of fresh produce and floral products, with a clear understanding of their role in public health, sustainability, and economic development.
  • Strong understanding of global food systems, regulatory frameworks, and international institutions.
  • Proven ability to build and manage strategic relationships across cultures and sectors.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-cultural, international environment.
  • Excellent communication, diplomacy, and project management skills.
  • Experience working with or within international standard-setting bodies is a plus.

Measures for Success

  • Increased visibility and recognition of IFPA in global and regional policy forums.
  • Strong, sustained engagement with Global Councils and international partners.
  • Timely and relevant tracking of international policy developments.
  • Effective coordination with internal teams to support cross-cutting advocacy goals.
  • Timely delivery of annual Global Council advocacy updates to the IFPA Board.
  • Effective facilitation of Global Council members and other volunteer leaders’ participation in advocacy efforts and events.
  • Successful coordination of international and local content for advocacy and communications.

Travel

Business-related travel, including international travel, required on average 8 times per year.

Location

This is a remote position based in the United States.

Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

jobs.excerpt: OVERVIEWReporting to Manager, IT Quality Assurance and working closely with the QA Lead, the 12-month Contract position of QA Tester performs hands-on testing for a new enterprise data platform that integrates and consolidates data from multiple source systems, including SAP and CRM, into a single, centralized source on AWS.
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

Reporting to Manager, IT Quality Assurance and working closely with the QA Lead, the 12-month Contract position of QA Tester performs hands-on testing for a new enterprise data platform that integrates and consolidates data from multiple source systems, including SAP and CRM, into a single, centralized source on AWS. This role focuses on integration testing across source systems and detailed data validation to confirm the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of integrated data across QA and Production environments. The QA Tester analyzes technical specifications and data-mapping documentation, identifies and resolves defects in partnership with development teams, and produces detailed reports and documentation of all testing efforts. A naturally curious and investigative mindset is essential to interrogate data, question anomalies, and drive issues to root cause. Their work is vital in delivering a reliable, high-quality data platform that aligns with organizational standards and business expectations.

Residency in Canada is required throughout this fixed term contract.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Test Execution: Develop and execute test cases, scripts, and scenarios for the data integration platform across QA and Production environments.
  • Integration Testing: Perform integration testing across source systems such as SAP and CRM, verifying that data flows correctly between systems and into the consolidated platform.
  • Data Validation: Conduct detailed data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality checks to confirm the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of integrated data. Work closely with development teams to reproduce, isolate, and resolve data discrepancies.
  • Documentation Analysis: Review technical specifications and data-mapping documents to understand intended data flows and identify potential areas of concern.
  • Reporting & Documentation: Produce detailed reports and documentation for all testing efforts, including results, data logs, and defect tracking, to maintain accurate records and facilitate communication.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate test progress, results, and issues to the QA Lead and project stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment with project goals.
  • Defect Analysis & Resolution: Analyze test results to identify, document, and resolve defects; partner with development teams to reproduce, isolate, and verify fixes.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is required.

Experience

  • 2-5 years of experience in software quality assurance, with a proven track record of executing various types of testing, identifying defects, and ensuring quality.
  • Experience with integration testing and/or testing data across enterprise systems such as SAP and CRM is required.
  • Hands-on experience with data validation and reconciliation; exposure to cloud data platforms (AWS) is an asset.
  • Familiar with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
  • Familiar with JIRA, Confluence, test management and data validation tools.

Knowledge/Competencies/Skills

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to document issues, track corrective actions, and provide data-driven insights for improvement.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the capacity to work effectively with cross-functional teams and influence quality-related decisions.
  • Excellent communication (listening, speaking and written) and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to communicate ideas in both technical and user-friendly language.
  • Keen attention to detail, tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn new products.
  • Highly self-motivated and directed, and adept in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Strong intellectual curiosity and an investigative mindset—naturally digs into data, questions anomalies, and pursues root cause.
  • Can effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Working Hours

  • Covering the core hours of operation, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM local time, this is a Full-Time position, scheduled forty (40) hours per week, working not less than 37.5 hours per week.
  • Extra or flexible hours, including occasional after-hours and weekend support, may be required.

Remote and/or Field Work

  • Remote

Travel

  • Not applicable

PAY TRANSPARENCY

ExpectedCompensation:

  • An annual base salary in the range of $70,000 to $85,000.
  • The salary range listed complies with the OntarioEmployment Standards Actand reflects a potential base salary range for this role. The actual salary offered will be determined within the range, and will depend on factors, such as the candidate’s unique qualifications, relevant experience, work location and expected contributions.

Circular Materials is a national not-for-profit producer responsibility organization (PRO) that supports producers in meeting their extended producer responsibility (EPR) obligations across Canada. Created by producers for producers, we design, and deliver effective recycling programs that drive advance innovation, improve environmental outcomes and create value across the recycling supply chain.

Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.excerpt: About Generation:At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives.
jobs.description:
About Generation:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have an 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

About the role:

The Regional Business & Program Development Associate will support the identification, design, and launch of new training and employment programs in high-growth sectors across Latin America.

This role is responsible for conducting labor market research, analyzing trends, gathering employer and learner insights, and supporting the development of evidence-based program concepts. The individual will work closely with country teams and global functions to analyze market opportunities, synthesize findings, and provide recommendations that inform program design and expansion decisions. The role will contribute to business case development and support the successful transition of new program concepts from research to implementation.

This is a regional role, initially focused on Colombia, with potential to expand across Latin America.

What will you do:

1. Market Research & Program Opportunity Identification

  • Conduct labor market research, including industry growth trends, hiring demand, and role-level analysis, to identify potential program opportunities.
  • Analyze employment trends, salary benchmarks, AI resilience, implementation considerations, and career pathways to support opportunity assessment.
  • Synthesize research findings into clear insights and recommendations for country and regional teams.
  • Support the use of existing program demand diagnostic methodologies and labor market intelligence tools (e.g., AI Job Market Agent, TalentNeuron, LinkedIn Talent Insights) to inform opportunity identification and assessment.
  • Prepare research summaries, market scans, and presentations to support program development discussions and decision-making.

2. Employer Insights & Demand Validation

  • Support employer outreach and engagement activities to gather insights on hiring demand, talent needs, and role requirements.
  • Conduct employer interviews, surveys, and desk research to identify workforce trends and employer pain points.
  • Synthesize employer feedback and translate findings into recommendations for program design and prioritization.
  • Support the maintenance of employer engagement records in Generation systems (e.g., Salesforce), including meeting notes, employer feedback, and demand signals.

3. Activity Mapping & Program Design Input

  • Support activity mapping and role analysis exercises in partnership with Curriculum & Instruction and other cross-functional teams.
  • Contribute insights on role scope, skills, competencies, and learner outcomes to inform program design decisions.
  • Synthesize activity findings and contribute to defining role scope, skills, and competencies required for successful employment.

4. Business Case Development & Stakeholder Support

  • Conduct learner research to identify target learner profiles, motivations, barriers, and program interest through methods such as focus groups and interviews.
  • Support the development of evidence-based business cases by gathering, analyzing, and synthesizing market, employer, learner, and operational data.
  • Develop reports, presentations, and briefing materials that communicate key findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with country and cross-functional teams to ensure business case assumptions and recommendations are grounded in evidence.
  • Prepare compelling materials to senior internal stakeholders to support decision-making, collect feedback and secure program approval

About you:

Experience:

  • 1-3 years of experience in research, consulting, strategy, business analysis, program development, or related fields
  • Experience conducting market research, data analysis, and developing insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Experience supporting business case development, program assessments, or growth initiatives
  • Exposure to employer engagement, talent market analysis, workforce development, education, or social impact programs is a plus
  • Experience working across multiple stakeholders and functions in a fast-paced environment preferred
  • Experience in Latin America or knowledge of regional labor market dynamics is desirable

Skills:

  • Strong analytical, research and structured problem-solving skills
  • Ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into clear insights and recommendations
  • Strong written communication and presentation skills, with attention to detail
  • Ability to develop reports, business case inputs, and decision-support materials
  • Effective project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete information
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and multicultural teams
  • Proficiency in research and data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, labor market intelligence platforms, survey tools)

Other:

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $135k - $160k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

135K - 160K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Network Automation (Go/Python) (f/m/d)
jobs.excerpt: Exoscale is the leading Swiss/European cloud service provider, offering a full spectrum of cloud infrastructure services—from instantly deployable virtual machines to S3-compatible object storage.
jobs.description:
Exoscale is the leading Swiss/European cloud service provider, offering a full spectrum of cloud infrastructure services—from instantly deployable virtual machines to S3-compatible object storage. Our mission is to deliver a simple, scalable cloud experience that enables our customers to focus on what they do best.
We’re a distributed team headquartered in Lausanne, driven by a culture of openness, technical excellence, and collaboration. We value diversity and strive to provide an inclusive, flexible, and empowering work environment.
About the Role
Our network team builds and runs Exoscale's network: the edge, the datacenter fabrics, and the out-of-band network across all of our European zones.
We are hiring a full-time software engineer to join that team and own one thing: the orchestration that takes a network change from a merged pull request to running on production devices, automatically and safely.
Today our network is described as code. Device configuration is generated from our sources of truth and reviewed in pull requests. The step after that, rolling the change out to the network, still depends too much on an engineer at a terminal. We want that to become an orchestrated workflow, with the guarantees software teams take for granted from their deployment pipelines: validated before it ships, rolled out progressively, verified afterwards, and rolled back when something looks wrong.
This is a software engineering role inside a network team. You will not be expected to design the backbone, but you will work every day with the engineers who do, and what you build decides how fast and how safely they can change it.
Location: Spain, Germany or Remote in EU
What You’ll Be Working On:
  • Design and build the orchestration of network changes. This goes beyond a deployment pipeline: it coordinates multi-step operations across devices and systems, with pre-change validation, staged rollout, post-change verification, and automatic rollback.
  • Write the services and tooling behind it in Go and Python, with the tests, CI, and observability you would expect of any production software.
  • Build a test environment (virtual labs, config and state checks) that lets us catch a bad change before it reaches a device.
  • Extend our source-of-truth and config-generation tooling (NetBox, Peering Manager, Ansible/Jinja2) so that more of the network is described by data instead of by hand.
  • Make the network’s state visible: detect drift between intended and running configuration, and expose it to the team.
  • Take part in code and infrastructure change reviews, and raise the software engineering bar of the team.
  • Join the on-call rotation after a training period.
About you:
You are a software engineer first, and you find infrastructure more interesting than CRUD apps. You may come from a network automation, SRE, or platform engineering background.
You have:
  • Solid professional experience designing, writing, and maintaining production software in Go, and fluency in Python.
  • Experience building CI/CD or deployment systems where a failed rollout has real consequences.
  • A habit of testing what you ship and automating what you do twice.
  • A working understanding of networking fundamentals (IP, routing, VLANs, what BGP is for). You don’t need to be a network engineer; you need to be curious enough to become dangerous.
  • Strong written and spoken English, and comfort working in a distributed team.
It’s a plus if you have:
  • Automated network devices before (Arista EOS, Junos, SONiC), through NETCONF, gNMI, eAPI, or similar.
  • Used Ansible, NetBox, or comparable configuration-management and source-of-truth tools at scale.
  • Worked with network test or validation tooling (containerlab, Batfish, pyATS, or similar).

jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

jobs.title: Lead Analyst (Crisis Intelligence)
jobs.excerpt: Lead Analyst APACWe’re looking for an ambitious and passionate team member based in Australia to join our Asia-Pacific Real-Time Coverage (RTC) team!
jobs.description:
Lead Analyst APAC

We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate team member based in Australia to join our Asia-Pacific Real-Time Coverage (RTC) team! As a Lead Analyst, you will be the human in the loop to support our AI-first approach to alerts by gathering, corroborating and curating social media chatter.

Who we are

samdesk is a real-time risk detection and situational awareness platform that delivers real time crisis alerts 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, powered by AI. We make sense of the world’s most valuable real time data sources with the purpose of creating a safer world. samdesk is proudly headquartered in Alberta, Canada, with team members located all over the world.

Please note that this is a fully remote, full-time Lead Analyst position. There is a requirement for regular weekend and public holiday shifts, typically between 9am - 5pm AEST. Specific roster requirements will be discussed with the successful candidate.

Check us out! www.samdesk.io

About the role

Reporting to the Regional Manager, Asia-Pacific, this is a demanding yet rewarding role providing critical live coverage of events occurring across the globe as part of our worldwide RTC team. The Lead Analyst will mentor and support other analysts while helping shape the direction of the Asia-Pacific team.

The samdesk platform is an AI tool that is not only the first to break the news but also provides the information and context needed by today's Fortune 500 organizations in their growing business continuity needs. The alert you send to a customer about an active shooter threat at a shopping mall may prompt them to advise nearby customers and employees to seek shelter, lockdown stores and reroute deliveries away from the area. As such, customers trust us to provide them with up-to-date and accurate information on time. It can be high pressure but we provide a friendly, supportive team alongside the tools and training you need to succeed.

samdesk alerts vary greatly and range from disruptive weather and conflict updates to bomb threats and shootings. During a shift, you may have hundreds of incidents to evaluate and make a decision on. You may only have 10 seconds to make a decision on each incident - do our customers need to react to this?

Who we’re looking for

  • You value accountability, both personal and collective, and ensure your team delivers on commitments with consistency and integrity
  • You are interested in breaking news and current affairs and understand the value of social media newsgathering and fact-finding
  • You are confident working independently and remotely as part of a diverse, globally distributed team and thrive in a breaking news environment
  • You have an interest in geopolitical issues and how they may impact businesses, people and governments

What you'll do

The successful candidate will join our real time coverage team and report to our regional manager in the APAC region. The role is approximately 75% on shift support and 25% people management, administration and projects.

  • Ensure the quality of our data output (alerts, content and information), and ensure that what customers see is timely and relevant
  • Manage at least two analysts, providing performance feedback, coaching and goal setting
  • Hire, onboard and train new team members as required, in coordination with the training team
  • Quickly understand which events are of higher impact and relevance to our users, using a combination of your experience, judgement and our playbooks to prioritize
  • Collect information in real time, corroborate it and build out the breadth and depth of our real time coverage as a crisis unfolds
  • Contribute to shared resources to improve our content and information discovery processes and foster collaboration on the team
  • Join an internal working group focused on geopolitics, forward planning and forecasting, or climate disasters
  • Support the team's day-to-day operations by giving teammates real time feedback and guidance, helping with scheduling and rostering, approving leave requests and acting as the liaison for interdepartmental requests when necessary, among other tasks
  • Uphold samdesk's culture and company values, serving as a role model for others, in an effort to foster and protect a positive workplace

To help you succeed, we provide a supportive team, the right tools, training and a variety of resources to help guide you. samdesk provides trauma-informed practice, ensuring analysts are supported on shift, including wellbeing tools, debriefs and professional support through the employer-provided health benefits program.

Although this is a remote role, you'll work closely with colleagues across the world as part of the wider RTC team. On shift, you will connect with other analysts in real time via an audio call to promote fluid communication and ensure incidents are monitored and context is provided to customers in real time.

We're looking for someone with:

  • A relevant degree (political science, international relations, journalism, etc.) or demonstrated experience preparing real time reports or analysis for crisis management or in a newsroom environment (e.g. Security Operations Center analyst, intelligence analyst, emergency dispatcher, breaking news/OSINT reporter)
  • At least one year of management experience, including coaching and performance reviews
  • The right to work full time in Australia, without visa sponsorship or restrictions

Bonus points if you have:

  • Worked in the corporate security or intelligence industries
  • Worked in a newsroom or OSINT environment
  • Proficiency in other languages

Salary

80,000 to 85,000 AUD per annum, excluding superannuation.

Working hours and flexibility

This isn't a typical remote role and may not be for everybody! We need to ensure continuous coverage of urgent emergencies, so this role requires you to be "plugged-in" and working on our dashboard during your shift. This can mean organized break schedules and set shift times.

In exchange, you don't need to take your work home with you, and your rostered hours are planned a month in advance, with limited requirement to work additional hours.

APAC analysts span several time zones and must be flexible to cover shifts supporting the wider APAC team.

What's in it for you?

  • Work with a committed and passionate team of innovators at a fast-growing startup
  • A career-building opportunity, working with cross-functional teams and the world's most notable brands to provide a life-saving solution
  • Company-funded health benefits

A note on generative AI

This role will involve working with AI-generated data, so please don't use AI to apply. The application and interview process are intended to let us learn more about you as an individual and how you make decisions.

Diversity and Inclusion

samdesk is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a safe, diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage qualified applicants of all backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation, family status, age, nationality and education levels, to apply. If you are contacted for an interview and require accommodation during the interviewing process, please let us know.

Salary: $80,000 - 85,000 AUD

jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Position Overview

Point Foundation seeks a hands-on, systems-minded Controller to run the day-to-day operations of the finance department and build the infrastructure that will carry Point through its next stage of growth. This is a builder's role for a nonprofit accountant who enjoys both doing the work and improving how it gets done. The Controller will manage expenditures and reconciliations, partner with the CFO to close each month and prepare financial reports, and keep the organization audit-ready throughout the year. Working closely with the CFO and the Program team, they will make sure scholarship funds reach Point's scholars accurately and on time. They will also lead efforts to streamline financial processes and organization-wide data, including thoughtful use of automation and AI. The role offers real room to grow, with the opportunity to develop into broader financial leadership as Point scales.

  • Audit Readiness – work with the CFO to establish and implement sound practices and documentation so the organization is fully prepared for the fiscal year-end audit, and coordinate with external auditors throughout.
  • Process Optimization & Automation – review current finance processes and lead improvements, incorporating technology, including AI, to automate repetitive work and increase accuracy and efficiency.
  • Cross-Departmental Systems & Data – coordinate financial practices with other departments to support scalable growth over the next several years, and strengthen data governance so organization-wide financial data is consistent and reliable.
  • Team Supervision – supervise and develop one coordinator-level direct report, setting clear expectations and supporting their growth.

Requirements

  • years of nonprofit fund accounting experience.
  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and QuickBooks Online (or similar accounting systems), along with the Microsoft Office suite.
  • Experience with AP and payment platforms such as Bill.com, and comfort using AI tools to streamline routine work.
  • A systems-first mindset, with an eye for how processes and tools can be improved or automated.
  • Strong skills in financial reporting and data analysis, including the ability to explain financial information clearly to non-finance colleagues.
  • Direct experience preparing for and coordinating an annual financial audit.
  • Strategic thinking about how finance operations scale, including familiarity with data governance practices.
  • A hands-on working style — comfortable owning day-to-day accounting work directly, not only overseeing it.
  • Experience supervising, coaching, or developing staff.
  • Discretion and sound judgment in handling sensitive financial and personal information.
  • Passionate about Point's mission and enthusiasm about communicating the organization's philosophy, mission, and values.
  • Commitment to advancing equity and inclusion in all areas of responsibility and across the organization.
  • Preferred: degree in accounting or a related field; experience designing or rebuilding finance workflows; and experience in a small finance department where wearing many hats is the norm.

Core Competencies – Our Ways of Working

  • Ownership: Owns outcomes, not just tasks. Follows through on commitments or proactively resets expectations, and raises issues early and directly.
  • Learn & Adapt: Stays curious and self-aware. Seeks feedback, reflects on impact, and applies learnings as conditions change.

  • Trust & Belonging: Builds relationships grounded in respect, honesty, and inclusion. Engages candidly, assumes good intent, and addresses issues constructively.
  • Collaborate for Scale & Growth: Clarifies roles and handoffs, shares information transparently, commits to decisions once made, and designs sustainable, repeatable systems over "boutique" solutions.

Compensation and Accommodations
