If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Kubernetes administrator with strong experience in managing and deploying cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP). This role requires hands-on expertise in containerization, cloud services, and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) practices.

The Kubernetes Administrator will collaborate closely with development, support, and cloud operations teams to support cloud-native applications and infrastructure.

  • Kubernetes Management:
    • Deploy, configure, and manage Kubernetes clusters on Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.
    • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to Kubernetes clusters and containerized applications.
    • Implement and manage automated scaling, health checks, and logging for Kubernetes environments.
    • Ensure high availability and disaster recovery for Kubernetes clusters in multi-cloud environments.
  • Cloud Infrastructure Management:
    • Work with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) to design and manage cloud-native infrastructures.
    • Optimize cloud infrastructure for performance, cost, and resource efficiency.
    • Collaborate with development teams to manage deployments to Kubernetes clusters.
    • Configure application and network integrations to customer on-premises and cloud-based services.
  • Security & Compliance:
    • Implement Kubernetes security best practices, including role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, and encryption.
    • Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements within the cloud environment.
    • Manage and monitor IAM roles, policies, and permissions on Azure, AWS, GKE platforms.
  • Documentation & Reporting:
    • Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of Kubernetes configurations, best practices, and cloud infrastructure.
    • Provide regular reports on cluster performance, issues, and resolutions to stakeholders.
  • Collaboration & Support:
    • Work with development teams to ensure seamless deployment and operation of applications within the Kubernetes clusters.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve Kubernetes-related issues across multiple environments.
    • Provide on-call support as required for cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes environments.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience:
    • Proven experience (4+ years) as a Kubernetes Administrator, Cloud Engineer, or similar role with hands-on experience in managing production Kubernetes cluster environments.
    • Strong knowledge of container orchestration and management in Kubernetes.
    • In-depth experience with cloud-native services on Azure (AKS, Virtual Networks), AWS (EKS, EC2, S3), and GCP (GKE, Cloud Storage) .
  • Skills & Expertise:
    • Proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
    • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Helm, ArgoCD).
    • Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Opensearch).
    • Strong knowledge of cloud security best practices, including network security, identity, and access management (IAM).

Key Competencies:

  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex systems in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across teams, including developers, cloud engineers, and support.
  • Adaptability: Comfort with rapidly changing technologies and cloud service offerings.
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to manage and maintain configurations with accuracy and precision.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills to document processes, report issues, and explain solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Enablement Manager, Post-Sales
jobs.excerpt: SpyCloud is on a mission to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground.
jobs.description:
SpyCloud is on a mission to make the internet a safer place by disrupting the criminal underground. SpyCloud’s solutions thwart cyberattacks and protect more than 4 billion accounts worldwide. Cybersecurity is an exciting, evolving space, and being at the forefront of the fight to disrupt cybercrime makes SpyCloud a special place to work. If you’re driven to align your career with a fantastic mission, look no further!

Our Senior Revenue Enablement Manager, Post-Sales is responsible for enabling SpyCloud's post-sales teams to deliver fast time-to-value, articulate customer value realized and potential value, and consistently position SpyCloud for renewal and expansion opportunities — increasingly through AI-assisted tools, not just static playbooks.

This role sits at the intersection of Product Solutions, Customer Success, and Revenue Enablement, building AI-assisted plays, coaching tools, and lifecycle programs that support implementation, adoption, and value realization. This role is highly cross-functional, you will work closely with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams to design and execute enablement programs that scale and deliver results across the Post-Sales organization. Partner closely with the Director of Revenue Enablement, to contribute to and execute the overall Revenue Enablement strategy.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing an AI-assisted coaching workflow, translating product capabilities into customer-facing value narratives, and partnering cross-functionally to improve lifecycle execution from onboarding through renewal.

What You'll Do:

  • Post-Sales Enablement Strategy
    • Develop and execute a Post-Sales Enablement strategy aligned to customer journey goals: implementation success, adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewals
    • Partner with Product Success and Customer Success leadership to identify gaps, friction points, and enablement opportunities across the customer journey — determining what needs a program, an AI-assisted tool, or neither
    • Works in coordination with the PS and CS leadership to identify and design scalable enablement programs tailored to their team’s goals and needs
  • Voice of the Field
    • Gather structured feedback from CS and PS on what’s working with customers, and translate it into recommendations for Product, Product Marketing, and Revenue Enablement. Surface readiness risk before product launches and releases, not after
    • Partner with CS and RevOps on using forecasting data, and translating risk patterns into targeted enablement (e.g., coaching, playbooks, or process fixes)
  • AI-Assisted Plays & Lifecycle Enablement
    • Build and maintain post-sales playbooks covering customer onboarding, implementation milestones, adoption motions, health checks, renewal readiness, and expansion opportunities
    • Use AI-assisted tools to personalize and maintain customer journey plays at lower ongoing effort than manual content upkeep
    • Enable CS and PS teams on consistent execution of customer journey plays, including handoffs from Sales and collaboration with SEs and Product
  • AI-Assisted Documentation & Enablement Assets
    • Own or contribute to technical documentation in partnership with Product Solutions and Engineering, using AI tools to keep it current with lower manual maintenance burden
    • Ensure internal-facing documentation is accurate, accessible, and aligned with how teams actually work in the field
    • Standardize internal and customer-facing materials used Post-Sale
  • Value Realization & Expansion Enablement
    • Partner with the Director of Revenue Enablement and CS leadership to operationalize value realization frameworks across the customer journey
    • Support development and adoption of value models, success plans, and customer-facing ROI narratives tied to SpyCloud use cases
    • Enable CS teams to confidently position realized value during customer QBRs, renewals, and expansion conversations
    • Drive accountability for joint account planning between Sales and CS for priority accounts, including expansion and renewal plans
  • Coaching & Adoption
    • Design and deliver AI-assisted coaching and training (live and asynchronous) for CS and PS teams, including onboarding, role-specific training, and ongoing readiness initiatives, in partnership with GTM Onboarding
    • Reinforce consistent messaging around implementation outcomes, adoption success, and value realization
    • Track adoption, readiness, and effectiveness of Post-Sales Enablement programs
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with Product, Product Marketing, Sales Engineering, Revenue Operations, and the Director of Revenue Enablement to ensure alignment across pre- and post-sales motions
    • Act as connective tissue between teams to ensure customer-facing execution reflects strategy, product direction, and revenue goals
    • Builds trust and influence with CS, PS, and Marketing through delivery, not just coordination. Natural collaborator with a proven ability to build strong relationships across the organization and within the team

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of experience in Enablement, Customer Success Operations, Product Enablement, or a related post-sales role in B2B SaaS (cybersecurity or technical SaaS strongly preferred)
  • Direct experience building or deploying AI-assisted enablement tools (Claude, other LLM-based coaching, documentation, or workflow tools) — not just using AI outputs, but designing how the team uses them
  • Proven experience enabling post-sales teams (CS, PS, TAMs, SEs, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience creating technical or process documentation for internal or customer-facing audiences
  • Strong understanding of post-sales motions, including onboarding, implementation, adoption, renewals, and expansion
  • Experience with value modeling, ROI frameworks, or success planning methodologies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to influence without direct authority
  • Data-informed mindset with the ability to measure enablement impact and iterate accordingly

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in cybersecurity, identity security, or fraud prevention domains
  • Background in or enabling Technical Account Management, Product Success, or Sales Engineering
  • Familiarity with value selling methodologies, MEDDPICC and customer value realization programs
  • Experience with Bigtincan or similar Learning Management and Content Management Systems
  • Familiarity in or enabling selling with or through Channel Partners

Base Salary Range: $115,000 – $150,000

The salary range reflects the expected base compensation for a fully qualified candidate at this level based on experience, qualifications, and market data at the time of posting.

U.S.-Based Benefits + Perks (for Full Time Employees):

At SpyCloud, we are committed to working alongside individuals who are equally passionate about preventing cybercrime, regardless of their department or role. Guided by our core values in all business decisions, we prioritize unity in our mission and ensure all SpyCloud employees have the support and benefits they need to stay focused on our goals. In addition to our engaging workspace in South Austin, flexible and remote-friendly work options, and competitive salary package, we offer our employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • 401(k) with Employer Contribution
  • Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

About SpyCloud:

SpyCloud transforms recaptured darknet data to disrupt cybercrime. SpyCloud is a place for innovative, collaborative, and problem-solvers to thrive. Individually, we’re amazing, but together, we’re unstoppable. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. SpyCloud complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

SpyCloud expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment. Improper interference with the ability of SpyCloud's employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us.

Our Culture:

Our culture is something really special. We’re all driven to disrupt the cybercriminal economy as we keep customer accounts safe from compromise. We support a truly worthy and serious mission, but we have fun doing it together. If you are driven, inventive, and collaborative, you’ll fit right in.

SpyCloud’s Recruitment Policy:

We will never ask an applicant for sensitive or personal financial information during the recruitment process. We advise all applicants seeking employment with SpyCloud to review available information on recruitment fraud. Anyone who suspects that they have been contacted by someone falsely representing SpyCloud should email .

Compensation Transparency Policy:

At SpyCloud, we believe in transparency and fairness in compensation. We strive to ensure that all employees are fairly compensated for their contributions, and we openly discuss our compensation philosophy and structure. We are committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits packages to attract and retain top talent, and we encourage open dialogue and feedback regarding compensation matters.

We've come a long way in a short time, but there's still so much more we can do. We have grand ambitions to make Dayshape the most usable, scalable, flexible and rapid to deploy solution on the market, and we’re not there yet.

Our tech leads are great with people, helping to elevate their team and the work they do, as well as being able to get stuck in technically. This role is a mix of technical and people leadership, leading a product engineering team that will operate in a particular area of the product.

What you’ll do

As a Tech Lead, you will lead, and work collaboratively with, your cross-functional team to plan and deliver new features and enhancements. You will take ownership of features and technical initiatives and make sure they are successful.

The time split between technical planning and delivery, and line-management will depend on the size of your team. Initially, as we build up the teams, you will be more hands on, adjusting the split as the size of the team increases.

  • Work as part of the Engineering leadership team to identify, set, and drive objectives and key results.

  • Analyse, code, test, and release new product features, enhancements, and improvements
  • Assist with technical, functional and design activities with our professional services team, product managers, and customers
  • Help us manage the entire lifecycle of features and product releases
  • Interview and hire additional software engineers
  • Champion our culture of learning, development, cross-company collaboration and teamwork.

About you

  • Direct line management experience is not essential, but you must be able to demonstrate experience as a leader. Emotional intelligence, cross team collaboration as well as the ability to help align team priorities are key parts of this role.
  • Strong full-stack developer, ideally closely matching our tech stack. Suitable candidates will be either experienced generalists or somewhat focused on the front-end part of our tech stack. Our standard tech stack is .NET (framework & Core), Azure SQL Server and the Azure platform, with a browser-based SPA UI in Vue.js and vanilla JS/CSS/HTML.
  • Great at breaking down big tasks into small chunks, solving tricky problems and tackling risks
  • Knowledgeable about a range of technologies, and quick to learn
  • Motivated by learning new things and using those to make a positive difference
  • Comfortable challenging and raising issues at any level
  • Great at asking awkward questions, kindly
  • An excellent, kind, and supportive communicator (who often finds yourself un-crossing wires between your colleagues)
  • Able to consider the broader impact of your design and coding decisions and those of others
  • Used to working with agile development teams on large software products

Bonus points if you are/have

  • Knowledgeable about wider Azure platform services.

jobs.description:
Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.

Our mission is to be the most reliable company by offering and maintaining consistently high-quality services.

We achieve this mission by fostering long-term relationships with customers, employees, and vendors. Personal attention, timely communication, and respect for all people are the foundation of our business philosophy!

At this point, Zelh is looking for a Product Formulator to join our team.

The Product Formulator & Quoter will be responsible for developing preliminary product formulas, preparing accurate Bills of Materials (BOMs), and creating quote packages for customer projects in the dietary supplement and nutraceutical industry. This role requires a strong understanding of ingredient science, potency levels, biological activity, and overage calculations to ensure that proposed formulas meet customer requirements and applicable labeling standards.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Development, Sourcing, Procurement, and Sales teams to ensure formula accuracy, cost transparency, and a smooth transition from initial quoting to final product specifications. As the role develops, the individual will also review and approve Finished Product Specifications (FPS) to ensure consistency between the original quote and the finalized product.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Product Formulation & Technical Analysis: Interpret customer briefs, target formulas, and label claims to develop technically accurate ingredient lists and preliminary formulas. Determine appropriate ingredient forms, potency levels, biological activity values, and extract standardization requirements.

  • Ingredient Calculations & Stability: Calculate ingredient overages to account for manufacturing losses, moisture, and shelf-life stability. Identify incompatible ingredients, potential formulation risks, and gaps in claim substantiation.

  • BOM Development & Costing: Build detailed preliminary Bills of Materials (BOMs) for powders, capsules, and other finished product formats, including raw material specifications, part numbers, quantities, yields, unit costs, and estimated packaging components.

  • Supplement & Nutrition Facts Panels: Prepare preliminary Supplement Facts Panels (SFP) and Nutrition Facts Panels (NFP), ensuring accurate ingredient declarations, serving sizes, percentage Daily Values, and required non-ingredient statements.

  • Quote & Data Management: Enter and maintain accurate quote information in ERP and project management systems, including Deacom and Odoo. Ensure data accuracy for costs, suppliers, minimum order quantities (MOQs), and raw material sourcing notes.

  • Sourcing & Procurement Coordination: Collaborate with Sourcing and Procurement teams on ingredient requests for quotations (RFQs), providing project details, estimated volumes, and sample requirements.

  • Finished Product Specification Review: Compare finalized Finished Product Specifications against the original quote to verify formula integrity, ingredient levels, overage calculations, BOM accuracy, and label compliance.

  • Quality Control & Discrepancy Resolution: Document discrepancies between original quotes and finalized specifications, escalating unresolved issues to the Product Development Manager before approval.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Development, Sales, Sourcing, and Procurement teams to communicate technical assumptions, ingredient availability, cost drivers, and project requirements.

  • Process Improvement & Documentation: Update legacy quote sheets, identify data gaps, maintain accurate formulation records, and support continuous improvements throughout the quote-to-order process.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific field.

  • 3–6 years of experience in nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, food and beverage product development, or technical sales support.

  • Strong knowledge of supplement ingredient science, including potency and activity declarations, overage calculations, extract standardization, and bioavailability considerations.

  • Hands-on experience preparing detailed Bills of Materials (BOMs), including raw material specifications, quantities, yields, and cost calculations.

  • Experience with ERP systems and project management tools; knowledge of Deacom and Odoo is an advantage.

  • Experience working with or alongside a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) is preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical skills and excellent numerical accuracy in formulation and cost calculations.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies in formulas, ingredient declarations, and product specifications.

  • Good understanding of supplement labeling requirements and Supplement/Nutrition Facts panel preparation.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Excellent written English communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly.

  • Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to identify potential formulation, sourcing, and costing risks.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a remote, international environment.

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining close communication with the Product Development team

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontier: AI Products. As a Core Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our enterprise accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from AI-driven automation.

About the Team:

This specialist team reports into a Sales Director (SD) and consists of specialist sellers aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of a new product and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to 1 or more regional directors for mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You are an AI pragmatist: You understand that AI Products are about outcomes, not just "cool tech." You can translate LLM and agentic capabilities into tangible safety and efficiency gains for the physical world.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara’s AI Products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-develop new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high potential “AI-ready” accounts
  • Drive high-touch pilot strategy and success metrics for early adoption
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle sales.
  • 2+ years of direct experience selling in AI-based commercial models (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Twilio, or AI-native platforms).
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with $200k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling "Version 1.0" products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • 4+ years direct experience selling AI-based commercial models with a deep understanding of forecasting and expansion mechanics.
  • Strong grasp of AI/ML concepts and how AI Products differ from standard automation.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$222,400—$278,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Boston Medical Center (BMC) is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Director, HRIS to lead the vision, optimization, and operational excellence of the organization’s HR technology eco system. This role oversees a team of eleven professionals responsible for HRIS platforms, including Workday, and UKG time and attendance system.

The Director will play a critical role in advancing BMC’s HR technology strategy by optimizing Workday functionality, establishing standardized and scalable HRIS processes, and ensuring seamless integration across systems. This leader will drive team effectiveness, lead through transformation, and partner closely with HR, Finance, and Operations, to deliver high-impact, user-centered solutions.

HRIS Strategy & Systems Leadership

  • Define and execute a comprehensive HRIS strategy aligned with BMC’s organizational and HR priorities
  • Lead ongoing optimization and enhancement of Workday, ensuring full utilization of system capabilities
  • Oversee UKG workforce management systems, ensuring alignment with operational needs and compliance requirements
  • Ensure seamless integration and data flow across HR systems and enterprise platforms

Workday Optimization & Governance

  • Establish governance models, standards, and best practices for Workday configuration, security, and releases
  • Lead prioritization and execution of system enhancements, upgrades, and new module implementations
  • Partner with functional HR leaders to continuously improve user experience and system adoption
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance across all HRIS platforms

HRIS Operations & Process Standardization

  • Design and implement standardized HRIS workflows, processes, and service delivery models across the enterprise

Change Leadership & Transformation

Partnership with Human Resources

Project & Portfolio Management

jobs.title: Remote Licensed Professional Counselor
jobs.excerpt: It is Adjuvant's vision to be the nation’s leading oncological behavioral health provider.
jobs.description:
It is Adjuvant's vision to be the nation’s leading oncological behavioral health provider. Our mission is to inspire hope through advancing mental wellness to cancer patients, their families and caregivers. We are looking for empathetic, experienced mental health professionals to come along side us in this endeavor!

This is a fully remote position.

Pay: $60-62/hr.

Role:

Through a respectful, constructive and energetic style, guided by the mission of the clinic, a therapist will seek to facilitate hope and change in the lives of their clients who have been affected by cancer. A therapist is responsible for accepting referrals and maintaining a client load (minimum 18 hours per week).

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Counsel clients or patients individually and/or within family sessions, to assist in overcoming dependencies, adjusting to life, or making changes.
  • Make internal referrals to IOP if little to no improvement occurs within 8 weeks of OP therapy.
  • Guide clients in the development of skills or strategies for dealing with their problems.
  • Develop and implement treatment plans based on clinical experience and knowledge, establishing SMART goals with the patient. Treatment plans are to be developed 72 hours after intake and updated / modified every 4 weeks.
  • Fill out and maintain client-related paperwork, including client diagnostic records and progress notes. Progress notes are to be developed 48 hours after every session.
  • Prepare and maintain all required treatment records and reports.
  • Evaluate clients' physical or mental condition, based on review of client information.
  • Collaborate with other staff members to perform clinical assessments or develop treatment plans within 2 days of establishing care with the existing patient.
  • Refer patients, clients, or family members to community resources or to specialists as necessary.
  • Learn about new developments in counseling by reading professional literature, attending courses and seminars, or establishing and maintaining contact with other social service agencies.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Masters Degree from an accredited college or university
  • Two years of professional level experience in a counselor setting
  • Current and active license to practice behavioral health in Texas

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience in healthcare with oncology
  • 1 year experience in Telehealth Settings
Salary: 60-62/hour

jobs.excerpt: About UsLive Oak Bank is a digital bank that serves small business owners across the country.
jobs.description:
About Us

Live Oak Bank is a digital bank that serves small business owners across the country. Our groundbreaking spin on service and technology has fueled our mission to be America’s Small Business Bank. Our products help customers buy, build, and expand their business, and our high-yield savings and CD products help them grow their hard-earned money. At Live Oak, we never lose sight of the well-being of our people. We believe our employees are the heart of our company. Our commitment to our customers and culture is intertwined, and we seek those who embody and embrace what it takes to empower the American dream.

How This Role Impacts Live Oak and Its People

As a Credit Risk Review Officer, you will play critical role in safeguarding the strength, integrity, and long‑term performance of Live Oak Bank’s loan portfolio. Serving as a subject matter expert within the Credit Risk Review function, you will independently assess the Bank's most complex Specialty Lending relationships, provide credible challenge to credit and underwriting practices, and help ensure that lending practices align with regulatory expectations, internal policies, and Live Oak’s high standards for sound credit risk management. Through your expertise, you will ensure transparency and accountability in loan quality, helping to shape strategic decision‑making, enhance credit risk governance, and support our mission of being a trusted financial partner for customers and communities.


Location Preference: This position is ideally based in Wilmington, NC; however, remote designations may be considered for qualified candidates. Work sponsorship is not supported, now or in the future.


What You'll Do at Live Oak

  • Lead reviews of the Bank's most complex, higher-risk, or specialized lending relationships, including the development of independent conclusions regarding risk ratings, underwriting quality, policy compliance, and portfolio management practices.
  • Support monitoring of portfolio performance to identify trends, emerging risks, and areas of concern. Identify and evaluate portfolio trends, including delinquency, bankruptcy, collateral sufficiency, and industry concentrations.
  • Contribute to the evolution of credit risk review methodologies, coverage strategies, reporting frameworks, and risk assessment practices.
  • Perform individual file and relationship reviews under the established risk‑based loan review program.
  • Validate the accuracy and consistency of loan risk grade assignments at the file or relationship level in alignment with established policies and regulatory guidelines.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for assigned commercial products, requiring a thorough understanding of all related product aspects, policies, underwriting and portfolio management guidelines, and
  • Ensure the quality, completeness, and accuracy of supporting credit risk review documentation and analysis performed personally or by direct reports as applicable.
  • Participate in findings discussions with credit risk and the first line leadership and monitor progress of corrective actions.
  • Provide independent, objective challenge to lending, underwriting, and portfolio management practices while maintaining effective working relationships with business and credit partners
  • Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and governance reporting activities through preparation of analyses, documentation, and response materials.
  • Deliver timely, actionable reports to the Managing Director, Credit Risk Review as required.
  • Maintain expertise in commercial and government‑guaranteed lending programs (e.g. SBA, USDA).
  • Manage, coach, and develop Credit Risk Review Associates and Senior Associates as applicable, providing quality oversight, technical guidance, and professional mentorship while promoting a culture of independence, professionalism, and continuous improvement within the Credit Risk Review function.
  • Serve as a thought partner to first line partners for assigned commercial products in enhancing credit policy, risk appetite, and portfolio management strategies.
  • Maintain strong awareness of applicable regulatory requirements including BSA, AML, CIP, and OFAC.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in credit risk review, special assets, internal audit, or commercial credit within a regulated financial institution exhibiting a focus on credit-related risk.
  • Extensive knowledge of complex and highly structured commercial lending structures, underwriting standards, credit risk frameworks, and portfolio management practices across a variety of bilateral and syndicated commercial loan products with expertise in Sponsor Finance, Lender Finance, Subscription Finance, Asset Based Lending, and Venture.
  • Capable of providing a fulsome review and opinion as to the credit risk and mitigated loan quality of large and structurally complex transactions.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory expectations related to credit risk management, independent loan review, and safety‑and‑soundness standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to implement review methodologies, drive process improvements, and contribute to executive‑level reporting.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and relationship‑building skills.

Preferred Experience

  • University or College degree majoring in a related discipline (e.g. Business or Finance).
  • Formal credit risk training or professional certification
  • Familiarity with risk analytics, credit metrics, portfolio analysis, and credit MIS tools.
  • Background in high‑growth or digitally‑focused banking environments.
  • Proven ability to mentor and lead high‑performing risk or credit teams.

Our Values

  • Dedication: Possess a deep commitment to Live Oak Bank’s mission and core values, exemplified through a strong work ethic, adaptability and pride in your work.

  • Ownership: Take initiative to deliver positive results by proactively and creatively solving problems, while maintaining a high degree of quality.

  • Respect: Treat everyone with courtesy, politeness, and kindness.

  • Innovation: Embrace fresh ideas and fearlessly contribute new solutions to emerging or existing problems.

  • Teamwork: Foster collaboration, accountability, and trust with others and understand that together, we do more

For a detailed overview of our employee benefits please visit:

Live Oak Bank is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled. We consider applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, veteran status or disability. Equal access to programs, service and employment is available to all persons. Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify human resources at.

EEO is the Law

A candidate’s salary is determined by several factors including travel, relevant work experience or skills and expertise.

Become a part of our caring community

Humana, a Fortune 60 Healthcare Company
Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 60 health benefits company with a long history of successful innovation and reinvention. It has transformed itself from the largest US nursing home company in the ’60s, to the largest US hospital corporation in the ’80s, to a leading health benefits company beginning in the ’90s. Today, Humana is a leader in consumer-focused health solutions and is one of the largest health benefits organizations in the country.

Role Overview: Strategy Advancement Advisor

The Enterprise Growth Strategy team is a newly created organization supporting growth across Humana’s businesses. The team has a strong dotted-line partnership with the Medicare and Medicaid organization, Humana’s largest, which comprises over 80% of the company’s total revenue and the majority of its earnings. Team members partner with the senior leaders of the business unit, and more broadly with leaders throughout the enterprise, as they deliver strategy projects addressing some of the businesses’ most important opportunities and challenges. These high-profile strategy projects place the team at the forefront of helping to define the future of Humana’s largest businesses.

Humana is seeking an experienced team member to support delivering some of Medicare and Medicaid’s highest priority projects and initiatives, with an emphasis on Medicare Advantage strategy development. As an Advisor, you will deconstruct issues and challenges, perform targeted research and analysis, and craft sound, logical solutions and recommendations. You will also shape implementation considerations, and work with business owners as appropriate to transition analysis into execution. While doing so, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with fellow team members, subject matter experts, members of Humana’s Executive Management Team, and corporate, functional, and business unit leaders.

This role will have a particular focus on Medicare enrollment growth strategy and investment optimization. The Strategy Advancement Advisor will help develop a framework that takes into account key dimensions of growth strategy such as marketing, sales, and product investment trade-offs that are responsive to local competitive and provider dynamics. The Advisor will be responsible for driving the development of deep consumer and competitor insights to inform key strategic choices that support sustainable enterprise growth.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Managing analysis and/or work streams within high-profile, high-impact strategy projects

  • Leading interviews and working sessions with leaders within Medicare and Medicaid and across the broader organization

  • Conducting industry, market, competitor, and financial analysis

  • Scoping and analyzing customer and broker research to develop strategic insights

  • Creating high quality analysis and deliverables that clearly frame objectives, issues, and challenges, and articulate insightful findings and recommendations

  • Working collaboratively with fellow team members and leaders across the company


Use your skills to make an impact

  • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities

  • Ability to quickly build and maintain trust with business leaders

  • Highly collaborative, flexible, teamwork-oriented working style

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop junior staff

  • Strong commitment to personal and professional growth

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, MPH, PhD, or graduate degree in a management field

Flexibility with work location; options include:

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Experienced Managed Care Claims Examiner - U.S. Remote

Job Type: Full-Time

Work Location: U.S. Remote

Work Hours: Pacific Time Zone

Position Overview

We are seeking an Experienced Managed Care Claims Examiner to join our growing healthcare operations team. This role is responsible for accurately reviewing, investigating, adjudicating, and resolving medical claims and provider dispute requests in accordance with payer guidelines, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.

This is a fast-paced, production-driven role requiring strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to process a broad range of claim scenarios. Successful candidates must be comfortable navigating complex claims, applying multiple benefit and reimbursement rules, and managing a high-volume workload while maintaining quality and accuracy standards.

The ideal candidate is self-motivated, accountable, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning and professional growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and adjudicate medical claims while ensuring accurate coding, data entry, and application of appropriate reimbursement methodologies.
  • Process a broad range of claim types, including professional, institutional, adjusted, corrected, and other complex claim scenarios.
  • Review and investigate provider dispute requests (PDRs), appeals, reconsiderations, and claim adjustments.
  • Verify member eligibility, provider participation, benefit coverage, and supporting documentation to facilitate accurate claim processing.
  • Research claim discrepancies and determine appropriate claim outcomes based on contractual agreements, benefits, policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Request additional information and collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve claim-related issues.
  • Process claims from initial review through final adjudication while maintaining thorough documentation of decisions and actions taken.
  • Handle complex claims involving multiple services, providers, benefits, or reimbursement methodologies.
  • Identify and escalate unusual or high-risk claims requiring additional review.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of claims processing activities.
  • Consistently achieve established productivity, quality, and timeliness standards.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing professional development initiatives.

Role Expectations

This position supports a complex managed care environment and requires examiners to process a variety of claim types rather than a single specialized inventory.

Successful candidates must be comfortable:

  • Learning and applying multiple benefit structures, reimbursement methodologies, and claim processing rules.
  • Managing a high-volume workload while balancing quality, accuracy, and productivity expectations.
  • Working independently and making sound claim decisions with limited supervision.
  • Receiving feedback and coaching in support of continuous improvement.
  • Adapting to evolving business needs, procedures, and claim scenarios.

Candidates seeking a highly specialized or narrowly focused claims role may find this position broader in scope than traditional claims processing positions.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of healthcare claims adjudication experience, preferably within a managed care, health plan, TPA, or payer environment.
  • Experience processing medical claims from initial review through final adjudication.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare claims processing and reimbursement principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to research, analyze, and resolve claim discrepancies and exceptions.
  • Strong attention to detail and sound decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage workload effectively and meet productivity expectations.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Basic to intermediate Microsoft Office skills.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations and verify claim accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience processing Provider Dispute Resolution (PDR), appeals, reconsiderations, and claim adjustments.
  • Managed care or health plan claims processing experience.
  • Experience processing multiple claim types and lines of business.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology.
  • Understanding of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding.
  • Experience handling complex claims requiring research, interpretation, and independent judgment.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Claims Examiners consistently:

  • Demonstrate accountability and ownership of their work.
  • Maintain high levels of accuracy and productivity.
  • Exercise strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Adapt to new claim scenarios and changing business requirements.
  • Work effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Remain engaged, resilient, and solution-oriented when faced with complex workloads and challenging claim situations.
  • Embrace continuous learning and professional development.

Ready to Grow Your Career?

We’d love to meet you! Click “Apply Now” and tell us why you’d be a great addition to the Imagenet team.

About Imagenet

Imagenet is a technology-forward healthcare operations partner with more than 25 years of experience helping healthcare payers manage critical administrative and operational processes. Founded in 2000 and headquartered in Tampa, Florida, Imagenet supports 150+ health plans through its payer clients.

Our teams help improve efficiency, accuracy, visibility, and service across complex healthcare operations, including digital mailroom, claims adjudication, contact center, member communications, and related administrative functions. By combining experienced operational teams, proven processes, and purpose-built workflow technology, Imagenet helps payers keep essential processes moving for the members, providers, and communities they serve.

Imagenet operates 10 secure facilities across the U.S. and one secure facility in Manila, Philippines.

Joining Imagenet means contributing to work that supports the healthcare operations members and providers rely on every day.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Laboratories are becoming increasingly connected, automated, and intelligent. As customers move toward autonomous laboratory environments, they need a coherent strategy that aligns instruments, software, automation, data, and workflows around their evolving scientific and business priorities.

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager, Autonomous Laboratories to help define and deliver those solutions.


This role will work directly with customers to understand their scientific workflows, technology environments, unmet needs, and future direction. You will translate those insights into product requirements and priorities, partnering across product, software, hardware, engineering, and innovation teams to shape solutions that address real customer problems.


The role sits at the intersection ofscience, technology, customers, and product management and is intended for someone with deep expertise in a relevant scientific or technology domain who can connect that expertise to a broader autonomous-lab vision.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as a product leader for autonomous laboratory solutions within a specific scientific, laboratory, or technology domain.
  • Engage directly with customers to understand workflows, pain points, automation requirements, technology gaps, and emerging needs.
  • Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, use cases, priorities, and solution concepts for product and engineering teams.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the customer workflow, including how instrumentation, software, automation, data, and laboratory processes interact.
  • Identify gaps in existing capabilities and opportunities where new products, integrations, or solutions could create differentiated customer value.
  • Partner across software engineering, hardware engineering, R&D, product organizations, commercial teams, and innovation functions.
  • Help shape product strategy and roadmaps that support the evolution toward increasingly automated and autonomous laboratories.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and their potential application within laboratory environments.
  • Work across traditionally separate product areas to help create integrated, end-to-end customer solutions.
  • Represent the voice of the customer throughout product development and prioritization.
  • Build strong relationships with strategic customers and use those relationships to continuously test assumptions and refine product direction.
  • Communicate product vision, customer requirements, priorities, and trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in a scientific, engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience working within a relevant scientific, laboratory, instrumentation, automation, or technology domain.
  • Demonstrated experience leading product strategy, portfolio direction, and strategic planning for complex technical products or solutions.
  • Experience engaging directly with customers to identify unmet needs and translate those needs into product requirements.
  • Strong understanding of how hardware, software, data, and workflows come together within complex technical environments.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering and R&D organizations and translate between customer, scientific, business, and technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and lead cross-functional initiatives in a complex global organization.
  • Strong strategic thinking coupled with the ability to turn ambiguous customer problems into actionable product direction.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred

  • Advanced degree in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline.
  • Experience with laboratory automation, integrated laboratory systems, scientific software, robotics, workflow automation, instrument connectivity, or data-driven laboratory environments.
  • Experience developing solutions that combine physical instrumentation with software and automation.
  • Experience working with highly technical customers in regulated, scientific, industrial, or R&D environments.
  • Experience helping bring emerging technologies from concept or customer pilot into scalable commercial products.
  • Understanding of AI-enabled scientific workflows or intelligent laboratory systems.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.  Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent

experience)

 Strong Microsoft Excel skills

 High attention to detail and accuracy

 Clear communication skills and ability to work independently as well as with a team

 Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines

 $28/hour

 Paid time off (vacation, sick leave, and holidays as outlined in the company handbook)

Talk NY is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color,

religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin,

disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Applied LLM Engineer
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLE House of YO is a connectivity and distribution business with compute layered on top.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

House of YO is a connectivity and distribution business with compute layered on top. YOlanda is our AI concierge.

On V3 of the YO platform, YOlanda is the interface. Users talk to her instead of tapping through menus. She answers questions about plans, data, top-ups and YOYO$ balances, and she takes the action on the user’s account. When she is wrong, the user is stuck and the product has failed.

Her knowledge is the YO ecosystem and nothing else. When a question falls outside it she hands off to YOnC, our compute cooperative, which routes it to a specialist model. Knowing where that line sits, and holding it, is central to the job.

She works to one golden rule: within five responses she has put a product or service in front of the user. Not five responses to be helpful. Five to arrive somewhere real.

This role makes her right, and keeps her fast, affordable and accountable in production. You write the prompts that govern how she thinks, build the evaluations that prove she works, run the caching, routing and controls that let her do it at scale at a cost per turn we can defend, and ship the code behind all of it.

YOlanda runs on our own LangChain and LangGraph build. You will open pull requests against that graph alongside the two engineers who own it.

You will not manage anyone. You will be in the model and in production every day.

WHO THIS IS FOR

You break things on purpose and explain exactly why they broke. You can read a bad answer and say in one sentence what is wrong with it, and read a trace and say in one sentence why it was slow. You would rather run fifty tests than win one argument about which prompt is better. You know what a turn costs, and you write well enough that people notice.

Location: Remote, global

Work format: Remote, full time

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Prompts and evaluation (45%)

  • Own YOlanda’s system prompt. Persona, tone, safety rules, what she refuses, when she hands off.
  • Write and maintain the prompts behind every user action on V3: plan changes, top-ups, balance queries, offers, troubleshooting, account support.
  • Hold the golden rule. Design the conversation so she reaches a product or service within five responses, without becoming pushy. Every clarifying question costs a turn she cannot get back.
  • Own the boundary. Decide what is inside YOlanda’s frame of reference and what goes to YOnC, and make the handoff seamless: same conversation, same voice, the answer simply arrives.
  • Manage context. Decide what YOlanda knows about the user, the account and the plan catalogue at each step, and what she must not carry over. Break long tasks into chains and tool calls.
  • Build the evaluation set for YOlanda. Every task she performs gets test cases, a pass condition and a score you can track over time, in both languages.
  • Measure the boundary, fact check plan prices, data allowances and YOYO$ maths, and red team the top-up and rewards flows. A confident wrong number costs a user money.

Production, caching and optimisation (35%)

  • Trace every call. Prompt version, model, tokens, cache hits, latency and cost on every turn. Set the SLOs for latency and availability, and build the alerts.
  • Own the gateway behaviour YOlanda depends on: timeouts, retries, and fallbacks across providers and models when one degrades.
  • Write prompts for the cache. Stable parts first, in a fixed order: system prompt, tool schemas, plan catalogue, then the user’s turn. A prompt that cannot be cached costs money on every turn.
  • Build semantic, retrieval and tool-result caching, scoped and invalidated correctly. A cached price from last week is a hallucination with a timestamp. A cached answer about someone else’s balance is a breach.
  • Own cost and latency per turn. Token budgets, context trimming, output length, and batch APIs for offline work.
  • Route by task. Benchmark frontier and open models on accuracy, latency and cost per turn, choose the model per task, and bring the numbers. Work with the engineers running open models on YOnC compute on what they serve and how.

Governance (20%)

  • Keep prompts, models and configuration in git with the rest of the code. Versioned, reviewed, tested, owned, and rolled back in one step when needed.
  • Build the release gate in CI: evaluation score, cost and latency budget. Then a canary, a staged rollout and a kill switch.
  • Audit every action that touches an account or money, from the user’s message to the tool call. Redact personal data before it reaches logs or a third-party provider.
  • Put the guardrails in the runtime: prompt injection defences, tool permissions, spend limits on top-up and rewards, and the point where a human approves.
  • Set cost budgets per feature and per model, with alerts. Know the rules that apply when an AI handles money and an operator account, and turn them into controls.

WHAT YOU NEED

  • Two or more years building with large language models in production, at real traffic. Daily use of a chat window does not count.
  • Python you can ship. Scripts, API clients, data handling, tests. Git, JSON, regex, markdown.
  • LangChain and LangGraph. You have shipped with both, and you can read a graph you did not write and change it without breaking it.
  • Prompting and evaluation. System prompts you wrote that shipped, and the evaluation harness that proved them. Code or work we can read. You change one variable at a time and record the result.
  • Production operations. Tracing, SLOs, fallbacks, and caching you have shipped with invalidation that was right. A before and after on cost and latency, with numbers on it.
  • Governance in practice. Versioning, release gates, audit logging, personal data handling. Controls in code, not policy in a document.
  • Retrieval in production. Chunking, embeddings, reranking, grounding an answer in a source, and knowing when retrieval is the wrong tool for the question.
  • Exceptional written English. Syntax, register, nuance. You can write in a voice that is not your own and hold it.
  • Care for the user at the other end. Many of our users are on prepaid plans and count every dollar. YOlanda gets it wrong at their expense, not ours.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Top-notch products disrupting the world of the traditional media-services industry
  • A brilliant, highly collaborative team with a shared drive to achieve goals
  • Flexible working hours
  • Competitive salary
  • Real opportunity for personal and professional growth

jobs.excerpt: Hello,Role: FCS Functional TesterClient: Utility Client, Liberty.
jobs.description:
Hello,

Role: FCS Functional Tester

Client: Utility Client, Liberty.

Work mode: Remote.

Start date: 10/26/2026 (Mon).

Duration: 3+ months, subject to the outcome of the project.

Immigration category: US citizen, green card, H1-B.

Project Overview:

Liberty Utilities uses the Itron Field Collection System (FCS) to support its field meter-reading operations, leveraging FC300 handheld devices and Itron MC3/MC4 Toughbooks used by field personnel. The current landscape includes FCS 4.3.0 for NY Water and FCS 4.5.3 for Liberty.

The field personnel has the FC300 handhelds and Itron MC3 / MC4 Toughbook at his/her truck. The field personnel uses bing map to display the street view and the route. Microsoft is ending support for that bing map version, effective 11/30/2026. So, the existing FCS environments will undergo a stepped upgrade to FCS 4.7 to continue bing map support. A new QA FCS environment will be established and upgraded to FCS 4.7 to validate the solution through Functional, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) before production deployment.

The upgrade scope also includes the associated FC300 handhelds and MC3/MC4 Toughbooks, along with the impact associated with the applicable Bing Maps version.

Job Description:

Responsible for Functional and Non-Functional testing of the upgraded FCS (version 4.7).

Key Responsibilities: Functional and Non-Functional test planning, test case preparation and Testing of the upgraded FCS (version 4.7), defect triage, retesting of defects, test result documents.

Must Have Skills: Functional Testing of Itron's Field Collection System (FCS) or any compatible Collection system.

Pay Rate: $70/hr

jobs.description:
Company Overview:Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Hours: Full-time, salaried (40hrs/week), Mon-Fri, 7:30am-9pm ET rotating shifts and rotating Saturdays 7:00am-5pm ET

The Opportunity:

As a BlinkRx Pharmacist, you are the clinical backbone of our closed-door facility. You will verify prescriptions with speed and precision, provide proactive phone-based patient counseling, and collaborate with prescribers to keep medications moving without compromising safety. This role is ideal for pharmacists who thrive in a structured, high-throughput environment and are passionate about improving patient outcomes at scale.

Responsibilities:

Prescription Verification and Dispensing

  • Review and clinically verify new and refill prescriptions for therapeutic appropriateness, drug-drug interactions, contraindications, and dosing accuracy
  • Validate prescription data entry performed by pharmacy technicians, ensuring transcription accuracy from provider orders and transfer records
  • Perform pharmacist verification of filled prescriptions in a closed-door fulfillment environment, confirming accuracy of drug, dose, quantity, NDC, and labeling prior to release for shipment
  • Perform daily prospective drug utilization review (DUR) to identify and resolve clinical flags before fulfillment
  • Manage specialty medication handling requirements including cold-chain verification

Patient Care

All patient interaction at BlinkRx is conducted by phone or digital platforms. Our pharmacists are the primary clinical contact for patients and must deliver a high standard of care in every call.

  • Provide proactive outbound patient counseling calls for new prescriptions, addressing drug education, expected side effects, dosing instructions, storage requirements, and adherence strategies
  • Handle inbound clinical patient calls related to counseling and clinical inquiries, while directing non-clinical inquiries, such as refill status and delivery questions, to the patient support team.
  • Document all patient interactions thoroughly in the patient profile within the pharmacy management system
  • Support Spanish-speaking patients with bilingual counseling where applicable

Prescriber Collaboration and Clinical Outreach

  • Contact prescriber offices via phone and electronic messaging to clarify incomplete, ambiguous, or clinically inappropriate prescriptions prior to dispensing
  • Partner with prescribers on therapeutic substitutions, DAW overrides, and formulary alternatives to reduce dispensing delays

Pharmacy Technician Supervision and Workflow Management

  • Supervise pharmacy technicians across data entry, prescription processing, packaging, and fulfillment workflows in accordance with state board regulations and in collaboration with technician management
  • Conduct real-time quality checks on technician work product, providing immediate corrective feedback to maintain accuracy standards
  • Identify and escalate technician performance trends to pharmacy leadership; participate in coaching and training as directed

Compliance, Safety and Quality

  • Ensure strict compliance with HIPAA, state pharmacy practice acts, federal DEA regulations, and all BlinkRx corporate policies
  • Oversee proper handling, documentation, and destruction of PHI-containing records and materials in alignment with privacy protocols
  • Participate in quality assurance activities including internal audits, prescription error tracking, and near-miss reporting
  • Report adverse drug events and medication errors through established pharmacovigilance channels, when applicable
  • Maintain fulfillment area compliance standards, including proper storage of temperature-sensitive medications

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with pharmacy leadership, patient services, clinical, compliance, and technology teams to drive operational and clinical improvements
  • Coordinate with the shipping and fulfillment team to resolve packaging errors, return-to-sender issues, and delivery failures affecting patient medication access
  • Provide clinical input on technology enhancements, workflow tools, and software configurations that affect the pharmacist verification or patient counseling experience
  • Participate in team huddles, quality reviews, and department meetings to support continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications:

Required

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an ACPE-accredited College of Pharmacy
  • Active Pharmacy License in good standing with your state Board of Pharmacy AND Idaho Board of Pharmacy
  • Active Missouri Pharmacy License in good standing with the Missouri Board of Pharmacy
  • Strong command of the English language (written and verbal); bilingual Spanish preferred for phone-based patient counseling
  • Demonstrated ability to perform high-volume prescription verification with strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn pharmacy management systems, verification platforms, and internal workflow tools

Preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in a mail order, specialty, retail or closed-door fulfillment pharmacy
  • Active pharmacy licensure required in home state; candidates must obtain licensure in 3 additional states from the list below within the first 9 months of hire (prior licensure in any of the following states is a plus):
    • AK, AL, AR, CA, ID, IL, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MS, NE, NV, OK, OR, TN, TX, VA, WV
  • Familiarity with pharmacovigilance or adverse drug event reporting protocols

What Success Looks Like:

  • Prescription verification queues are processed accurately and on time without sacrificing clinical quality
  • Every patient who receives a counseling call feels informed, supported, and confident in their therapy
  • Prescriber outreach is proactive and efficient, minimizing dispensing delays caused by incomplete or unclear orders
  • Compliance and quality standards are upheld without exception in a fast-paced environment
  • You are a trusted clinical partner within the BlinkRx team — shaping the patient experience from behind the scenes

#blinkindeed

Why Join Us:It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.
