jobs.excerpt: OverviewPhoenixTeam is hiring a Salesforce Product Manager to lead product strategy and delivery for Agentforce and Salesforce Data Cloud (now Data 360) for a commercial customer.
jobs.description:
Overview

PhoenixTeam is hiring a Salesforce Product Manager to lead product strategy and delivery for Agentforce and Salesforce Data Cloud (now Data 360) for a commercial customer. This role owns the path from business problem to released capability: use-case intake, data readiness, roadmap, backlog, solution definition, pilot, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.

The right person has already delivered with both Agentforce and Data Cloud/Data 360. They understand that a useful agent depends on trusted data, clear business logic, secure actions, defined guardrails, and measurable outcomes. They can challenge a weak use case, identify missing data or governance dependencies before delivery starts, and turn a sound opportunity into a release plan that business, architecture, data, engineering, security, and operations can execute.

This is a hands-on platform product role. The Product Manager owns product decisions, prioritization, requirements, and success measures while partnering closely with Salesforce architects, administrators, developers, data engineers, and customer stakeholders. They do not need to be the primary configurator or developer, but they must be technically fluent enough to make informed tradeoffs and hold the product to a high quality bar.

Key Functions

  • Own the product vision, roadmap, priorities, and backlog for Agentforce and Data Cloud/Data 360 capabilities.
  • Manage intake and qualify use cases by user need, business outcome, data availability, risk, reuse potential, cost, and delivery readiness.
  • Translate priorities into product requirements, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, agent evaluation criteria, data requirements, and release plans.
  • Define Data Cloud/Data 360 requirements, including source systems, data streams and connectors, zero-copy access where appropriate, data-model mapping, identity resolution, calculated insights, segments and activations, unstructured content, permissions, consent, data quality, and governance.
  • Define Agentforce requirements, including topics, instructions, actions, grounding and retrieval, Flow and API integrations, access controls, guardrails, human handoff, and monitoring.
  • Prioritize work based on business value, data readiness, governance risk, technical dependencies, enterprise reuse, and delivery capacity.
  • Partner with business, architecture, data, engineering, security, privacy, legal, operations, and adoption teams to resolve dependencies and sequence releases.
  • Lead prototype, pilot, testing, and launch-readiness activities; define how the team will evaluate groundedness, task completion, reliability, access control, escalation, user experience, and business impact.
  • Use production feedback and metrics to improve agent behavior, data quality, adoption, cost effectiveness, and reusable platform patterns.
  • Maintain clear decisions, assumptions, risks, and traceability from the intended business outcome to the data context, agent behavior, release, and measured result.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management or product ownership experience for enterprise software, CRM, data platforms, AI-enabled products, automation, or SaaS.
  • Demonstrated product management experience with both Salesforce Agentforce and Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360, including taking Agentforce or Data Cloud capabilities through pilot or production release. Candidates must be able to explain their personal decisions, the data and agent design, quality measures, adoption approach, and business outcome; training or certification alone is not sufficient.
  • Practical knowledge of Data Cloud/Data 360, including data ingestion or zero-copy access, data streams, Data Lake Objects and Data Model Objects, identity resolution, calculated insights, segmentation and activation, data quality, permissions, and governance.
  • Practical knowledge of Agentforce, including topics, instructions, actions, grounding or retrieval, Flow or API integrations, access controls, testing and evaluation, guardrails, human escalation, and monitoring.
  • Proven ability to own a product strategy, roadmap, backlog, and release plan and to write product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable success criteria that technical teams can execute.
  • Strong Salesforce platform fluency, including the relationship among Salesforce applications, Flow, platform security and permissions, metadata, APIs, integrations, and enterprise data.
  • Experience coordinating decisions across business, architecture, data, engineering, security, privacy, legal, and operational stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment and communication skills, including the ability to challenge low-value or poorly prepared use cases, explain technical tradeoffs clearly, and make prioritization decisions under ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications or Skills

  • Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist and Salesforce Certified Data 360 Consultant (formerly Data Cloud Consultant).
  • Additional Salesforce credentials such as Platform Administrator, Business Analyst, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Service Cloud Consultant.
  • Experience with Salesforce Flow, MuleSoft or other API and integration patterns, Tableau or CRM Analytics, and enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience defining AI-agent evaluation, responsible-AI controls, prompt or grounding strategies, observability, incident response, and human-in-the-loop operating models.
  • Experience working in a Salesforce Center of Excellence, enterprise platform product team, or customer-facing consulting environment.
  • Experience driving adoption and operating-model change for new CRM, data, automation, or AI capabilities.

Position Details

Employment type: Full-Time, W2.

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.-based).

Hours: 40 hours/week with availability during core U.S. business hours.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Openings: 1.

About PhoenixTeam

PhoenixTeam partners with organizations to deliver real results across GenAI, data, product, and technology. We help clients modernize platforms, redesign complex workflows, and move practical AI and digital solutions into production.

PhoenixTeam is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Channel Account Manager

Remote [within the US]

ABOUT THE ROLE:

HiddenLayer is seeking a Channel Account Manager to build and grow relationships with strategic channel partners and drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue. This role is ideal for a channel sales professional who understands how cybersecurity and cloud security solutions are sold through and with the channel, can create strong executive and field relationships, and enjoys building repeatable partner motions in a fast-moving startup environment.

You will work closely with HiddenLayer's direct sales, solutions architecture, marketing, customer success, and operations teams to develop joint account plans, activate partners, accelerate opportunities, and create a consistent co-selling experience. You will play an important role in expanding our channel presence and helping partners confidently position HiddenLayer's AI security platform with their customers.

WHO WE ARE:

HiddenLayer protects the world’s most valuable technologies from adversarial AI attacks. We were founded by AI professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial AI attacks can be to detect and defend against. Determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of AI securely.

Our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as RSA's Innovation Sandbox Winner, CB Insights AI 100, CyberTech 100, and SC's Most Promising Early-Stage Start-up.

  • Own a portfolio of strategic channel partners, including VARs, solution providers, and cybersecurity-focused resellers, and build relationships across executive, sales, technical, and delivery teams.
  • Develop and execute joint business plans that define revenue goals, target accounts, pipeline actions, enablement priorities, and measurable partner outcomes.
  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by identifying opportunities, facilitating introductions, and supporting partners through the full sales cycle from qualification to close.
  • Collaborate with direct sales to align account coverage, coordinate co-selling activities, avoid channel conflict, and increase deal velocity.
  • Enable partners to effectively position, demonstrate, sell, and support HiddenLayer's platform through training, sales resources, technical alignment, and ongoing engagement.
  • Plan and support joint go-to-market activities, including field events, campaigns, webinars, account mapping, and partner marketing initiatives.
  • Lead regular partner business reviews, communicate performance against goals, and translate partner feedback into actionable recommendations for internal teams.
  • Manage deal registration, partner opportunity tracking, forecasting, and reporting in partnership with Sales Operations and Revenue Operations.
  • Serve as the internal advocate for partners while holding both HiddenLayer and partner stakeholders accountable to shared commitments.
  • Help improve the partner experience by contributing to channel processes, enablement programs, tools, and playbooks as the business scales.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • 5+ years of experience in channel sales, partner management, account management, or direct and overlay B2B software sales, preferably within cybersecurity, cloud security, or enterprise technology.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with direct sales teams and cross-functional stakeholders while maintaining clear ownership and accountability.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage both executive and field-level audiences.
  • A self-starter who is comfortable operating without a fully built playbook and is motivated to create practical, repeatable processes.
  • Strong business judgment and a data-informed approach to prioritizing partners, accounts, and activities that will have the greatest impact.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and familiarity with partner relationship management, deal registration, and partner performance reporting tools.
  • Ability to travel periodically for partner meetings, customer engagements, and industry or company events.

WHY HIDDENLAYER?

We just raised $100M in Series B funding led by Delta-v Capital, with backing from Morgan Stanley, Microsoft's venture arm, Booz Allen Hamilton, and others. It's a validation of what we've built: 10x revenue growth, 50+ new enterprise customers, and deployments across defense, finance, and the world's largest AI platforms. This funding goes straight into expanding our platform and GTM capabilities, and into growing our team globally.

Attracting and retaining the very best people is our #1 priority. That’s why we offer our team best-in-class benefits, including:

  • Fully Remote: We are a completely remote global team. Though we’re distributed, we are intentional about getting the team together a couple of times a year. We offer a generous stipend for your home office setup, annual upgrades to ensure you have a comfortable workspace and a monthly stipend for internet/phone expenses.

  • Flexible Time Off: Enjoy unlimited and flexible time off for all salaried employees, in addition to 15 paid company holidays.
  • Commitment to Learning and Development: We support personal growth and education through a dedicated L&D fund that can be used for training, conferences, certifications and industry events.
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We are committed to building a diverse team with individuals from various backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

The successful candidate will bring a strong problem-solving approach to enhancing and maintaining the performance, data integrity, and workflows of our Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Learning Management, and Travel applications. Additionally, this position will participate in the delivery of IT services and ensure internal client satisfaction. Ideal candidates will have a foundational understanding of procurement operations, SaaS applications, expense management, and systems integration in a dynamic, high-growth environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • System Configuration: Configure, develop, and maintain the Coupa platform (Procurement, Invoicing, Expense) as well as Skilljar and Egencia, tailoring features to meet evolving business needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Testing: Lead QA and end-to-end testing cycles for system release upgrades and internal rollouts. Develop and execute test scripts to ensure system stability before deployment.
  • Workflow Development: Assist in building and modifying approval chains, custom fields, forms, and workflow rules across all supported platforms to streamline internal operations.
  • Integrations Management: Support the integration of Coupa with core financial systems (e.g., NetSuite) via APIs, flat files, and cXML. Monitor and assist with integrations for Egencia (e.g., SCIM Provisioning with Entra ID) and Skilljar (e.g., Avalara connectors, Proctoring).
  • Production Support: Manage and resolve production support issues, acting as the escalation point for complex incidents across the Coupa, Skilljar, and Egencia environments.
  • Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including configuration guides, QA testing plans, integration data maps, and support procedures for all managed systems.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Procurement, Finance, HR, Education Services and IT teams to ensure effective communication and alignment on business processes.
  • Compliance & Security: Ensure system configurations comply with IT security and regulatory standards (e.g., SOX, Information Security) during any enhancement or deployment.

30-60-90 Day Expectations

First 30 Days (Learning & Onboarding):

  • Complete initial onboarding and required internal system training.
  • Shadow senior developer to understand SailPoint’s current architecture, integrations, Procure-to-Pay/Expense, and travel processes.
  • Review existing technical documentation and business process maps.
  • Begin handling Level 1 and Level 2 support tickets (e.g., user access, basic routing errors, expense policy inquiries) under supervision.
  • Gain familiarity with the sandbox environment by executing basic test scripts.

First 60 Days (Contribution & Configuration):

  • Take ownership of standard support tickets and resolve them independently.
  • Execute small configuration tasks such as updating approval matrices, creating custom fields, or modifying expense auditing rules.
  • Assist in the QA and testing phases for upcoming patches or minor system enhancements.
  • Identify at least one area in the current support documentation that can be updated or improved.
  • Participate in requirement-gathering sessions with business stakeholders alongside senior developers.

First 90 Days (Development & Ownership):

  • Successfully develop and deploy a minor enhancement or workflow change from start to finish.
  • Gain a solid understanding of the integration touchpoints between Coupa and the core ERP (NetSuite), assisting with integration monitoring and error handling.
  • Proactively identify recurring user issues and propose sustainable configuration solutions or user-training opportunities.
  • Act as a reliable point of contact for basic Coupa functionality and troubleshooting for the Procurement and Finance teams.

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience working with financial or business systems (SaaS platforms), with direct experience configuring or supporting Coupa being a strong advantage.
  • Exposure to or experience with Learning Management Systems (e.g., Skilljar) or Travel Management platforms (e.g., Egencia) is a plus.
  • Foundational understanding of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Expense Management processes.
  • Exposure to systems integration concepts (APIs, flat-file transfers, cXML, SCIM Provisioning) and basic scripting is highly preferred.
  • Experience running QA testing, creating test scripts, and managing sandbox environments.
  • Solid knowledge of IT compliance frameworks (SOX, Information Security) as they relate to financial systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills across technical and non-technical teams.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
  • Coupa Platform Certification is a strong plus.

Sales Account Executive – (Independent Contractor)

Location: Europe or Canada – Remote (Travel Required)

About us

Niricson is driving innovation in civil infrastructure inspection and risk management. Our technology (sensors, AI data analytics, software) delivers actionable insights into structural integrity—more efficient, reliable, and accurate than traditional inspection methods. We’re committed to excellence, growth, and building strong client relationships. As we expand and scale in the European region, we are seeking talented sales professionals who want to make a real impact.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Sales Account Manager (Independent Contractor) to help lead Niricson’s business development and client relationship efforts across Europe. In this role, you’ll focus on expanding our presence within the infrastructure sector by developing new client relationships, identifying opportunities for collaboration, and representing Niricson’s technology and service offerings with professionalism and enthusiasm.

You will operate independently as a contractor, managing your own schedule and approach, while collaborating closely with our internal Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to help grow Niricson’s reach and reputation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, research, and engage potential clients across the infrastructure, engineering, and asset management sectors (e.g., public agencies, hydro dam operators, engineering consultants, asset owners). Utilizing various channels such as cold calling, email outreach, and networking events/conferences to generate leads and build a pipeline of opportunities.
  • Manage the full business development cycle, from initial contact to negotiation and deal facilitation.
  • Build and nurture relationships with existing and prospective enterprise and government-level clients through discovery meetings, delivering sales pitches, product demos, and tailored solution presentations.
  • Collaborate with our internal marketing team to develop and execute targeted campaigns to generate interest and engagement from enterprise clients.
  • Effectively navigate complex sales cycles and overcome objections to close deals within agreed timelines.
  • Develop long-term client rapport (e.g., with C-level executives, decision-makers, and influencers within target accounts).
  • Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and industry trends to position our offerings and differentiate them from competitors effectively.
  • Collaborate with the product team to provide customer feedback, market insights, and suggestions for product enhancements.
  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets, including quarterly and annual revenue goals.
  • Ensure accurate and timely reporting of sales activities and opportunities in the CRM system.
  • While this is a remote role, you’ll collaborate regularly with the rest of the North American teams via virtual meetings. Flexibility in working hours may be required to accommodate time zone differences.

We aim to provide as much support and guidance as is helpful to you, but we encourage you to help set the path forward - your ideas matter here!

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field. A basic understanding of civil engineering/infrastructure in general is also a plus.
  • 3–5+ years of enterprise sales experience, preferably within infrastructure, SaaS, construction tech, or engineering services
  • Proven track record of success in enterprise sales, preferably in the technology industry, with a focus on B2B & B2G solutions.
  • Strong business acumen and understanding of enterprise-level buying processes, including complex sales cycles and multi-stakeholder decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively articulate value propositions and build rapport with executive-level contacts.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic Startup environment.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills, with a strategic and consultative approach to selling.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools to manage and track sales activities.
  • Willingness to travel as required to attend client meetings, industry conferences, and other
    business-related events.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Able and keen to work in a lean, fast-paced, continuously growing environment.
  • Familiarity with European public procurement processes (federal, state, municipal)

Diversity and Inclusion

Niricson is a diverse and inclusive equal-opportunity employer. We encourage diversity, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, products, and our community. We are committed to fostering belonging through a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate against any race, gender, religious affiliation, ethnicity, or any other demographic - instead, we celebrate diversity.

We’re a close-knit, mission-driven team that celebrates curiosity, diversity, and excellence. If that sounds like you, we can’t wait to meet you!

Contract Terms

Engagement Type:
Independent Contractor (not an employee of Niricson)

Compensation: Competitive commission-based structure, with a base monthly retainer depending on experience and contribution level.

Schedule: Flexible, you control your working hours and methods of delivering results.

Term: 12-month renewable agreement, subject to mutual satisfaction and performance.

Reporting: The contractor will liaise directly with our Chief Sales Officer to coordinate strategic priorities and deliverables.

Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled ServiceNow Application Developer to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: ServiceNow Application Developer

Salary: $120K - $170 K

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.

We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.

No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.
However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.

For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Application Developer to build and maintain solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, and custom scoped applications. The role focuses on hands-on configuration and development — including workflows, Flow Designer, scripting, integrations, UI customization, and platform extensions — while applying best practices that keep the platform clean, upgrade-safe, and performant. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful ServiceNow work in production, balances declarative and programmatic approaches thoughtfully, and writes maintainable code that survives upgrades and team turnover.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build workflows using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, and Process Automation Designer where appropriate.

  • Develop scoped applications that follow platform best practices and avoid global-scope pollution.
  • Build integrations with enterprise systems using IntegrationHub spokes, REST/SOAP APIs, and MID Servers.

  • Implement Service Portal, Employee Center, and custom portal experiences using widgets and AngularJS.
  • Develop and maintain CMDB integrations, identification rules, and data quality improvements.
  • Implement reports, dashboards, and Performance Analytics where required, ensuring stakeholders have the operational visibility they need to monitor service performance and make informed decisions.
  • Participate in design reviews, contribute to platform standards, and document technical decisions.
  • Support upgrades, regression testing, and remediation of customizations across releases.
  • Troubleshoot performance, scripting, and integration issues across development, test, and production instances, applying systematic root-cause analysis and contributing durable fixes back to the platform.
  • Collaborate with admins, BAs, and stakeholders to refine requirements and propose pragmatic technical solutions.
  • Stay current with ServiceNow releases, new features, and emerging best practices.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
  • Strong JavaScript skills including ES5/ES6 patterns used in ServiceNow.
  • Deep expertise with Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Actions, and UI Policies.
  • Experience with Flow Designer and IntegrationHub.
  • Hands-on integration experience using REST, SOAP, and MID Servers.
  • Strong understanding of the ServiceNow data model and CMDB concepts.
  • Experience with Service Portal widget development.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) credential.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD).
  • Certified Implementation Specialist credentials (ITSM, HR, CSM, ITOM).
  • Experience with Now Assist or GenAI Controller.
  • Familiarity with App Engine Studio.
  • Exposure to multi-instance ServiceNow environments.

How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

About Modular Solutions

Founded in 2015, Modular Solutions delivers enterprise-grade technology to the insurance industry. Our configurable platform helps insurers, mutuals, MGAs, and brokers manage core operations through a single system designed for flexibility, long-term growth, and complex regulated environments.

Position Summary

Modular Solutions is seeking a Director of Data & Analytics to own the architecture and governance of our data and analytics platform and how our data is turned into decisions, so that the data we collect becomes reporting and answers that clients and teams can trust as we continue to grow our platform, client base, and internal capabilities.

Reporting to the CTO, this role leads the Data function, including data engineering, data science, business intelligence, analytics, and migration, and owns the architecture of the data and analytics platform that connects them. While the data and analytics platform is the primary focus, the role also contributes to and collaborates on the data architecture and design of our core application alongside our Product and Development teams.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who sets direction and stays close to the work: designing the analytics data architecture, data models, and semantic layer alongside engineers rather than managing from a distance. You should bring deep experience in data architecture, data modelling, BI and analytics, and data governance, with a working knowledge of data migration and AI-enabled workflows, along with the ability to lead people, prioritize work, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

This role is well suited for someone who can build structure, develop teams, improve processes, and help Modular responsibly adopt data and AI practices that create real value for clients, employees, and the platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the data strategy and long-term roadmap for the Data function, including platforms, vendors, budget, and cost, and build a high-performing team across data engineering, BI and analytics, and data migration.
  • Own the data and analytics platform architecture: the target-state design for how data flows out of our application into ingestion and pipelines, the data warehouse and data marts, the semantic layer, and the BI and AI tools that consume them, supported by reference architectures and documented architecture decisions.
  • Define and maintain the analytics data model for insurance data, including policy, billing, claims, bordereaux, brokers, and coverage, aligned with the application's data model, so that migration, reporting, and analytics map to it consistently.
  • Collaborate with Product and Development on the data architecture and design of our core application: bring a data perspective to schema and data model design, assess the downstream impact of changes, favour incremental improvements over large-scale redesign, and establish data contracts so that application changes do not break reporting, integrations, or client deliverables.
  • Own metric governance: a single set of business definitions and KPIs with clear owners, implemented once in the semantic layer and consumed consistently by BI, client reporting, and AI.
  • Design how clients access their reporting and analytics data, including governed data sharing and extracts, partnering with product engineering where access runs through application APIs, with appropriate tenant isolation, security, and performance.
  • Set standards for data quality, governance, privacy, security, and data residency, including PII classification, retention, lineage, and access control, in support of our security and compliance programs.
  • Establish a data quality and validation framework, including automated reconciliation, testing, and certification of trusted datasets and AI-generated outputs, so that our teams and clients can trust results at scale.
  • Define the reporting operating model for standard and client-specific reporting, including intake and prioritization, move clients toward governed self-service analytics, and deliver executive-level insights and advanced analytics, such as forecasting, where they create clear business value.
  • Build data migration and onboarding into a repeatable capability, with a reusable conversion framework, reconciliation, and post-migration validation, led by a dedicated migration lead.
  • Build AI-ready data foundations so that AI features call governed data and semantic models rather than calculating on their own, lead AI adoption within the Data team, and help define the product direction for self-service and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Partner with Product, Development, Implementation, Operations, and leadership to align priorities, and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to executives.
  • Perform other duties as required to support the Data function.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, or a related data field, including designing data platforms or data models at an organizational level.
  • 3+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical teams, while remaining hands-on in the work.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise data architecture, including data models, data warehouses and marts, ETL/ELT pipelines, semantic models, and the integration between operational systems and analytics platforms, with a track record of collaborating with application engineering teams on data design and improving existing systems incrementally.
  • Hands-on experience building and governing business definitions, metrics, or semantic models, and working directly with engineers to implement them.
  • Strong grounding in data governance, data quality, privacy, and security, including access control, PII handling, lineage, and validation of data and reporting outputs.
  • Experience leading data migration, data conversion, or reconciliation initiatives.
  • Strong technical knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and cloud data platforms, with experience in tools such as Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, and Python, or similar technologies. Familiarity with C# or TypeScript is an asset.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day work, and the ability to encourage and support their use across a team, with sound judgment on accuracy, privacy, and security.
  • Experience designing KPI frameworks and delivering executive-level reporting, with strong data visualization and storytelling skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into technical direction and technical concepts into clear business language, and to set standards and repeatable operating models across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and cross-functional dependencies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in the insurance, InsurTech, SaaS, financial services, or other complex regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with insurance data, including policy, billing, claims, broker, customer, coverage, risk, transaction, or reporting data.
  • Previous involvement in AI adoption, AI enablement, or AI transformation initiatives within a software, data, or product organization.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

jobs.excerpt: The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.
jobs.description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary


At The Standard, Agile Product Managers connect customer needs, business priorities, and technology to deliver measurable value. Within Enterprise Data, the Senior Product Manager turns enterprise data into reliable products for internal business teams, analysts, operational systems, digital experiences, AI solutions, partners, and other consumers. Following a data-as-a-product approach, teams deliver analytical and transactional data products across the data lifecycle.


The Sr. Product Manager owns strategy, roadmap, prioritization, lifecycle, adoption, and business outcomes for an enterprise data-product portfolio.


Working with customers and stakeholders, this role translates data needs for decisions, experiences, processes, and downstream products into defined products with measurable outcomes. Partners include Data Engineering, Architecture, Data Governance, Analytics, AI, and business teams.


Success means customers can find, understand, trust, access, and use data that measurably improves processes, experiences, and decisions.


Key Responsibilities:


Data Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own portfolio vision, strategy, lifecycle, and a forward-looking roadmap explaining direction and rationale.
  • Translate customer problems, enterprise strategy, regulatory requirements, and technology opportunities into priorities.
  • Define each product’s customers, problem, value proposition, and outcomes.
  • Prioritize investments and resolve competing needs using customer value, reuse, strategic alignment, risk, effort, and measurable outcomes.
  • Balance new development with enhancements, technical debt, quality, modernization, and lifecycle needs.

Customer Discovery & Product Definition

  • Understand internal and external customers’ workflows, decisions, experiences, and data needs.
  • Continuously engage business, operations, analytics, application, digital-product, and partner stakeholders in discovery.
  • Translate customer problems into capabilities, requirements, outcomes, and success measures.
  • Distinguish one-time requests from reusable capabilities serving multiple customers and use cases.
  • Define how customers discover, access, understand, and consume products.
  • Validate assumptions early through feedback, prototypes, data analysis, and incremental delivery.
  • Represent customers in development and lifecycle decisions.

Build Enterprise Data Products

  • Partner with Data Engineering and Architecture to build scalable products that meet customer and business needs.
  • Guide products from source through transformation, modeling, quality validation, governance, and delivery.
  • Select fit-for-purpose delivery with engineering: datasets, APIs, events, files, analytical models, or other data services.
  • Define product scope, ownership, service expectations, and consumption patterns.
  • Design for reuse rather than customer-specific pipelines, extracts, or point-to-point integrations.
  • Address reliability, scalability, performance, and maintainability throughout the lifecycle.

Internal & External Customer Products

  • Build data products for internal processes, analytics, reporting, digital experiences, operational systems, and AI.
  • Understand data needs for experiences serving employers, employees, partners, and other external consumers.
  • Partner with digital and application teams to power customer-facing experiences.
  • Define downstream interfaces and service levels; prioritize experience, timeliness, accuracy, reliability, and usability.

Data Quality, Governance & Trust

  • Make data quality and trust core product requirements.
  • Partner with Governance, Security, Privacy, Risk, and Architecture to meet enterprise requirements and manage sensitive and regulated data throughout the lifecycle.
  • Establish business definitions, metadata, lineage, ownership, quality expectations, and access controls.
  • Define meaningful quality measures and thresholds with customers and engineering.
  • Embed governance in the product experience so customers can confidently understand and use data.

Product Adoption & Value Realization

  • Own portfolio adoption and value realization, with measures tailored to each product’s purpose and customers.
  • Track adoption, usage, quality, reliability, customer experience, and business outcomes.
  • Regularly validate that products solve intended customer problems.
  • Use telemetry, feedback, operational performance, and outcomes to guide the roadmap.
  • Improve, consolidate, replace, or retire underused and duplicative products.
  • Communicate outcomes and portfolio health to business and technology leaders.

Cross-Functional Product Leadership

  • Partner across Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Architecture, Governance, Analytics, AI and application Product Management, and business teams.
  • Lead complex products across systems, business areas, and delivery teams.
  • Translate business problems into product decisions without unnecessarily prescribing technical solutions.
  • Explain technical topics to business and executive audiences and align teams on outcomes.
  • Resolve conflicts among customer needs, architecture, engineering constraints, governance, and enterprise priorities.
  • Mentor Product Managers and Product Owners and mature Enterprise Data product-management practices.

Skills and Background You'll Need


Education: A High school diploma or GED is required; Bachelor’s degree preferred.


Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in product management, data, analytics, technology, or a related business environment. Experience working with a globally dispersed team is highly preferred.

  • Ownership of complex products through discovery, delivery, adoption, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience building data, analytics, API, integration, digital, or enterprise technology products.
  • Experience serving internal customers and supporting external customer experiences.
  • Experience partnering with Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, or Data Governance.
  • Experience navigating complex enterprises, multiple stakeholders, and competing priorities.

Product Management Skills

  • Strong discovery, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and lifecycle-management skills.
  • Identify customer problems beyond requirements and distinguish reusable capabilities from one-time requests.
  • Translate a clear product vision into executable priorities.
  • Strong customer discovery and stakeholder management.
  • Define outcomes and measure product success.
  • Make difficult tradeoffs using customer value, outcomes, risk, strategic alignment, and technical feasibility.
  • Strong written, verbal, and visual communication.

Data Product Skills

  • Strong understanding of data-as-a-product principles and modern enterprise data architectures.
  • Understand ingestion, transformation, modeling, quality, storage, integration, and delivery.
  • Understand analytical and transactional product patterns, including APIs, events, streaming, data sharing, and batch delivery.
  • Understand metadata, lineage, business definitions, quality, privacy, security, and access controls.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms and lakehouse architecture.
  • Working knowledge of Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, SQL, APIs, and related technologies preferred.
  • Discuss architecture and engineering tradeoffs without personally designing or implementing solutions.

Analytics & AI Understanding

  • Understand how analytics, machine learning, GenAI, and operational applications use enterprise data and how product design affects outcomes.
  • Identify shared data products serving analytics, AI, operational, and digital use cases.
  • Apply understanding of emerging Data and AI capabilities to evolving customer needs and roadmap decisions.

Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate

  • Customer Focus: Start with customer problems and value, not available data or technology.
  • Product Thinking: Treat data as a product with customers, outcomes, quality expectations, lifecycle decisions, and measurable value.
  • Driving Success: Own decisions and outcomes; deliver value across organizational boundaries.
  • Technical Curiosity: Understand engineering, architecture, analytics, and AI to ask informed questions, challenge assumptions, and make decisions.
  • Enterprise Thinking: Look beyond individual requests for reusable capabilities and shared data products.
  • Improvement Mindset: Use feedback, adoption, performance, and changing business needs to improve the portfolio.
  • Winning Together: Build partnerships across business, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Governance, Analytics, and AI; share informed perspectives constructively.


Why Join The Standard?

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

  • A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about working at The Standard.

Hello! ✨

We’re Wildix, a global leader in Unified Communications & Collaboration as a Service (UCaaS) and we’re on a mission to redefine how businesses connect. Our secure, web-based and AI-powered solutions help companies around the world collaborate smarter, serve customers better and grow stronger — and we want you to help shape what’s next.

About Us…

In 2005, brothers Dimitri and Steve Osler set out to reimagine how businesses communicate, and that vision became Wildix. Today, from our headquarters in Tallinn, Estonia, Wildix is one of the world’s fastest-growing UCaaS companies, with 300+ team members from 15+ nationalities, working across Europe, the UK, the Americas and beyond. We serve businesses in 135+ countries through a partner-first ecosystem, delivering secure, intuitive solutions that keep companies connected, productive and ready for what’s next.

At Wildix, we don’t just build technology, we live it. As a remote-first company, we rely on our own platform every day to collaborate globally and innovate fast. With steady growth and a strong foundation, we offer real opportunities to advance your career as we scale, making an impact in a global team that’s shaping the future of work.

At Wildix, our mission is clear: Empower companies worldwide with seamless communication solutions that drive productivity, efficiency, and growth.

About The Role

We're building the AI layer of business communication — voice agents, chat agents and AI assistants that work in real customer conversations and real phone calls across 135+ countries.

You'll join our AI Agents stream, an 8-person engineering team owning the product end to end. You'll build the agents themselves as well as the platform behind them: skills, workflows, tools, connectors, orchestration, observability and the infrastructure that makes AI reliable, fast and measurable in production.

This is a hands-on product engineering role for someone who wants to build real AI products, not just integrate AI APIs.

What You Will Do

  • Build and ship AI agent features end to end — from Node.js/TypeScript services on AWS to the interfaces used to configure, test and observe agents.
  • Extend the AI agent platform — building skills, workflows, sandboxes, tools, connectors, tracing, audit and orchestration capabilities.
  • Integrate and orchestrate AI providers — LLM, STT and TTS — using prompt and context engineering, tool calling, structured outputs, streaming and robust failure handling.
  • Make AI quality measurable and production-ready — build evaluations, tracing and monitoring while engineering for latency, reliability, cost, privacy and security.
  • Drive product discovery and ownership — challenge scope, propose solutions, bring your own ideas and stay involved after release by using quality and adoption signals to iterate.
  • Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, architecture decisions, knowledge sharing and collaboration across the AI Agents stream.

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js backend skills and confidence working across the frontend with React or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered features used by real users in production. You should be able to explain what you built, how it worked and the engineering decisions behind it.
  • Practical experience with AI application patterns including prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, RAG, streaming and handling non-deterministic behaviour in production.
  • Experience making AI systems measurable and observable through evaluations, tracing, monitoring and regression detection.
  • Strong production AWS experience with serverless and/or containerized environments. Our stack includes Lambda/SAM, ECS, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS and OpenSearch.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals across REST/API design, WebSockets, SQL and NoSQL data modelling, caching, testing, CI/CD and production debugging.
  • A strong ownership and product mindset — you take initiative, challenge assumptions, work comfortably with ambiguity and turn ideas into shipped features rather than waiting for detailed specifications.
  • English B2 or above.

Bonus Points If

  • You've built agentic systems involving multi-step orchestration, tool selection, state management, guardrails or recovery from failures.
  • You've worked in security- or privacy-sensitive environments, including GDPR or ISO 27001.
  • You have public evidence of building for the sake of building — open-source contributions, side projects, technical writing, talks or similar.
  • You have experience with real-time audio and communication technologies, such as WebRTC, streaming STT/TTS or low-latency voice pipelines.

Why You’ll Love It Here

👫 Work with a Supportive, High-Performing Team – We believe in trust, autonomy, and working with bright, passionate individuals who drive real impact.

🌍 A Truly International Workplace – Our diverse and inclusive team ensures you’ll always feel connected and supported, no matter where you are.

🚀 Shape the Future of Global Communication – Be part of a team transforming how businesses operate in an era of remote work and AI-powered collaboration.

💼 Join a Profitable & Stable Company – We’re not a startup experiment, we’re a two decade old success story with sustained profitability, meaning we can back your boldest ideas.

What we offer

Happy with them? We offer even more! Our Benefits are country-specific, you can ask your recruiter for more information

jobs.description:
Are you a senior or principal full-stack software engineer with startup experience who would like to help us to scale the next generation of AI-powered shopping experiences to thousands of customers and hundreds of millions of shopper sessions?

Who we are

We are an exciting new startup, Product Genius, bringing the power of the most advanced AI to small and medium-sized businesses so that they can compete online. We help stores provide their visitors with great information so that shoppers can make good buying decisions more easily.

We have proven in A/B tests that our product (Product Genius) provides a 50% - 300% increase in shopper engagement and 20% revenue lift for the online stores that use it. This means that we can essentially mint profit for stores, and they are signing up for our Product Genius through our automated onboarding flow. We know we are onto something, and now we need to work on scaling as we continue to incorporate our learnings from our initial batches of customers into our offering.

Our lead investor and board member has over two decades of experience in eCommerce, having co-founded and built two >$billion startups, Endeca and Toast, and having funded many other successful eCommerce startups. Our CEO has over two decades of experience building deep learning-based technology and products.

We've designed and implemented cutting-edge A.I. learning systems for the most innovative technology companies in the world, and now we're bringing our A.I. to e-commerce to give the same power to small businesses who need it most.

Our product is the first content management system for applying AI-generated and AI-curated content to eCommerce. Our AI technology leverages large deep learning models with state-of-the-art AI-control developed in a $40M DARPA AI program with Stanford and MIT.

Much of our team is located in Boston, Philadelphia, and Chicago. We work together very collaboratively over Slack and Zoom, getting together periodically in person.

Who you are

  • Your motivation is to make the experience awesome for the end users. Knowing that your work had a real impact for real-world customers makes you super happy.
  • You love checking stuff off a to-do list, but also appreciate being on a fast-moving team where our to-do list continues to evolve.
  • You balance your love of creating beautiful code and architectures, with the needs of a fast-moving startup where we sometimes need to deliver functionality to the end user with code that isnt super pretty, at least at first.
  • You are generous with others and collaborate well in a team environment.
  • You have a strong interest in being part of a successful high-growth company, and part of a team building AI-first software products.
  • You are a seasoned software architect, you have ideas about product and features yourself, and you feel comfortable brainstorming and defining features in collaboration with product leadership, as well as with machine learning engineers and other software engineers.
  • You are interested to help lead/mentor junior engineers.
  • You have made a measurable impact on a commercial code base, working in a startup or other highly dynamic environment.
  • You are proficient in backend software engineering and technologies such as
    • server side Python 3.x,
    • caching,
    • reinforcement learning and/or machine learning architectures,
    • modern database technologies,
    • and cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP
  • A working knowledge of front-end technologies such as HTML5, React, Node.js, Websockets, etc. is a big plus.
  • You have ideally 10+ years of work experience in software development

﻿What you will do

  • You will be a leader on our product development team, working with software engineers, machine learning engineers, and product leads to help develop our product for end-users.
  • You will take a leading role in architecture discussions for the components of our product.
  • Work in an agile environment, rapidly delivering shippable features into production.
  • Consider design constraints as you deliver backend APIs meeting front-end requirements, and communicate these ideas regularly with the team.

We provide comprehensive healthcare (including dental and vision), commuter benefit, 401k plan, and stock options.

You may not feel that you have all of the experience and skills listed above, but if you are very excited about this role, please apply anyway. We have found that people who are passionate to join us are also often the people who we are passionate to hire..

We value a diverse team, and we have seen firsthand that as our team diversity has increased, so has the quality of our ideas, teamwork, and delivery.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or other characteristics.

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer

This role reports to the Chief Technology Officer.

This is a full-time position open to candidates in Canada.

Compensation: $98,000 - $147,000

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our engineering team. You'll work across our stack to build and maintain the tools independent publishers rely on every day. Our environment spans multiple languages and frameworks, so we need someone who's comfortable moving between them and picking up new ones as needed.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and ship features across the full stack, from database to UI
  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code
  • Collaborate with product, design and other engineers to scope and deliver work
  • Debug and resolve issues across our systems
  • Drive technical decisions and help shape our architecture
  • Work directly with the CTO on technical strategy
  • Scale and unify our systems and infrastructure to scale to hundreds of independent publishers
  • Review code and mentor other engineers on the team

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of professional full stack software engineering experience
  • Expertise in TypeScript, one or more frontend frameworks, and at least one other language
  • Solid understanding of HTML and CSS
  • Experience with relational databases and API design
  • Ability and willingness to learn new languages and frameworks as needed: our environment includes Python, PHP, Ruby, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Understanding of application security best practices (secure coding, CSP, authentication/authorization, common vulnerabilities like XSS, XSRF, and SQL injection)
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working in a remote, distributed team
  • Confidence in writing unit and integration tests
  • A track record of shipping and owning production systems
  • Ability to own the full development lifecycle of a work product, whether that’s a prototype (that may not have a design or be fully scoped) or a full production feature
  • Comfortable using AI coding tools responsibly: able to leverage them for productivity while still understanding, reviewing, and taking ownership of the code you ship

Nice to have

  • Experience in publishing, media, or subscription/membership platforms
  • Experience with Python, PHP, or Ruby specifically
  • DevOps experience with Heroku, Google Cloud, AWS, or Cloudflare

In line with Indiegraf's company values, we are seeking new team members who:

  • Love learning and sharing. We believe that constantly testing, gathering data and listening to feedback drives innovation. You are willing to learn and share with humility and are obsessed with seeking feedback to refine your work.
  • Are committed to equity and inclusion. Indiegraf is on a mission to change who owns media so that it better serves everyone. We want to work with people who are mindful of the power dynamics in everything they do and who contribute to an equitable work environment.
  • Are energized by growth. Creating new products and processes is your thing. Being part of a big, ambitious vision excites you. You're not afraid of change. You love taking chances and being accountable to goals.
  • Are always seeking ways to do things more efficiently. Indiegraf is scaling a network of independent news outlets that can succeed in markets where traditional news models fail because they are more efficient. Our team is obsessed with replicability, scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Value a healthy work culture. We are a mission-driven, female-led company shaking up legacy news media dynamics. We work hard and unplug most weekends and during vacations. You want to contribute to a great culture that makes our team love Mondays. We are collaborative, and strive to win together as a team.

About Indiegraf

Indiegraf is a mission-driven technology company built by and for independent local media leaders. We serve large and small digital media, newspapers, radio stations and public media across the Americas, in both English and Spanish, with a special focus on underserved communities. We are a privately-held company, incorporated in Canada and the U.S., majority-owned by employees and impact investors who believe the future of local news is independent.

Headquartered in Vancouver Canada, we launched in May 2020 and now support publishers globally in English and Spanish.

Our mission is to defend independent journalism by reducing reliance on any single funder, revenue stream, audience platform or government, so local media can dictate their own future.

Our vision is a world where every community is served by a resilient, sovereign news outlet—transforming local civic information from a fragile endeavour to a thriving pillar of democracy.

Read more about us here.

Applying For This Role

  • We are committed to being a diverse and inclusive company. We encourage candidates with a range of perspectives, abilities, backgrounds and experience to apply. This job is fully remote with the possible, occasional, need for in-person gatherings in Vancouver. Applicants based anywhere in Canada are welcome to apply.
  • If you think this role sounds right for you but you don’t quite check all the boxes above - or you’re more senior than this - please apply anyway. We’d love to hear from you! All applications are reviewed by humans, and we’re happy to have a conversation with promising candidates.
  • To help make sure your application doesn’t get lost, please apply through bambooHR rather than sending a separate email or LinkedIn message. The application involves submitting your resume and answering a few questions. There is an optional cover letter if you want to add more context - you will not be dinged for skipping the cover letter if the questions already cover what you want to share.
  • We are hoping to hire for this position at the end of September, 2026.
Salary: $98,000 - $147,000

We're growing our IBM Maximo practice and looking for a leader who wants to help us build something, not just fill a seat.

This role is eligible for Niyam's Incentive Compensation Plan (ICP), which rewards contributions to business development capture and program management outcomes.

We're maintainers of CNCF Sandbox Project kcp and among the leading European corporate contributors to Kubernetes. Our engineering team actively contributes to CNCF projects and open-sources our core products on GitHub. We regularly present at industry conferences and community events.

jobs.excerpt: Turn Trusted Data into Better Decisions. Doodle is a B2B SaaS platform used by millions of professionals to coordinate meetings and collaboration across teams and companies.
jobs.description:
Turn Trusted Data into Better Decisions.

Doodle is a B2B SaaS platform used by millions of professionals to coordinate meetings and collaboration across teams and companies. We are building the future of scheduling and productivity, and trusted data has become one of our most valuable products. Every product decision, experiment, customer insight and business metric depends on it.

You are more than an Analytics Engineer. You are a builder who cares about getting the numbers right, and you love helping people make better decisions with them.

The Role

In this role, you’ll co-own a share of the analytics layer that powers decisions across Doodle. You’ll turn raw product data into trusted, scalable datasets for experimentation, reporting and product innovation. Our transformations are built in dbt on top of Amazon Redshift, with Athena alongside it, and teams explore and report on data in Power BI, Hex and our own internal AI tools.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Leadership. Some days that means defining the metrics the whole company runs on. Other days it means helping a Growth Manager design an A/B test, or showing a team how to answer their own questions without waiting on anyone. If you get excited by clean models, well-defined metrics and data people actually trust, you’ll find a stimulating environment here.

AI is at the heart of how we work. We expect you to use AI coding tools to move faster on modelling, testing and documentation, and to help the rest of Doodle get more out of AI in their daily work with data.

What You’ll Actually Do

  • Model the Data: Design, build and maintain scalable analytics data models in dbt, following analytics engineering best practices.

  • Own Data Quality: Build reliable transformations from raw product data to business-ready datasets, with testing, validation and documentation across the analytics layer.

  • Define the Metrics: Define, document and maintain the trusted business metrics used across the company, and keep definitions aligned across teams.

  • Build the Semantic Layer: Evolve a scalable semantic layer that makes consistent reporting and self-service analytics possible.

  • Power Experimentation: Partner with Product and Growth Managers on A/B tests, funnels, retention and customer insights, through high-quality event modelling and instrumentation. Then help teams read the results and decide what to do next.

  • Measure What Matters: Give product launches and feature rollouts reliable measurement frameworks from day one.

  • Enable Self-Service: Build dashboards and reports in Power BI, Hex or our internal AI tools, and coach stakeholders so they can find their own answers.

  • Lead with AI: Build AI-enabled analytics workflows and help teams across Doodle adopt AI in how they work with data.

What do you bring?

You’ll thrive here if you combine strong analytics engineering fundamentals with a product and business mindset, and you’re honest about your strengths, gaps and what you’re still learning.

  • The Modelling Experience: Strong, hands-on experience building analytics data models with dbt or a similar transformation framework, and a good grasp of dimensional modelling.

  • The SQL: Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large analytical datasets.

  • The Warehouse: Experience with cloud data warehouses such as Amazon Redshift.

  • The BI Toolkit: Experience building dashboards and self-service reports in Power BI or similar BI tools.

  • The Product Lens: Familiarity with experimentation frameworks and product analytics.

  • The AI Mindset: Hands-on experience with Claude or similar AI assistants, including setting up MCPs and using AI coding tools. You’ve helped drive AI adoption in a team or organisation.

  • The Communicator: You can explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical people alike, and turn data into recommendations that help stakeholders decide.

  • The Location: You are based in, and have the right to work in, the country where this role is advertised. We cannot sponsor visas or support relocation at this time.

Nice to have:
